tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 18 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur ba gtso bo/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur gzhon pa dang / gtso sgrig pa/ karma bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig pa/ mun sel/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/zla ba bstan 'dzin/ shes rab bzang po/zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ phur pa phrin las/dkon mchog bsam gtan/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan pa dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ tshe ring chos sgron/ shes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'brug rgyas/

〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/ de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/ dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/ dpe thum gsol/ dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/ rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/ srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉 zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang / da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhug〉 ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/ de yang sngon byon mes po mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang / 'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/ nang don rig pa dang / gso ba rig pa/ tshad ma rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ lo rgyus/ rtsis rig sogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yin/—1—

'a 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa na tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brdzid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung rga'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'jug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/—2—

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu sbungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / to wid lta bu yo rob dang / a— rdo rdogs su grags rṣa gyi slob grwa rṣa mo

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod chen po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi bee ro ska cog zhung / /gnubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ shangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/dzi—2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang myongs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnam ba/bsab/ nyams pa rnams gsos/ 'khru/gas pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/ —3—

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhyu/na mkhye/na/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu me las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs tog 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu'o/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyams po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4—

bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi bandi dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod — 1 —

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras sbungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2—

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon to bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 31khu byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3—

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni ma rman dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu mā theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bshes mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4—

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras sprungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'byung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈rja 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di( 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5—

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song stsi krin sogs kyi rgya'i sbyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—6—

khong ni slob dpon chen pyu dhi~X sgro 1 6 3 'byu / shad dang gnas dang / paṇḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575) la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs te mes pos padma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang sbyin bdag / nye gnas sogs kyi lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid 'khrul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis — 1 —

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung / dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhud don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gas yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhud lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

mkhan po dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod khro| rde llī yī / ༷ ༷ sgri/rdo /༷ tī khri nga bdag kar ༵ ljo nga po bkra ṇa chen dza tai/ /hūṃ / tsū rdo/py-i nga po dpal na po hūṃ nghru shrī ri sa pa mngo gyur pa'i kyi snyen ra sbyi khri kyaX hūṃ sdi gsan gsan//bhe rtse snyu sti /rde ༵/ dhī ༷ /rde sbyor drug gdams spya khrid dang ༵'ig su/ 'a bum ༵ ḍā spyu ༵ ༵ ḍā ma/ ༵ ༵ ༵ ba/ kyā/ ༵ rgyas ༵sna ༵/ sde / ༷ / stag dag lung ma lu stso khri / pyu /kri dhi shang blo bzhi'i gyi gru sdu/ stsi rdo phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bshe/sa gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gtul/sa te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3—

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mai tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug smra ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/ rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang /ni gu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang /rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ārya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhung bcu/ sa ra he'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhung drug lha hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lanta ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591)la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4—

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bshe/sa gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gshi/na rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab btus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag mo'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon padma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bzhas bgres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bzhes bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/ dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta pu khyu nanda dang pra yā mā nanda gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang cen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6—

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod chen po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni khyu ṇa shrī dang puṇḍa badzra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du shambha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku bas gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen da /nga lo zhe lha cig ༵ snro ༵ dzi ༵༵ pa'i sna/nga yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dzhai rlo gas kau/kau sna zlo la/ khang /spya ༵dhi ༵༵ ༵ ga sdu lha gas sgri rdo~X bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal lubor lo sdom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshe/gas mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/༵lha/ kū/ rjo sna la tsha ༵ /dri ༵ dang ga/sna ༵ la~X da rgos sko ( 1 ༵ rjo sna rlo/ shing par du tshwa~X /sna sna smo kau~X ༵ je ༵ rjo rjo dzī sna/ wo/ ra byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel chen pod gnyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhan yang dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras sbungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khong ra bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635) la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9—

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /g.yin yang bstan pa'i spyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—10—

zhes bya ba'i smad cha bzhugs/drug pa ni/ lus kyi gnas dang phyi rol gyi yul rnams la sa bcur brjod pa ci zhig snyam na/ gang zag dbang po'i bye brag rnams pa lngas dman pa la phyi rol gyi yul dang / 'bring po la dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs dang / wo po la gsum du byas pa'i chung ngu la lus dkyil dang / 'bring po la rdzogs rimagyi skabs kyi rtsa khams thim tshul dang / chen po la stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin rab dga' la sogs pa'i sa bcur bstan pa yin no/ /zhes man ngag snye ma las 'byung ba yin no/ /gnas la sogs pa'i ming don ni/ /spyin pas sems can dpag tu med pa tshim zhing rten par byed pas gnasadang / brgod pa'i mthus yon tan phul byung skye bas zhing dang / rang gzhan gyi don sgrub pa'i 'dun pa dang de lta bu bya'o zhes rtog pas 'dun rtog ste tshwa sgro dang /thabs kyi phar phyin gyis ting nge 'dzin dang mngon shes sogs mtshan ma med pa rtsol bas 'du ba dang / bdag med pa dur khrod dang mtshungs pa'i chos dbyingasakyi don rtogs nas gzhan la ston par byed pas dur khrod dang / bde ba chen po'i ye shes 'thung zhing rnam rtog gcod pa ni 'thung gcod do/ /de dag re re bzhin las lhag pa'i nus pa yang yod pas nye ba'i de dang de dag go /gnyis pa ni/ lhag mthong sogs te bskyed rim gyi ye shes de yang zhi

lhag gi rim pas bskyed dgos pa'o/ /gsum pa la nyer rgyu dang 'bras bu gnyis/las/ dang po spyod pa sogs te thun mong gi dngos grub chen po rnams sgrub pa labaskyed rim brtan nas spyod pa spyod dgos pa ste/ rnal 'byor gnyis pa'angagasum pa grub nas thun mong gi dngos grub chen po rnams sgrub pa yin no//gnyis pa la mdor bstan ni/ las dang sogs te/ las dang po dngos grub 'i de dag kyang 'gro ba'i don gyi phyir sgrub pa yin no/ /las tshogs tsam sgrub pa la ni spyod pa spyod mi dgos te mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa grub pa na byar rung ba'o/ /rgyasabashad la gsum gyi las kya dngos grub ni/ las chen bcu gnyis zhes bya ba ni/rtsa rgyud las/ dbang dang dgug dang dbye ba dang / /bsad dang bskrad pa lasogs dang / /rmugs dang rengs par bya ba dang / /rmongs dang de bzhin phur bus gdab/ /tshig 'phrog lkug par 'gyur ba dang / /'on dang de bzhin long ba dang / /ma ning nyid du bya ba dang / /gzugs ni yongs su brje ba sme /las chen bcu gnyis 'di dag ni/ /zhes gsungs te/ tshig 'phrog sogs bzhi dbang po nyams par 'gyur ba'i las zhes gcig tu bsdom/ 'dir zhi ba'i las kyi gsal/ kha ma byung yang snga phyir mang du gsungs te de bsnan pas bcu gnyis so/ /'di ni mtshon pa tsam ste/ rdo rje mkha' 'gror las rim brgya gsung༅pa sogs las rab 'byams rnams so/ /thun mong gi dngos grub 'gring po grub pa chen po brgyad ni/ lha mo bzhis zhus pa las/ rdzas brgyad yan lag sgrub parabashad/ /ril lu mig sman dngos grub dang / /sa 'og ral gri'i dgros grub dang / /mkha' la 'phur dang mi snang dang / khre ba med dang nad 'joms—2—

so/ /zhes dang / gur las/ mig sman dang ni rkang mgyogs dang/ /ral gri dngani sa 'og 'grub/ /ril lu dang ni mkha' spyod nyid/ /mi snang ba dang bcud kyisalen/ /zhes sogs rgyud so sonas 'dren tshul mi gcig pa mang po byung yang/rgyud 'di nyid las/ sa 'og steng 'gro ral gri dang / /tshar gcod phan 'dogasanyid dang ni/ /ril lu mig sman rten rnams sam/ /rkang mgyogs dgag5bcud kyis len/ /zhes pa ltar brgyad dang / 'di ni phyogs mtshon pa tsa༅ste/phyag mtshan gyi rig pa 'dzin pa dang / bzhon pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa dang/ rgyawasrid sna bdun sgrub pa la sogs pa longs spyod kyi rig pa 'dzin pa dang / mjogatu gyur pa ro langs sgrub pa dang / lha dang lha ma yin dang klu dang gnod sbyin dngasrin po la sogs pa mngag gzhug tu sgrub pa dang / gnod sbyin mo'am tshangasapa'i bu mo sgrub pa la sogs pa dngos grub rab 'byams mtha' yas pa sgrub par byed do/ /thun mong gi dngos grub mthar thug pa 'dod gzugs kyi rig pa le lta pa gnyis te/ lus kyi rig pa 'dzin pa 'di gnyis ni yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa te/ yon tan brgyad ni/ gzugs phra reg pa yang ba dang / khyab pa yang dgathob pa nyid/ /rab tu gsal ba nyid brtan pa/ /dbang phyug nyid dnga'o dod dgur bsgyur/ /gzugs phra ba ni rtsi shing nags tshal la sogs pa snod kyi chosaji snyed sprul zhing bsdu bar byed pa phra ba dang / sems can sna tshogs pa spras bsdubyed pas yang ba dang / gnyis ka sprul bsdu byed pas yang dag par thob pa'amabadag por gyur pa dang / yid kyi bsam par phyin pa gang yang khyab pa dang/'byung po kun gyis mchod par byed pa ni rab tu gsal ba dang / gang thos par—3—

'dod pa de thob nus pas dga' mgur gnas pa ste brtan pa dang / tshar bcad rjes 'dzin gyi dbang yod pa ni dbang phyug gam dbang du gyur pa dang / dzi tsamo'adod pa thams cad 'byung ba ni 'dod dgur bsgyur ba'o/ /yang na/ phra ba ni 'ja' lus su gyur pa dang / yang ba ni rdul rags pa'i khams med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis thogs bcas kyi lus ma yin pas na/ sa chu me rlung nam mkha' thams cad la ci dgar spyod pa/ gzhan rnams 'dra'o/ /des na skye ba gcig gis bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa ni mi'i lus rten kho na la yin gyi/ gzhan lamayin no snyam du bsam par mi bya ste/ rig pa 'dzin pa de nyid kyang 'o dod gzugs kyi lhar gtogs mod kyi/ rten de la brten nas ye shes kyi sku rma3 du byed do/ /gnyis pa rdzogs rim 'khor dang bcas pa la/ bstan bshad gnyisalas/ dang po ni des kyang sogs blo ka gcig ste go sla'o/ /gnyis pa la rgyud nas 'byung ba rdzogs rim gyi spyi'i chos bshad pa dang / grub chen so so'i min ngag zhib mor bshad pa'o/ /dang po la yan lag gi dbye ba dang /tho yi dbye ba'o/ /dang po la rgyu gtso che ba'i yan lag dang / 'bras bu gtso che ba'i yan lag go /dang po la/ yan lag drug bsha/da pa/ rim pa lnga bshad pa/ ma glog/giphyag rgya'i dbye ba bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ so sor bsdu dang sogs te/ byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rjes mdzad pa'i stod 'grel las 'byung ba'i yan lag drug gi rnam gzhag dang mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor gsungs pa'i dgongs don rgya gar gyi grub chen rnams kyi bzhed pa stoganyis las/ dang po'i rnam gzhag ni rgyas—4—

par dus kyi 'khor lo'i phyogs las shes dgos la/ 'dir mdo tsam brjod na don dngos dang / log rtog gsal ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rtsa rgyud le'u dngapo las/ sngags bzlas pa dang bsam gtan dang / /bde bas kyang ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don la/ sngags bzlas zhes pa srog rtsoladangos su bstan/ de'i 'bras bu 'dzin pa zhor la 'phangs/ bsam gtan zhesapas bsam gtan gyi yan yag dngos su bstan zhing / rang rgyu sor bsdud shugs/kyis bstan/ bde ba zhes pas mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba ting nge 'dzin bstan pas/rgyu rjes dran yang bstan te de ltar drug go /de la so sor bsdud pa ni/ tha mal gyi dbang yul gyi 'brel ba gcod pas so sor gcod pa'am/ yang na sha'i migalasogs pa'i dbang shes gzhan lngas stong pa'i gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya lnga len pa ni/ so sor bsdud pa ste/ khral len pa la khral bsdud ces bya ba dang 'dra kho /robo ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i rang bzhin la mnyam par bzhag pas stong gzugs mngon sum du mthong ba'i ye shes so/ /dbye ba ni/ du ba/ smig sgyu/ me khyer/ mar me 'bar ba ser po 'barab/ zla ba/ nyi ma/ sgra gcan/ glog thig le ste rtags bcu me ri dbye bas rnam pa bcu'o/ /'di ni spyan lnga las sha'i mig dang / rigs drug las rdo rje semasadapa'i lam mo/ /bsam gtan gyi ngo bo ni/ sor bsdud kyi skabs su tham5gyi dbang yul gyi 'jug pa bkag pa tsam yin la/ 'dir ni yid shes kyi steng du stong gzugs dang shes pa gnyis kyi gnyis snang bkag ste ro gcig tu bsgom pa'o/ /dbye ba ni/ shes rab/ rtog pa/ dpyod pa/ dga' ba/ bde ba ste yan —5—

lag lnga/ de'i yul lho nge gzugs lnga ste bcu'o/ /kha cig ni sha'i mig la so gos pa dbang po lnga dang / yul lnga'i dbye bas bcu shes kyang gsung ngo / /'i de ni lha'i mig dang / mi bskyod pa'i lam mo/ /de la shes rab ni stong gzugs mthong tsa5de nyid la rnam par mi rtog pa'i tshul gyis bzhag pas/ spros pa gang gi yangathobor ma skyes pa'i rig stong ngo / /de nyid las phyi nang gi 'char sgo ma 'gagasapa'i snang ba lam me ba mthong ba rtog pa dang / snang ba de rnams rang semasasugasal bar snang zhing de yang brjod bral gyi ngo bor mthong ba ni dpyod pa dang /de ltar shes pas drangs pa'i yid dga' ba ni dga' ba dang / lus sems shin tu sbyangs pa'i bde ba ni g.yo med bde ba'o/ /dang po gsum la mi 'dra ba rmang du 'chad kyang / rje btsun bla ma'i zhal lung ni 'di yin te/ sems 'grel skoragasum gyi dgongs pa nges don mthar thug pa'o/ /yan lag gnyis po'i 'di stong gzugs sgrub byed yin pas sku rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dang / bsnyen pa dang / thog mar dge bar gsungs go /mngon sukhobazhi las dbang mngon no/ /srog rtsol ni ro rkyang gi rlung dang srog thur dbu mara'aching ba ste/ dgang dbyung bum can sogs kyis de bcings pas dbu ma'i rludadu byas pa'i skabs kyi stong gzugs mthong ba'i mngon sum la ngos 'dzin la/dbye ba ni dgag bya g.yas 'byung ba lnga'i rlung / g.yon phung po lnga'i rlung god bye bas bcu'o/ /'di don grub kyi lam mo/ /'dzin pa'i ngo bo dbu ma 'ba' zhinanas 'bab pa'i rlung de yang rim pas lte snying mgrin pa dpral pa gtsug tor rnams kyi lte bar bkag nas thig le thim pa'i gzugs brnyan mthong ba'i mngon —6—

sum mo/ /dbye na 'khor lo lngar 'gro 'ong gi dbye bas bcu'o/ /'di rin 'byungagi lam mo/ /'di gnyis rlung dag byed yin pas gsung rdo rje'i rnal 'byor dang/nyer sgrub dang / bar du dge ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi spyan dang / yid kyi mngon sum mo/ /rjes dran ni srog thur 'dres pa thim pa'i stobs kyis gtum mo 'baraba'i snang ba la khams gsum gyi gzugs brnyan spro ba dang / rang 'dod pa'i lha mthong ba'i mngon sum mo/ /'di thob pas ha yig zhu ba nor bur son pa'idaga' ba khyad par can rnams thob ste/ 'jig rten 'dod pa don du gnyer ba na/chags yul yid la byed pa dang / de dag 'phrad 'dod pa dang / des las kyi gtum mo cung zad 'bar bas lus la drod 'bar ba dang des kha skam pa dang /mgrin pa zas mi 'a sdug pa dang / chags yul dang phrad nas sems brtan pa med par g.yo ba dang / spyod pa rang bzhin du mi gnas pas spyo ba dang/ bya ba dang bya ba min pa la rmongs pa dang / yid 'dzag bde'i gzhan dbang du song bas rnamapar 'khru/la pa dang / brgyal ba ltar ltongs pa ste gnas skabs bcu dag pa/gnas skabs bcu dang rnam pa 'dra ba'i bde ba'i ye shes rim pa bzhin du rtags bcus drangs pa'i mtshan ma bcu rim pas thim pa'i dbye bas bcu ste/ dedagathim pas lha mo du ba ma sogs bcu 'grub bo/ /de sgrub pa'i yan lag dab/thugs rdo rje dang / shes rab kyi spyan dang / 'od dpag med dang/ ye shes kyi skuphyogs mthun 'grub pas rnal 'byor mngon sum mo/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lagani rjes dran gyi skabs kyi lhan skyes g.yo ba can de g.yo ba dang rba rlabs zhi ba na mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba ste de'i mngon sum mo/ /'di yang srog 'dzin sogs rlud—7—

bcu 'gags pas bcu'o/ /'di ni sgrub chen dang / ye shes rdo rje dang/ ye shesakyi spyan dang / rnam snang dang rang rig mngon sum mo/ /de gnyis tha maradagoba'o/ /'di la lam lnga dang sbyar na dang po gnyis tshogs lam/ /bar pa gnyis sbyor lam drod/ rjes dran rtse mo/ /ting nge 'dzin bzod pa dang chos༅gogo /ting nge 'dzin gyi skabs 'dir rtsa 'khor lo drug tu las rlung nyi khri chig stongadrug brgya 'gag /sbyor lam gyi sa bcu gnyis 'grub bo/ /de dag dang bskyed rim gyi skabs so sor rlung dang gtum mo phyag rgya sogs kyi man ngag mang du 'byung ba ni bla ma las rtogs par bya'o/ /rdzogs rim gyi srol 'di yang shin tuzab pa yin no/ /dus 'khor ba 'ga' zhig 'dus pa rim lnga dang bde mchogarim lnga sogs dang sbyor te/ kho bo ni legs par mi sems so /gnyis pa ni/ 'dir kha cig khyed cag dang po tha ma thams cad mi rtog pa 'ba' zhig bsgoms na zhi gnas 'ji/ba pa tsam srid kyang rdzogs rim 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam yin pas ma rig pa'i gnyen por 'gro dgos pa la khyed cag gi lam 'di la ni bdag med la rtog pa'i lhag mthong med pas ma rig pa mi zlog ste/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ 'jig rten pa dag stong nyid sgom byed kyang / /des ni bdag tu 'di shes 'jig mi byed/ de yi nyon mongs phyir shingarab 'khrug ste/ lhag spyod skyid ni ting 'dzin 'dir sgom bzhin/ /gal te chosal bdag med so sor rtog /so sor de brtags gal te bsgoms na ni/ /de nyid mya ngan 'das thob 'bras bu'i rgyu/ /rgyu gzhan gang yin de ni zhi mi 'gyur/ /zhesagasungs pas so zhe na/ kho bo cag ni bdag med mngon sum ma rtogs par thar—8—

pa thob pa ga la smra/ rnam par mi rtog pa nyid las rdzi zhig nas bdag med mthongaba'i ye shes skye'o/ /zhes smra'o/ /bdag med so sor rtog ces gsung༅pa ste khyed ltar na rjes dpag kho nar byed snang bas sangs rgyas la yod dam med/yod na sangs rgyas kyang rnam rtog la spyod par 'gyur ro/ /de la de med kyang sngon de goms pas da lta thar ba brnyes snyam na/ 'o na yang byang sems 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag na so sor rtog pa med par 'gyur ro/ /yang bdag med gnyisasrid par lkog tu gyur pas/ dang por rjes dpag med par mi rtogs/ rjesadapag goms pas de'i gsal snang skye'o/ /des na mkhas pa kun gyis kyangadapyad pa 'di mang du gsungs so snyam na/ gsung pa ni bden te/ bdag med gnyis mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes pa yin na rjes dpag sngon du song ba yin pas khyab par gang nas ma gsungs la/ mdo sde mang po nas/ de bzhin gshe/gas pa'i sku'i 'od zer phog pa dang / stong pa nyid kyi don mi 'go pa'i chos lto thos pa rkyang pas grol ba ji snyed cig gsungs/ slob dpon zla ba grags pasakyang rigs pa drug cu pa'i 'grel par/ rgyu'i stobs kho nas stong nyid rtag༅pa'i rgyu mtshan du/ shā ri'i bu/ chos rnams gang dag sogs sho ka gcig thos mthagatu bden pa mthong ba bkod do/ /jo bo rjes kyang / mngon sum rjes dpagadagos pa med/ /mu stegs rtsod pa bzlog phyir du/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis byasapa yin/ /zhes ma gsungs sam/ thar pa'i rgyu nges par rjes dpag dgos na dgos pa med ces bya ba tsi zhig lkog gyur mngon sum du shes par 'gyur ba thams cad la rjes dpag sngon du 'gro dgos na 'di bden kyang / 'phags pa —9—

rnams kyi mngon shes drug gi lkog gyur mthong ba thams cad rjes dpag sngon 'gro can ma yin pa kho nar snang ngo / /des na rab rib can gyis skra shad sogasamathong ba/ med pa'i rgyu mtshan bshad kyang med par nges pa 'byung mod snang ba mi'agal la/ rgyu mtshan gtan nas ma ba4/da kyang / mi sman bzang po bsten/ du bcug pas skra shad sogs su snang ba dag nas med par mngon sum du mthong ba bzhin no/ kho bo cag ni rjes su dpag pa'i lam la yang thabs mkhas su shesapas gus par byed mod/ des mtha' gcig tu ma khyab ste/ dpal ldan dpa' bo sar has/ rtog pa nyams pas blo nyams shes/ /blo ngan rjes su rtog byed lo/ /de nyid las ni blo bzang po/ /nam mkha' las lhag ci yang 'byung/ /zhesablo gros ngan pa rnams rnam rtog med na so sor rtog pa'i shes rab med pas nges par rtog pa dgos zer yang / mi rtog pa las blo gros bzang po ci yang zhin skye ba tsam rjes dpag la med ces gsungs so/ kha cig bskyed rim rtsa rlung thig lebade ba sogs rdzogs rim ma yin zhing / rdzogs rim spros bral 'ba' zhin sgowapa'o snyam pa dang / lung yang dang por bskyed rim dang / bar du las tshu'i bde ba dang / tha ma mi rtog pa sgom pa bde chen sgom par 'dod pa thog bar tha gsum du dge ba yin par sems 'grel rnams su gsungs pa'i lung 'dren zhing / bsazapa thams cad yongs spangs nas/ /nyi ma gcig tu yongs su brtag /gal te rtags ni ma byung na/ /de tshe nga yi brdzun tshig yin/ /zhes gsungs pa yin pa las/ bskyed rim sngon 'gro can gyi rtsa rlung thig le yun du goms nas phyis lasakyi phyag rgya la snyoms par zhugs pa'i lhan skyes de nyid mngon sum gyi thog ma —10—

yin na/ nyi ma gcig tu brtag ces pa 'di yang ma 'brel bar thal bar 'gyur/zhes sogs mang du 'dri bar byed do/ /'di la ni sems 'grel rnams ni rgyud bzhin du dgongs pa mang ba'i gnad ma rtogs par rgyas par gzhan du brtag par bya la/ dngos lan ni sems 'grel du ni de rnams don dam gyi rdzogs ri5yin par 'dod pa bkag pa yin/ don dam yin zhes ni kho bo cag kyang mi'adod/ gang zag 'ga' zhig la ni rnam par mi rtog pa'i lam 'di la zhugs kyang / lo dang zla bas kyang mngon sum gyi rtags mi mthong ba yod/ sngags kyi gdul bya mtshan nyid ldan pa la ni/ dbang dus nyid nas brtsams te las rgye'i ye shes mngon sum lam byed yod pas nyi ma gcig ces gsungs pa dang ga la 'gal/ rtsa rlung thig le'i rnam 'byor gyis kyang gdul bya mtshan nyid tshang ba lanyi ma gcig tsam gyi rtags mi 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yod/ des na gya cho mi ca co mi 'tshal lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtsa rgyud kyi lung gong bzhin/ bshad rgyud mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ so sor bsdud dang de bzhin du/ /bsam gtan srog rtsola'adzin pa dang / /rjes su dran dang ting nge 'dzin/ /sbyor ba'i mashaṃ nyid rnam drugago /zhes gsungs pa'i man ngag ni zhal lung dang phyogs mthun te/ thamal/gyi dbang shes lnga'i rjes su 'brang ba'i gzugs sogs kyi rtog pa'i 'jug pa nang du bsdud pa ni so sor bsdud pa dang lha'i rnam pa la sems 'jog pa ni bsam gtan te/ phung khams skye mched lha'i ngo bor rtog pa rtog pa dang / dmigs pa la sems brtan par byed pa ni dpyod pa dang / lha'i dmigs pa la sems brtan pas yid dga' ba ni dga' ba dang / lhar snang nam shar ba na des sems tshimo—11—

par 'gyur ba ni bde ba dang / ting nge 'dzin rnal du gnas te tha mal gyi snang ba log nas lha sku la rtse gcig tu gnas pa ni rtse gcig pa ste bsam gtan yan lag lnga'o/ /de gnyis ni bskyed rim mo/ /srog rtsol ni thig le'am med migs sam rlung gi rnal 'byor gang yin yang rung ste rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum byed pa'o/ /'dzin pa ni thim pa de'i nus pa las gtum mo 'bar 'dzagagi rim pas rlung rnams thig le la thim pa'i rtags lnga 'byung ba yin no/ /rjesadran ni rtags kyi gsal snang mched de snang ba kun la khyab par gyur pa na/dkyil 'khor dang bde ba'i spro bsdu byed pa'o/ /ting nge 'dzin ni ye shes kyi sku dang mngon par byang chub pa 'od gsal sgrub pa yin te rdzogs rim thams cad la phyi ma bzhi po 'di tshang ba yin no/ /'di dag la'ang bshad par bya ba mang mod kyi/ mang par 'gyur bas re zhig bzhag go /gnyis pa ni/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ rang gi sku ni sgyum mnyam/ /bdag byin rlabs 'di phra modang / /khro rje'i bzlas rang mtshan nyid sgo /rjegasapu'i byang chub sems kyi gter/ /de las lhag ma zung 'jug go/rdorje'i sogasakyis rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i rim pa dang / sems kyi gter zhes pas sems dben dang / rang gi sogs rkang pa gnyis kyi sgyu lus dang / rdzogs pa'i byang chus cesapas mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa 'od gsal dang / zung 'jug nyid de lnga las/ dang po la/ rten lus dben dang / brten pa ngag dben gnyis gyi dang po ni/ yid ngor shar ba'i lha'i sku rlung sems dbu mar cung zad thim pa'i bde stongagi rgyas thebs pa'o/ /'di la spyod bsdus sgron me las ni rigs brgya la sogs—12—

pa'i dbye ba la zhib bshad mang du mdzad mod kyi/ ma rgyud phyogs kyi rgyud rnamasaspyir rigs brgya zhes pa tsam las de ltar zhib mor bshad pa ma mthong zhing /rigs gsum dang lnga dang drug dang gsang chen rigs gcig sogs rgyas bar/da ci rigs par byung ngo / /gnyis pa'i ngo bo ni rlung dbu mar thim par byed pa'ithabs te/ rlung gi de kho na nyid sbyang ba la sogs pa sngon du song nas rdo rje'i bzlas pa sogs la bslab pa'o/ /gnyis pa sems la dmigs pa'i ngo bo ni khams phra rags thim tshul khyad par can gyi ye shes te/ snang ba dang / mched pa dang / nyer thob kyi rtogs pa thun mong ba rnams phyi nang gi srog rtsol gang yangarung bas bskyed nas/ nyer thob thun mong ma yin pa dpe'i 'od gsal mtharathug mngon du byed pa ni/ nges par phyi'i srog rtsol las kyi phyag rgya la lhos pa yin no/ /'di la sems la dmigs pa'i rim pa zhes kyang zer rdo /gsum pa ni rlung sems tsam las dngos su grub pa'i sgyu lus te/ sgyu ma'i dpe bstoganyisakyis nye bar mtshon pa'o/ /de thob byed kyi rgyu ni da ltar sad rmi gnyis char du lha sku snang stong la sbyang ba'i nus pa dang / zhu bde khyad par can bskyed pa yin la/sems dben mthar thug gi dpe'i 'od gsal des rkyen byas nas 'gru/ba par 'gyur te/ 'di la bdag byin rlabs pa'i rim pa zhes kyang bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ steng 'og gi sgo gang la brten kyang rung snye 'od gsal bdestong da lta sgom pa thams cad rgyur 'gro ste/ dngos ni sgyu lus de thob nas rnawa'abyor rnam pa gnyis kyis stong pa nyid du yang yang bcug ste/ snang ba gsukhodang / bzhi pa dpe'i 'od gsal rtag tu bsgoms pas/ rang bzhin brgyad tsu'i—13—

rnam rtog ma phro gyur dro she pa na/she sgro she ༈she rgya la dzi pararkan che te/chos snyad mngon sum st+ri she gya 'ad 1 stso sgal la tshe she//lnga pa na ke las langs pa na zung mun she ga sku grub ste ngo bo ni su spyad pa spyad pa dang/sprul pas sems can gya khron byed so ri/ngo bo di sgom thin rta chis/ da' spong byed snang stong bde ba ye shes so/sa/ma pa 'a yang shan tuche zhang rtogs par dkri' bas pa'i rim pa kya/gzhan di'i chi pas gan par god do//rgyud thams cad kya rdzogs pa' ma pa la 'a—'a sa gnas pas/bdemachog nyid kyi rdzogs pa'i rim pal rdzi ltar sna/sna tshul ni/de tsam pon dpasartse 'di la shes par 'gyur ro//bde mu pa / spra kas drug so gos te/ dzirtse' la chas 'a/ yul phyag rgya' dbye ba/khyad par ngos cha shes/khosal ri stsol drug dang rigs bdun ni mchodang 'a/ rdza nyi/kau po na/ de la ri drug dang gas bdun mchod pa' skabs su bshad zan to//gas brgyad rmongagazhung nyi//mchog tu gyur pa sngags kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i mu ba ste/de dag kyang gzhung drangs na mang par 'gyur bas 'dri zhi zhi/ nyad du shes par bya'o//mdor bsdu na/kha dog dmar ser/padma / zhen par lha la rjes su 'gro ba dang /yang na sen mo dang mig dmar ba/gnyisardekar khyim du padma 'bri ba ni padma'i rigs so//mdog sngo skya/smin mtshams na rtsebirwa nge khye tshor dzo mu0ri ra dzo :do de tsho rje'i rtsa ji ra tshogasum gya ma/rda rje 'bra zhang mchad pa /he ru ka rda rje' gas sa//dpral par rtse gsum 'a mdung gi ri mo can/mig dang bzhin dang yan lag dmarab/ra skyes dang khyam bya la dga' ba// rje 'bri ma rdzo byed pa/dpal he ruka

bdud rtsi'i ste rin wo rigs so/ /dpral pa dang lag par 'bor lo'i ri mo/mdog sngo ba/ mgo g.yogs pa la dga' ba/ dpal che zhing 'khor lo 'dri mchod byed pa ni/ phag mo dang rnam snang gi rigs so/ /stobs kyis dregs shing mdogaganag pa/ so mtho ba/ gdug cing sems stobs dang ldan pa/ khrus la dga'/tshig nyung ba rdo rje 'dri mchod byed pa ni/ mi bskyod pa dang phag mo'i rigs te/grogs sam 'khor mkha' 'gro ma stong phrag bco lnga dang ldan pa yin no/ /mdogaser/ mig dal/ sbu mang / dpral pa dang g.yon pa'i srin lag la rdo rje'i rimoyod pa/ gdug pa'i las dang rgyal srid la dga' ba/ mā li ka'i dri 'byung ba/ rtse gcig pa 'bri mchod byed pa ni khaṇḍa ro hi te rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs las byung ba'o/ /mdog gnag skyem pa/ sha la dga' ba/ dpral par mdu pa dngagale'i gzugs yod pa/ gtsang sbra chung ba/ thod pa 'bri mchod byed pa ni rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka'i rigs so/ /mdog sngo bsang / so mi ma lta/zhing g.yon gyi mche ba can gdug pa'i las la dga' ba/ dgra sta 'bri mchod byed pa ni/rnam 'dren te don grub kyi rigs so/ /rigs lnga ni/ lā me'i rigs te/ bzhin zlum/ sbu ring ba/ ngang tshul bzang ba ni rnam snang gi lā ma ste mtshan mni padma 'o/ /rus sbal gyi phyag rgya bstan par bya ste/ spyi blugs kyi phyag gyo ni lan no/ /mchu 'phyang mig dkyus ring / dbal che/ mdog ser/ so snyoms/ dprawabar ri mo gsum pa/ skra mtshams mthob/ dgod cing lam 'gegs/pa/ g.yulagyi gtam la dga' ba ni rin chen lā ma ste/ mtshan ma rtse gsum g.yon brkyangadang / gi mdung phyag rgya bstan te/ g.yon nas ldog pa lan no/ khur tshos na khung 15—

bu snang ba/mdog dmar/mig gnag pa/skra 'khyil ba/dpral pa'i mtha' rden dar dpyangs kyi ri mo can/smin ma sgos su ri mo gcig pa/ma yo pa thib/ra tsho yi ri ra tsho tre ste/ :) gas ku lo/ dang glu la dga' gu/lan 'ga' 'a na mu ba/ste mtshan ma sna phros/rdorje ༷rib gsal ba/dril bu'i phyag spyo spya padma 'a sbyi ma //༷tshan ma sna shes rda 'a//she dang byil buX phyag she se//g.yan nas ༵res tha / swa na//ri ba la / ye 1 /'bazhin rje'i lwa ma ste//gas rnyi ba bo'i cho bye/rde sudabyung ṇa gi dga' ba rda rjeX lwa ma ste/she ma she bo rdo rje/wor yi sdo( dang cing phyag rgya 'im 'phe/ga~Xn nas she pa ༷na na//ba sbu btaXpa/shanag nga mu/sdo kyi the 'al sa/lus sbam/mdag ni/ /mchu sla/glu la mdung gi phyag rgya herukaX lā ma dzi/spe ma spyo she//sbruX/dngamadung 'i dus ni ba/stan//g.ya/nas dod spru ldag pa na phyag rgya' sne she naX/gang du bshad pa dus sa rnams la sno bri rnams kyang mtshan ma sa sa ma myong gnyin/ pa ni byed la/gi rigs shes kyang dngos grub mchog spyi zu/rdzoX' bya~X// pa 'a/'a dag she shes greng da she dhi mdzo non rdo ma 'a(rtag na gi phyar/brda sags 'a nyad gis sna smas ta/she la brda na gnyas/ban brda dang/lus kya brda/rdo/ je/sko 'i brda bzhi bcu/ḍa ༵ba/bya ba skyesabur ba / ne nga//sang ga gi spre gshe pa' brda sna bcu zhe sa she /lo yig / /rdenyer ba pa sa ngag mu brda rpā ma sdeg cu rtsa ba ཿnga ༷ yan ///lus brda la lag pa' bar/༷ sa/ pa las/nya shu sdom ca'e /rdeng /sa pa nas lnga dang /yan lag gzhan gya brda dang la/ sum cu/ gnyas pa las//dbang du

byed pa'i brda nyi shu rtsa gcig bstan pa rnams so/ /brda gzhan rnams kyis dngos grub ster ba'i rigs su shes na/ dbang du byed pa'i brdas dbang du bya ba yin no/ /dbang du gyur kyang rjes su ma chags na dngos grub mi stsol bas/ gsum pa ni rjes su sogs te/ 'di la go zlog pa'i lta ba dang / bzhin 'gyur ba dang/ glo bur du bya ba zlog pa dang / sngar bshad pa'i tshig nyams pa dang / gdong 'jigasapa dang / smin ma g.yo ba dang / sgra gsal ba ste/ rtags bdun dang ldan pa ni dngos grub stsol bar rig par bya'o/ /'di dag ni las kyi phyag rgya'i mchogatugyur pa zhing gi rnal 'byor ma'am rigs ldan ma rjes su chags pas mchod pa'o/ /de ltar yang rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ /tha mal sngags kyi lus can ma/ /zhing skyes ma ni gang yang rung / /de dag thams cad rnal 'byor pa/ /phan pa'i mchog gi bde ba sgrub/ /'di dag bsnan pas longs spyod kyi/ /bsnyen bkur gyis ni bsten mi bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ tha mal te lhan skyes ma/ sngags lus can te sngags skyes ma/ zhing skyes ma ste pho nya gsum po gang yang dra5bsadagos te rnal 'byor pa la dngos grub gnyis kyi phan bde stsol zhing sgrub pas/'di dag bsnyen bkur ba 'ba' zhig gis mi mnyes pas/ bde ba'i is spyod kyis mnyes pa'o/ /gnyis pa 'bras bu'i dbye ba la gsum/ ngo bo ye shes lnga ldan dang/ sgogasum gzhan don spyod pa dang / rang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pas brten pa ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ gti mug chen po sogs te/ rnam rtog ye shesalngar gyur pa/ zhes pa'i skabs su bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa ni 'gro ba sogs—17—

te/nyer 'tsho'i gzhi zhes bya ba ni/gnas dang longs spyod dang 'tshob thamasacad kyi gzhi ste/sems can rnams kyi de dag gang ci yod pa thams cad 'byungab bzhi dang nam mkha' la brten pa de bzhin du/rang gi lus ngag yid gsumardeyang de ltar gyur cig ces smon pa'o//rin chen bum pa sogs ni/rnam paramirtog bzhin du sems can gyi don byed pa'i dpe ste/gter gyi bum pa dang/dpag bsam gyi shing gis sems can la phan 'dogs pa bzhin no//gsum pa ni/dbang dang sogs te/dbang ni dbang bcu'o//tshe la dbang ba ni/bskal pa brjod du med pa yang gnas nus pas 'chi ba'i gnod pa med pa'o//yo byad ladabang ba ni nam mkha'i mdzod thob pa ste dbul ba med pa'o//sems la dbangab ni ting nge 'dzin grangs med pa la 'jug pa stonyon mongs med pa'o//lasaladabang ba ni sdig pa'i las byed pa'i rnam pa ltar bstan yang de nyid tshogs rdzogs pa'i thabs su 'gyur ba ste/'bras bu mchog 'byin pas na nyes spyad med pa'o//skye ba la dbang ba ni 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du smon la5dang dbang 'byor ba'i skye ba rnam pa sna tshogs par ston pa ste ngan 'gro med pa'o//mos pa la dbang ba ni sangs rgyas med pa'i 'jig rten du sangs rgyasakyis gang bar mos pa tsam gyis de ltar snang bar ston pa ste/gang mos pa de ltara'abyung bas chos kyi 'phongs par byed pa med pa'o//'ga' zhig tu zad par bcurdethob pas mos pa la dbang ba zhes kyang 'byung ngo //smon lam la dbang ba ni slob lam btab pa bzhin du ston par nus pa ste/'dod don mi 'grub pa med pa'o//rdzu 'phrul la dbang ba ni/rdzu 'phrul ci 'dod par dbang bsgyur ba ste 8

chos 'tshol mi nus pa med pa'o/ /chos la dbang ba ni/ gzhi lam gyi chos thams cad mngon sum du thugs su chud pas ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du dbang bsgyur bas/ gzhan gyis khrel ba la sogs pa'i dogs pa med pa'o/ /ye shesaladabang ba ni gnas dang gnas ma yin pa la sogs pa'i ji snyed pa'i chos mngon sum du rtogs pa ste rgol bas gnod pa med pa'o/ /gzungs ni gzungs kyi sgobazhi ste/ bzod pa'i gzungs ni a la sogs pa gzungs kyi yi ge re re la brtan nas/ yi ge de nyid skye ba med par rtogs pas rkyen byas te chos thams cad skyeb med pa la bzod par thob par 'gyur ba'o/ /sngags kyi gzungs ni bden tshigagrub cing rig sngags gsar du byed nus pa'o/ /tshig gi gzung ni tshig ji tsasathos pa thams cad mi brjed par 'dzin pa'o/ /don gyi gzungs ni tshig de rnamasakyi don mi brjed par gzung ba'o/ /'di dag ni gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku grub pa na thob par 'gyur te/ so so rig pa bzhi yang ngo / rnam par thar pa zhes bya ba ni ril por 'dzin pa dang rjes su gzhig pa'i bsam gtan gyi snang ba thob cing / phyi nang gi khams thams cad nam mkha' lta bu dang / shes pa'i snangabar shar tsam dang / gdod ma nas med pa dang / dran pa dang bcas pa dang/dran pa yang med pa ste/ stong pa nyid 'od gsal la 'jug pa'i tshul mthon parabyang chub pa'i rim pa 'di la rnam thar brgyad kyi ming 'dogs te/ bdaganyid rlud sems lha skur snang ba 'gag pa med bzhin du snang ba thams cad gsal /rdo kyi phu nga cad lnga ma cedi'i dag 1 ༵ kau dhi dho/ ghra spyu gyi ༵ ༵ dho grin ba /ma ༵ /lha rdo —19—

dang sgyu ma lta bur dmigs pa ni gzugs med gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar du ming btags/ rjes gzhig bya bar brtsams te rang dang phyi rol gyi snang ba thams cad ci yang mi dmigs par mthong nas rnam par 'jig par rtsom pa dang / lha sku dang bde ba snang ba yang mi dgag la rang bzhin med par shes pa ni khyad par sdug pa'i rnam thar/ kun rdzob kyi snang ba gzhan ni bsdus la stong sang nger snangab snang ba'i ye shes ni nam mkha' mtha' yas kyi rnam thar/ de nyid shin tugasal bar snang ba ni mched pa ste rnam shes mtha' yas kyi rnam thar/ de yangarang bzhin med snang ba ni nyer thob ci yang med pa'i rnam thar/ der 'dzin pa yang med la cung zad dran pa'i rtsol ba dang bcas pa ni thams cad stong pa la mtshams sbyar ba'i nyer thob ste/ 'du shes med min gyi rnam thar/ rtsol ba yangamed par bde stong gi ye shes gnyis snang thams cad 'gags par gnas pa ni 'gog pa'i rnam thar/ 'di dag ni lam thun mong ba'i rnam thar brgyad dang mingamathun pa tsam las/ don mi 'dra ste 'di ni 'od gsal du 'jug tshul te bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las phye ba'o/ /so sor yang dag par rig pa bzhi ni/ tshig gis brjod pa dang mingagobarda tshad thams cad mkhyen pa chos so sor yang dag rig pa'o/ /don thams ho kyi ma.āoṃ nyid so sor ma 'dres par mkhyen pa don so sor rig pa'o/ khul skad so so dang so so'i sgra don ma lus pa mkhyen pa nges tshig so sor rig pa zho khesabya thams cad mngon sum du gzigs pas dri ba kun gyi lan thogs med du spobs pa ni spobs pa so so yang dag rig pa'o/ /gnyis pa ngo bo'i dbye bal/—20—

rgyu'i rdzogs rim dang 'bras bu'i rdzogs rim gnyis las/ dang po la rang byin gyis brlabs pa dang / dkyil 'khor 'khor lo dang / phyag rgya chen po gsuralas/ dang po ni/ a wa dha tī sogs te/ de yang rtsa dbu ma de ngos su bsgomasakyang rung ma bsgoms kyang ga rung ste/ mi dmigs dang / thig le dang / yi ge bsgom pa la sogs pa dmigs pa'i gtso bo rnams dbu mar gtad de bsgom pa yin pas/ gang du sems gtad pa der rlung rnams 'du ba ni chos nyid yin te/ de ltar bsgoms pas rlung bsdus nas gang du sgom pa'i 'khor lo de rnams kyi lte bar dang por 'jug bar du gnas/ mthar thim par 'gyur rdo /thim pa'i tshe khams phra rags kyi rim pa thim lugs dang / zhu bde khyad par can rang po 'gyung ste/ 'di yang bde ba chen po'i rgyu yin no/ /gnyis pa ni phyag rgya'i sogasardete/ 'di la 'a las kya phyag rgya dang de'i yan lag go /dang po ni/ phyag rgya'e srogartsol te/ steng gi srog rtsol la brten nas rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thitshagasum rim gyis byed pa bzhin du phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyar ba yang srog rtsol du 'gyur ba'i skabs su sleb pa na/ phyag rgya'i rkyen gyis zhugs gnas thim gsum cig car byas nas dbu mar byang chub kyi sems 'bab pa'i zhi bde'i bde chen myur du 'dren par 'gyur te/ rang lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i dga' ba bzhis/ bde ba dang / stong pa dang / rang bzhin dang / snang ba'i dbyeb rnamasarags pa dang / tsi rigs par mtshon nus kyang zhib modang rdzogs par mtshon pa ni las rgya la rag las pa yin no/ /de yang rang lus kyi gnas mi 'dra b.ragand du bsnun pas/ ye shes rnam pa mi 'dra ba tha dad par 'char te/ de dag re 21—

re la rtogs pa khyad par du 'gyur lugs mi 'dra ba re yod pa de bzhin du/ las rgya rigs mi 'dra ba'i khyad par la yang ste/ 'on kyang snang ba bzhi dang dga' bzhi'i ye shes rdzogs par 'dren mi thub pa dang thub pa'i khyad par ro/ /lasakyiphyag rgya'i mchog tu gyur pa gnas gsum gyi pho nya mo ni/ gnas gsum la yulanyi shu rtsa bzhir phye bas de rnams kyi ste/ de dag gi 'du ba khyad par can thob na/spyir dngos grub rnam gnyis shin tu myur bar ster ba dang / khyad par rtsa bdun khrinyis stong gi rtsa mdud grol ba dang / rlung 'pho ba nyer bzhi 'gags pa dang/khams snyigs ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang dwangs mar gnas 'gyur ba dang / de ltararten dag pa'i nus pas brten pa bde lhong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rba rlabs dang bral ba rab 'byams su mched par 'gyur ba ni/ rim gyi las rgya gzhan gyis kyang byed mod/ 'dis 'phral du byed pas na las kyi phyag rgya'i mchog cesasmos pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ ye shes de brtan par bya ba'i phyir du yid kyi phyag gyonyeye shes kyi phyag rgya zhes kyang bya/ rnam rtog gis bsgoms pa'i phyag rgyar snang ba ste/ rnam rtog med bzhin du snang ba ni rang snang gi rig ma'am rnam bcas phyag rgya chen mo zhes bya ba yin no/ /gsum pa phyag rgya chen mo ni/ /stong pas sogs te/'di la bde ba 'dren byed kyi phyag rgya chen modang / yid nang du 'jug byed kyiphyag rgya chen mo gnyis yin te/ dang po ni/ zhu bde lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shesagoms pa shin tu brtan par gyur nas/ bde stong gi ye shes kho na la mnyam parabazhag pas/ de nyid kyis slar yang rlung sems 'du ba'i rkyen byas te zhu bde khyad —22—

par can yang yang 'dren pa yin te rnam med phyag rgya chen mo'i rna/ /gnyis pa ni/yid ces bya ba ni khu ba dang yid rtog gnyis char la 'jug pas/ byang chub kyi sems dbu ma'i nang du chud cing bcings pa na/ rnam rtog thams cad 'od gsal du bcug pas/ stonge ga pa nyid rkyang pa bsgo mes pa las ches lhag paragazung 'dzin gyi gnyis snang 'gags pas 'dod pa'i de ngos grub gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku phyag rgya chen mo mchog gi dngos grub thob par bya ba'i rgyu phyag chen la 'byud pa ste sgom par zhes pa'i don no/ /skabs 'dir de dag go mersha/ par rtogs pa cung zad brjod na/ bde stong 'dren tshul e wa gyi don bshad pa dang / 'dren byed phyag rgya bzhi'i dbye ba bshad pa'o/ /dang po la thob bya 'brasabu'i e wa/ bsgo me bya lam gyi e wa/ 'dren byed rtags kyi e wa ste gsum las/dang po ni/ e ni shes rab 'od gsal stong pa nyid yin la/ wa ni ye shes kyi skuris med pa rnam pa thams cad du 'char ba ste/ kyai rdo rje las btsun mo'i bha gabade chen du/ ston pa sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ gtso bo dpe byad brgyad cur ldan/zhes sogs gsungs pa ste/ 'di la'ang mthar thug pa'i dbang du byas na chos sku e dang / gzugs sku wa gyis mtshon pa yin no/ /gnyis pa la/ bskyed rim lasbyar ba sogs mang du yod kyang / re zhig 'dir mi 'chad de/ rdzogs rim gyi dbang du byas na/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje dbyer med yin par mang po lasabashad kyang / rdorje phreng ba las/ e ni stong pa nyid du gsag /de bzhin wa ni go/sna bye /༵ nga/sa/ dzi/ de ༵ stong ༵ rnyi / snru rnam dī /ra kau rlo rdo rnyi lja sna —23—

can te/ e zur gsum pas mtshon pa yin no/ /phyi nang gi rkyen gyis lusalagand du bsnun pas zhu bde khyad par can skye ba dang / des drangs pa'i rangabazhin lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes sam bde ba chen po'i ye shes ni waX yig gis mtshon no/ /thig le ni ye shes de yang ngo bo tha dad pa ma yin gyi/de nyid bde ba yang yin la stong pa yang yin pa mtshon pa'o/ /gsum pa la rang lus kyi rtsa 'khor la sbyar ba dang / gzhan lus shesarab ma la brten pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dpal yang dag sbyor ba ga sdi pu di las/ spyibo lte bar son 'khor lo/ /tshe yig rnam par yang dag gnas/ /snying khamagrin par yang dag gnas/ /waX gyi yi ge 'dra bar 'dod/ /ces lte ba dang spyi bo gnyis zur gsum du gnas shing / rten yin pa dang yangs pa'i don gyi tshedangachos mtshungs la/ snying kha mgrin pa gnyis zlum po dang / brten pa dang/ yangasapa ma yin pas waX dang 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje phreng ba las/ tshe ni padma'i mtshan nyid de/ /bha ga rten du shes par bya/ /brten pa rdo rje zhes ni gsu7gzhes sogs dang / kyai rdo rje las kyang / /tshe yig cha byad bzang mo gang/ /dbusasu waX gyis rnam par brgyan/ /bde ba thams cad kyi ni gnas/ /sangs rgyas yin chen za ma tog /ces gsungs te/ sangs rgyas rin chen ni de'i rgyu ste rangabazhin lhan skyes so/ /de'i za ma tog gam snod ni zhu bde lhan skyes yin te/ de gang las byung na/ e gru gsum gyi cha byad can shes rab ma'i padma dang/ lo yigagis mtshon pa thabs kyi rdo rje snyoms par zhugs pa las 'byung ngo zhes pa'i don te/ ewaX ni rdo rje dang padma 'o/ /spyir rtags kyi e waX gzhi la sbyar ba yin zhing/—24—

'on kyang rdzogs rim gyi bde chen 'dren pa la nges pa bskyed de/ waX gyis e yi sgo 'byed cing / /e yis waX gyi sgo shin tu dbye dka' ba rnams kyang 'byed parabyed pa ste/ bde stong rtogs tshul la yang 'di ltar shes dgos so/ /'di'i gnad cung zad zhal las shes par bya'o/ /'di la e rten dang waX brten pa ste/rgyud gang du 'di skad ces gsungs pa'i don te/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i zhes tshig med pa rnams la don ni yod de/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud kyi rgyal po 'dir/ /gsang ba mchog gis dgyes pa na/ /zhes gsungs pa'i gsang ba e dang / rdo rje sems dpa' ni waX 'o / /des mtshon pa/ rdo rje phreng ba las/ e ni gsang ba mkha' dbyings dang / /bha ga chos 'byung padma la/ /rnal 'ebyor sengage'i gdan la bzhugs/ /mchog tu rmad byung ston par mdzod/ /ces e dang / rdo rje sems dpa' waX rdo rje/ rdo rje 'jigs byed dbang phyug dang / /he ruka dang dus 'khor lo/ /dang po'i sangs rgyas la sogs mtshan/ /zhes waX gyi rnam grangasagasungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ spyir phyag rgya bzhi'i ngos 'dzin ni mi 'dra ba mang ngo / /'khor lo bzhi la sogs pa yang phyag rgya bzhir bstan pa mang mod kyi/phyogs mthun du sbyar ba yin no/ /phyag rgya bzhi'i rnam gzhag ni rgyud sde mang po zhig gis rjes su 'brangs nas/ slob dpon 'jigs med 'byung gnas 'di skad ces bzhed de/ bskyed rim dang / rdzogs rim dang / 'bras bu la sbyar ba gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ lha mo'i gzugs mngon par bsgom pa ni las kyi phyag rgya/ yi ge bkod pa ni chos kyi phyag rgya/ 'od zer spro bsdu la sogs pas 'phrin 25—

las byed pa ni dam tshig gi phyag rgya/ lha sku snang stong ni phyag rgya chen po'o/ /gnyis pa rdzogs rim gyi ni/ dngos kyi rig ma ni las kyi phyag gyo ste/'byud pa la sogs pa las kyi dga' ba ster ba'i phyir ro/ /rtsa a wa dhwa tī ni chos kyi phyag rgya ste/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba khyad par can ste re ba'i phyiraro/ /bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes ni phyag rgya chen po ste/ blan med pa'i byang chub kyi sems yin pas so/ /yid kyi phyag rgya lha mo'i rnam par snang ba nidam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /gsum pa 'bras bu'i ni/ sprul pa'i sku ni dma'i gi gophyag rgya/ bde ba chen po'i sku ni phyag rgya chen po/ chos kyi sku ni chos kyi phyag rgya/longs spyod rdzogs sku ni las kyi phyag rgya'o/ /yang na sprul longs chos gsurabade chen bzhi la rim pas las dang / chen po dang / chos dang / dam tshigagophyag rgya rnams so/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i lugs kyang 'di nyid yin par bzuyo/dges pa rdo rje'i dgongs don du mdzad de/ phyag rgya bzhi gtan la dbab pa'igazhung / klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i rjes su 'brangs te/ mnga' bdag chen po mi tri pa rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i bced pa ni/ dngos kyi phyag rgya ni gtso bo dang / yid kyis bsgoms pa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya ni yan lag ste las kyi phyagargya'o/ /rlung dang / thig le dang / gas mo'i rnal 'byor dang/ dbang pord kyis sems kyi bde ba 'ba' zhig la dmigs pa mi shigs pa ste chos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /de skad du/ lhan cig skyes pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i gnas pa bsdus pa las/ chos kyi phyag rgya bsgom pa ni/ /tha mas rtsa dang yi ge'i rim/ /gtso/mo'i bye brag 'bring gis so/ /mi shigs pa ni rab kyis te/ /thig le phra sogs rnal—26—

'byor pas/ /bsdus pa'i rig par 'dod pa yin/ /zhes bshad do/ /phyag rgya chen po ni/ rang bzhin gnyug ma spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i ye shesaso/ /dam tshig gi phyag rgya ni ma brtags par shar ba'i lha sku ste/ de'i rgyur bskyed rim gyis bogs 'byin zhing rgyas 'debs pa yang phyogs mthun yin no/ /zhesab ched de/ 'jigs med 'byung gnas kyi zhal snga nas kyis ni/ phyag rgya bzhi pa'i gzhung de 'gog par mdzad mod kyi/ mi tri pa lta bu'i dngos grub brnyes pa'i skyesabu rnams la 'khrul pa med pa'i phyir dang / rgyud kyi don dang 'gal ba med param zad shin tu zab par yang mthong bas mi 'gal bar khas blang bar bya zhing /'di ni dges pa rdo rje'i dgongs par snang ngo / /de gnyis ni rdzogs rim thamasacad phyag rgya bzhin sdud pa'i lugs te nyi tshe ba ni gzhan yang 'byung ngo / ge nyesapa la stong phyogs kyi rdzogs rim dang / zung 'jug gi rdzogs rim mo/ /dang po ni bde stong sogs te/ rang bzhin brgyad cu dang snang ba gsum rim pas thim pa'i bde stong dbyer med lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi sems rang bzhin gyi dri mas dag pa mngon sum du rtogs pa ni stong phyogs kyi rdzogs rim mo/ /gnyis pa ni 'od gsal sogs te/ bshad ma thag pa'i stong phyogs de nyid las ma g.yos pa ste mi 'bral bar yan lag bdun ldan gyi gzugs sku'i snang ba rgyun chad pa med pa'am/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad par 'char ba ni/ skudang ye shes dbyer med kyi zung 'jug ste rdzogs rim mthar thug pa'o/ /snangaphyogs zhes smos pa ni/ snang phyogs kyi rdzogs rim 'di'i yan lag tu 'dusapas 'di shes na de yang shes par 'gyur ba dang / stong phyogs gong du bshad —27—

she de/'aXshe sa zhi po she pa'i she ༷ smosapa'// rnams ni dan sa par bya ba mdar bsdus zhag ༷rnga dam na/’nga phyagasaspyod pa/bzhi phyags ye she sdo skye/zung she she pa'//gsus gyi ming gi dang /rang ba kau she/'i rang bzhin ba la//kau pa la/3ni snang ri phyo shernam grangs rim /sa sna rang ban bshad sdo'//dang pa khro / rnga 5 re snos mched yo sems la ༵ pa bzhan du/shes gsu 5 /she dang /zhe sngeng ga gas te mu / 5rderde/mas dang / da dang /rnam sa gsuX//'dad chags sngeg sto/༷ mug/she/ngal sdug ste ngo/shes dbang se/yangs snab gsum/ris pas cas grungaphyags zung 'a sdugs sto nga ba nyad she/ mas/ she/ma shi pa gci sum ga tsho/chag/sa bral 'dad chag/sa/'dad chal/sa bar ma gsum/stang pa na tu stang pa/stong pa wo po gsum ste/rim pa bzhin gyi ming gi rnam grangs yin la/spyiralbo sku/co sho/ jesno chi / /ge 7rde snye skyo sku/ yig1de/ 1do/nga rnam grangs she sbyi/ ge rdzo ༷ ga zas mthun rtsasaX na gya/ pre shi dkyi thams zi she wo po hūṃ/'an kyang snang ba spyang pa/tshang pa gam byu tu stang pa/stong pa ste snang bzhi she zhi ngo bo/ji srid pa / tsernga ka ci/nga mi 'jog dngas thams ༷da ge spe gu /snang ba stang ba nga ba ga mu she 'dags thad da pa mu dzod phyi 'a lda~X ༷ na~Xre bde bdang/snang ba3 tshe' cha mu btogardepa'a~Xd sa 'a/she thus ༵ she de snang ba dang sta nyad spru gsal rhacan sna pa' phyar ༵ she tha dad da shrī//sa na snang / gsum/jigazoms mi//rde/ma sa gsu~X/ she/ mas zhe mu/shas pa gsu5rnamasarde rnam grangs na la/snang ba 'dad skyi bde ba shas chung bas chagasarde

bral/ mched pa bde ba shas che bas 'dod chags/ thob pa bde stong ma mnyam pas 'dod chags bar ma zhes bya/ ming gi rnam grangs gzhan rnams la dar na/snang ba ni bde stong gnyis kyi stong pa shas che bas shes rab dang / mched pabadeb shas che bas thabs dang / thob pa cha snyoms pas 'dres par bzhag pa bzhin no/ /gzhan yang snang ba la oṃ dang zla ba dang padma dang bud med dang g.yon pa dang / mtshan mo dang / 'jam po'i brdas btags so/ /mched pa la/ a dang nyi ma dang / rdo rje dang rin po che dang / nyin mo dang / skyes pa dang / g.yas pa dang/rtsub mo zhes btags so/ /thob pa la ma ning dang / mtshams dang/ dbus dang/bar ma dang / 'dres pa dang / 'dus pa zhes gsungs te/ de rnams kyi sgra bshad pa ni mang par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa la gnyis kyi dang po lam dus kyi snang gsum ni/ spyod bsdusasgron me las/ snang ba'i mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ rnam pa med pa'i rang bzhin lusadang ngag med pa ste/ ji ltar ston gyi dus su nam mkha' dri ma med pa la zla ba'i 'od zer gyi snang bar byed pas khyab pa lta bu rang bzhin gyis gsal ba'i rnam par dngos po ma lus pa thams cad la dmigs pas na/ 'di ni don dam byangachub kyi sems shes rab kyi snang ba stong pa dang po ste/ zhes snang ba dang/ mchod pa la gzhan rnams phal cher 'dra ba la gzung ba dang / 'dzin pa dang bral ba'i rang bzhin zhes dang / nyi ma'i 'od zer gyis khyab pa bzhin du shin tu gsawazhing dri ma med pa'i ngo bo zhes dang / thob pa'i skabs su mtshams kyi smag la bab pa'i ngo bor khyab pa phra zhing bdag med pa srog dang rtsol ba mi rgyu ba sems pa —29—

med pa migayo ba zhes gsungs so/ /de la gzung ba dang 'dzin pa med pa niganyis snang rags pa 'gags pa'o/ /rnam pa med pa'i rang bzhin zhes kyangade'o/ /ston nam g.ya' dag pa la zla 'od kyis khyab pa ltar dkar lam dang gsal shas chung zhing stong shas che ba'o/ /lus dang ngag med pa ni tha mal pa'i lus ngag tu snang ba 'gags pa'o/ /rang bzhin gyis gsal ba'i rnam pa zhisems kyi gsal ba'i rang bzhin ci rigs par snang ba'o/ /dngos po ma lus pa la dmigs pa ni khyab pa'o/ ston na tu gsal ba ni snga ma las kyang tshes gsal/ba'o/ /nyi 'od kyis khyab pa lta bu ni/ dmar lam dang gsal shas che ba'o/ /don dam byang chub kyi sems ni rjes mthun pa ste bde stong dbyer med kyi ye shes so/ /smag la bab pas khyab pa ni nag lam dang / rnam rtog gi snang ba kre rsha 'gyur ba thams cad 'gags pa'o/ /phra ba ni rtogs dka' ba'o/ /bdag med pa ni/ rang bzhin ngos bzung ba med pa'o/ /srog rtsol mi rgyu ba ni rlung dbu mara'agags pa dang / sems pa med pa dang / rnam rtog gis g.yo ba med pa rnamasasnang ba gsum ka yod kyang 'di shas che bas 'dir gsungs so/ /de rnams kyi wobo ni/ mi rtog pas stong nyid brjod bral gyi rnam pa gsal bar mthong ba'i zhu bde mnyam bzhag tu gnyis snang mngon 'gyur ba 'gags pa zhes thams cad la sbyar te/ dkar lam sogs kyi snang ba dang gsal mi gsal gyi khyad par phye ba'i ye shes so/ /nyer thob kyi dbus la bab pa'i mtshams shig tu dran med du 'byurabar yang bshad do/ /rlung thim pa shas che chung gi gsal snang rgya che chung dngamirtog pa srab 'thug dang / gnas yun ring thung sna tshogs 'byung ste/ 'dir rtags—30—

snang 'char tshul ni/ spyod bsdus las mngon par byang chub pa'i skabs sudangapor smig rgyu/ de nas zla nyi mun pa skya rengs lta bu pre zhad pas/ bla ma mang posartags lnga dang rtags can bzhi'i dbye ba mdzad pa'ang 'byung mod/ dgongs don rtags lnga smig rgyus go ba'i dbang du mdzad pa ste/ dang por rags pa nyer lnga thim skabs rtags kyang nyer lnga 'byung mod gtso bor smig rgyu sogs rtags lnga dang / de nas zla 'od dkar lam sogs bzhi snang ba gsum mam bzhi'i skabasasu 'byung ba yin no/ /'di ni lam bsgoms pa'i ye shes kyi dbang du byas pa ste/gnyis pa (〈j-i〉 rtsegazhi dus kyi snang gsum ) ni/ shes pa spyi la snang ba gsum gyi mtshan nyid tshang ba gzhi dus kyi snang gsum la dbye na/ gnyid kyi dus snang ba gsum/ sad dus kyi snang gsum/ 'khrig dus kyi snang gsum/ 'dusakyi snang gsum mo/ /dang po dang gsum pa phyogs mthun tsam dang / bzhi pa tho'aphrod cing lam du longs ma longs kyi khyad par ma gtogs lam dus ji lta ba dang / gnyis pa shes pa de la yul snang tsam snang ba dang / khyad par gyi mo thong ba gsal du song ba mched pa dang / mthar yul las sems rang 'gags su logapa thob pa ste/ 'di ltar bzhed pa rgyobasgyur chen po mar pa lho brag pa rjes 'brangadang bcas pa ste/ shin tu gnad che bar snang ngo / /gnyis pa rang bzhin pond pa la/ rang bzhin brgyad cu dang / de 'khor ba'i 'jug ldog gi rtsa bar bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ snang ba'i rang bzhin so gsum ni/ gsang 'dus rim lnga las/de yi rang bzhin 'phro gsal ba/ /da ni rab tu bshad par bya/ /chags braladangani bar ma ṣka/ /de bzhi du ni wo po dang / /yid la 'gro zhing 'ong ba —31—

dang / /mya ngan la sogs gsum de bzhin/ /zhi dang rnam rtog 'ordze gas pa dang / /'jigs pa bar ma shin tu 'jigs/ /sred dang sred pa bar tshadang / /shin tu sred dang nyer len pa/ /mi dge bkres dang skom nyid dang/ /tsoradang tshor ba bar ma dang / /shin tu tshor ba'i skad cig dang / /rig pa grodangarigs 'dzin gzhi/ /so sor rtog dang ngo tsha shes/ /snying rje dang ni brtseb gsum/ /dogs dang bsags pa nyid dang ni/ /phrag dog ces ni bya b.ragrags/ /rang bzhin sum cu rtsa gsum gang / /lus can rnams kyi rang rigaste/ /zhes gsungs pa la/ chags bral ni yul la mi sdug par 'dzin pa ro bo zhe sdang ste che chung gi dbye bas gsum mo/ /de yang 'dzin stangs mi gsal ba chudangudang / gsal po byung yang 'du byed rtsom mi thub pa 'bring / 'du byed la bskuwanus pa chen po ste/ 'og ma rnams la'ang rigs 'gre'o/ /yid la 'gro bdanga'ong ba gnyis ni yul la sems pa dang slar nang du sems pa ste/ sems pa lasajaphye ba'o/ /mya ngan ni yul yid du long ba dang bral ba'i gdung ba snye che chung gsukhomo/ /zhi ba ni ngal zhing thang chad pa ltar had de 'dug pa ste/ shes bzhin ma yin pa'o/ /rnam rtog ni mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i 'du shes so/ /'jigs pa ni skragapa'o/ /sred pa ni yul yid du 'ong pa dus gsum la dmigs nas zhen pa stotshechung gsum mo/ /len pa ni sred pa'i yul la 'jug par byed pa'i semasaso/ /mi dge ba ni 'gyod pa'o/ /bkres pa dang skom pa gnyis ni go bar zad de/des rgyus yid mi bde ba'o/ /tshor ba ni tshor ba bde sdug btang snyoms rnams te che chung gsum mo/ /rig pa po dang / rig pa'i byed pa po dang / lo sdon gzhi dzhai—32—

rig bya'i yul rnams la log par 'dzin pa'i sems te log pa'i don yang bden par rtog pa mngon gyur pa'o/ /so sor rtog pa ni rigs pa dang mi rigasapar dpyod pa'o/ /ngo tsha shes pa ni rang la rnam smin sdug bsngal sogs nyes pa 'byung bar shes nas kha na ma tho ba la 'dzem pa'o/ /snying rje ni sdug bsngal brala'adod do/ /brtseb gsum ni/ gang la dga' ba'i yul de la yid du sdug pa dang phrad cing rnyed par 'dod pa dang / de gnod pa las bsrung bar 'dod pa gsu5mo/ /dogs pa ni the tshom dang 'brel bar nyams nga'i rnam pa can brtan pa med pa'o/ /bsags pa ni ser sna ste gtong mi bro ba'o/ /phrag dog ni gzhan gyi phun tshogs la sems 'khrug pa'o/ /mched pa'i rang bzhin bzhi bcu ni/ /chags dang zhen dang de bzhin dga'/ /dga' ba bar ma shin tu dga'/ /rangs dang shin tumagu ba dang / /ngo mtshar de bzhin rgod pa dang / /tshim dang de bzhin 'khyud pa dang / /'o byed de bzhin 'jib pa dang / /brtan dang brtson dang nga rgyawadang / /bya dang 'phrog dang stobs dang ni/ /spro dang lhan cig skyes nyid dang/ /de bzhin lhan cig skye bar ma/ lken tu lhan cig skyes dang drag /rnam par sgogadang zhe 'gras nyid/ /dge dang tshig gsal bden pa dang / /mi bden pa dngadebazhin nges/ /nye bar mi len byin pa po/ /bskul dang de bzhin dpa' bodang / /ngo tsha med dang sgyu dang gdug /mi bsrun pa dang gya gyu nyid/ /mtshan nyid bzhi bcu gang yin pa/ stun na tu stong pa'i skad cig ste/ /zhes gsungs pa las/ chags pa ni thob par bya rgyu'i yul la yid chags pa'o/ /zhen pa ni the bo zin pa'i yul la chags pa'o/ /yid 'ong ni yul yid du 'ong ba snang tsam nas 33—
