'bab pa'i rtsa so gnyis zhes gsungs/ saX pu zhir/ sbas pa'i rtsa lnga gsungs pa yang sum skor ma sogs bzhi/ rtsa chu shing me tog dang lnga ste/ sum sto rtsa bdun du byed na/ chu shing me tog dbu ma las logs su mi bgrang / ro rkyang dbu ma bsdud 'bral bzhi gcig tu bsdoms nas bu ga brgyad dam snying ga'i phyi'i brgyad bsnan pas so bdun du byed pa nā ro pa'i lugs yin gsungs te/ so bdun dang sbasapa'i rtsa lnga bgrang tshul 'di kho na rnam par dag pa'o/ /sbas pa'i don shin tu zab cing gsang ba'i don yin gyi/ snying dbus su sbas pa dang / rtsa rgyud du sbas pa la'achad pa ni legs par ma mthong ngo / /bzhi pa de dag lha lha modang sbyar ba ni/ ro rkyang dbu ma gsum rdorje phagamo dang / sum skor ma sogs phyogs kyi bzhi rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs lha rmobazhi ste/ de dag nas rlung ma gtogs khams gtso bor mi 'bab pa dang/ bu gabargyad kyi rtsa rnams kyang khams dwangs ma gtso bor mi 'byung bas snyigs ma tsam 'bab mod/ gtso bor ma bzhag par de dag nas yan lag gi rlung rnams gtsobor 'bab pa sgomatshams ma brgyad de/ de ltar bcu gnyis sbyangs gzhi'i skabasadwangs ma mi 'bab/ bskyed rim skabs yab kyis ma 'byud pa go khu khrag 'dresapa rlud gsum cha mnyam 'bab pa ni/ khams mun pa thugs kyi chos yin pasathugs 'khor ba dang / rdul 'bab pa'i rtsa brgyad khams gsung gi chos yin pasagasung 'khor ba dang / khu ba 'bab pa'i rtsa brgyad khams sku'i chos yin pasasku'akhor ba'i lha dang / sbyor ba khams dpa' bo dang / rtsa lha mo'i dag pa yin pasartsa 'di dag nas dwangs ma 'bab pas yab yum gnyis sbyor ba'i dag —86—

'a//pus zang dang khams mi 'bab rang gi ngo skal de rtsa gzhasbu ma yin padhogazhadus su rlung dang khama~X sa sde'/rang ngo skal de rtsa gzhan du gyur ba gegs kyang byed pas dus na gya 'cha ba dang rgas pa dang rgud pa sogs bskyed pas 'chi ba~X rtsa zhes sder/des na 'di la 'a kyi cha med pas lha mo bco lnga'i dag pa la gyi sbyor bar kya rdor las/gang phyar ༷sna drug cha sa pas//'bad bas zhes lhag ma spangs//zhes gsungs/'dar yang 'jags rtsa kri ngelardeganas sbyis man ngag snye 'a/de dang 'dra bar gsungs te/tha mal po'i de ladag pa sbyor/lam sgom pa' tshe de yang lte ba nas brtsams te/rim/pas byangachub sems kyi gang bas 'chi ba dang rgas pa dang rgud pa sel bas te/rdorje phagamor mu ge de na sa zhes pa 'a 'a //gzhan yang//rje snying 'grel lagab 'a bu' grangs nyad kya//sno sto/gis phyed dang ba //spyo/ka rtsa rtsa pasartsa' rnam gzhag mtha' dag par su sa brjod par byed/gnyas/ pa la rlungadang thig le'i rnam gzhag gnyis las/dang po ni/spyir gsang 'du po rje phreng0ri lha ni/ 0ri ke tshob nas rlud brgya rtsa brgyad kyā rnam gzhag ༵sungs pa/rang ban gya rnam rtagabasdo mi brgyad bskyed tshun sgos pa brtas pa/na zhes rtog zhes rnam pa mthun pa' ḍi btang bzung la sogs pa snye' sa zhes 'ga~X zhag gsung kyi/bzhi / smin ge rgor lo so dhi rma rgyu ba 'a ge mu gyas dbye ḍi na te/kho jolab / na mtshams rlung sa pa'i kru//mgrin 'og me'i 'khokhro lo ste/zhi yi sbyabalo drug tu zhe 'ari byed ma ga|gas sna rlung dgu dgu rgyu bas lnga mu ge ge ni ba yan la/de yang nyan mtshan gnyas kyas cha ci bas brgya rtsa brgyad yan zhes 'chad pa

yang yod do//'on kyang re ṣka de rnams kyi dpyad pa bor te/rtsa dzi tsas pa de tsam gi rlung yod mod kyi/bsdu na rlung bcur 'du sde/rtsa ba'i rlud lnga dnga'i/rni/ lag rlung lnga'o//sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor las/ko ṭa kṣa la sogs pa gis bstan zhing /dgongs pa lung ston dang /dus kyi 'khor los las/klulasogs pa'i ming gis bskyun no//rdorje sgo nas/nga tshal : kyi ring bar sa lasogs pas bskyun/dus kya 'khor lo las bya | byed tshul 'dra bar gsungasaso/skabs 'dar de dag bshad pa gi sgo gnyi sgo brtan pa dang /gas kri mi rnye(bshad pa'o//dang po la/steng 'og sgo gnyas dang /sku gsung thugs— sgogasum mo//dang po ni/kha sbyor las/steng gi sgo dang 'og kho de/'og gi sgo ni rnam par shes/steng gi sgo ni dbyings nyid do//zhes gsungs te/gzhi dusasusteng gi sgo ni ro ma/'og gi sgo ni rkyang ma'i sgo ste/hro phyir 'gro ba'i tshegasapab nas smin mtshams kyi bar du 'gro ba yang ro ma la ltos te 'gro ba'i phyir/steng gi sgor bzhag la/de yang 'chi ba sogs bkra mi shis pa bskyed pa dang/mdangs zad par byed pa can yin pas stong pa dang mthun pa'i phyir dbyings zhes gsungs/rlung nang du 'ong ba'i tshe smin mtshams nas gsang ba'i bar du 'jug pa rkyang ma la ltos nas 'jug pa'i phyir de 'og gi sgor bzhag ste/tshe ringardeb sogs dge legs dang /mdangs rgyas pa dang rnam rtog skyed par byed pa'iphyir ye shes zhes btags/lam sgom pa'i tshe/steng gi sgo nas smin mtshamos/kyi dbu ma'i yas sna dang /'og gi sgo nas rdo rje dang /ze 'bru la gnas pa dbu ma'i mar rtsa'i sgo'o//dbyings ni stong pa ༷ bskyed pa dang /ye shes ni bde gsalo

bskyed pa'o/ /rgyud 'dir steng 'og gi sgo mi 'dra ba gnyis gsungs pa'i phyi mthugs kyi sgo gnyis yin pas 'di gnyis bsres na rgyun tshig 'chad pa la lhag chad nor ba'i skyon gsum char 'jug go /gnyis pa la/ sku'i sgo dgu/ gsung gi sna sgo bzhi/ thugs kyi sku gnyis rnams yod pa'i dang po ni/ kha sbyor gyi lung dpyod thig tu drangs pa/ kab go 〉 /po sgo dgu pa/ /lhag pa'i lha ni sbom po lnga/ /bu ga dgur ni gyur pa'i sgo/ /rnamapa dgur ni yongs su grags/ /zhes sogs gsungs te/ ka ba gcig ni dbu ma/sgo dgu ni bu ga dgu/ sbom po lnga ni phung po'i lnga'i rlung / lhag pa'i lha ni 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung ste/ de yang srog gi rlung gcig pu nyid las/ byed las kyi dbang gis phung khams dgu'i rlud du bzhag pa yin no/ /des na lus 'grub par byed pa'i rlung rnams 'gro 'ong byed pa'i sgo'i gtso bo ni bu ga dgu ste sku'i sgo dgu go /gnyis pa ni/ snying ga chos 'khor gyi phyogs kyi rtsa 'dab bzhi'i sgo ste/ shar nasachu rlung / byang nas rlud gi rlung / nub nas me'i rlud / lho nas so'i rlung ste bkatshig 'grub par byed pa'i rlud 'gro 'ong byed pas gsung gi sgo bzhi zhes grags/gsum pa ni/ snying ga dang lte ba'i dbu ma'i rtsa mdud gnyis rlung thams cad kyi rtsa ba srog thur 'byung 'jug byed pa'i sgo gleg lta bu yin la/ 'khor lo'i lte bde nyid ni sgo yin te/ 'dir srog gi rlung ni snying ga'i dpyid dang 'brel bas zla ba'i rlung zhes bya/ thur ser ste ba'i thig le dang mas sna'i gtso/ mo rnams dnga'abrel bas nyi ma'i rlung zhes bya/ 'di sems 'pho zhing 'jug pa'i dus kyi rludagi gtso bo yin pas/ de rgyu ba'i sgo yin pa'i phyir de gnyis la'ang thugs kyi sgo —89—

zhes gsungs/gong du bshad mu steng 'og gi sgo de gnyis kya lha pa thib dmu ༵ nga : /'dzag gi lam yin pas thugs kya sgo zhes tha snyad 'dogs te ga le' nga rnam grangs la yid ces kyang bya ba yin no//dpyid kyi thig ler/gsum pa'i sgo0ri6) rwa ri ge ri nyi / do/dzhai da yi 0 / bcas/'i/zla dro nya mar rab phya bas//ljog dang tagaser gyi sgo ches//nga smin mtshams gnad/sa/zhes ga//ris so'i// gtsug gser sgo stengazhig ga / na mtshams gnad kya sgo 'og sgo gnyas zhes bla ma snga ma 'ga' ga 'a ste/ni/ kyang snga 'a ltar 'thad do// she yishes gnyas pa /'a ba 'a rlung lnga yang ge mu lnga so so dang mus ba na ra kya/bya 'ad kya rlung hpho gisang ga gtso bor bskyed kyi / lus ba 1 phra ba~Xganas pa yan te/de 'ba' ga sna ngag gtso rno/ bskyed /lus bskyed pa mthu chung ba yin ༷//des na 'a ༷ zhi ཿnga ba snru) dang /rnam khyur snro thigata//dge 'di/ni rlung dang ni nasaḥdang ni de bzhin mas te/dad ga tu/mu nyad dang na rlung dang //dbang wo dang de ba chu//'khoralothugs kya kun spyod las//steng logs ba bzhi bzhi tu gnas//zhes ji lnga za te/rluX re re yang nang rdo/ 'byung zho /rdeng ba ba ba dang bcas te rgyu/ ltar rgyu ba 'a snyen sa rnams rtsa ba snrong ba lha skabs su kyi rla tha pa da pa 'dre'od//des na hā/pa'i the gya rlung chu khams na yang/chu khams rlung tha///cad rje ge mu won pa nges pa med de/dper na rtsa rlung dgu brgya pa rnog ga rgyu ༵'a skabasasgasrog chas gtso lo las byed pa snra gtogs rgyu ba sngu bcu char ༵ no//gnyas pa la/rlung bcu ga 9 0 ba/gnas/ gas gta na pa/byed

las/ rgyu ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ dgongs pa lung ston pa las/ srog dang thur sel gyen rgyu dang / khyab dang mnyam gnas zhes bya dang / klu dang rus sbal rtsangs pa dang / lhas byin dang ni gzhu las rgyal/ zhes gsungs te/ srog 'dzin dang/thur sel dang / mnyam gnas dang / gyen rgyu dang / khyab byed de rtsa ba'i rlung lnga/klu ste rgyu ba dang / rus sbal te rnam par rgyu ba dang / rtsangs pa ste yang dag par rgyu ba dang / lhas byin te rab tu rgyu ba dang / gzhu las rgyal lam nor las rgyal te nges par rgyu ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ spyir 'di rnams lus thams cad la khyab pa'i tshul gyis gnas kyang so so ni bya ba byed pa'i gnas ni/ srog 'dzin snying gdang/thur sel 'dom dang / gyen rgyu mgrin pa dang / me mnyam nye ba dang / khyab byed spyi bo nas brtsams te tshigs thams cad la khyab par byed do/ /rgyu ba ni migarnam par rgyu ba ni rna ba/ yang dag par rgyu ba ni sna/ rab tu rgyu ba ni lce/ ces parargyu ba ni lus thams cad la gnas so/ /rlung de dag snying ga'i rtsa'am/don snod la gnas pa'i tshe ni klu la sogs par ming btags pa ste/ snye ma sbrul 'khyil/ba 'dra ba la gnas pas klu dang / mchin pa rus sbal 'dra ba la gnas pas rukhosbal dang / glo ba rtsangs pa 'dra ba la gnas pas rtsangs pa dang / snying lhas byin gyi bu mo go zu dkar po gyon pa 'dra ba laganas pas lhas byin dang / mkhalamagazhu'i dbyibs 'dra ba la gnas pas gzhu las rgyal zhes btags par mkhas grub chen po 'gos lo tsa ba lhas btsas bzhed do/ /gsum pa ni/ srog 'dzin rdorje mgon po mi bskyod pa/ thur sel rin wo mgon po rin 'byung/ /yo rgyu padma'i mgon po 'od dpag med/ /me mnyam las mgon po don grub/ khyab —91—

byed sangs rgyas mgon po rnam snang ngo / /yan lag gi rlung rnams la gsal b.ram bshad kyang rigs kyi dbye ba sbyar na/ rgyu ba rnam snang / rnam par rgyu ba mibaskyod pa/ yang dag par rgyu ba zin 'byung / rab tu rgyu ba wod dpa na med/ cesapar rgyu ba don grub kyi rigs so/ /'byung ba chen po'i rlung rnams kyi tshang nang na 'byung chung bzhi bzhi yod pa rnams ni/ lha mo bzhis bsdus pa yin zhing/ sroga'adzin mi bskyod pa'i rigs su bstan pa bzhin du chu'i rlung yin tshad rigs chen rigs chung gang la ltos nas yin yang mi bskyod pa'i rigs su 'ong ngo / /desagazhan rnams kyang shes par bya'o/ /des na mā ma ki'i rlung rigs chung gi mibaskyod pa dang / gos dkar mo'i rlung rigs chung gi 'od dpag med yin pa sogs zhib mor shes pa bya la/ yan lag gi rlung rnams rigs lngar bsdus pa yang / rigs chen gyi dbang du byas na/ lnga'i bdag nyid bcu ming can/ zhesarlung lnga'i bdag nyid du ma 'dus pa med kyang / srog 'dzin gyi cha shas dbang po so so la gnas nas yul lnga 'dzin pa'i bya ba byed pa rnams byed las kyi khyad par gyi srog 'dzin gyi rlung byings las logs su bkar te yan lag gi rlung lnga'i tha snyad byas par gsungs pas mi bskyod pa'i rigs yin kyang / rigs chungagodabang du byas na/ mig sa'i snying po rnam snang dang / rna ba phyag rdor mi bskyod pa dang / sna nam mkha'i snying po rin 'byung dang / lce 'jig rten dbang phyug 'od dpag med dang / lus sgrib pa rnam sel don grub kyi rigs yin pag rten dbang po'i rigs kyis brten pa rlud la rgyas btab pa yin no/ /phal cer du rigs chen rnams gtso che ba yin kyang / 'ga' zhig tu rigs chung gtso tsheb —92—

yang yod do/ /bzhi pa ni/ srog 'dzin gyi rlung gis tshe gnas pa dang steng gosnasgor rgyu ba'i las byed/ thur sel gyi rlung gis bshang gci khu ba 'phen sdom gyi las byed/ me mnyam gyis zas kyi dwangs ma lus la khyab pa dang / zas dwangasasnyigs 'byed cing 'ju bar byed pa gtum mo'i me sbor bar byed/ gyen rgyus zab dang myang ba dang skyug pa dang smra ba dang rlung gzhan rnams gyen du g.yo ba la sogs pa'i las byed/ khyab byed kyis ni rlud gzhan thams cad lus la khyab pa dang / 'gro ba la sogs pa'i bya ba byed cing nad kyang bskyed par byed do/ /yan lag gi rlung la/ mig gi sgo nas rgyu ba zhes bya ba'i rlung gis mig gi rnam shes kyi bzhon pa byas nas/ 'bras bu yul gzugs 'dzin pa'i bya ba byed pa nas rimapa bzhin du sbyar te/ rnam par rgyu bas sgra dang / yang dag par rgyu bas dri dang/rab tu rgyu bas ro dang / nges par rgyu bas reg bya 'dzin zhing lus kyi rnam shesabaskyed pa'i rgyu byed do/ /yang yan lag gi rlud 'di dag rnams snying ga nas rgyu ba'i tshe lus kyi gnas gzhan du song ste las sna tshogs pa 'di ltar byed de/ kluyis sgregs pa dang / rus sbal gyis yan lag brkyang bskum dang / rtsangs pasakhro zhing sems 'khrul pa dang / lhas byin gyis glal pa dang / nor las rgyal gyisasrog 'gags kyang dus cung zad du lus mi gtong ba'i bya ba byed par gsungs shing / gzhan yang snye ma la sogs par gnas pa na rlud 'di dag tshogs pasade rnams kyi nad bskyed pa dang / legs par rgyus pas nad byang zhing bde b.raganas pa'i las byed do/ /des na rim lnga las/ lus can rnams kyi srog gyurapa/ /rlung zhes bya ba las kun byed/ 'di ni rnam shes bzhon pa sto lnga'i bdag—93—

nyid bcu yang yin//spyo sema~Xkyi ba lko ga 'dzi gyur 'a lam sgi ma byas na rnamapar rtog pa bcings nga bskyed nga /gzurdo nga ge mu ge gnyas snang 'a ba bye/ la/legs par bangs pas lam du swo//na gnyas snang 'gagasa~X//nga /bab yang dbebang nga ming sheba'i 'a1bu bu tham 1 sa cad gi byed pa smya no//༷dzin yang dge ba dang dge ba 'a 'bras bu //༷sta she hro mthu sa tshe yi tha dī ༵ston pas las kun byed pa gi she pa yan na//sdam 'byung las/na gyis ni rgyal srid tu 'gyur//slu pa yi / lha rdzu nar rnams zad par byed//dbang wo sa rgyalarded geb spru/rde/ga/sta lang bzas sa zer dag 'byung //me la rlung gang rgyu baX//tses skam ngal༄ sdo 'dzi gar dung //bya ba she cad sne/parabyad//she she rda rjaXn pa maXg /bang chen nor dnga' dngashe//rnyed pa thong pa dang dan sdus ge mu//pa ni rna nar she 'grulasags//da pa thab/ pa sdud par dzhai//〈ni ba nga rde rgyu ba na//'dad pa thams/rdecad grub si gi a gi//zhes me rlung sa 'a ba dang bkres skom la sogs pa byed/gis / srid dang dbang ba dang kyi pa dung sgro ba la sdogs pa rtsa gi/sasbyong sa rgyal da dang dbang thang kau langs spyad thab par byad/chu rtsasadan thams cad yi 5 6 /ba par na skaba'i// sa// she'ishe ga tsho ltar 'a ba pe spyi dang/khyad par 'pha ba rnam dzā/nagardegashe/dang pa she khaXg kya sto dbyeb dang/khyad par rngu 5 / grang pa ྅ ro'o ni zer ni ༵sdi ba 'a//dang pa la/sdam 'byung las/g.yas nas 'thon pa cad zer// dkyil lubor la rgyu ba//dza ba'i me tog dang mchas pa//de'i lha ni go dpag94

med/ /g.yon nas rnam rgyu'i 'od zer ni/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor la rtags khadog ljang khu dang mtshungs pa/ /de yi lha ni don yod do/ /gnyis nas rnam rgyore 'od zer ni/ /gser gyi 'od dang mtshungs pa ste/ /dbang wo dkyil ge rsha largyu rlud / /thams cad tshen rin chen 'byung / /'og nas dal bu rab rgyu ba/ /dkar po kun da zla ba mtshungs/ /chu yi dkyil 'khor la rgyu ba/ /'od chen rdo rje mgon po'o/ /lus kun la ni rjes 'gro'i rlung / /sems kun rab tu 'jug byed pa/ /rnam par snang mdzad rang bzhin du/ /rlung chen de ni rab tu gragagazhes gsungs shing / rdo rje phreng bar/ phal cher 'di dang 'dra ba la/ lnga pa'i skabs su/ 'chi ba'i lus las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ de laganyis las/ sgo gang nas grangs ji tsam rgyu ba ni/ khyab byed kyi rlud 'tshe ba'i tshe dgu brgya pa phrag gcig ma gtogs dngos su gtso bo byas te sna sgo nas mi rgyu ste/rlung gzhan bzhi po'i 'khor gyi tshul du 'dres pas ni ci rigs pa rgyu la/ de nyid kyi dkyil 'khor rgyu ba la dgongs nas/ 'chi ba'i lus las 'byung bar 'gyur/zhes gsungs pa yin no/ /gzhan bzhi la g.yas nas rgyu ba dang / g.yon nas rgyu ba dang / gnyis ka nas drag por rgyu ba dang / gnyis ka nas dal bar rgyu ba ste/gtso bor gyen rgyu dang / thur sel dang / me mnyam dang / srog rlung rnams rim pa bzhin yin te/ de dag kyang gsang ba'i sna rtse nas byung nas kun rdzob kyi sna rtserargyu ba yang zugad pas 'khor lo so so thams cad nas kyang rgyu ba yin la/ gtsobor gong du bshad pa lhar so so'i gnas nges pa dang / snying ga dang/ lte bdang/rdo rje dang / padma'i sna rtser rgyu zhing spyod pa gtso che ba yin no/ /de la dbugs phyir—95—

ldang ba dang / nang du 'jug pa dang / cung zad gnas pa'i cha rnams gcigatubasdoms pa ni/ rlung gcig gam dbugs gcig ste/ de lta bu'i rlud nyi khri cigastong drug brgya zhag gcig la rgyu la/ de yang mgon po re re'i rlung la grangs dgubargya pa re rgyu zhing / dgu brgya de la cha bzhir btang nas nyis brgya nyer lnga pa reyin pas/ rigs chen mgon po de la dbye na rigs chung lha mo bzhi yod pa yin no/ /g.yas nas gyen rgyu me'i rlung dgu brgya pa phrag gcig rgyu ba ni pa blo'i mgon po'i rgyu ba dang / g.yon nas me nyams rlung gi rlung dgu brgya pa phrag gag rgyu ba las kyi mgon po'i rlung dang / gnyis ka nas drag tu thur sel dgu brgya pa phragagacig rgyu ba rin chen mgon po dang / gnyis ka nas rgyu ba zhan pa srog rlung dgubargya pa phrag gcig rgyu ba rdorje mgon po'o/ /de lta bu nyin mo khor gsum dngamatshan mo khor gsum rgyu'o/ /lha mo rnams kyi rgyu ba ni dang po la dpes tshan na/'byung chen spyi me rlung yin kyang nang tshan shas che chung gi dbye ba bzhi ste/ me rlurjokho na shas che ba dang por nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga rgyu ba ni/ me gos dkar mo'i rgyu ba dang / de nas nang tshan cung zad rlung shas che ba nyis brgya nyer lnga rgyu ba ni sgrolawadang / cung zad sa shas che ba nyis brgya nyer lnga rgyu ba ni/ sangs rgyas spyan ma dang /de nas cung zad chu shas che ba nyis brgya nyer lnga rgyu ba ni chu mā ma ki'o/ /'byungachen 'byung chung gi tha snyad ni/ dper na me 'bar ba zhig gi rdul rags pa thams cad ni me rdul yin te de ni 'byung chen no/ /me rdul re re yang grogs 'byung ba lhag ma gsum gyi rdul dang lhan cig gnas pa kho na yin pa 'di ni 'byung chung ngo / /des dkyil 'khor gzhan rnams la yang rigs 'gre'o/ /—96—

de ltar yang dgongs pa lung ston las/ gos dkar la sogs zlasabastso/da pa/ brgya phrag gnyis dang nyi shu lnga/ /bzhi po legs par bsgres nasani/ /sbyor bzhi bsdus pas brgya phrag dgu /dgu brgya dag tu gang bstan pa/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rim gyis ni/ /de ni so sor 'byung ba las/ /nyis khri cig stong drugabargya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa kha dog dang rgyu ba'i tshul nges pa ni/ rludargyu ba thams cad 'od zer sna lnga'i rnam pa yin kyang / padma'i mgon po dmar po shas che/ las kyi mgon po nag po shas che/ 'dir ljang khu zhes pa 'gyur nyes pa yin nam dpyad do/ /rin chen mgon po ser po shas che/ rdo rje mgon po dkarapo shas che/ lha mo rnams la sbyar na/ spyir padma'i mgon po me rlung dgu brgya pa phrag gcig dmar po shas che ba yin pa de la/ me rlung gi me gos dkar mo'i rgyu ba shin tu dmar shas che ba dang / me rlung gi rlung sgrol ma nang tshan du ltos pa'i cung zad nag shas tsheb dang / me rlung gi sa spyan ma cung zad ser shas tsheb dang / me rlud gi chu mā ma ki cung zad dkar shas che ba ste/ des gzhan rnamasalarigs 'gre'o/ /rgyu ba'i tshul yang / steng logs thad ka 'og tu gnas/ /zhesagasungs pa ltar/ 'byung chen gyi dbang du byas na/ me gyen dang / rludagyen gsegs/ chu thad ka dang / sa thur du rgyu ste/ de nyid nang tshan du byas pagadaper na gos dkar mo rgyu ba'i skabs su dmar po dbus/ ljang khu'am nag po g.yon/ dkar po dang ser po 'og /sngon po steng la rgyu'o/ /des mi zhi nasasgrol ma la ljang khu'am nag po dbus dang / spyan ma la ser po dbus dang/ māmaki la dkar po dbus su 'byung zhing / dbus kyi tha snyad mdzad pa ni sna'i b.raka—97—

yin la/ g.yon ni sna gshog dang / 'og ma chu dang / steng sna rtse phyogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ jo bo nā ro pa'i bzhed don bla ma gong ma'i bzhed pasaganas ni 'byung bzhi'i rlung snying gar gnas kyang lte ba nas rgyu ste/ lte ba'i sharanas chu rlung rgyu ba na/ snying ga'i byang mgrin pa'i nub/ spyi bo'i lto nas sna bugagang rung la rgyu ba yin par bzhed la/ gang ltar 'gro 'ong byed pa'i rlung rnamasathams cad bsdu na steng 'og tu 'gro 'ong gnyis su 'du/ steng gi rlung rnams phyira'agro ba'i tshe lte bar sa/ snying gar chu mgrin par me/ spyi bor rlud/ smin mtshams su nam mkha'i khams kyi rim pas 'gro bas 'gyung ba thim rim gyi tshul du rgyu la/ nang du 'ong ba'i tshe de las zlog pas 'byung ba skye ba'i rim pa zho /'ogagi dbang du byas na lhe bar lus dang/ gsang gnas su ngag dang /rdorje 'amagasang ba'i sna rtser yid kyi rim pas te/ phyir 'gro ba'i tshe 'di yang thim rimayin la/ nang du 'ong ba'i tshe yang skye rim mo/ /steng du 'byung ba'i tshe thur sela'ajug pa dang / steng du 'jug pa'i tshe thur sel ldang ba dang / steng phyir gnasapa'i tshe thur sel nang du gnas pa rnams gzhi dus kyi skabs yin la/ rnawa'abyor gyi stobs kyis srog thur gong bu gcig tu byed pa yin no/ /gnyis pa rluda'apho ba'i rnam gzhag la bla med spyi'i lugs dang / bde dges nas sgosasugasungs pa'i lugs gnyis las/ dang po ni gong du bstan pa ltar/ rlung dgubargya pa phrag re la 'pho chen rer byas pa nyin zhag gcig la nyi shu rtsa bzhi 'byung ba yin no/ /dbugs nyis brgya nyi shu rtsa pa re ni 'pho chung re ste/ 'pho chen relade 'dra bzhi bzhir dbye bas nyin zhag gcig la 'pho chung dgu bcu rtsa drug —98—

go /'pho ba'i don yang 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor che chung mi 'dra ba 'phos pa dpa/sna bug g.yas g.yon gyi rgyu ba 'phos pa'i don no/ /gnyis pa la/ 'khor lo so so'i 'pho ba dang / gnas nyi shu rtsa phro 'pho ba'o/ /dang po ni/ lngin zhag gcig la dbyug gu drug cu rtsa bzhi yod de/ lte ba'i rtsa 'dab re re nas dbyug gu re re'i rlung rgyu bas drug cu rtsa bzhi'o/ /dbyug gurel dbugs sum brgya sum cu so phyed dang brgyad do/ /nyin zhag gcig la chu tshod ni sum cu so gnyis te/ spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab re nas chu tshod re'i rlung rgyu ste/dbugs drug brgya bdun bcu don lnga re'o/ /zhag gcig la 'pho ba bcu drugayod de mgrin pa'i rtsa 'dab re nas 'pho ba re rgyu ste/ de la dbugs sum brgya lnga bcu'o/ /zhag gcig la thun tshod brgyad yod la/ snying ga'i rtsa 'dab re nas lhun rdzo re rgyu ste de la rlung nyis stong bdun brgya yod do/ /ge nar lo bzhi nas de rnams dus gcig la rgyu ba yin la/ dus 'khor nas dbyug gu dang chu tshod gcig tu bshad/ bde dges kyi lugs la dbyug gu gnyis la chu tshod gcig tumadzad de/ brda chad so sor mdzad pa yin pas mi 'gal lo/ /der ma zad dbyug tshod che chung mi 'dra'o/ /des lte ba'i rtsa 'dab gnyis dang / spyi i gotsegade'i gnyis dang mgrin pa'i gcig de'i gnyis dang snying ga'i gcig rnams mnyam mo/ /yang 'pho ba bcu drug la ni mgrin pa nas rgyu ba ma yin pa'i lugs/gzhan yang snang ste/ dper na/ phyi na rgyu skar rnams la dbang byed pa zhi lugaglang 'khrig pa karka ṭa/ /seng ge bu mo srang sdig pa/ gzhu dang chu phrin bum pa nya/zhes khyim bcu gnyis/ de dag tu nyi ma dang zla ba lho bgrod dang byang bgrod kyi —99—

tshul gyi rim pas 'pho'o/ /lo dus su zla ba gshol 'dor/ nyi zla dus su gzasa'adzin/ dbyar dgun la sogs pa nas bskal pa'i bar gyi tshad 'dzin par byed do/ /nang du lte ba'i gnas skabs kyi rlung rgyu tshul te/ rgyud sde 'di 'e bzhed pasadangos su rtsa 'dab bcu gnyis med rung / 'pho ba bcu gnyis kyi re re rgyu ba'i rtsal 'dab ma gcig gi ming btags te phyi skor lnga bcu nga drug gi dbang du byas na rtsa 'dab bzhi dang gnyis la cha gsum du btang ba'i cha gcig ni 'di'i skabs kyi 'pho ba re'o/ /phyi skor re bzhi'i dbang du byas na/ rtsa 'dab lnga dang sukhocha'o/ /nang skor brgyad kyi dbang du byas na rtsa 'dab re'i sum gnyis go /de yang lug nas nya'i bar bcu gnyis g.yas skor du gnas pa las rlung stong brgyad brgya pa re 'pho chen re la 'bab/ de la thabs kyi phyogs dgu brgya pa gcig dang / shes rab kyi phyogs dgu brgya pa gcig 'bab pa la nang trelo'abyung chung bzhi bzhi'o/ /'di'i dbang las phyi rol tu 'pho ba bcu gnyis 'byung/'pho ba'i rlung 'di rnams kyi lhag chad las tshes chad lhag dang zla ba gzhol 'dor ba 'byung / nang du khu khrag 'dres pas phyi rol tu nyi zla gzas 'edzen/ de dag gi dbang gis nang du 'byung bzhi'i khams 'phel 'grib 'byung / de'i stobs kyis phyi ru dus bzhi 'byung ngo / /sdom 'byung las/ 'pho ba lhag ma bzhigasungs pa la/ thig le 'gog pa ni phyi ru skar ma'i rgyu ba dang / nang du rtsa 'dab kyi byang chub kyi sems 'phel 'grib byed pa'o/ /nam mkha' 'gog pa ni phyi na nam mkhas go skabs byed pa nang du rlung dbu mar 'bab pas mi rtog pa'i cha shas bskyed pa/ zla ba gzas 'dzin pa ni nang du rkyang ma'i khu ba dang khrag 'dres—100—

pa/ nyi ma gzas 'dzin pa ni nang du ro ma'i khrag dang khu ba 'dres po gi /de bzhin sngar gyi bcu gnyis po'i nang tshan gyi byed las 'ga' zhig zur du bgrangs pa'o/ /'di dus 'khor nas bshad pa'i 'pho ba bcu gnyis dang phal cher 'dra ste/'byung ba'i khams rtsi tshul yang mi 'dra ste/ der ni stong brgyad brgya pa re la 'pho chung lnga mdzad pa sogs yod pa/ sems can so so la dgongs par sems la/nyi ma'i shing rta sogs rjes su bzung ba'i don du yang ste/ 'bum phrag bzhi pa'i 'jig rten bzhin no/ /zhes kyang 'ga' zhig gsung ngo / /phyag rdor bstode 'grel las/ rlud gi 'pho ba gzhan yang yod de/ yi ge mang par 'gyur bsa'adir bzhag go /gnyis pa ni/ slob dpon nag po spyod pas rim bzhir phyi nang go yulanyer bzhi bshad pa'i rjes su pu snyi ra ma la yar dbang du byas so/ /dza 'a zhi raralongs spyod do/ /o rgyan du 'jug go /dza lanta rar dbang du byed do/ /o rgyan du longs spyod do/ /arbu tar brten no/ /zhes sogs nag si rgyur dbang du byed do/ /ma rur longs spyod do/ /ku lu tar brten no/ /ma rur dbang byed do/ /ku lu tar longs spyod do/ /yan lag thams cad la 'jug go /zhes pa'i bar du gsungs te/ nyin zhag gcig gi 'pho chen nyer bzhi'i skabs 'pho ba rere'i rlud gis gnas gsum gsum du khyab pa la/ dbang du byas pa ni rgyu ba'i bya ba zin nas 'pho kha ma dang / longs spyod pa rgyu bdo ba dang / 'jug pa'am brten pa mgo rtsom pa'o/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi song ba'i 'og tu snga ma'i rlung gis lus thamasacad la 'jug ste khor gcig po de rdzogs pa'i dbang du byas kyi/ yang gnas—101—

tshor gsar pa mgo rtsom pa sogs/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas nyer bzhi po rgyun chad med par 'jug ste/ ku lu ta longs spyod pa'i rjes su/ yang rlung gsar pa pu snyi ra ma la yar mgo rtsom snga ma'i rgyun ku lu tar dbang du byas pa na yan lag thams cad longs spyod pa'i skabs su gsar pa pu lir longs spyod/ dza lanta rar mgo rtsom/ rlung snga ma la yan lag thams cad la dbang du byas pa ste mdu nye ba na/ gsar pa'ang pu lir thim du nye/ dza lanta rar rgyu bdo/ o rgyan du 'jugasnga ma'i rgyun thim zin pa na gsar pa'i yang pu lir thim zin nas med pa dang /dza lanta rar thim du nye ba/ o rgyan du longs spyod pa dang / arbu tar mgo rtsom pa sogs rim pas rigs 'gre'o/ /'di la 'pho ba re la dgu brgya ba phrag re yin zhing / yul rer ji tsam rgyu ba ni 'pho ba gsum gyi bar ro/ /'di dag shin tukhams 'phel 'grib la mthu che ba yin no/ /gnas lus sbyor ba'i tshul ni/ /rnal 'byor ma kun spyod las kyang/ /pu lir ma ya mgo bo la//dza lanta ra spyi gtsug nyid/ /o rgyan rna ba g.yas pa ste/ /arbu ta ni rgyab tshigs so/ /gnas so/ /go da ba ri rna ba g.yon/ /ra rmi shwa ra smin ma'i dbus/ /de piko ṭa mig gnyis te/ /ma la ba ni dpung mgoraro/ /nye ba'i gnas so/ /kā ma rā pa ma rma ni khung dgod/ /o ṭa nu ma gnyisala'o/ /zhing ngo / /tri sha ku ne lte ba'i dbus/ kos la ni sna rtser rdo /nye ba'i zhing ngo / ka liṅka ni kha la dgod/ /la sba ka ni mgrin 'dabus nyad/ tsharjo ha'o/ /kañtsi snying la dgod par bya/ /hi ma la ya gsang rtsar rdo /nye ba'i tshwaṭīha'o/ /pre ta pu ri mtshan la ste/ /kṛ ha de ba ta bshang lam/ /'du ba can no/ /so —102—

da ni ni brla gnyis sam/ /gser gling rje ngar gnyis la'o/ /nye ba'i 'dus pa can no/ /na ga ra ni sor mor dgod/ /se rkang pa'i bol rnyas go /durakhrod do/ /ma ru mthe bong gnyis la dgod/ /ku lu ta ni pus mor khag /nye ba'i dur khrod do/ /zhes so/ /sngar bshad pa'i 'pho ba nyer bzhi'i skabs ni yin kyang ngo bo ni mi gcig ste/ de rnams sna sgo nas rgyu ba dang / 'di ni spyi bo sogasasu rgyu zhing spyod pa'o/ /'pho ba nyer bzhi phyi ma 'di bde mchog gi thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam gzhag go /de ltar zhag rer nyi khri chig stong drug brgya rgyu ba de dag ni las rlung zhes bya la/ de dag gi cha shas dbu ma'i skal ba bsdud 'bral mja/ ba ye shes kyi rlung gi ming can drug brgya bdun cu don lnga re rgyu ste lam du ma byas na 'chi ba ster/ lam du byas na des drangs te/ dbu mar 'bab pa'i ye shes kyi rlung dngos su 'gyur ba'ang yin no/ /gnyis pa thig le la ngo bo gnas pa'i tshul dang / de'i 'pho ba zugad pa'o/ /dang po la gsum gyi khams kyi dbye ba ni/ spyir khams so drug ni/ bshangab/ gci ba/ khrag sha /rna ba/ sna/ mig lce/ barsha/nga lam/ skra/ rnagabad kan/ shig srin bu/ chu ser/ zhag ba sbu/ go rgyu ma/ mkhris pa/rus pa/ rkang / mchin pa/ glo ba/ rtsa/ pags pa/ snying/ tshil bu lte nyer bgyon dang / rna ba/ sna/ mig bsha/nga lam/ rtags/ bha ga /ma 'an/ khung// yan lag thams cad de brgyad kyi dri ma dang so drug khu ba khyab byed de so bdun no/ /de bsdu na nyer bzhi ni/ so sen sogs so/ /de bsdu na khams 'ag druganyede yang / gsang ba mchog gi dges pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtagatu—103—

bzhugs/ /zhes pa'i rgya skad/ ra ha phya pā ra ma rā me/ sarpā khru nis dwa snyi ta/zhes pa'i yi ge bcu drug gi khams re re bstan te/ sa spru ṭi las/ ra ni khrag gokhams yin te/ /ha ni ri las byung ba ste/ /phya ni dri yi lo ma yin/ /pu ni pagasapar rab tu bshad/ /ra ni dri nyid yin pa ste/ /yi ge ma ni me tog 4nad/ /rā ni de bzhin lan tshwa'o/ /me ni sha wo por 4zhad do/ /sa ni rab tu sbyor ba nyid/ /drwa ni mgo bor rab tu gsungs/ /lha mo khru ni rkang yin te/ /ni ni dri'i mar khu'o/ /sa ni so dang sen mo ste/ /dā ni rgya mtsho las skyes pa zho /sgri ni khaba'i snying po ste/ /ta ni ga bur bstan pa yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ khrag klad pa/ drim/ pags pa/ bshang ba/ rang byung / dri chu/ sha chen/ tshil/ skra/ rkang/dri chen gyi bcud/ so sen/ glo ba/ mchil ma/ khu bzhi de'i thog mar yigagodon khrag mtha' ma ta yig gi don khu ba ste/ bar pa thams cad de gnyis kyi rnam par 'byung ba'o/ khu khrag rtsa ba yin tshul yang mngal du chags pa'i tshe'ongagazhan rnams kyi rtsa bar gyur pa dang / da lta gnas pa na yang zas sogs kyisakhrag bskyed cing des gzhan rnams bskyed/ thams cad kyi dwangs ma khu bar gyurapa de ni mdangs dang / stobs dang srog gi rten yin no/ /de yang sa spru di dang /lha mo ba'i kha/ zhus sogs las kyang mgrin gcig tu/ pags pa khrag dang sha rnams ni/ /ma las skyes zhes brjod pa yin/ /rus pa rkang dang khu ba ni/ /pha las skyes zhes brjod pa yin/ /zhes pha ma'i khams dkar dmar las byungaba'o/ /gnyis pa rtsa spyi la khams gnas tshul ni/ rtsa gnas 'dir thig le khams 'di gnas zhes gsungs pas gzhi dus su nam dgos 'byung ba la dgongs kyi/—104—

dngos su de na blug pa lta bu ni med de cha shas ni kun tu khyab pa'i tshul lo/ /de dag kyang rdo rje phreng ba las ni/ rtag tu rmad du byung ba'i rtsa/ /stong phraganyi shu rtsabazhi ni/ khu ba 'bab par shes par bya/ /tshig rkang dang po gnyis 'drab la/khrag 'bab par ni shes par bya/ /rlung 'bab par ni shes par bya/ /de rnams kyi rtsa ba rtse nyer bzhi po re re las khu rdul mun pa gsum so sor 'bab pa'i rtsa re re gyes pas bdun cu rtsa gnyis rnams yin pas/ de dang de las byung ba rnamasakhams 'bab tshul mthun pa yin no/ /thugs kyi rtsa chen brgyad ni/ mi phyed walasogs pa brgyad de/ snyigs ma 'bab tshul gong du bshad zin zhing/ dwangasatshamun pa'i khams dang rlung gtso bor 'bab pas thugs kyi rtsa zhes ming btags/gsung gi rtsa chen brgyad ni/ skyon ma la sogs pa ste/ dwangs ma rdul ge mi bora'abab pas gsung du bzhag sku'i rtsa chen brgyad ni gzugs can ma la sogs pa brgyad de khu ba gtso bor 'bab pas sku'i rtsa brgyad ces bya'o/ /'di dag bdun cu rtsa gnyis ni khams 'bab tshul mi 'dra ste/ dper na mi phyed ma mun pa gtsobor 'bab pa yin kyang / de las gyes pa'i rtsa gsum ni khu khrag mun pa gsuraso sor 'bab pa yod pas/ des gzhan rnams la'ang rigs 'gre sho /snyingagachos 'khor gyi phyogs bzhi'i rtsa nas kyang gtso bor rlung kho na 'bab mod kyi/ chashas 'byung ba bzhi'i shin tu dwangs ma'i theg le rnams 'bab bo mtshamasarnams nas bdud rtsi lnga'i dngas ma rnams 'bab ste/ 'di la shar lho nas g.yas bskor gyi khrag dang / khu bdang / sha chen dang / bshang gci rnams 'bab par bla ma gong ma rnams bzhed/ bshang ba dang / gtsib dang / bad rkan dang/ khrag—105—

dang / spyi khyab tu khu ba rnams 'bab par man ngag snye mar bshad do/ /gzugs dri ro reg bya'i dwangs ma rnams 'bab pas mchod pa'i rtsa zhes gsungs/ ro rkyangadabu ma gsum khams gsum 'bab pa ni/ slob dpon nag po spyod pa gde yi nang drenas 'an pa ni/ /rdul dang snying stobs mun pa'i tshul/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ rgyas par sam pu di las/ snying stobs lus te rdul ni ngag khrin pa sems kyi rang bzhin te/ snying stobs khu ba rdul khrag ste/ /de las skyes pa mun pa yin/ /zhes sogs mang du gsungs so/ (〈dzee〉rtsegasum pa )khams kyi gtso bo dbu ma'i nang gi thig le ni/ 'khor lo'i steng 'og rnams nas ro rkyang gisabacings pa'i bar du/ bar stong cung zad yod pa ni rtsa mdud kyi dbus zhes bya ste/de yang snying ga na dkar dmar cha mnyam pa dbus su rnam shes dang lhan cig skyes pa'i rlung drod kyi rang bzhin can mi shigs pa'i rlung zhes bya ba dang lhan cig gnas te mi shigs pa'i thig le zhes bya'o/ /lte ba dang / mgrin pa dang/rtsa rin po che'i pho brang na dmar cha gtso bor gnas pa yin/ spyi bo dang smin mtshams dang / nor bu rnams su dkar cha gtso bos gnas pa yin la/ khyad para'adir shin tu bsngags pa ni dpyid dang thig le ste/ yang dag sbyor ba'i rgyud kyi lung dpyid kyi thig ler drangs pa ni/ snying ga'i nang son padma ni/ /'dab mabargyad pa snying por bcas/ /de yi nang du son pa'i rtsa/ /rang gi wo bo 'bar ba'i me/ /chu shing gi ni me tog bzhin/ /'phyang bzhin kha ni 'og tshun/ /de yi nang son dpa' bo ni/ /yungs kar gyi ni sbom phra tsam/ /gzhom med hu gyis bon ni/ /ba mo lta bur 'dzag pa nyid/ /lus can rnams kyi snying dga' ba/ /'di nodapyid —106—

ces bya bar bshad/ /rgod ma'i me yi gzugs kyi ni/ /phag mo thig lor brjod pa yin/ zhes gsungs te/ snying ga chos snyen ra gyi lte ba'i nang g.yon na cung zad nye ba na/ rtsa chu shing gi me tog ces bya ba kha thur du bstan pa/ de'i nang na mishigs pa'i rang bzhin gyi thig le yungs kar sbom po'i tshad tsam gnas pa ni dga' ba dang bde ba dang tshim pa thams cad bskyed pas dpyid ces bya ba yin no/ /lte ba'i dmar cha ni lam du ma byas pa'i tshe byang chub kyi sems skam parabyed pas rgod ma'i mes rgya mtsho skam par byed pa dang 'dra bas rgod ma'i me'i tshul zhes gsungs pa yin te/ 'di la ni thig le'am phag mo zhes brjod do/ /spyi bo'i haX yig la yang mi shigs pa'i thig le zhes ma rgyud las ni gsungs so/ /spyibo'i haX cha bzhi pa dang / mgrin pa'i dkar cha cha gsum pa dang / snying ge'i chaganyis pa dang / lte ba'i cha gcig par bshad pa ni/ lte ba'i gtum mo dang thaganye rim gyi skams pa shas che ba gyur par/ nā ro ta pa'i slob ma rnams ba ched do/ /slob dpon a bha ya ni/ gsang gnas nas rlung steng du song ba'i tshe lte b.rathung ngu dang / snying gar ring cha gnyis pa dang / mgrin par ring cha gsum pa dang /spyi bor ring cha bzhi pa'i tshad du 'gyur bar bzhed/ gang ltar na yang de dag du dgod bya'i yi ge ring thung gi dag pa ste/ kha spyor las/ lte ba a yi gzugasakyis ni/ /thung ngu ru ni rab tu grags/ /snying la yang ni huX nyid de/ /ring po mamoganyis dang ldan/ mgrin par oṃ gyi gzugs kyi ni/ ma mo gsum brjod gluta/ /dpral par haX gi rnam pa ni/ /sgra dang thig le mi shigs pa/ /zhes gsungasardeso/ /thig le dang rlud las logs su grub pa'i yi ge ni med la/ thig ledang—107—

bcas pa'i rlung des rtsa gnas so son yi ge'i gdangs sam sgra 'byung ba'i nus pa yod pa ni/ de dang der yi ge gnas pa'i don yin la/ yi ge bsgo༅pa yangade'i mtshon don te/ yi ge de dag gi gzugs yod par 'dod pa ni 'thad pa mamathong ngo / /gnyis pa la/ thig le 'pho ba bcu drug zhes bshad de/ bla mgongawarnams ni/ lug gi 'pho ba sogs bcu drug dang yang sbyor bar mdzad de/ 'on kyang 'dir de btang snyoms su bzhag ste/ mdor bsdus su brjod na/ gangala'apho ba'i yul/ ji ltar 'pho ba'i tshul/ de ltar 'phos pa'i dag pa snyegasumardelas/ dang po ni/ skyes pa dang bud med kyi lus la phyi mthe bong la sogs pa'i gnas dang / nang rtsa so gnyis por 'pho ba yin zhing / phyag rgya chen po thigalelas/ rtsa mdud so gnyis po la'ang g.yas g.yon gyi dbye bas bcu drug bcudrug tu bya ste/ 'khor lo bcu drug po rnams kyi steng gi mdud pa rnams ni rkyangams bcings pa'i nus pa yin pas yar ngo dang / 'og gi mdud pa rnams ni ro mas bcings pa'i nus pa yin pas mar ngo dang sbyor te/ de yang rtsa ma du dadangartsaso gnyis po rnams kyi nus pa yin pas de ltar bzhag cing / dngos su 'pho ba nimathe bong la sogs pa kho na'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ skyes pa la yar ngo'i tshes gcig la rkang pa'i mthe bongagayas pa nas mgo 'dzin/ bud med la g.yon pa'i mthe bong nas mgo 'dzin/mar ngo la skyes pa'i g.yon gyi mthe bong dang / bud med kyi g.yas kyi mthe bonganas mgo 'dzin/ rtsa dang sbyar ba'i tshe skyes pa bud med gnyis jig/ g.yon —108—

gyi mthe bong nas brtsams te mi phyed ma sogs bcu drug dang / g.yas kyimathebong nas brtsams te gtso/ mo sogs bcu drug go /zhes bla ma gong ma rnamasagasung ngo / /'on kyang brtag par bya'o/ /gang ltar yang tshes ga khrig la g.yas kyi mthe bong du yi ge a'i ngo bo thig le 'char zhing / tshes gnyis la byin par ā dang / gsum pa la brla la i dang / bzhi pa la gsang gnas 'i/rdzi dang / lnga pa la nye bar u dang / drug pa la snying gar mū dang / bdun pa la nu tshal3dang/brgyad pa la lag pa la grwa dang / dgu pa la lkog mar lo dang / bcu pa lam chun/lī dang / bcu gcig pa la 'khur chos su e dang / bcu gnyis pa la mi tu e dang / bcu gsum pa la rnam par o dang / bcu bzhi pa la spyi bor o dang/ bcolnga pa la spyi gtsug tu a ste 'di ro ma la gnas pa yin par thebad/ ya sgo'i tshes bcu drug pa ste bco lnga'i 'phel ba'i cha rdzogs shing / 'grib pa'i mgo wabartsams pa de la yi ge a tsheg drag can gyi rnam pa dbu mar thim zhing lus thams cad la khyab pa yin no/ /de dag ni skyes pa'i g.yas dang bud med kyi g.yon no/ /mar ngo'i rmas gcig nas brtsams te/ mthe bong nas le sgo ba sogs snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ mar ngo'i tshes bco lnga la spyi bor gnas pa de gtso bor rkyang ma la brten pa yin gsung zhing / mar ngo'i bcu drug la zla ba 'grib pa rdzogs/ 'phel ba ma brtsams pa'i bar der lus thams cad la khyab paraganas pa yin no/ /'di ni skyes pa'i g.yon dang bud med kyi g.yas go /tshesabaco lnga pa gnyis la ro rkyang du gnas pa bzhed pa ni/ khungs gsal po tshamathongabs brtag par bya'o/ /'pho ba'i don ni/ thig le dag gis las byed pa'i ri—109—

mos 'phos pa lta bu yin gyi/ mthe bong gi thig le'i rgyun de byin par 'phos pa ni ma yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ nang gyi byang chub sems kyi snang ba las phyi rol du zla ba 'byung bas zla ba tshes pa bcu drug dang / dga' ba bcu drug dang/byin gyis rlopapar byed pa'i lha mos dbang byas pa dang / 'bras bu sku bcu drug rnams kyidagapa sbyor ba yin no/ /yas brtan dang mas brtan gyi dga' ba bcu drug yas ritshadang mas rim du sbyor zhing / lha'i dag pa ni/ kyai rdo rje las/ rtsa ni gnyis gnyisarnal 'byor ma/ /re re'i rnam pa rnams su brjod/ /rkyang ma ro ma kun 'daram/ /bdag med rnal 'byor ma zhes brjod/ ces gsungs pa'i rim pa rnamasasbyor zhing / 'dir ni rgyud las lha'i dag pa gsal kha ma mdzad kyang/ blatsharnams kyi man ngag gis/ ma mo bcu gnyis dang sku gsung thugs kyi rnal 'byoram brgyad tshan gsum re re bsdoms pas gsum ste/ bco lnga dang / bcu drug pa ni rdo rje phag mo'i dag pa yin la/ rtsa rnams kyi sbyar tshul dang ma mthun no snyaman/ gang nas byung ba dang / gang du las byed pa gnyis dag pa tha dad pa gzhan yang mang bas skyon med gsung / yang rtsa nyer bzhi las gnyis gnyis 'pho b.rere la sbyar/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi la 'pho ba gnyis/ bco lnga'i zhin mo sgomatshamasam kun tu spyod pa dang bcu drug pa'i cha la phag mo zhes 'dod pa'ang yod pas mi 'gal ba zhig gam zhes zhib tu brtag go /gzhan yang / sku bcu drug ni dga' ba bcu drug go 'bras bu yin pas de'i rim pa bzhin sbyar bar byogo /gnyis pa lus gnas 'jig 'chags pa'i rnam gzhag la/ dus kyi 'khoralo—110

sogs nas/ de dag gi dag pa sbyar ba dang / rnam gzhag shin tu rgyas par 'byung mod kyang 'dir ni mi 'chad la/ 'di nyid kyi rgyud dang man ngag las lwa/ngab rim pa cung zad brjod na/ gnas pa dang / 'jig pa dang / 'chags pa'i tshuwagasum las/ dang po ni/ srog gi rlung tshul dang mthun par rgyu ba ni lus gnasapar byed pa'i rkyen yin zhing / rlung tshul bzhin du rgyus pas bad kan dang/mkhris pa dang / rlud rnams cha mnyam pa ni lus gnas par byed pa'i rgyu kho/ /de dag kyang sngon gyi las kyis 'phangs pa gtso che zhing / tshe 'di nyid kyi dge ba'i las la sogs pa 'phral rkyen las gyur pa yang yod do/ /tshe yun ring du dzinasapar byed pa'i thabs/ sngags dang rdzas dang rnal 'byor gyi stobs kyis sgus pa yang rgyud las mang du gsungs so/ /gnyis pa la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang sdowa'abyung sogs las phyi nang gi 'chi ltas kyi rnam gzhag dang / khyad par nang rlung gi ltas la nges pa dang ma ces pa dang nyi zla dang / rgyas pa'i 'chi ltas sogs mang du gsungs pa ni/ rgyud dang man ngag rnams las shes par bya zhing 'dir yi gosa'ajigs so/ /'chi ba'i tshe khams rnams 'od gsal du 'jug pa'i mtshan marnams shes par bya ste/ gzugs phung 'od gsal du 'jug pas/ yan lag thams cad phra ba dang / lus nyams chung bar 'gyur/ tshe long ye shes thim pasasems mi gsal ba dang / sa khams thim pas sgo rnams skam pa lta bu dang/mig dbang thim pas mig zum pa dang / gzu gas thim pas mdangs nyams/pa ste/ rnam snang gi rigs rnams 'od gsal du zhugs pa'o/ /tshor phung thim pasarlung mkhris sogs kyi tshor ba gsol po nyams su mi myong ngo / /mnyam nyid ye —111—

shes thim pas tshor ba gsum mi dran/ chu thim pas mchil ma dang / rdas dngadrichu dang khu khrag skam/ rna ba thim pas phyi'i sgra mi thos/ yul sgra thim pas rang lusakyi sgra mi thos te rin chen rigs so/ /'du shes thim pas 'du shes rnamasamigasal/ sor rtog ye shes thim pas ming rnams mi dran/ me thim pas zasami'as sna thim pas steng rlung dal gyis 'gro/ dri thim pas dri mi tshor te padma'i rigs so/ /'du byed thim pas bya ba la 'jug mi thub/ bya grub ye shes thiwapas bya ba dang dgos pa mi dran/ rlung thim pas rlung bcu rang gnas nas 'pho/lce thim pas lce sbom pa dang thung ba dang rtsa ba sngon por 'gyur/ ro thim pasarodrug nyams su mi myong ste las kyi rigs so/ /de rnams ni rags pa nyi shu thitshalugs so/ /nang gi 'byung bzhi phra ba thim lugs ni/ sa chu la ma pas sgulaskyod mi nus shing zung mi thub/ lus bying ba snyam byed/ nang rtags smin rgyu lta bu 'byung / chu me la thim pas kha sna skam zhing lce phugs su 'gro/ nang rtags du ba lta bu 'byung / tshe rlung la thim pas drod mtha' nas sdud/ nang rtags srin mu me khyeralta bu 'byung / rlung nam mkha' la thim pas phyi dbug chad/ nang rtags mar tsheltabu 'byung / de rnams su rnam shes kyi phung po dang / nam mkhe'i khams dang /chosadabyings ye shes dang / lus dbang dang / reg bya rnams thim ste/ de'i rjesasurang bzhin so gsum 'gag /gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog rags pas stong pas stong pa'am shes pa'i rang mdangs gsal bar snang bas snang ba zhes bya ba 'char/ 'di'i skabs su spyi bo'i haX yig rtsa ba nas chad de snying khar bab pas zla ba ltar skya lam pa'i snang ba 'byung / de nas sems snang ba dang po de nyid sems—112

byung la thim pas/ 'dod chags sogs rang bzhin bzhi bcu 'gag gzunga'adzin gyi rtog pa phra rags 'gags pas shin tu stong pa zhes bya sems shin tu gsal bar snang bas snang ba mched pa zer 'di skabs lte ba'i a yig rtsa ba nas chad de snying khar 'bar bas dmar lam pa 'byung / de yang sgyu ma lta burazar zir mthong / sems byung ma rig pa la thim pas/ rang bzhin bdun 'gags gzung 'jin gyis stong tshul snga ma las kyang lhag pas stong pa chen po zhes bya/ sems 'gags pa la phyogs pas snang ba nyer thob/ 'dir srog dngathur sel gyi rlung gi cha shas phra mo tsam zhig dbu mar gnas pa yang thim pas nag lam pa 'char zhing dran med du 'gyur/ de nas sems snying gar thig le dkar dmar gyi dbus su cung zad gnas pa na/ ma rig pa 'od gsal la thim/thams cad stong pa 'od gsal mtha' dbus med pa'i nyams 'char 'chib 'od gsal chos sku'am/ 'chi ba shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya/ 'chibathams cad la 'di 'char te/ lam la ma goms pa rnams 'khrul nas 'khorabar 'jug pa yin/ rlung sems dbur mar bcings pa rnams ni skabs 'edira'od gsal mngon du byed do/ /gsum pa la thog mar bar do grub tshul dang/des skye ba len tshul lo/ /dang po la bar do grub tshul dang / grub zin pa'i bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'chi ba 'od gsal las langs ma thag thob pa rangabazhin bdun dang bcas pa skye/ de las mched pa rang bzhin bzhi bcu dngaga~X ༵sa la/ ༵ sdu / ༵ se~X spu shā~X ༵ rjo ༵ dkard lto/༵ —113—

rten dang bral nas/ bar do'i lus 'grib pa yin zhing / de'i rten thig lo yangadakar po thur du lhung zhing dmar po gyen du song ba'i bar nas rnam shes gzhan du 'pho ba yin zhing / snang gsum lugs zlog tu 'byung ba des/ srog 'dzen dang/me mnyam dang / khyab byed kyi ming can dug gsum gyi rtog pa'i bzhon par gyurapa'i rlud ma rig pa'i rtsa bas bcings pa can gyi bar do'i lus sems grub pa dus mnyam/ 'dir/ jo bo nā ro ta pa'i gsung bgros las/ tshe 'ar rlungalegs par bsgoms na skyes ba gar len rnam shes dbang che/ ma bsgoms na rlung dbang che bas rlung rta dang mtshungs/ 'on kyang rgyud 'di'i dpa' bo dang rnawa'abyor ma rnams gzhan pas byin rlabs myur ba yin pas/ 'dir dbang bskurathob cing dam tshig ma nyams pa/ lha dang bla ma la yid brtan pa zhig yin na/dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis mchog tu brtse bas gzigs nas de'i mthus ngo shes pa 'byung ste/ bar dor ri bo stobs pa dang 'dra ba'i 'jigs snang byunganas/ gnyen 'dun la sogs pa'i drung du bros pa na/ ngo ma shes te der bar do yin par shes nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor dran pas/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byoram mang pos zhal bstan nas rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas rnams su 'khrid pa'am/mtho ris kyi gnas su skye ba gdam du rung bar byed pa yin gsungs te/ man ngag gi gnad dam pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ bar do'i lus de yang gang skye bar 'gyur ba de'i rnam pa tshebazhin lag dang dbang po tshang ba/ rlud sems tsam las grub pa/ gang bsawapar sleb pa/ ma'i mngal dang rdo rje'i gdan ma gtogs pa la thogs pa med pa/—114—

de'i tshe'i tshad kyang thung ba'i mtha' dus mtha'i skad cig ma tsam nas zhag bdun gyi bar du gnas pa yin la/ de las lhag pa bar do'i tshe gcig gis ba nas pa med pas/ skye ba'i tshogs pa ma rnyed na zhag bdun bdun nas snga ma'i lusashizhing bar do'i lus gsar pa re len pa yin no/ /'on kyang bdun phrag bdun gyinang du tshogs pa mi rnyed pa mi srid pas skye ba len zhing / brdzus te skye na gnasal sred pa dang / drod gsher las skyes na dri ro la sred pa dang / sgong skyes samamangal skyes la ni gcer bu char bas bdas pa'i snang ba byung nas/ khang bzangangam phug pa la sogs par bros pa'i snang ba 'byung ste/ der pha ma 'dus pa mthong ba'am/ khu khrag la de lta bu'i phyin ci log gi snang ba 'byung ste/ mor skye na pha la chags shing ma la sdang phor skye na ma la chags shing pha la sdang / gang ltarayang de dang rtse dga'i sems kyis drung du reg pa na rtags sam skye gnas ma gtogs/ gzhan ma mthong bas khro ba'i sems 'byung ste/ khro ba de'i rkyen gyisabar do'i lus zhig ste khu khrag gi dbus su 'jug pa yin no/ /'chi ba dngabarado'i rnam gzhag lugs so so mi 'dra ba'i khyad par dang bcas pa rgyas par gzhan du shes par bya la nyadir bla ma gong ma'i man ngag gtso che bar byas te bkod do/ /gnyis pa la rtsa rlung chags tshul dang por nges par bya ba dang/ lusaspyi'i 'chags tshul mdo tsam bshad pa'o/ /dang po la rtsa chags tshul ni/ rmangaladu zla ba gcig rtsa chags pa med de/ gcig kho na'i mtshams nas snying ga'i thad kyi dbu ma chags shing / de dang dus mnyam du ro ma/ rkyang ma/ gsum skor ma/'dod ma ste/ snying gar dang por sas pa'i rtsa lnga'o/ /dbu ma'i nang du mi—115

shigs pa'i thig le thog ma nas lus 'grub byed kyi thig le de yang der gnas 0ri no ra tsho sdishā yig 0si tresashang/da dang pa ste sbyi gas pa'o tshul du byang de kya 'a gsum ༷ rakta 'bru gsum ga la cha drug kyang 'grub/da 'a khyam ma she/gtso/rdem 'a /bsdud 'bral ma da ge ge ge por ge zhe mu zhe ge ge cha /stsa nga kau dang sngur na kho/pa' rtsa brgyad o bya/da las ga ston sde sde sgyu dag shad 'dab ma na khri mu brdu pa skye ste / de/rnams bskyed tshul ni rtsa lnga cud na ga lhas dang /gas sgo ge mu dzon rtsa nyi sa// rnams bskyed tshul rtsa lnga yi ri/ gā nas bzung ste/nas zla bzhi/rtsa brgya re skye ste/bye )sa glu ba bcu mu kyā bar nghru btsaX sa zla mni dzhai ba rman rtsa bdun dges stang chags spyo ji mas 0 //pa rdzags sa//dbu ma tai ༷ nasayas mas su skye zhang /rdo phran kho / rnams pags pa dang sha dang bcas pa ba spya~Xrdo mar lor pas che/chi ge de ge zhes tshong ba dge de /rgyus/ pa dang rkang rnamaX/rkangamanas yar si snying pa shas/da nas rnyi snging dbu gsum yas mas susang skas blo kho /nye bdang nga rnyi chags/'de nas ba dang gsang 'i ba'i chags de nas mchas dang rtsa sa chen ba ba byuganyis te/de nas ge mu bu mo go kho rngu khri / rderge ge'/de 'a 'as chen ༷sdo yi mi ༷ rdza she pa gnyus gru ma 'i/ shezi ga kha de she/༈༷༵dhi/kha/bal ga pa gnyas /mas su ༵stiramu ge ge ge/ she sar sa ni tshigs kyang 'grub gsung /da rnams rtsa 'dab gya grangs dus zhabar las sa wo rnams la 'dab ma mu dzñā re smra dgo/sor tshigs rnams she/da/)//rlud chags tshul na/ ra rlungakhams tsam snga nas yad kyang rtsa gnas 6 rlung 'grub pa yang mngal du zla ba

gcig gi mtshams su dbu ma grub pa dang / srog 'dzin gyi rlung chags pa dusamanyam ste/ skyes bu'i tshe'i gnas skabs la khyab 'jug gi 'jug pa bcu dang sbyor ba'i bcu ni/ nya dang rus sbal phag pa dang / /mi yi seng ge mi'u thung dang/ /rām rā ma nag po dang / /sangs rgyas kalki ta te bcu/ /rā ma sngon mni dgra starām/ phyi ma dga' byed rā ma/ ka zhi ta ni rigs ldan no/ /de ltar zla ba dang pokhukhrag 'dres pa/ nya ro hi ta ltar dmar skyar snang ba dang nar por yod pas lusanya'i rnam par gyur pa'o/ /zla ba gnyis pa la thur sel skye/ lus yan lag lnga'i rnam pa 'bur por dod pas rus sbal gyi rnam pa dang / zla ba gsum pa lamemanyam skye/ lus sgur por snang bas phag gi rnam pa 'gyur/ zla ba bzhi pa larostod rgyas shing gdong gi rnam pa dod pas mi'i seng ge'i rnam par 'gyur/ zla ba lnga pa la tshigs rnams la khyab byed skye ste/ yan lag thung ngu tsam grub pa mi'u thungagi rnam pa'i mgo tshugs nas/ zla ba drug pa la rlung klu dang 'byung ba sa khams/kyirlung rnams shas cher skye/ zla ba bdun pa la rlung rus sbal dang chu rlung shas cheraskye/ zla ba brgyad pa la rtsangs pa dang me rlung rnams shas tsher skye/ zla ba dgu pa la/ lhas byin dang rlud gi rlud shas cher skye/ zla ba bcu pa la gzhu rgya5grub/lus dbang dang mkha' khams rdzogs nas btsas pa'i dus te rlung bcu chagasatshul lo/ /so skyes pa nas dgra star rā ma ste gcod par byed pas sgo /so lhunganas dga' byed rā ma ste/ lo bcu drug tshun chad 'khrig pa'i longs spyod med pasaso/ /de nas nag po ste g.yo sgyu shas che bas so/ /rgan por gyur pa na sangasargyas te bu dang tsha bo sogs la 'doms par byed pas so/ /shi ba na rigs ldan —117—

te 'byung bzhi gcig tu gyur pas go /dus kyi 'khor lo'i lugs la btsas pa nimi'i seng ge dang / btsas zin nas mi'u thung du 'jog pa ni khyad par ro/ /blamarnams kyis bzhed pa ni zla ba drug pa nas bcu pa'i bar la dgra sta rā ma sogs lnga sbyar te zla ba bcu/ 'jug pa bcur sbyor bar mdzad pa'ang rung ro/ /phro don no/ /gnyis pa ni/ mngal 'dzin pa'i thog mar bar dor rnam shes rakta lami'ajug khu ba la 'jug ste/ phyi rol du nyi ma la gza' 'jug ces pa 'ang/nyi wal dngos su 'jug mi thub pas/ gnam stong gi nyin bar nyi zla kha sbyor du byung ba na zla ba la gza' 'jug pas nyi ma la'ang zhor la 'jug go /rnam shes rlud dngabacas pa sgra gcan gyi chos/ dkar dmar nyi zla'i chos so/ /mngal du khu rdu5gyi bar du bar do'i rnam shes zhugs pa na bar srid kyi lus 'gags shing btang nas sems dang khu khrag rten brten par gyur pa ni skye ba blangs pa'i thog ma yin la/ de nas sems bde bas brgyal ba'i gnas skabs de bde ba dam pa'iyeshes zhes 'ga' zhig las gsungs te/ bde ba'i rten thig les byin gyisabarlabs pa shas che bas de ltar btags kyi tshor ba bde ba tshes myong ba ni med de gnyid 'thug po ltar brgyal ba'o/ /de nas dkar dmar gyi 'gyung bas nyer len dang / ma'i mngal gyi 'byung bas lhan cig byed rkyen byed de mngal gyi sa khamasakyis sa bon mi lhung bar 'dzin/ chus gong bur byed/ mes ma nyid kyis chosashing 'thungs pa dwangs ma sa bon de la 'jug rlung gis 'phel zhing rgyasapar byed/ mngal gyi bu ga nam mkha'i khams kyis 'phel ba'i skabs 'byin/ sa —118—

bon rang gis sas sra bar byed/ chus mnyen zhing mi 'bral bar byed/ mes zasakyi dwangs ma smin par byed/ sa bon gyi tshe rtsa gnas kyi rlung bcu med kyang/ spyirarlung bcu'i cha shas yod pas de dag gi 'phel bar byed/ rang nyid kyi nam mkhas 'phel ba'i skabs byed do/ /rnam par shes pa dang bral na gzhan rnams thamasacad bya ba mi byed pas rnam shes ni bdag po'i rkyen no/ /zla ba gnyis pa'i mjug tu mgo bo dang rkang lag dod par byed de/ gal te pho yin na dku g.yasalabarten zhing ma'i tshigs pa la mdun bstan te gnas/ mo yin na dku yon labarten zhing ma'i tshigs pa la rgyab brten nas gnas so/ /zla ba bzhi pa rdzogs pa na sor mo'i bar du rdzogs pa zla ba lnga pa na sha la brten nas shin tu snyi ba'i rus tshigs sum brgya drug cu rtsom ste/ zla ba drug pa'i bar du chags/ de'i tshe pagasapa dang khrag kyang shas cher 'grub/ zla ba lnga pa'i bar du shin tu rmongs pa brgyawaba'i gnas skabs yin/ de nas tshor ba bde sdug kyang shes/ sngon gyi skyeb yangadran/ phyi ma'i dus kyang ci rigs par shes/ de nas zla ba bdun pa la smin tshadang skra dang / sbu dang / mig la sogs pa dbang po'i rten rnams 'byung lce skye/de'i stobs kyis zla ba brgyad pa la bshang gci'i cha shas kyang 'byung / zla ba dgurdzogs tsam mam bcu pa la mngal nas skye'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' srid pa tham pa lhums su zla ba bcu gnyis gnas pa dbang po yongs su smin pa'i don dang / gzhan yang bcu gcig bcu gnyis bcu gsum sogs ci rigs pa'i mjug tu yang mngal nas 'byung ngo / /de nas mngal nas 'byung ba'i tshe phyi rolagyi rlung sna sgor zhugs pa'i rkyen byas te dbugs 'byung 'jug 'byung zhing/ de —119—

yang mgon po bzhi'i rlung tshar gcig ma 'khrug par rgyus pas 'byung ba mi'akhrugs shing 'tsho ba yin la/ der 'khrugs par rgyun na nad mi bzad padanga'achi ba la sogs pa 'ong ngo / /dus kyi 'khor lo las ni thog mar dbu mo'i dbugs nga drug rkang bcas 'bab cing / de nas phyi'i dus sbyor gang yin pa de dang mthun par g.yas g.yon gang rung la 'bab la/ de nas gzung nas zhagarel nyi khri chig stong drug brgya re 'bab cing / 'pho ba drug sna bug g.yas pa rgyu/drug g.yon la rgyu zhing / g.yas la rgyu ba na sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor re re la sum brgya drug cu re rgyu ba 'pho ba re ste/ g.yon pa rnams la 'byungaba'i go rim de las zlog pa'o/ /'pho mtshams su dbugs nga drug rkang pas bzhi cha dang bcas pa 'bab ces gsungs pa yang / dbu mar 'bab pa'i cha thur du bgrangs pa yin gyi/ stong brgyad brgya la mi gtogs pa ma yin no/ /gang ltarayang skabs der rlung de lhar rgyus pa las dbang po rnams sad de yul snang rags pa'i 'khrul pa 'byung / yul gyi mtshan ma mthong nas gzhan la smra b.ra'adod pa'i rtog pas rma bskul te/ rlud gi gdangs drag po lce rkan 'phrad pa'i rkyen gyis yi ge dang ming dang tshig dang brjod pa sna tshogs pa 'byung ngo / khus5rlung gsum po rim pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi rgyur bzhag pa ni/ gsu5gnagasum kas bskyed pa tsam du 'dra mod kyang / bskyed tshul gyi khyad par yin te/khur bas lus 'grub pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu byed/ gzhan gnyis kyisagrogs byed de/ 'og ma gnyis la'ang rigs 'gre'o/ /de rnams kyang/sdoza'abyung las/ sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin/ /rab tu mi shes mi rnams ni/ /thog—120—

med dus can nyon mongs kyi//bag chags rab tu bsags byas pa//des na sngon byas las kyis ni//skye dang 'chi ba yang dag 'byung //tshogs pa ma rnyed de srid du//zhag 'dun bar do'i srid par gnas//srid pa bar rda'i sems can ni//mgron po rnams kyis bgrod par bzhin//'di lta las kyi srad bu yis//'gro ba drug tu rab tu rgyu//dang po pha ma'i kun sbyor las//srid pa'i skye bo can du mthong //shin tu nges par kun dga'i stobs/kha yi lam la rab tu'ajug/rta zhon pa yi rnam shes ni/rlung gi bzhon pa zhon pa bzhin/khyen tumyur bar 'ongs gyur te//skad cig thang cig tsam la ni//gnyis dang stong phragabadun cu'i rtsa//rab bskul de yi skad cig la//mchog tu dga' ba yang dgathob//ā li kā li zhu byas pa'i/khu khrag de dag god bus swa//thig le'i rdegazugs kyis gnas par 'gyur//dang por nur nur por rnam pa//mer mer po ni gnyis pa yin//ltar ltar por skyes gsum pa ste//bzhi pa gor go re poranyid do//rlung rnams kyi ni bskul ba na//nya yi rnam pa lta bur 'gyur//zla ba lngar gyur sa bon las//yan lag lnga ni rab tu skye//skra sbu sen mo rnams dang rtags//zla ba bdun gyis skye bar 'gyur//dbang po rnams dang gzugs rnamasani//zlab brgyad las skye par 'gyur//zla ba dgu yis yang dag rdzogs//zla ba bcu na sems dang ldan//mi bskyod gzugs kyi nur nur po//zhes sogasardegasungs te/don rnams ni gong du zhib mor bshad zin te/sgyu ma lta bu'i tingange'adzin ni/rlung sems tsam las grub pa'i sku yin te/ma shi tshud chad du de grub na srid par skye ba mi len pas/de mi shes pa zhes gsungs pa yin la/gnyisarde

dang stong phrag sogs ni/ mngal du lus 'grub pa'i thig le ni rtsa stong phragabadun cu rtsa gnyis kyi dwangs mar ston pa'o/ /mchog tu dga' ba yang dgathob/ /ces pa ni/ dus der rlung dbu mar cung zad thim pas rlung yang cung zad mnyam rgyur 'gro la/ der dga' ba bzhi thob pas 'jug tu sa bon lhung zin pa'i skabs slar yang rlud dang po'i rgyun bzhin du 'gyur te/ g.yas la 'bab na khye'udang / g.yon pa 'bab na bu mo yin la/ mnyam rgyu nyid la gnas na mni nga du 'gyur ro/ /de rnams kyi dag pa ni/ dus kyi 'khor lo sogs nas ma shas ni mi'adra ba mang du bshad kyang / 'dir ni 'chi ba chos sku dang / bar do ni los sku dang / skye ba ni sprul sku dad / len pa po'i sems ni bde chen gyi sku'o/ /mngal du brgyal ba'i gnas skabs chos sku/ skye ba dran pa sogs ni longs sku/ btsas pa ni sprul sku'o/ /mngal gyi gnas skabs lnga dang / phung po lnga yang de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i dag pa yin pa dang / gnyid 'thug po ni chos sku/rmi lam ni longs sku/ skye ba ni sprul sku/ snyoms 'jug ni bde ba chen po'i skras dag pa rnams so/ /de rnams kyi bar sdom ni/ 'jug tshul skye srid blang ba'i tshad/ /'gyung bzhi'i las dang zla ba'i grangs/ /btsa' ba'i dus dang rnam grangs bkod/ /lungadon dag pa'i dbye ba'o/ /gsum pa gtan la phab pa'i dgos pa ni/ rtsa rludathig le'i rnam gzhag zhib mor ma shes na khams 'jug tshul dang / rlung 'jumoganas thim pa'i rim pa dang / rtsa la gnad du bsnun tshul dang / 'byung ba'ikhams kyi rim pa la brtan nas gegs sel dang bogs 'don byed tshul rnams mi shes la/ 'di rnams shes na de dag bde blag tu zhes pa yin no/ /'chi srid —122—

kyi rnam gzhag legs nga ra shes pas 'chi ba lam 'byer dang da lta yang 'od gsal du 'jug tshul gyi khyad par shes shing / bar do dang skye srid kyi rim pa yangam shes na 'khordo ra bar 'ju ga tshul mi shes pas/ de dang rnam pa mthun parabasgom pa'i gnyen po rnams kyi rnam gzhag zhib mo rtogs dka' la/ rdze rnamasartogs na de dag rtogs sla ba'i dgos pa yod do/ /gsum pa ni/ rim bzhi nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i spyi'i mngon rtogasate/ 'on kyang rgyud sde mang po la nges pa ster bar 'gyur rdo /de lagasum/chosathams cad rang lus kyi rgyu can du gtan la dbab pa dang / bzhi 'bras dgapa rgyas par bstan pa dang / de nyid gang la rag las pa'i lam gyi ro bo'o/ /dngapo la/ 'khor lo bzhi'i chos rnams gtan la dbab pa dang / sku gsung thugs kyi chos gtan la dbab pa dang / thabs dang shes rab kyi chos gtan la dbab pa'o/ /lus sems thun mong ba'i skabs 'di rnams ni/ slob dpon chen po nagapo spyod pa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa/ gsang ba'i de nyid rab tu gsal bdang/rim pa bzhi pa dang / dpyid kyi thig le rnams zhib tu mnyam pa las gzhan du mtha' chod pa dka' mod kyi/ 'on kyang de rnams kyi mjug sgo bstan pa tsamamador bsdus par brjod na/ dang po ni/ spyir rgyud sde rnams las bzhi tshan du sbyar ba'i chos mtha' yas pa zhig gsungs pa las/ 'dir nye bar mkho ba tsirigs pa bsdus pa ni/ yi ge bzhi/ phyag rgya bzhi/ 'byung ba'i rlung bzhi/ blten/ sgrub yan lag bzhi/ bden pa bzhi/ sde pa bzhi/ cha shas bzhi/ skad cig mabazhi/ dga' ba bzhi/ 'bras bu bzhi/ ma sna'i/ gam bzang po'am gsal ba bzhi/ba123—

gdan bzhi/ de kho na nyid bzhi/ tshad med bzhi/ phar phyin bzhi/ lha rmobazhirnams so/ /dang po ni/ e wa ma ya bzhi ste/ lte ba e dang snying gawa gyi rnam paraganas shing / mgrin pa'ang ma ste thig le'i rnam pa dang / spyi bo yang yi go ya stokhong stong gi rnam pa can du gnas pa la/ de bzhin gshegs pas brda mdzad pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ lte bas gtum mo 'bar ba'i las byed pas las kyi phyagargya snying ga ni sems kyi rten yin la des chos thams cad la rgyas 'debs pa'i phyir chos kyi phyag rgya/ mgrin pa nas ngag 'byung la/ ngag ni grag stong nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i phyir phyag rgya chen po spyi bo ni bde ba chen po'i dam tshig gi gnas yin pa'i phyir dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /bla ma rje btsun rdorje 'chang gi zhal snga nas kyi man ngag ni/ spyir lam phyag rgya bzhi tshang dgos shing / bzhi kas kyanga'akhor lo bzhi ka'i rtsa mdud dgrol ba'i nus pa yod mod kyi/ 'on kyang phyag rgya bzhi po so so bsgom pa las snyen ra lo de dang de thog mar grol ba'i nus pa yod de/ 'di rnams so sogatso bor bsgom pa las/ bde stong 'thug po dang / gsal snang mang po dang / sems can gyi blo dang mtshams par chos skyi sgo ma 'gags pa ston pa dang / bde gsal gyi nyams 'khrul pa dang bcas pa 'byung bar snangagasungs te/ rgyu 'bras mngon sum du gzigs pa'i bka'o/ /rigs pas kyanga'athad cing shin tu legs par mthong ngo / /des na 'khor lo bzhi la gnad du bsnun pas phyag rgya bzhi'i rtogs pa skye ba'am/ phyag rgya'i bzhi la gnad du bsnun pas 'khor lo bzhi dag par 'gyur bas phyag rgya bzhi 'khor lo bzhi la sbyar ba yin no/ /o la pa ti'am rim pa bzhi pa las/ tshe lo ma ya/ tshe ni las—124—

kyi phyag rgya'o//wa ni chos kyi phyag rgya'o//ma ni phyag rgya wo po'o//ya ni dmatshig phyag rgya'o//zhes gsungs pa'i don legs par bshad pa yin no//gsum pa ni/spyir gong du bshad zin mod/myur ba ni me rlud dang/rlangs pa ni rlung gi rlung dang /rnam par 'ching ba'am rnam 'dud ni sa'i rlungadang /sna tshogs gnas pa'am dal ba can ni chu rlung ngo //rgyu tshul gi o la pa ti las/chu tshod ni sum cu rtsa gnyis so//dbyug gu ni drug cu rtsa bzhig/'pho ba ni bcu drug go/thun ni bzhon//zhes gong du bstan pa ltar te/steng dngasogs kyang de dag rgyu ba'i tshul te mgrin pa nas me'i rlung rgyu ba la sogs pa'o//myur ba phyir 'gro ba dang /slangs pa nang du ma 'ongs pa'i bar dang /dal ba 'ju / ga pa dang /'a cing ba gnas pa la bshad pa dang /de dag la 'byung bzhirim pa bzhin sbyar ba gong dang 'dra ba ste/'byung bzhis bya ba byed tshul tshwa che chung gi dbye'o//bzhi pa ni/lte ba ni bsnyen pa ste gtum/ mo ni lte bar 'bar ba yin la/de nyid bde ba chen po la nye zhing bsnyen pa yin pas so/snying ga ni nyer sgrub ste/der gtum mo 'bar ba ni rtsa mdud grol dka' ba grol byed yin pas bde chen sgrub pa la shin tu nye bar song bas so//mgrin pa ni sgrub pa stoder gtum mo 'bar ba na/lte ba'i me dang mgrin pa'i me gnyis 'a sgos pasame shin tu stobs che bar gyur te/zhu bde 'phral du sgrub pa'i nus pa spod pasaso//spyi bo ni sgrub wo te/der gtum mo 'bar na dngos su bde wo bskyed nus pas so//bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi gsungs pa'i rgyud kyi nges don yangayin te/bsnyen pa'i ting 'dzin rab spyor ba/zhes gong du lung drangs zin pa de

nyid kyi don te/byang chub mchog ra ri/sing thim pa ste/de lasamu ge ge mo 'bar ba'o//rdo rje skye mu ge rtse rdo snying ga 'a rtsa mdud 'a ba na ga po ni kya st+ri5rde dnga~Xhā//sngags kya bdag po /mgran par ngag thams cad bskyed pa' nus pa nga ga ste de bskul bzho/rangasngags rdo rje can ni/lte ba'i gtum mo sngags kya de nyid du'ang bshad pasadedang /rdo rje can ni snying ga'i thig le'o//dbu brgyan la gos kyi bdagapo0ri :de :re yi mi /spri/bsam pa' don /haX las byung ba byang chub kya sems gshul mos borasleb pa'o//pe ni skrub chen no lnga pa ni pa'i tshe/'bar 'dzag khyad par can gyibade stong skye ba sgrub chen no//'di /lte bar gnas pa'i rlung sems kyi byed pas sdug bsngal can gyi phung po 'a— rnams snang sna'i phyir sdug bsngal bden pa dang /las snyes 'a pa las rwa thung bye dho// nga ga'i rlung sems kyi byed pasanyon mongs 'byung ba 'a phyar kun 'byung nga ga dang /las nyon 'bras bu dang bcas pa 'gags pa'i ye shes ni mgrin pa'i rlung sems stong par thim pa'i byed sing migs pas mgrin rno 'gog bden dang /dza ge' la byed pa'i gi paralam gya dmags rnam rnams— bor rlung sems 'dus pa'i sems snang ga rtsa ba can yin pa'i phyir spyi bo lam bden te/'khor lo bzhi la gnad du bsnun pasab// bzhi'i don ma phro sum rtogs ri zhi nus pa can dzi pa'i phyir bden zi nga she ste/yang gtum mo 'ba' skre la sbyar ba /gtum/ mo sbar ba sags kya rtsol bsang la ba dang /bab pa'i chos ༵mas cad bo tshor lo bzhi phya/rodrug 'gog pa dang /byang sems 'bab ༷ lam na pas 'khor ra lo ba zhes de

ltar btags par bzhed do//drug pa ni/'khor lo bzhi po so rbe'i rlud semasakyi byed pa shas che ba las sde pa ba ni so so'i grub mtha' 'byung ste/dper na 'phags pa gnas brtan pa rnams kyi lta spyod sgom pa ni/lte ba rlung semasarde'adus pa'i rnam rtog shas che ba mang du tshogs pa las byung ba bzhin no//rgyo don ni rlung rnams phal cher lte bar gnas shing brtan pa yin la/lus kyi 'phela'agrib ni rlung gis byed pa'i phyir lus bskyed pa'i gnas su song bas gnas brtan pa dang /snying ga ni rnam rtog gi gnas kyi gtso bo yin zhing/de 'ang/grub mtha' sna tshogs kyi chos smra bar byed pas snying ga thams cad yod smra dang/rodrug po rnams kyis bkur bsti byed pa'i gnas yin pas mgrin pa mang bkur ba dang bde ba'i rgyu byang chub kyi sems phal cher spyi bor gnas pas spyi bo dge 'dun phal wo pa'o//kyai rdo rje las kyang /gang phyir sprul pa'i dzinas brtan phyir//sprul pa'i 'khor lor gnas brtan nyid//chos ni smra bar byung ba'i phyir//chos kyi snyen ra lor thams cad yod//gang phyir mgrin par ca bkuraphyir//longs spyod wor lor kun bkur nyid//gang phyir bde wo khoraganas pas//bde ba'i 'khor lor dge 'dun che//sde pa zhes bya sku ru sngon/ces gsungs so//bdun pa ni/chung ngu thig le cha gcig pa dang/'bringachaganyis pa dang /chen po cha gsum pa dang /chen po'i chen po ma bzhin pa ste/dernams kyi mthu las rnam rtog gam 'du shes kyang dbye ba bzhi po de 'byung ste/dngos po gang la gcig tu 'dzin pa mig sman la nag po kho nar 'dzin pa lta bu 'du shes chung ngu dang /the tshom za ba lta bu cha gnyis pa na 'bring dang/da ltar gyi

mchod rten 'di ni sngon lhan byin gyis bzhengs la ma 'ongs pa na 'jig par 'gyur ro snyam pa lta bu dngos po gcig las khyad par mi 'dra ba gsum gyi 'du shes 'jug pa ni chen po dang / ge ngos po gcig nyid la yang khyad par du me'i 'du shes 'jug pa ni chen po'i chen po'o/ /brgyad pa dang dgu pa ni 'og tu'achad par 'gyur te/ 'khor lo de rnams su de dag 'char ba yin no/ /bcu pa ni/ thun mong ma yin par dga' bzhi dang sbyar ba 'og tu 'chad la/ 'dir 'bras bu bzhi yin tshad la ni mi sbyor gyi/ sems can gyi rgyud dugatogs pa la sbyor te/ rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bu 'byung ba'i las gang yin pa ni/lte ba'i rlung sems kyi mthu dang / de bzhin du rnam smin bskyed pa'i las ni snyingag dang / skyes bu byed 'bras bskyed pa'i rtsom pa ni mgrin pa dang / bral 'brasabaskyed pa'i lam bsgom pa ni spyi bo ste/ de dag gi rlung sems kyi byed pas de rnams kyi las la rtsol bar byed pa'o/ /bcu gcig pa ni/ lte ba ni bdag gi gnas te gtum mo'i gnas bzang po yin pa dang / snying ga ni gtum mo lasagazhan pa'i mi shigs pa'i thig le gnas sa yin pas gzhan bzang po dang /'bar 'dzag thog ma brtan pa'i dus kyi gnas mgrin pa yin pas de ni dus bzang po dang / ye shes skye ba'i rgyu ni spyi bo'i thig le zhu ba yin pas spyi bo ni yeshes kyi bzang po'o/ /bcu gnyis pa ni/ lte ba'i rlud sems kyi byed pa lasagazhi'i dus su bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog dang / mthar thug tu sems kyi rangabazhin gsal cha rgyun mi 'chad par mthong bar 'byung ste/ de ni phra ba'i bdagayin no/ /de'i phyir nye ba ni bdag gog dan no/ /snying ga'i rlung sems kyi byed —128—

pas gzhan du snang ba khams gsum po 'di dag snang ste/ rdo rje phreng ba las/snying por gyur par rang srog las/ khams gsum na ni gzhan med de/ /sgyumarlung gi khams gsum mo/ /rmi lam rmi ba bzhin du snang / /zhes rlud sems kyi 'khrul snang du khams gsum po snang ba ni/ rmi lam bzhin du snang ba zhesag sdo/ngas pas/gsang 'dus rdo rje phreng ba'i lugs la phyi don tshad grub tu yod par 'dod pa dag 'di kho nas dngos su bkag la/ sgron gsal du ni slob dpon zla bas kyang / ji skad du/ chos thams cad ni rmi lam mthong ba'i dusasusems las phyi rol na mi gnas te/ mig yor tsam du snang ba gang yin pa de thams cad ni rang gi sems te/ rang gi sems nyid las gzhan na ci yang med do/ /zhes gsungs shing / gzhan yang snang ba sems su bzhed pa'i tshigazuramang du yod pas/ slob dpon 'di'i dgongs pa 'grel par smra ba rnams bgayod par spyod cig phyi don 3 grub tu 'dod pa dang / sems rlung gisabaskyod nas phyi don du snang bar gsungs pa ni shin tu 'gal ba yin no/ /denasagazugs sogs rdzas grub tu 'dod pa la/ gdan bzhi'i nang gi gzhan gyi bdan gsungs pa'i dgongs pa gtor ro/ /lam dus su 'od gsal gyis gzhan snanga'agag pa yang snying ga'i mthu las 'byung bas gzhan gyi gdan no/ /sngags dngargyud kyi sbyor ba mang po ni ngag gi mthu grub pa las byung zhing / ngag gi gnas kyangastong / rnyi~X hūṃ ༵sdo pa'i ye she ༵rnyi ga/ sgo dud ༵ zhag bdu / khri/ nyis stong gi byang ༵py-i—129—

sems spyi bor 'dus shing 'bab pa las 'byung bas spyi bo gsang gdan du bzhag go /bcu gsum pa ni/ sngags thams cad kyi rtsa ba rlung yin la/ de nyid kyangalte ba'i gtum mo'i rjes su 'gro ba yin pas de sngags kyi de nyid dang / gzhi dus su lus su snang ba dang / lus len pa'i thog ma dang / bar dor ldang ba sogasardesnying ga nas byed pa dang / bskyed rim gyi tshe dkyil 'khor lha rnams kyang de nasasprul zhing rlung sems kyi sku yang der 'grub pas de lha'i de nyid dang / ngan rludagi byed pa la brten nas rmi lam gyi yul snang sna tshogs 'byung bas de rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang mtshungs pa'i phyir dkyil 'khor gyi de nyid du bzhag la/ yeshes kyi de nyid ni gsang ba'i gdan nam de kho na nyid kyi gdan ces bya ba gong du bshad pa de'o/ /bcu bzhi pa ni/ nye ba snying rje / snying ga byams/pa/ mgrin pa dga' ba/ spyi bo btang snyoms te de rnams su rlung sems thim pa'i ye shes lasatshad med bzhi rang gis skye'o/ /bco lnga pa ni/ spyir lha mo bzhi'i dag pa'i dbangagis sbyar ba yin mod kyang / don dngos ni so so skye bo'i lam du rtsa khamasathams cad dag par byas pas/ gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku la rtsa khamasarlung gsum dngos su med kyang / ye shes nyid kyi snang ba tsam gyi de dag ni yod pas/ sa drug la skye mched drug yul dang bcas pa dag cing / de yang ye shes kyi sku de'i skye mched drug tu snang ba'i rtsa khams rlud gi snang cha tsam dag pas sgrib bral du gyur pa las/ sa de de'i yon tan rnam par 'phel ba yin la/ 'dun pa phan chad bzhi 'khor lo bzhi dag pa yin pas/ sa de dag tu pha rol tu phyin pa'i —130—

spyod pa mthar phyin pa dang sbyar nas lte bar thabs/ snying gar smon lam/ mgrin par stobs/ spyi bor ye shes zhes sbyar ba yin te 'khor lo 'byung ba bzhi'i gnas yin la/ ye shes kyi snang cha 'byung ba ltar snang ba de dag dag pa yang lte ba sogs dag pa la rag las pas so/ /de rnams spyod pa brten nas dag tshul 'jam dpal zhal lung las gsungs pa ltar te/ phreng ba ha ra nu 'bur sogs/ /mdog dang ku tsal sogasapa/ /padma brtag pa'i dga' shes pa/ /dang por rab tu shes par bya/ /zhes pa nas/ de bas de 'dra'i don chen la/ /yang dag 'jug par mi nus pa zhi /gdul bya rnams la bde gshegs kyis/ /rab tu dga' sogs mtshan nyid du/ /bstan nas de yis don zhugs pas/ /de yis rtogs kyang sla dngabacas/ /zhes pa'i bar du ste/ 'di yang pha rgyud nas gsal bar ma gsungs pa ma rgyud kyi man ngag gis gsal bar mdzad pa'o/ /bcu drug pa ni/ lte bsangasargyas spyan/ snying ga mā ma ki mgrin pa gos dkar mo/ sgyi bo sgrol ma ste/ 'byungaba'i dwangs ma'i rlung dang thig le gnas pas de rnams lha mo de dang de'i dag pa yin par gsungs pa ste/ lteb nas rlung dang sa khams kyi dwangs ma'i thigaleganas pas de spyan ma ste/ gzhan gsum la'ang de bzhin no/ /de skad du yang/sa ni spyan zhes bya bar bshad/ /chu yi khams ni mā ma ki/ /dkar dang sgrolatshazhes bya ba/ /me dang rlung du rab tu grags/ /zhes so/ /yang lha mo bzhis phyag rgya rigs bzhi bstan pa yin te/ spyir padma can ma spyan ma'i rigs sogs yin kyang / bde mchog rang lugs la/ spyan mas ri mo can ma/ snyam kis padma can —131—

ma/ gos dkar mos dung can ma/ sgrol mas glang chen ma bstan te/ 'khor lo de dag gi rtsa mdud grol ba la phyag rgya de dag so sor bsngags pa dang / dedagakyang so sor 'khor lo de dag dag pa'i nus mthu can yin pa dang / 'khor lo de dag dag pa las rigs bzhir gtogs pa'i pho nya mo'i 'du ba thob pa dang 'khor lo bzhi'i bde ba yang de dag gis drangs pa'i zhu bde dang mtshungs pas/de dag gi zhu bde dag byed du 'gyur ba sogs don mang du ston pa yin no/ /gnyis pa la ting nge 'jin gsum/ las gsum/ dkyil zhe bor gsum/sku gsum mo/ /dang po ni rlung gang dag rgyu bar mgo rtsom pa ni gzhi dus kyi sprulasku/ longs spyod pa de rgyu ba de bzhin pa ni longs spyod rdzogs sku/ 'ag ka pa laphyogs pa ni chos sku'o/ /de ltar yang o la pa ti las chos dang longs spyod rdzogs pa dang sprul pa ni skye zhing gnas la 'jug pa'o zhes gsungs te/ 'di'i rgyas bshad du/ phyi nang gi yul nyer bzhi ngos bzung ba dang / der nang god pa' bo'i rnal 'byor ma rtsa thig rlung gi 'gros bshad pa zhib mor mdzad do/ /lamadus su rlung dang thig le de dag thim pa'i rang gnas so so nas zhi tir thim zhing /yan lag kun gyi rlung 'jug spyod dbang du byed pa gsum ni/ sa par phyag rgya zhi lam la ltos te/ rtsa bdun khri nyis stong gi thig le zhu ba gsang ba'i sna rtserabartan pa ni/ der de dag thim 'gro ba yin no/ /de la rlung gis grangs te thig le yang thim par 'gyur te/ des na rlung gang dang bdun khri nyis stong gi rtsa nasa'abyung ba/ rang rang gi rtsa ba'i gnas/ rtsa nyer bzhir 'jug spyod dbang gsu༅gyi 'jug pa dang po sbyor ba/ longs spyod pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog thiska—132—

pa las rgyal mchog ces bya/de thams cad mthar dus gcig tu gsang ba'i padma nas dbu mar 'jug spyod dbang gsum byed pa na yang de dang 'dra ste/rdzogasarim gang mthar phyung kyang 'dra bas/ting nge 'dzin gsum po 'di ḍā b.raḥngango //gnyis pa ni/lha spyan 'dren pa dang gshe/gas gsol dang //bzhugs pa gsum gyi nges don te//rma nang du 'jug pa spyan 'dren pa/phyir 'gro ba gshegs su gsol ba/gnas pa bzhugs pa ste/'di rnams kyi rdor bzlasagrub pas de rnams kyi phan yon dang dngos grub sogs ci 'grub pa 'dis 'grub pa dang /lha yang de'i tshul gyis dngos su bskul nas byin gyis brlob pas/sngags rgyud cho ga'i spros pa med kyang rdzogs rim 'di las 'byung zhing /'byunga'ajug gnas gsum sngags kyi rang bzhin te/rgyud sde rnams las rdo rje'i bzlasapa yi ge gsum pa dang /gnyis/ pa dang /drug pa la sogs pa ji snyed gsungasardepa'i 'di'i gnad kas so//thig le la sbyar na gtum/ mos thig le spyi bo nasa'adzag pa spyan 'dren/lus thams cad la khyab par byed pa gshegs gsol//thig le rtsa 'khor so sor yas babs mas brtan gyi skabs brtan par byed pa bzhugs pa ste/rgyu mtshan gong dang 'dra zhing rlung la sbyar na/spyan 'dren pa sprulardesku/gshegs su gsol ba longs sku/bzhugs pa chos sku'o//thig/lol sbyaran spyan 'dren pa longs sku/gshegs gsol sprul sku/bzhugs pa cho se/sku'o//gsum pa ni/rtsa sku'i dkyil 'khor/rlung gsung gi dkyil 'khor/thikale thugs kyi dkyil 'khor/yang na bde ba'i rgyu yin pas thig le gsung longs

snri dung /dzī sems deb lo pa skur sbyar ba yod pa ltar rtsa 5 6 5 thig / shad dod / le//rga pa she/ rtag pa chas gyi/sa su snying gar gnyi/gsal ba ༷mi sprul sto sku'am gri spruX/skra'/mi she she dus su nga gar gnyad stig rngi de'/de dang do/lto rdi~Xzhes spya/de bar sad pas sprul sku'// yang 'a gshe hro ༵ snang sto// sa rtse gyi snang bde dag las byud bas de༅/rdede rnaskyo du da pa/ she de/ kya sku gsum snang ba dkri las spyong/ bshe~Xghrirde rnams su she ga/ ltar yang /gī nga spyi ni kya nang du she/snyad / dbus su brjad par rdo snro ༷lja//rtse mu ge mu ge po cha /de bar bde ba wo pa //snarde~X spyod pas/ ba gyi sna snga kya 'dzag ba she /des ca da zi' nga pa'i ( da par can ༵'a ge shes sam she/'i/dus snying gar spre lha brakrimar 'di ge ge spe/hro mas gto la rgyag lteb pa dus ye she ༷ra ba'i ngas spyi bo gya dus mgran dror pa bzhi/༷ dus bar 'a/pha ma sbyar ba dus bar 'i gdams rnga spu rnams de dag tu gan tha dung /rma ༷ma rna/ dang /sgyu lus dngani shi rgya gdams so ro/ de lta dkyi tu gnas zan pa dgas da she pa shan tu gnad // ltar na mas skur sbyar ba thams cad ru 5 4 /zu ri / shad dge ke ge zhe0/rdeskur sbyar ba thams cadang ga she~Xsbyar ba ba mi she da lus rdo ma༅yan ḍi ge mu /lte yi steng ma ri 'bre /ngag ra ma/ char mu she rnyi ada~X mi/rtsa dag kyang rte sna/'a sga zhe 4 5 /na 'a 'al bha ༷sneng she/rkyang ma' sga no ba dang ba dang/dhū gnas snyang ga yan pas 'khar la gsum dang 'bral bar gnas pas rang lus la nges par byed pa'o//gsum pa la/ā li kā li gnyis/yi goganyis4

thabs shes gnyis/ sgo gnyis/ shes rab gnyis/ yul dbang gnyis 'phrosadang bcas pa'o/ /dang po ni/ yi ge rnams kyi sgra so sor mi gsal ba yi gornams kyi brjod pa'i gzhi tsam 'byung ba'i rtsa rlung thig le las ni ngag gi brjod pa'i dbyangs rnams 'byung zhing / yi ge'i gdangs su gsal por 'byung ba'i lus can rnams ni gsal byed bskyed par byed pa'o/ /de la dbyangs 'byung ba'i rtsa yig rnams ni gzhi dus su rkyang ma'i byed pa can yin zhing / gsal byed 'byung ba rnams ro ma'i byed pa can yin no/ /lte mgrin khams dmar po shasatsheb yin pas ro ma dang / spyi snying ni dkar po shas che bas rkyang ma dang 'brel b.rami 'gyur ram/ yi ge'i dbye ba ni go zlog tu 'byung ngo zhe na/ dkar dmar gnyis por gcig gis cig shos kyi grogs byed pa tsam rigs 'dras mi byed pas phan gdags bya gdags byed ni khams rigs mi mthun gtso che ba yin no/ /de'i phyir khams dmar po can gyi lte mgrin rkyang ma'i byed pa can yin pa dang /dkar po can gyi snying ga dang spyi bo gnyis ro ma dang 'brel ba yin pa'i mi 'gal lo /gnyis pa ni/ e dang wa gnyis te 'khor lo bzhi dang sbyar ba ni sngarabashad zin/ 'khor lo so so las gyes pa'i rtsa rnams kyang rtsa ba'i 'khor losabasdus pa yin pas de'i rigs pas sbyar bar bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ 'khor ba'i dus su yul gzung ba shes rab sto ro ma dang / yul can 'dzin pa thabs te rkyangapa ༵she snro~X tyā sdo ḍi /ga ro~X /༵ pyi kā skyed ༵ shā/ba/༵ dzhai da~X ༵ ༵/ bab mi mis —135—

btab pa'o//lam dus su de rnams kyi chos ni es ro ma'i chos dang/wa gyisarkyang ma'i chos rnams 'dzin pa yin no//bzhi pa ni/sgo gnyis kyi rnam dbye gongadu bshad zin pa ste/yang phyir 'gro ba steng gi sgo ste ro ma dang 'brel nas spyi bo dang /'og smin mtshams sam rlung dang thig le nang du 'dug pa rkyang ma dang 'brel ba'o//lnga pa ni/o la pa ti las/shes rab ni dmigs pa dang bcas(pa dngadamigs pa med pa'o//dmigs pa dang bcas pa ni de bzhin gshe/gas pa'i dbugs dbyung ba ste 'khor ba'o//dmigs pa med pa ni rdo rje 'chang god bugasadabyung ba sto mya ngan las 'das pa'o//zhes gsungs pas/gzhi dus su semasardekyi cha nas bzhag pa'i bde ba dang snang ba gnyis sngar bshad zin/lus kyichanas bdud rtsi lnga'i dwangs ma ni bde ba'i rten yin pas/rdo rje 'chang ni dbugasa'abyung dang /khams nyer bzhi sogs 'bab pa ni cha shas tha dad pa sna tshogasardesgrub byed yin pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbugs dbyung ngo //lam dus ji skad du/bde dbugs 'byin gsungs pa ni//dag pa'i lus ni skyon med pa//zhesagasungs te/lha sku'i rnam pa rang shar ba dang /rtsa rlung thig le dmigs bcasarnams ni/bde gshegs dbugs 'byen dang /shes rab bde stong gnyisasumed pa'i ye shes ni rdor sems dbugs dbyung ngo //'bras bu laganyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku dang /mngon par byang chub pa'i bde ba gnyis la rim para'ajog go /dmigs bcas ba dang /dmigs med e yi 'khor lo las/'byung ba dang de'i ye shes 'char tshul shes dgos so//drug pa ni/ol pa ti 6

las/ byang chub sems ni mig la sogs pa dbang po drug go zhes gsungs pas/mig gi dbang po rtsa rlung thig le dang bcas pa ni sa'i snying po'i dag pa yin te/sems kyi steng na de ltar snang ba'i gsal cha de nyid dri ma dang bral ba las/'bras bu sa'i snying po'i ngo bor 'grub pa yin la/ de'i tshe gzugs su snang ba yang rnam par dag ste/ lha mo gzugs rdo rje mar gyur pa yin no/ /lhag ma rnamasala'ang de bzhin sbyar bar bya'o/ /yul gzung ba dang yul can 'dzin pa'i chosayin pas/ e waX dang sbyor tshul gong bzhin no/ /des na lhan cig skyes grub lasakyang lcam dpal mos/ sangs rgyas bdag nyid lus la ni/ /dngos grub bde ba mi nus shing / /bdag nyid 'phrog pa'i chom rkun de/ /de yi sdig pa ma byasasam/ /bdag nyid 'di dag gzhan pa la/ /gzhan dag tu ni rtog parabyed/ /bdag nyid 'phrog pa'i chom rkun de/ /de yi sdig pa ma byas sam/ zhesadang / lus gnas lus las ma skyes pa/ /rtog pa gnyis ni spangs pa ste/ khyab bya khyab byed tshul gyis ni/ /dngos po kun la yang dag gnas/ /zhes lusalaganas pa'i bde ba chen po mi shigs pa dang / bdag dang gnan du snang ba thams cad rang sems las gzhan du rtog pa rnams kyis lus sems sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin gyis dag pa laganod pa byas pas sdig pa bsags pa ste bya ba nyes pa zhes bya'o/ /snang ba thams cad sems kyi bag chags kyi mthu lasasnang ba dang / sems la bag chags ci yod lus su smin pa dang / de lagand du bsnun pas bag chags de dag sbyor ba'i thabs su 'gyur ba ste/ dpal yang dag par spyor bas sa khru ṭi las/ lus las gzhan du sangs rgyas nyid/ /mi shes pa —137—
