yis g.yogs pa'i lugs/ zhes gsungs pa'i nus pa dang ldan par byasaso/ /slob dpon ārya de bas shing gcig pa'i dka' 'grel las kyang/ phyi rolade bzhin rang bzhin ni/ /lus la gnas pa'i lha rnams mchod/ khres sogasardenas/ sngags pa phyi rol spyod byed na/ /bskal pa bye ba brgya rnams ga /sgrub kyang dngos grub byed mi nus/ /zhes nang gi de kho na nyid 'di lta bu mi shes paraphyi rol gyi lha la mngon par zhen pas mchod kyang dngos grub thob par mi 'gyur zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa la/ phung khams kyi dag pa/ ye shes kyi dag pa/ rtsa khams kyi dag pa'o/ /de dag thams cad ni zhor la rtogs par 'gyur bsasabacad tsam bstan pa ni/ dang po ni/ o la pa ti las/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni gzugs dang tshor ba dang 'du byed dang 'du shes dang rnam par shes pa'o/ /zhes pa dang / dpyid kyi thig ler yang / gzugs ni sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad/ /rdo rje nyi ma tshor ba ste/ /'du shes padma gar dbang phyug /de bzhin 'du byed rdo rje rgyal/ /rnam shes rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ /kun gyi ngo bo he ruka /zhes sogs phung po drug dbang po drug khams lnga rnams kyi dag pa sa pu ṭi bzhin gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ o la pa ti las/ ye shes lnga ni melong lta bu dang / mnyam pa nyid dang / so sor rtog pa dang / bya ba sgrub pa'o/ /zhes pa ni rnam rtog ye shes lngar gyur pa zhes pa'i skabs su bstan no/ /gsum pa ni/ dbyid kyi thig ler sa pu zhi'i gzhung drangs te le'u bzhi paramador bstan dang / lnga pa drug pa rnams su rgyas par bshad pa'i yul nyi shu rtsabazhi dang / rtsa dang khams dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams kyi dag pa rgyas par bstan pa —138—

ste/ de ltar de dag thams cad gong du bshad pa ltar dag pa gsum gyi rangabazhin gyis rnam par dag pa ste/ mdor bsdu na/ rang sems kyi snang ba la de de 'char ba'i gsal cha dag lam du ma byas na 'khor ba'i chos su snang / de nyid kyingo bo lam du byas na lam dus su yang dkyil 'khor dang bde ba zung du 'jug pa'i tshul du snang la/ 'bras bu'i dus na gzhi dus kyi rang bzhin thams cad mngon du gyur pa zhes bya ste/ ma dag pa'i chos rnams dag pa ste/ rang bzhin stongapa chos kyi sku la dbye ba med kyang / snang ba dang bde ba gzugs kyi skur 'char ba ni/ thob skal rtsis na so so ba de dag go /zhes shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ yid tshes bzhi dang ldan pa ste/ gsang ba'i de khon nyid gsal ba las/ lung las yid ni chen/ pa dang / /bdag nyid las ni yid ches dang / /gzhan la yid ni ches pa dang / /de bzhin bla ma la yid ches/ /zhes/lungal yid tshes pa ni bka'i dgongs don yin pa dang / gzhan la yid tshes pa ninyams myong can gyi slob dpon gyi rim pa yin pa dang / bdag nyid la yid cesapa ni nyams myong 'phral du skye zhing de'i yid tshes dang ldan pa'o/ /bla ma la yid tshes pa ni rdo rje slob dpon te rtogs pa dang ldan pa la yid ches pa'o/ /yid chesade rnams kyi phyi ma gtso che ste/ de nyid las/ de ni yi ge'i nang na oX/ /phyugs nang ri dwags rgyal por mtshungs/ /rig byed nang na nges brjod dang / /tshe tog pa radzi tar mtshungs/ /zhes pa dang / yid tshes dang ni thams cad la/ /bla ma nyid nibyed por 'gro/ /zhes gsungs shing / de'i bla ma yang rdo rje slob dpon yin la/phyi'i las rab 'byams ston pa dang / rtsa rlung thig le la sogs pa lus kyi de —139—

ni nang gi nā ni phyi'i bla ma ste mdor bstan pa'o//sems kyi de khon spug da ni de na nang mu bla ma ste rgyas mje chi/ mdzad pa'o//mdor brtagazu / tsho ni/ kau rgyas 4nad de kho na nyad gzur/sa tsam ma pa dang /cham pas cis yi 'tshe khyad par rdo/de ltar yang de kyi 'a bha (5she/smru ma rnam pa gnyas yan te/khyu shengashe gyur she//myo lasang ngangs yi 'tshe pa//skyas ru rgyas ༵༵smi ༵'a//mdar bstan lus dang ngag na ta//rgyas dan byad pa na//zhes gsungs so//gnyis pa la/lam 'ar ngo bo rim bzhi dang /de pol rgyad kyi/khu mi sa 1 4 tshul/bi zigazu bu sgrub byed ska rim pa sne ge' snro//dang po la rgyud spyi snyo/sngags kyi ma pa/༷ shes kya ma pa gsang ba 'a ram pa'o//dang po la/— don dang /zhi las don ge ge shes las/| pol/sgra3/she/zhi yin tsa/de nyid cwa merdete ba las/dang po na/rgyud rtsa gsum 'kha/ra la ba na la/de sgamardepa'i rim pa yin pas rim pa'o//gnyis pa ni/rtsa'i rnal wor rdo/gsum pa ni/spyir rdzogs rim mtha' dag rim pa bzhi'i mtshan nyid 'a du ni 'du ba yin rdos/de'i dbang gis phye /go/rtsa 'ba' zhig sgom pa dang /ya go sgom pa dang/nga sbyor 'ba' zhi//rlung 'od zer rtser ge ge mu/ga 'ang pa'i b.rang yab rlung bzhi pa ni —— pa dang /lnga char tshang thi nas ga spyos 'dus pa bar du yod do//ba pa /dbu mar zhugs rkerges ma gsum ra mi tha spre can la~X༈nang du nas dngos su gtum mo 'bar te/ro ma' nang nas 'bar thub pa de du rgyud rim yin la/thub nas ni sngags rim du 'jog go/gnyis pa gzhungago40

don ni dzee rtse 'khor lo sogs te skabs 'dir rgyud kyi rim pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi rdzogs rim rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang /yang dag sbyor ba'i rgyud kyisartsargyud kyi sbas don bshad pa ni skabs 'di'i rgyud rim ste/rtsa 'khor bzhi po yi gedang bcas pa rnam par bsgoms pas/thog mar rlung phyi rol gyi yul la rnamapar rgyu ba zlog tu nye ba'i rtags lnga 'byung /de nas cung zad zlog pa'i rtags lnga 'byung /mthar gyi rlung 'khor lo bzhi dang /gtso bor lte bar zhugs gnas thiwagasum gyis rim pas rlung rnams rim gyis las su rung ste/zhu bde ci rigasardepar 'dren pa dang /'khor lo'i yi ge rnams gsal bar snang ba rgyud kyi rim/pa'o//lugs 'dir yi ge'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba'i tha snyad 'ga' zhinamadzad mod kyang /'dir yi ge zhes bya ba de ci/sra ba'i cha zhig yin na ni snyigasama'i khams sam rtsa'i rigs su 'gyur la/dwangs ma'i khu ba zhig yin na ni/thig le'am khams bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor du 'gyur la/rlung yin na yang de'i dkyil 'khor du 'gyur bas/rtsa dang khams dang rlung ma yin na ni sems sa5yang na sems can dang rjes su ma 'brel ba zhig tu 'gyur bas/kho bo cag ni lugs 'di mi sbyor te/rlung dang yi ge ni gcig pa kho na'o zhes spro gi/gnyis pa sngags kyi rim pa la spyi don dang /gzhung don gnyis las/dang po la rtsa po zhad sbyar bas rdzogs rim la nges pa bskyed pa/bsgom bya gtum mo'i dbye ba/de las bde stong skye ba'i tshul lo//dang po ni/rgyas par slob dpon nyid kyi rdzogasarim gzhung gsum las shes dgos mod kyi/'dir sgo tsam bstan na/dpyid thig las/de nas de bzhin gshegs pa gang yang rung ba'i sku'i dkyil 'khorarde4

dang /sbyin sreg dang /mchod sbyin dang /bzlas pa dang /sgom pa la sogs pa'i cho ga'i bya ba phyi rol dang mthun par nang gi ngo bos rab tu 4nad par bya'o//zhes mdor bstan nas/de dag ci rigs par gsungs so//gsang ba'i de nyid dang /o la pa ti'i rim pa bzhi pa las kyang gleng gzhi'i nges don rgya cheragasungs te/gzhan yang dpyid thig gi tshig de'i rjes su 'brangs nas de dgagonges don sa pu ṭi las rgyas shing tshang bar gsungs te/lus dkyil la brten nas de dag gi rlung sems zlog par byed tshul dang /'khor lo'i dbus su padma la gnas pa'i nyi zla kha sbyor sgom pa sogs kyis ni/rtsa 'khor so sor lara'adzag byed pa ston pa dang /bzlas pa'i nges don yang rdo rje bzlas pa sogasarlung gi sbyor ba rnams dang /sngags btu'i nges don gyi gtum mo dang rlung dngalas rgya'i man ngag mang po ston pa ni/gru gsum dkyil 'khor nyams dga' bar//rdo rje ra zhi rnam par 'byung /zhes sogs so/khyad par rtsa rgyud kyi phyagargyabazhi'i skabs dang /sbyin bsreg gi nges don rnams kyis rgyas par 'chad cing/las kyi phyag rgya'i rim pa rnams kyang mchog tu rgyas par rtsa bshad kyi rgyud thams cad dang /khyad par rdorje mkha' 'gro las rgyas par bshad do//gnyis pa ni/jo bo nā ro ta pa'i man ngag gi bzhed pas/sngags kyi rim pa la nyams su blangabya bcu gnyis te/gtum/ mo gsum/thig le gsum/rlud gsum/mi rtog pa gsum mo//dang po la/sku gsung thugs kyi gtum mo gsum mo/khri'i rnala'abyor dang zhabrul 'khor byed bcings kyis gtum mo ro mar sbar thub pa ni sku dang /yig 'bru dang rlung gi mdog dbyibs la dmigs nas de thub pa ni gsungarde4

dang /dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i gtum mo zhes bya ba gtso bor drod bskyed pa dang/chos rgya'i gtum mo ste drod la brten pas bde ba sgom pa dang /phyag chen gyi gtum mo ste de la brten pa'i bde stong dbyer med bsgom pa ste de gsum ni thugs kyi gtum mo'o//thig le gsum ni/a ha dang nyi zla kha sbyor sogs sgo5pa kha dog la bslab pa dang /dbyibs tha dad sna tshogs sgom pa dbyibs labaslab pa dang /'od zer spro bsdu sna tshogs sgom pa 'ben rgyang la bslab pa'o//rlung gsum ni/'jam rlung la bslab pa zhi ba dang /bum can kha sbyoradrag po dang /rdor bzlas dang dgang dbyung sogs ni/dgang thon la bslab pa'o//phyag chen la bslab pa gsum ni/bsgrim pa sogs blos byas stong nyid ni btsan thabs su bslab pa dang /rang sar glod pa ni zhud dbyung ba dang/dmigs pa la brten nas dmigs med skye ba ni/rtog bcas la brten nas mi rtog pa sgom pa ste/de ltar bcu gnyis po rnams kyi man ngag rnams ni phal tsherasngon chad snyan brgyud du gnas pa'i phyir 'dir mi 'dri'o//gal te don du gnyeran bla ma'i zhal snga las rtogs par bya'o//gsum pa la/bde stong ngos bzung /zhu bde 'byung tshu kho pond/de'i lam gyi rab dbye'o//dang po la/bde ba/stong pa/zung las/ngos bzung ba gsum las/dang po la gnyis las/dang po bde ba'i ngo bo ni/sems gnasapas rlung rnams rang lus la phan 'dogs par song ba'i shin sbyangs kyi bde ba ni zhi gnas pa thams cad kyi thun mong yin zhing /yid kyi dga' bde yangathams cad kyi thun mong ba ste/stong nyid mthong bas drangs pa'i dga' bde yang4

mdo dang thun mong ba dang / srog rtsol phyi rol tu rgyu ba bkag tsam gyi bde ba yangargyud sde 'og ma rnams las kyang 'byung bas/ de tsam gyis ni 'di'i bde ba chen po'i go mi chod do/ /de rnams kyang 'dir lam du byed mod kyi/ rdze'i sa mongam yin pa'i bde chen ni/ zhu bde khyad par can dang / rang bzhin lhan cig skyesapa'i bde chen no/ /'jigs med 'byung gnas kyi zhal snga nas kyang/ bas༅gtan dang po'i bde ba yod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis bde chen lam byed sngags kyi thun mong ma yin par 'jog pa mi 'thad pa'i rtsod pa bkod nas/ de'i lan 'di skad ces/ bden te 'di ni lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba ma yin te/ de nyid kyi phyir bde ba chen po yang ma yin zhing / las dang po pa'i gnas skabs su thabasasu gyur pa yang ma yin te/ khab kyi bu ga ni nam mkha'i bu ga'o/ /zhes pa khonasanam mkha' dang yang mnyam par 'gyur ba ma yin pas so zhes dang / 'o na shesarab kyi pha rol tu phyin par gang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi bde ba zhes gsungs so zhe na/ gsungs mod/ 'di'i thabs ni bstan pa mayin te/ thabs su gyur pa lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba chen po nye bar ma bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi bde chen tsam 'ig bstan du chugakyang / de sgrub byed kyi thabs ma bstan zhes gsungs te/ thun mong ma yin pararo rkyang gi rgyu ba dbu mar 'gags pa' zhu bde khyad par can mtshon te/ zhu bde lam byed khyad par can dang / de la brten te sems kyi rang bzhin lhan skyesamangon du gyur pa ni/ rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi ye shes te/ thabs su gyur pa lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba ni 'di'o/ /theg pa 'di nyid ma gtogs thams cad du —144—

sbas pa ste/ padma badzra gyi zhal snga nas kyang / bya ba spyod pa'i dbye ba dang/ mdo sde'i sde snod la sogs su/ /mchog tu dga' ba gcig pu nyid/ /rnam par du mar rnam par gnas/ /phung po rin chen snod nyid du/ /sems can bsam pa'i dbangagis ni/ /de nyid 'bad pas sbas mdzad nas/ /sangs rgyas mgon pos rnamapar gzhag /ces gsungs te/ mchog tu dga' ba gnas pa'i don yang/ de la dkri bar byed pa'i lam 'ga' zhig yin zhes pa'i don no/ /de lta bu'i zhu bde khyad par can la'ang dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje zhes gsungs te/ man ngagasnyem las/ thabs ni dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje chen po 'gro ba'i don byed pa lhan cig skyes pa'i bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa phan yon ni/ skye ba gcig gis bla na med pa'i byang chub rme'u/ du byed pa la/ yan lag go thabs ni mang mod/ med na mi 'byung go rgyu ni bde chen gyi ye shes 'di yin te/ dpal sam pu ṭi las/ de phyir de rgyas rtsi zhinabya/ /mdor bsdus pas ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /bskal pa bye ba grangs med pas/ /ji srid sangs rgyas gang thob pa/ /gang gi dam pa'i bde bas khyod/ /skye ba 'dir ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs shing / gsang ba grub pa las kyang / sgrub po de nyid la gtad pas/ brtul zhugs med kyang 'grub para'agyur/ /brtul zhugs brgya phrag spyad byas kyang / /de nyid mnan na 'grub mi'agyur/ zhes gsungs te/ brtul zhugs ni/ dka' thub dang / sdom pa dang/ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam grangs so/ /ye shes 'di kho nas dkyil 'khor la sogs pa spros pa'i bya ba yun ring por spyad pa'i tsho gos rdzogs tshul thams cad yud tsam —145—

gyis 'byung ba ni/ kyi rdo rje las kyang / stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa/ byang chub sems zhes rab tu brjod/ ces dang / de la spyi'i spros pa rnams mi dgos paragasungs nas/ de ni sngags bzlas de dka' thub dang de sbyin bsreg /de ni dkyil 'khor can dang de ni dkyil 'khor nyid/ /mdor bsdus na ni sems ni 'dus pa'i tshul can no/ /zhes gsungs pa ste/ snying po de ni bde chen gomatshams med lnga'i las can gyis kyang dngos grub mchog 'grub pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo yang de'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ rgyu sogs stong pa sngon 'gro ba/ /zhesagasungs pa'i don/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod las/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shesaste/ /he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni bkod pa dang bral ba/ /ka nigangadu'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs shing / khyad par/ dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ e wa la sogs gnyis med spangs/ /shrī zhes bya'i yig desabarjod/ /he yig snying ga gnas kun du/ /he ru ka sogs rab 'khora'agro/ /sgom pa kun gyis 'byung nas las/ /'dzin pa la sogs rnams bskyed cing / /de ni rgyu stong bdag nyid do/ /rgyu'i bdag nyid du mi rtogs pa'o/ /rangabazhin chos bdag med pa nyid/ /de ni stong pa'i rnal 'byor gnag /bkod pa gang dag bdag med pa/ /rtog pa'i drwa ba chen po ste/ /ru yig rkyen gyi bdag nyid can/ /de ni bdag gi bkod bral ba'o/ /slar brjod ka ni mi 'i nus pa/ /bdag gis gnyis byar mi shes gang / /gang phyir ci la'ang mi gnas pa/ /de phyirakazhes bya bar brjod/ /ces he yig gis chos gyi bdag med/ ru yig gis gangazag gi bdag med/ ka yig gis yul can gyi ye shes/ shrī yig gis gnyis —146—

med kyi ye shes rnams bstan te/ rgyas par gzhan du gtan la dbab par bya'o//kha cig stong pa nyid ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs las lhag po cung zad kyang gtan la dbab rgyu med ces dang / yang skabs shig tu stong nyid de la yulayul can gnyis yod pa'i bde stong gi stong nyid ni yul stong nyid de yin zhesadang / bde stong gnyis chu la chu bzhag pa ltar dbyer med du 'gro dgos zhes pa dang / stong nyid rnam bcas mdo las ma bstan zhing sngags las bstan zhesasogs smra ba ni/ rang tshig gcig gis gcig sun 'byin par byed pa yin no/ /des na thos pa'i lta ba'i dbang du byas nas mdo las lhag pa med kyang/gtan la dbab rgyu'i stong nyid ni lhag po yod de bde ba'i rang bzhin gyi stong nyid yin pa dang / gtan la dbab na thos bsam kho nas gtan la dbapodagos par ma nges pas so/ /sdom 'byung las/ lhan skyes snang brnyan rang bzhin no/ /'od gsal rnam dpyod spyod yul min/ zhes yul can rnam par dpyod pa'i sgom pas/ 'od gsal stong nyid spyod yul du byed mi nus par bshad cing/rdzogs rim gyi lha sku yang rdul gyi cho se can ma yin par lhan skyes kyi snang brnyan du bsha/da pa dang / rlud rang mtshan pa las grub pa la rdul las ma grub pa misrid pas 'di bsam dgos so/ /bde stong sbyor ba'i stong nyid de yang gong du bshad pa ltar chad stong kho na ma yin te/ spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi bzag pa med pa'i sems rgyud gang yin pa gsal bar mngon du gyur pa ni rnam bcas kyi stong nyid dngos yin la/ de'i 'char sgo yin pa'i phyir/ stong pa'i gzugs brnyan thams cad la yang rnam bcas kyi stong nyid ces gsungs kyi/ rdul gyis stong pa —147—

la stong nyid kyi go bar byed pa ni shin tu tha chad do/ /rang bzhin gang du yangabarjod du med par mthong ba ni rnam med stong nyid do/ /'dir smras pa/ rgyal ba'i sras gcig 'jam dbyangs kyis/ /4nga golta'adod mdor bstan las/ /phung po rnam dpyad stong nyid ni/ /chu shing bzhin du snying po med/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /stong nyid de ltar 'gyuratshayin/ /gsungs 'di rdul gyis stong tsam la/ /'chad pa gang de 'brel/med smra/ /ci phyir zhe na lta ba mchog dman gyi/ /dbye ba'i skabs su skabs gzhan gtam byas phyir/ /rgyal la co 'dri smra bar ma byed cig /de phyir bzung 'dzin gnyis stong dag la brjod/ /gzhan yang phung po rnam dpyod kyi stong nyid ces bya ba'i ri bong rwa ltar cang med du 'dzin pa la ni mi brjod de/ 'di ni rang sde'i ltab mchog dman gyi dbye ba yin pa las/ sangs rgyas pa de lta bu'i lta ba 'dzin pa ni tshes nyung bas so/ /gzhan yang 'dir mang du brjod par byar yod do/ /gsum pa la bde stong gi ngo bo ni/ bde ba'i snang ba yang ma 'gags la/ de nyid kyi skabs su brjod bral spros pa med pa'i rnam par shar ba gang yin pa de go /las dang po pa'i skabs su 'di ni thabs su 'gyur ro/ kha cig bde ba dang de'i stong pa dus gcig 'grub pa na/ rnal 'byor pas dbyer med du byed mi dgos/stong pa la phyis bde bas rgyas 'debs dang / bde ba la phyis stong pas rgyas('debs kyi go mi chod chul byas nas mthar gshugs pa'i don la don gyi lhan skyes skyes na yul stong pa dang / yul can bde ba dbyer med yod/ de gang du mos pa 'jug ces dang / yang dbyer med kyi don blo gnyis ngo bo tha mi dad kyi —148—

grub pa de rdzas gcig la ngos 'dzin pa sogs nus pa yang med la/grus mtha' gting ma tshugs pa'i gzu lum mang du smra mod/dgag sgrub bris na mang para'agyur bas ma bkod la/rang tshig 'gal ba mngon gyur de dag go/sa pu ṭilas kyang /da rigs med gnas su shes rab dang //dmigs med snying rje chen po nyid//blo dang lhan cig gyur gcig gyur pa nam mkhar nam mkha' ji ltaba'o//zhes gsungs te/sems gcig po de nyid bde ba dang stong pa gnyisakam yin na/yul yul can sbyor skad mang po byas kyang /nam mkhar nam mkha' ji lta ba sogs kyi dpe mi 'grig go /bde ba chen po 'di med na rdzi ltar 'grub par 'gyur zhe na/rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de//nam mkha' la ni mtshan nyid med/khams gsum po ni ma lusapa'i//'gro kun sgyu ma lta bu yin/brtan pa dang ni g.yo ba yi//'grob dmigs su med pa ste//mthong ba dang ni reg pa'i dngos//thams cad sgyumadzibazhin no//gang gis blun po 'ching 'gyur ba//'dir des mkhas rnams rnamapar rol//phyag rgya'i sbyor ba 'di yis ni//sa gsum ma lus bza' b.rabya//gzhan du gal te spyor ba ni//me tshad mar me lta bu 'da'//zhes gsung༅rdete/chos thams cad nam mkha' ltar rang bzhin med kyang /khams gsum gyi snang ba mi 'gag pa ni sgyu ma lta bu yin pas/de'i phyir brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad yod med gang du yang ma dmigs te/'di ni chos thams cad rangabazhin gyi rnam par dag pa yin pas/blun po rnams 'ching bar 'gyur ba'i mthong reg sogs 'dod yon rnams la/mkhas pa ste rang bzhi shes pa rnams49

rol bas grol bar byed do//de bsan phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i bde stong gis khams gsum du snang ba'i 'khrul pa thams cad stong pa nyid du thim zhing bza' bar byed de/bde ba bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs 'grus pasabla na med pa'i byang chub 'grub par 'gyur la/bde ba ma tshang na stong pa ni/thabs gzhan dang bcas su zin kyang bsod nams kyi tshogs mi 'grub pas mar me shi ba bzhin du mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ro//zhes gsungs so//pha rol tu phyin pa las kyang /gnyis sbyor gyi 'dod yon lam du 'byung ba yod de/byangachub sems dpa' khye'u skar mar gyur pa bzhin no//de'i phyir sngags kyi khyad chos ma yin no snyam na/de tsam ni spyod 'jug las/de ltar gnas pa'i mkhasapa la//bsod nams mi 'gyu/ra gang yang med//ces pa ltar byang chub kyi sems/kyis zin pa'i spyod pa tsam du bstan gyi/lam gyi ngo bor yang ma bstan la/'dod yon kyi bde ba de kun lam du ma gsungs shing /mdo lugs kho nal de lam du byed nus pa'i lam yang med do//'dir ni de lta bu'i bde ba chen wa'i ye shes de nyid lam gyi dngos gzhir len tshul ston pa'i phyir ro//gnyis pa zhu bde 'byung tshul ni gsum las/dang po gang bzhu bar bya ba ni thig le dkarachaste/kha cig spyi bo'i ha yig 'ba' zhig yin zhes zer na'ang /rang gis/kyangasnying ga'i dbyid 'dzag par byas pa dang nang 'gal zhing /don la yang mi rigasardete/spyod bsdus sgron me las kyang ji skad du/nā ḍi stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyisalas/dri ma med pa'i chu rgyun lta bus ā li kā li zhu bar gyur pa/zhes/gsungasapa dang /gzhan yang lung mang du yod do//des na gtso bo ni spyi bodang snying ga'i 0

thig le yin mod kyi/yan lag ni kunda lta bu thams cad do//thig lo de'i rangabazhin rgyud sde gzhan las ni/khams gsum gyi gnas so sor khams drug gochashas mang nyung tha dad par gsungs so//gnyis/pa gang gis zhu byed ni/gtso/rdemo ste dmar cha'i dwangs ma 'bar ba las yin la/de yang me'i 'khor lolasatshangs pa'i me 'bar bas bskul te lte ba'i gtum mo rab tu sad par byed pa dang /gsang ba'i 'khor los bskul ba las kyang 'bar bar byed de/mdor na/sbor byed kyi sto mo yang gsum te/lte ba dang /rdo rje'i sked pa dang /kludabang 'byil ba'i kṣa yig rnams so//gsum pa zhu bar byed pa'i rkyen ni/las/kyi rlung gis bskul ba yi//lte ba'i dkyil 'khor du ni 'bar//zhes gas rtsa/rdepas/dbu ma'i mas sna rgyas pa las thur sel gyi rlung gsar pa zhig dbu ma'i nang du skye nas/zhes tshangs pa'i me sbor bar byed/de'i me rlung go shu kha kyisalte ba'i gtum mo lhag par 'bar bar 'gyur ro//de yang steng sgo la ni/stengagorlung 'gag pa'i sbyor ba la yang yang gom par byas pas rim gyis dbu ma rgyas par 'gyur zhing /de yang steng rlung 'gags pas 'og gi dbu ma rgyas pa dang /de rgyas pas steng 'gag pa ci rigs pa 'ong /'og sgo la brten pa ni ji skad du phyag rgya chen po thig le las kyang /me 'khor nang du chu skyes ni//gang tshe rdo rje bskyod par byed//de tshe me ni khong du chud//'khor lo chu skyes thams cad ni//je gsal je gsal kha byer 'gyur//de rnams rtsa kun 'dzag gyur te//snod 'dzagapa yi chu thigs bzhin//zhes gsungs pa dang /rdo rje phreng ba las/kyang/dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma//gang tshe gsang ba'i rtsa gnyis po//yang dag sbyor bas

reg gyur pa//de tshe nam mkha' rnam rgyas nyid//nam mkha' las ni skyes pa'i rlung //de yis me ni sbar bar byed//rtsa ni stong phrag bdun cuganyis/khornams rab sad me de yis//bde ba kun gyi go 'phang mchog/bde ba chen po byang chub sems//rnam pa zhu nas rtsa gnas pa//zhes/ gsungs te/spyir mnyam/par spyor ba'i stobs kho na las kyang /de rnams phyogs mthun 'byung ba yin mod kyi/gtso bo ni rtsa'i sbyor bas zhu bde yongs su rdzogs pa 'dren pa ste/phyag zhi thig le las/padma'i snying po'i dbus na ni//rdo dbyings dbang phyug ma ni bzhugs//de ma rnyed kyi bar du ni//thabs gzhan la ni byang chub med//de ni rang bzhin dga' ba'i rgyu//phra mo'i phra mo yang dag mchod//ces rdorje dgyir/kyi dbang phyug ma'i rtsa'i sbyor bas so//gsum pa la/'di la yang thig/le dang/rlung dang /gtum mo'i rnal 'byor ci rigs par 'byung zhing /de dag rnams kyangalte ba'i gtum mo sbar nus pa phan chad ni 'jog pas so//rgyud sde so so'i man ngag rnams las kyang /de thams cad dam re re la rtsal du 'don pa ci rigasardepar snang ste/dwo ha sogs nas mi rtog pa rtsal du 'don pa dang /dus kholdenas dum can sogs rtsal du 'don pa dang /ḍombhi lhan cig skyes grub sogasagatum mo rtsal du 'don/ye shes zhabs skor rnams phra thig rtsal du 'don/'dus pa 'phags skor nas rdor bzlas rtsal du 'don/dbang yon tan rmi5pa sogs thog ma nas phyag rgya rtsal du 'don pa sogs yod pa bzhin no//gtum mo la dbye na/rnal 'byor gyi gtum mo//las kyi gtso4 mo/lhan skyes kyi gtum mo gsum las/dang po ni/rang lus la brten pa'i rnal 'byor thams cad de/

skabs 'dir ni me dmigs kyi gtum mo'o//gnyis pa las kyi gtum mo ni las rgya la brten nas gtum/ mo 'bar ba ste/ye rgya la'ang phyogs mthun du bsdu'o//gsum pa ni bde stong nyid kyis bde stong 'dren pa dang /rnam bcasaphyag chen rnams kyang ste/'di gsum du rdzogs rim phal cher 'du'o//gnyis pa gzhung don la/lte bar rlung thim pa'i rtags/de nas gtum mo 'bar tshul/byin gyis brlabs pa'i dmigs pa'i khyad par/sngags rim gyi ye shes ngos gzung ba/'phros don nyams rtogs 'byung tshul bshad pa zho/dngapo ni/ rdza 〉 rlung gnyis sogs te/o la pa ti las/bsrub bya srub byed yang dag par sbyor bas ye shes kyi me las kyi rlung gis sbar te lte ba'i dkyil 'khong ra du du ba 'thul ba dang /'bar ba dang gnas pa dang gsal ba dgasardezhes gsungs pas/bsrub bya srub byed ni ro rkyang gi rlung gnyis te/de gnyisarde'agag pa'i sbyor bas las kyi rlung rgyas nas/lte ba'i gtu pa mo 'bar te ltebarazhugs gnas thim gsum gyi mthar du ba la sogs pa'i rtags bzhi byung ba ni rlung gnyis thim pas gtum mo 'bar ba brtan pa'i rtags so//gnyis pa ni/dmar cha'i dwangs ma ga65 mo ste rim gyis thog mar ro ma nas 'bar bar 'gyur te gtum mo stobs chung /rtsa mdud dam pas dbu ma'i nang du 'baramathub pa'o//ro mar cung zad 'bar ba de nyid rim gyis rim gyis rje mthoje mthor song nas snying gar sleb ste/snying ga chos 'khor rim pas gang ba dang/yang ro ma nas song ste mgrin pa gang ba dang /yang ro ma nas song ste sgyi yi bar du 'gro bar 'gyur/de dag gi bar du drod re dang sbrags nas rtsa ༅satsi

rigs pa'i thig le zhu ba'i bde ba de yang 'ong la/ 'on kyang me shas che ba'i stobs kyis gang du mes phyin pa der gdung ba drag po bskyed par byed/ gtso/mo nam 'bar ba'i tshe gtum mos khyab pa'i rtsa thams cad kha dog dmar zhing shin tu 'od zer gsal bar 'gyur bas dmigs pa'i tshe'ang de bzhin byed pa yin no/ /de nas gtum mo'i me spyi bor sleb pa des byang chub sems dwangs ma'i gtso bo rnams spyi bor rim gyis 'grub par 'gyur la/ phyi nas 'bab para'agyur te/ rtsa mdud dam pa'i phyir dbu ma nas 'bab mi thub sto byang chub kyi sems kyi rtsa yin pas g.yon rkyang ma nas 'bab bo/ /de yang rim pas mgrin pa dang snying ga'i 'khor lo rnams khengs pas sngar gyi gdung ba zhi nas bde drod kyi nyams khyad par can skye zhing / mthar lte bar phyin pa na/ nye ba'i gtso/motshes gsal zhing nus pa dang ldan par 'gyur te dbu ma'i nang du 'bar bar byed pa'i cha rtsom mo/ /'di tshun chad sngon ro ma nas 'bar ba nas yud tsam gyisa'agrub pa ma yin te/ lo zla'i bar du 'bad pas rim gyis 'byung ba yin no/ /lan cig lte bar 'bar 'dzag 'phrad phyin dbu mar cung zad 'bar mod/re zhig ro rkyang gi 'bar 'dzag de ni 'byung ngo / /de yang shin tu phra ba'i gtso/mos dbu ma kha 'byed par byed kyang / dbu ma'i lam brgyud/ spyi bor ma phyin bar du ro ma'i 'bar ba mi 'chad cing / thig le dbu ma'i lam nas nye b.ratshaphyin bar du/ rkyang ma nas 'byung ba'ang mi zlog go /'bar 'dzag thams cad dbu mar rdzogs pa lan cig byas rjes su/ ro rkyang du 'bar 'dzag gi rgyu ba zlog go/'bar 'dzag cha tshang ba byung ba'i tshe/ ro rkyang ngam dbu ma gang la yang rung ste/—154

dga' bzhi cha tshang ba 'byung ngo //gsum pa ni/bde gshegs bdud rtsis byin rlabs pas//zhes pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyud la 'gro 'ong byed pa ste/'di la bha danta pa dang /tshe tsha gling pa sogs don gzhan du 'chad kyang/de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi byin gyis rlobs pa'i gnad khyad par can yod pas sangs rgyas rnams nyid kyis thugs rgyud bskul ba yin no//zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//'di ni byin rlabs 'jug pa'i gnad khyad par can te/lto mo sgomapa rnams kyis nan tan du 'tshal lo//bzhi pa ni lte bar sogs te/lte ba'i gtum mo 'bar ba nas brtsams te/lte bar thig le'i zegs mas sleb pa'i bde ba re ni 'byung la/gtso bo ni dbu ma'i nang nas 'bar 'dzag byas pasadapyid zhu ba'i thig le nye bar phyin pa/dpyid dang phag mo kha sbyor gyi bde ba'i ye shes lhan cig skyes pa'o//dpyid thig kyang rim pa 'di kho na'i skabs su gtso che ba yin la/spyir gong du bshad pa ltar sngags rim la rigs mi 'dra ba de snyed yod kyang /'bar 'dzag gi dbye ba mang po 'byung ba 'di ni/me dmigs kyi gtum mo kho na yin par mngon zhing /thig le dang rdo rje'i bzlas pa sogs lasa'abar 'dzag sgrub tshul 'di nyid tshes myur te/ro rkyang gi lam du 'bar 'dzagabyed pa la dka' ba med cing /de byung na dbu ma'i nang du 'bar 'dzag byed pa yang shin tu sla ba yin te/'khor lo so so 'bar 'dzag gis legs par sbyangasazin pa'i phyir ro//des na dbu mar rang du 'bar 'dzag byed pa de dka' bzhig yin pa la/shin tu sla ba'i ro rkyang gi 'bar 'dzag gis de yang tshe gos med par 'grub pa ni zab mo'i gnad do//gu ru lho phyogs pa'i zhal snga na ga spros

byas kyi rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'di rnams la/rdor bzlas thig le la sogs pa'i rnal 'byor dang /gtum mo'i rim pa dang /phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor rnams bde stong mtshon par byed pa la phyi ma phyi ma myur ba yin gsung /kha cig rtags lnga tshamathong bar du me dmigs sgom du mi rung zer ba ni/bsgom bya dang rgyud la skye tshul gyi dbye ba ma phyed pa ste rang bzo yin zhing /ro rkyang gi 'bar 'dzag rgyud gyogazhung gang nas kyang ma bshad/thun mong ma yin pa'i gtum/ mo'i rnam gzhanamashes pa yin zhes zer ba ni/de bas kyang rang gis ma shes pa yin zhing/rangagang gi rjes su 'brang ba'i bla mas kyang /sa skru zhi'i dgongs pa man snye'i lugs/su byas te/spyin bsreg gi nges don skabs/ro ma spyi bo'i thig lo 'chubar byed pa yin pas blug gzar dang /rkyang ma thig le 'bab byed yin pas dgangagazar yin par yang bshad na/rom nas gtum mo mi 'bar na de 'chu byed dang /rkyang ma spyinas bo'i byang sems mi 'bab na de 'bab byed yin pa de hrasasu 'gal ba'i phyir/rgyud gzhung rnams la dbang za bar ma zad rang lugs dngayang 'gal ba yin no//snga rabs kyi rjes 'brang du rlom pa kha cig kyang 'barab sngags rim dang /'dzag pa ye shes kyi rim pa la sbyor te/sangs rgyasamathob kyi bar du 'bar 'dzag lan cig las mi 'byung na bden no//des na ol pa ti las kyang snga ma ltar dam tshig gi 'khor ra lo sreg go zhes pa dmigs pa'i dbang du ma/ byas la dngos su 'byung ba'i dbang du byas pa dang /rgyud gzhungagazhan rnams las kyang de bzhin du 'byung bas lugs de dag ni ma brtags pa'o//gtum mo la zhu ba thim pas/gtum mos re ga bsil bar byed ces6

'byung ba'i bsil ba'i go don drod chung du song ba ni ma yin la/ bde ba skyesapas gdung ba dang bral ba'o/ /rtsa 'khor rnams su gtum mo 'bar ba brtan pa'i tshe/ 'od zer ba sbu'i bu ga nas byung ste lha dang lha min thams cad skrag parabyed ces gsungs pa ni/ de rnams kyis sgrub pa po la de ltar mthong ba'o/ /lnga pa la sngags rim gyi ngo bo/ sa mtshams/ lam rtags kyi rnam gzhag go/dang po ni/'bar 'dzag khyad par can la brtan pa'i bde drod kyi ye shes so/ /gnyis pa ni/'khor lo bzhi'i rtsa mdud cher grol te/ cha bzhi pa'i dga' bzhi 'dren nus pa tshud chad de/ de phan chad ni ye shes kyi rim pa'o/ /gsum pa la zhugs gnas thim gsum spyir bstan pa dang / rtags snang zhib mor bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ dmigs pa la nam sems gtad pa'i tshe mnyam rgyur nges par thongs na dbu mar zhugs pa ste 'bab pa yin no/ /gtso/ mo cung zad 'bar ba re 'di la'ang rtag par yod cing / dmigs pa gtad kyang mnyam rgyu zlog ste slar yon por 'bab na/ gnad 'byugs pa lasogs pas 'bar 'phro chad pa yin no/ /sna sgo'i rgyu ba 'gags shing rtsa rnamasami 'gu/la la/ lus/gang la snyam byed pa ni gnas pa snyed bu mar 'gags pa yin no/ /de yang yal ba ni thim pa ste 'di la'ang bde drod khyad par can byung na gnad du song ba yin zhing / spyir bde drod tsam 'byung ba dbu mar 'gags pa'i nges pa med la/ drod la'ang bde ba 'byung bsam khyab/ drod la tha mal pa lasrab 'thug myur bul phyi nang la sogs pa'i rigs mi 'dra ba mang du 'byung /zhugs gnas kyi skabs su rtags snang ci rigs pa dang / thim pa'i skabasasu—157

rtags lnga 'char la/ 'bar 'dzag legs par 'phrad nas brtson pa ma dor na/thun so sor rtags lnga'i mjug tu snang gsum phyogs mthun dang dga' ba bzhi 'char ro/ /gnyis pa la/ zin pa'i rtags bzhi/ brtan pa'i rtags druga'abyongs pa'i rtags bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ steng 'og gi rlung dbu mar zin pa ste/'bab pa'i skabs su me rlung zin pas snang ba bun long nge ba du ba lta bu dang / chu rlud la gya gyu srab srab po smig sgyu lta bu dang rlud go rlung la snang ba tsig tsig me khyer lta bu dang / sa rlud la mar chagayo ba med pa ltar brtan zhing gsal ba 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa ni/ skabs drug po 'di la phyi nang gi rtags mthun na/lam gyi rigs drug gi ye shes yin la/ ma mthun na mi ma yin gyis rlamasapa'am nges med kyi nyams ban bun tsam mo/ /de la 'og sgo'i lam gyi dbu maras rlung brtan pa na/ phyir nyi zla nyin mtshan go zlog tu 'char/ nang lus nyamasasu lus lci ba dang / yan lag spom por 'phel te skrangs pa snyam byed pa dang/rmi lam nyams su 'dren non pa lta bu 'byung / 'di dag drug gar la nang du mirtog pa'i ye shes gsal stong shas che zhing bde ba cung zad dang bcas pa 'byung ngo / /dri chu'i lam gyi dbu mar chu rlung brtan pas phyir thi mo zla ba dang skaratshogs mthong ba dang / lus dngos po gang la yang byings 'gro ba snyam byed pa 'byung / ro ma'i sna rtses bcings pa'i dpral pa'i dbu mar me rlung brtan pagame chen po 'bar bar mthong bas lus la drod mi zad pa skye zhing nam mkha' la 'phar 'gro ba snyam byed cing / shes pa rtsub rtsub khro snying 'dod/ rmi la pa du mechen po rtag tu rmi ba 'ong / rkyang ma'i yas rtse sna bug g.yon gyi thad son yod pa —158—

des bcings pa'i dbu mar rlung gi rlung brtan pas 'ja' tshon gyi dkyil 'khor mthong ste/ bad kan shas tshen dkar po/ mkhris shas che na ser po/ khrag shasache na dmar po/ 'dus pa la cha mnyam pa'o/ /nam mkha' la 'phyar bsnyam byed pa dang / rmi lam du 'phur ba dang g.yangs la mchong ba sogs 'byung/ de ngosasu'aphar g.yo byed pa byung na 'debs pa'i gdams ngag dgos/ rlung gi rlungarorkyang dbu ma gsum lce lkog tu 'dus par brtan pas byad skrangs snyam pa dang/ /mgo la srog chags rgyu ba snyam byed pa dang / sna la sbrul rgyu ba dang /no bar nā da'i sgra ci rigs par 'byung ba dang / lce chung nas bdud rtsi 'bab pa snyawa'abyung / rlung de nyid lte 'og tu brtan pa thig le nag po mthong ba dang/ lusabade bas zhu ba snyam byed pa dang / rmi lam du yang bde ba 'byung ro/ /ye shes kyi rlung dung can mar brtan pas mngon shes phra mo 'byung / a wa dhwa tir gas/sabarnyan sbrul mgo'i gdeng ka lta bu phyi nang gnyis char du mthong / tshos mthong thosal sogs pa'i rkyen gyis dad pa rlabs po che skye/ nyams kyi snang ba'i yid dmagyi lha mang po mthong / de la then pa mi bya/ zhen pa byung na phung po'i bdud kyisa'abyer ba yin zhes jo bo nā ro pa gsung ngo / /phyi ma 'di rdo rje sems dpa' dngagazhan rnams 'byung ba'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i rigs kyi dbye ba dang sbyar ro/ /de yan chad dbu mar 'gro'ong mi thub pas ro rkyang gi 'bar 'dzag can no/ /'di dag tu gzhan yang 'phar g.yo 'byung ngo / /der ro smad na ba'i khyad par rnams ni thur sel zin pa la'ang yod pas de byung na smin phrag tu semasagatad/ der mgo bor zug skye na gyen rgyu zin rgyas byung ba ste lte bar gtad/ de —159—

yang na na mnyam gnas zin rgyas te mgrin par gtad der yang mi bde na lce dbang la zin rgyas byung ba ste snying gar gtad/de yang mi bden na srog won zin rgyas te nor bur gtad/der lus thams cad la zug skye na khyab byed zin rgyas te rang bzhin med par bsgom/'ga' zhig 'di dag la zur za ste/grub chen ḍombhi pa'i gtum mo rim pa gsum par yang bshad pas ci brtol ma skyed cig de ltar goms pas brtan por song ba na/gsum pa ni/ro rkyang gi mas sna dbu mar chud pa ste/wa go/ gi lam gsum 'gag/lte bar rtsa khams thig/lebarten pa yi dam gyi snang ba mang po la chos nyan/lus kyi bkod pa sna tshogasardedang /'byung ba bzhi la thogs pa med pa sogs mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul/ci rigs pa res 'ga' 'byung /res 'ga' zhig mi 'byung /lte 'og tu gtso/rdemoye shes kyi me sor gnyis kyi tshad lan gnyis su 'bar zhing shi nas gsum pa la lte bar phyin par 'gyur/phung po lnga'i rnam rtog mngon 'gyur 'gag lte ba'i rtsa mdud grol bas gtum mo 'bar ba dngos su mthong ba dang /'byung ba lnga'i rlung gi rgyu ba gsal ba snang /de brtan par gyur na las bzhi thogs med du 'grub/nam mkha'i rlung gi nus pas me dang dug dang gcan gzan la sogasardepar rengs par byed/sems can mang po ngan song nas 'dren pa dang/sa pa༅rgyas byang chub sems dpas cho me ston pa rmi ste dang po'o//yang gtum molarab lam gnyis su zlog/gsum pa ni mi zlog ste/snying gi rtsa ma du da'agrol/khams lnga'i rnam rtog nub/snying ga'i padma kha gyen du ston par gyur te/mngon shes lnga shin tu rgya che zhing brten pa 'byung /spyir rtsa 'khor kha gyen du bstan pa 60

ste/ thig le 'bab pa'i rtsa rnams gyen du bstan pa na/ rten thig lo brtan pasabarten pa ye shes kyang khyad par du bstan par 'gyur te/ phyag chen thig le las/lte ba'i rtsa bar srog rlung ni/ /skad cig tsam yang mi byed na/ /gang zhig padma khaphung 'di/ /skad cig gis ni gyen du 'gyur/ /de yis lte ba'i dbus su/sems ni brtan par 'gyur ba'o/ /zhes gsungs te gnyis pa'o/ /yang sorabacu drug 'bar ba lan gnyis zlog par 'gyur la/ gsum pa mi zlog cingamagrin pa'i rtsa mdud kha phye/ skye mched drug gi rnam rtog nub/ lce de bzhin gshegs pa'i ljags lta bur gyur ngag gi dbang phyug 'grub/ sde snod kyi chosardernams ma bslabs kyang shes/ mig rtsa dmar ba dang dbang du byed pa'i lta stangasa'agrub pa stogasum pa'o/ /de nas gtum mo ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i rgyun gcig gis spyi bor sleb/ 'di phyin chad gtum mo dang 'bar 'dzag brtan pa thob pa zhes bya/ dbu mar 'bar 'dzag rdzogs pa rtag par 'ong ro/ /tshe lce'i rtsemo phra mo rlung dang bcas pas rim gyis smin mtshams su phyin te/ smin mtshamasagand kyi sgo zhes bya ba dbu ma'i yas sna 'byed pa yin/ gzhi dus su ni rmechiba'i tshe gnad gcod pa dang de 'brel ba'i sgo yin pas gnad kyi sgo zer zhesagasung ngo / /des na dbang po'i sgo rnams su yang gtum mo'i me lce 'gro/ de nasasgrub pa pos bskul ba'i sems med kyang / me lce'i 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul te byin gyis brlob pa yin pas ched kyis ma bsgoms kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyud la 'gro 'ong byed par rang bcas su 'ong / 'dis sngags rim gyi rtogs pa thams cad mthar phyin pa yin —161—

no/ /bzhi pa'o/ /gsum pa ye shes kyi rim pa la spyi don dang gzhud don go nyegadang po la dga' bzhi'i rnam gzhag rgyas par bshad pa la/ dga' ba bcu drugagi ngo bos ngos gzung ba/ zhu bde dang rang bzhin gyi 'brel ba/ ye shes kyi ritshapa'i skye tshul rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /gsang ba chen po 'di dag shin tu brjod par bya ba mang zhing zab la phra ba'i gnas yin mod kyi/ mdor bsdus cung zad cig brjod na/ dang po la/ bya rtsol la ltos pa'i dga' bzhi dang/ bsnyen sgrub bzhi la ltos pa'i dga' bzhi dang / snang ba gsum la ltos pa'i dga' bzhi dang/'khor lo la ltos pa'i dga' bzhi dang / lam gyi sa mtshams la bzhag pa'i dga' bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ dges pa rdo rje dang / sa bu zhir yang mang du bshad cing / gzhan las kyang 'byung ba ni skad cig ma bzhi dang sbyor ba ste/ dzi skad du brtag pa gnyis pa las/ sna tshogs dang po'i dga' ba nyid/ /rnam smin la ni mchod dga' nyid/ /rnam nyid dga' bral dga' ba nyid/ /mtshan bral lhan cigaskyes dga' nyid/ /ces dga' ba dang rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i skad cig ma/mchog dga' dang rnam par smin pa'i skad cig ma/ khyad dga' dang rnam paranyed pa'i skad cig ma/ lhan skyes dang mtshan nyid bral ba'i skad cig ma rnamasasbyar te/ skad cig ma bzhi ni/ 'byud pa la sogs pa phyi'i bya ba sna tshogs pa ni skad cig ma dang po'o/ /rdo rje padma mnyam par sbyar bas rgyu phyi'i bya ba nyung zhing/'bras bu bde ba che ba ni rnam smin/ de las 'das te sems cung zad mi rtogapas chags pa spangs/ thig le ma lhung bas chags bral spangs pa ste mtshan nyid dang bral ba'i skad cig ma/ de ltar gyi dus na bde ba med kyang sngar nyamasasu—162—

myong ba dran par byed pa ni rnam par nyed pa'i skad cig ma ste/ de rnams kyi dusasu dga' ba re re 'char bas phyi'i bde ba tsam ni dga' ba/ thig le spyi bonasagasang gnas su babs pa'i bde ba ni mchog dga'/ gsang ba'i rdo rje laganas pa'i dga' ba ni lhan skyes/ tha mal pa rnams kyi lhung bas chags bral du gyur pa dang / /lam dus su gyen du gshegs pa'i chags bral ni dga' bral te/mchog mtha' dga' bral dang por ni/ mun pa la ni mar me ltar/ /de bzhin bus kyang yid tshes kyis/ zhes pa'i gzhung ni lhan skyes gsum par ston pa shin tu gsal ba yin par/ mnga' bdag mi tri pa 'di kho na bzhed cing/ sdom pa bshad pa yang / gzhan yang dga' ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ /phreng ba tsan dan bud med sogs/ /gang tshe mthong bas bde 'dzin pa/ /de tshe dga' bar yang dgabashad/ /sems can kun la yang dag gnas/ /rdo rje padma ra mnyam sbyorabs/ /ji ltar sems ni rnam par gnas/ /de yis sems gang mo tshon pa ni/ /de tshe mchog tu dga' bar brjod/ /sbyor ba las ni dga' bral semag /bde ba'i mthar ni yang dag gnas/ /de ni dga' bral zhes byar gsung ga khye dang 'jig par rab tu grags/ /dga' dang mchog tu dga' ba dang/ /dga' bral dang ni rnam gsum mo/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin 'di/ /brtan g.yo kun gyi rang bzhin te/ /lhan cig skyes pa thams cad gang / bsam yas su ni rgyal bas gsungs/ /gang phyir brjod med kun 'gro la/ /ye shes he rukarubarjod/ /ces sogs lhan skyes la rgyas bshad kyang mdzad do/ /sle bod pon nagapo chung ba zhes bya ba dngos grub brnyes pa zhig gis mdzad pa bde mchog nag po —163—

lugs kyi dgongs 'grel khyad par can te 'dir yang bde ba'i mthar ni zhes dga' bral tha mar bshad do/ /yang lhan skyes gnyis shor gnyis mnyam du bshad pa ni/ thig le cha bzhi bab pa la cha gnyis padma ra 'babs pa ste rtsa'i snartser lhung / cha gnyis ma lhung ba ste gnyis lhung bas stong pa dang/ gnyis gnasapas gsal ba dang bde ba'i char song ste bde stong cha mnyam pa'o/ /rgya bod gzhan mang pos de nan gyis 'gog la/ mchog mtha' dga' bral dang po can/ /zhes 'don par byed mod kyi/ rgyud tha dad pa'i dgongs pa don ga khonar sgrig dgos na/ sems can bsam pa'i dbang gis lam gyi 'jug sgo mtha' yas pa gsungs zhes zer ba'ang tshig tsam du song zhing / rgyud sa khring/nasakyang he ru ka zhal phyag mi 'dra ba mang du ston pa la 'gal ba med pa bzhin du/dga' bzhi'i rnam gzhag kyang mi 'dra bar ston pa 'gal ba med do/ /dga' bzhi dbang bzhi dang sbyar ba ni bum dbang dus ye rgya dang 'byud pa'i dga' ba tsam yod pa dang / gsang dbang la padma ra ltas pa'i dga' ba mchog dga' tsamayod pa dang / shes rab ye shes la bzhi char yod kyang lhan skyes mtshon mi spyosapas dga' bral dang / dbang bzhi pa'i ye shes sgom byung ni lhan skyes mtshon nus pas der bzhag pa dang / dbang ni bzhi yis grangs nyid kyis/ /dga' ba la sogs rim shes bya/ /zhes gsungs te/ shes rab ye shes nyid la bzhin phye ba rgod pa'i bde ba sogs dga' ba shes rab ye shes nyid kyi bum dbang ngo / /bha ga ltas pa gsang dbang / lag bcangs shes rab ye shes dang ge nyesasprod bzhi pa ste 'di yang bya rtsol la ltos pa'i dga' bzhi 'jog mtshams mi 'dra —164—

ba zhig go/dpal sangs rgyas thod pa las/ji skad du/mthong ba las ni 'dod chags skye//'khyud la 'bras bu cung zad tsam/khrud pa las ni dga' ba skye//kun gyi tha mar dga' bral lo//zhes sngar bshad pa'i dang po la dga' ba gnyis su phye ba ste/gzugs sgra dri gsum gyi bde ba dga' ba dang /ro regagomachog dga' dang /byang chub kyi sems zhu ba'i bde ba lhan skyes dang/zhun pa nor bur ma 'phos par bcings pa dga' bral du bshad pa dang /de dgakyang tshad med bzhin bshad de/lha dang ldan pa snying rje dang //'khyud pa byamasapar 'gyur ba'o//drud pa'i sbyor ba'i bdag nyid ni//dga' ba yan lag ma yi mchog/gnyis ka 'dus las gang 'dzag pa/de ni bdag gis btang snyomasagasungs//zhes bshad pa ni/theg pa 'dir thun gcig la 'char ba rdzogasarderim gyi dga' bzhir grags pa 'di dag la/dmigs pa med pa'i tshad med bzhin 'dogs pa'o//gnyis pa ni/'dus pa rgyud phyi ma sogs mang po'i dgongs don te/zhal lung las/rdo rje padma ra reg pa ni//bsnyen pa'i de nyid yin par bshad//rdo rje padma ra zhugs pa ni//nye bar sgrub pa'i de ho do//denas bskul zhing bskyod tsam gyis//snying ni 'dar zhing dran pa nyam ga/spyi bo'i skra grol gos kyang 'dor/rdul gyis lus khyab mdog dmar dang //rig dmaraphra bas bdag la lta//yang yang bskul bas sgrub pa'o//de nas sems/khral/med pa sa/sdom brtson gzhi dbyibs g.yo ba yis//sum mdo ye shes tshe sbarabs/khams zhu nas ni bcu drug char//gyur pa me tog kunda 'dra//rlud ni sbyorabs phul bar bya//rang bzhin gyis ni rab zhi ba//chos kun zhi ba de kho6

na/ /bde ba de nyid nor bur 'dug /skad cig dran med g.yo bar byed/ /sgrub pa chen po'i de nyid do/ /zhes dbang po gnyis reg pa dga' ba dang/ rtsaganyis 'phrad pa mchog dga' dang / bskyod pa khyad par gyi dga' ba dang/ byangachub kyi sems gsang ba'i nor bur brtan pa na lhan skyes so/ /gzhu dbyibs ni rlud ste las rlung thur sel gyi dmar cha 'bar bas cha bcu drug gi byang sems zhu ba rlud gis 'gyur ba bkag ste/ rnam rtog gi dran pa dang g.yo ba med pa'i lhan skyes mtshon par bya'o/ /'di'i bsnyen sogs ni dga' ba'i bsnyen sgrub bzhi ste/rang bzhin bde ba chen po la nye bar bsnyen pa dang / dngos su sgrub pa la las/pa dang sgrub pa dngos dang phal cher grub pa'o/ /sgrub pa ni ye shes lnga ldan te'adar ba dang dran pa nyams pa ni gsal tsam las sems g.yo zhing brtan pa nyams pa me long ye shes/ skra grol bas ni rnam rtog mi rags pas 'dun tshuwazhig pa ste/ rtog pa cung zad nyams pas sor rtogs ye shes/ go so'i dor ba ni 'dzem bag dang bral ba ste/ dbye ba'i rnam rtog bral bas chos dbyings ye shes/lus rdul gyis khyab pa ni rgyu ba sna tshogs pa zhan pas mnyam nyid ye shes/mdog dmar ba dang mig dmar ba phra bas lta ba ni/ gdung ba'i bya ba yin pasabya sgrub ye shes te/ 'di ni shes rab ma las 'byung ba ste/ de'i gzhan rkyen gyisathob pa'i bdag nyid la yang dga' ba'i khyad par thob pa ste/ dga' ba'i sgrub pa ye shes lnga ldan zhes bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ snying ga na byang sems 'dus pasaltos bya yang yod mod/ gtso bor dga' bzhi'i dbang du byas pa dbab zlogalagatso bor tshang dgos pas/ byang sems rdo rje'i rtsa pa bar phyin pa na snang bdang—166—

dga' ba/ sked par phyin pa na mched pa dang mchog dga'/ nor bu'i mgul du phyin pa na thob pa dang khyad dga'/ rtse mor brtan pa na 'od gsal dang lhan skyes so/ /phyag chen thig le las/ gang phyir dga' ba de snang ba/ /snang ba mched pa mchog dga' bshad/ khyad dga' nye bar thob par shes/ /lhan cigaskyes de 'od gsal ba'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di'i ye shes kyi rim pa'i rtogasapa skyes pa lta bu gcig la/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog 'gags tshul khyad par can rnams 'byung ba yin la/ spyir dga' bzhi dang snang ba bzhi ge nyesagacig kyang / zhu bde snying gar bsdus pa'i dga' bzhi dang / thig lo dbab zlog gi dga' bzhi gnyis mi 'dra bas/ snying ga na bsdus pa'i 'od gsal las langs pa'i snang ba gsum dang / thig le gsang gnas nas gyen du ldog pa'i snang ba'i khyad par ro/ /de yang mas brtan dga' ba ni rlung sems thig lo dbu ma'i nang nas phyir gyes pa med la/ phyi ma phyi ma bde ba yang lhag cing/'od gsal las langs pa'i snang gsum lugs zlog ni/ rlud dbu ma nas phyir gyesapa'i rim pa yin la/ bde nyams kyang phyi ma phyi ma chung ngo / /rlung sems dbu mar zhugs pa brtan por song ba'i skabs shig nas/ mas brtan gyi thig le brtan pa'i mgo rtsom ste/ de phan chad mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi thams cad kyang lhan skyes yin no/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang mas brtan lhan skyes de las yas brtan rnams bde ba yang che zhing / gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog kyang nub phul che bsalhan skyes las ma g.yos pa'i phyir der bzhag go de'i phyir gnas skabs de nas bzung ste mas brtan la lhan skyes kyis khyab cing / de gong du ni dga' ba —167

gsum dang lhan skyes kyi gzhi mthun pa med par mngon ste/ kyai rdorje las/ yangan de nyid thams cad bdag /yang na kun gyi rnam par spangs/ /zhes gas5saso/ kha cig mas brtan yin na/ lhan skyes kyis khyab par 'dod pa ni/ rangagis/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i phyogs la ni/ /'di ltar lhan cig skyes rnam bzhi/zhes pas bstan par 'dod pa gnyis 'gal bar mthong ste/ rdzogs rim ma yin pa la yang mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi tsam po yod pas so/ /bzhi pa la 'khor lo bde mchog gi rang lugs ni/ mngon brdod blamalas/ lte ba snying bar nu ma'i dbus/ lce'i rtsa dang mgo stengs su/ dga' ba dang ni mchog dga' nyid/ /dam par dga' dang lhan cig skyes/ /dang po 'dab madrug cu bzhi/ /gnyis pa brgyad pa mchog yin te/ /gsum pa 'dab ma bcu drugapa/ /bzhi pa sum cu rtsa gnyis 'dab/ /phag mo nye ba'i rtsar gnas pa/ snyan cig skyes dga' khrag 'thung mchoge /ces gsungs pa gzhan rnams go sla ste mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi ston pa yin/ phag mo lte ba'i rtsar gnas pa/ zhesapa'i phag mo ni lte ba'i gtum mo a shad yin la/ don dam pa'i khrag 'thung lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba yang snyen ra lo 'di nas bskyed ces zugad pas 'di ni yas babs yin no/ /de yang spyi bo nas zhu ste mgrin par sleb pa dga' ba/ de nas snying gar sleb pa mchog dga'/ de nas nye bar sleb pa dga' bral/ de nas nor bur sleb pa lhan cig skyes pa'o/ /lugs zlog gi tshe yang lte bar sleb pas dga' ba rdzogs/ snying gar sleb pas mchog dga' rdzogs/ mgrin parasleb pas dga' bral rdzogs/ spyi bor sleb pas lhan skyes rdzogs te 'di ni —168—

gsang 'dus rdo rje phreng ba dang / ma rgyud phal cher las kyang rim pa 'di khonasagasungs pa mang ngo / /dus kyi 'khor lo las ni gtsug tor nas smin mtshams/kyi 'kho7ra lor zhu ba dga' ba dang / mgrin par babs pa mchoge dga' dang/snying gar babs pa dga' bral dang / de man chad lhan skyes su 'jog pa dpa/mas brtan dang po gsum gzhan dang 'dra ba la/ lhan skyes gtsug tor du brtan pa la 'jog go /'dir gsungs pa'i phyi'i bya rtsol yang / ji skad du/ 'dod pa bskyed par byed pa 'gro ba rang gi yid la'o gang ba dang ni gang ba nyid du 'gyur/ gang ba yan lag mchog dag la ni ri bong 'dzin pa zhu bar byas nasa'abar ba'i thig le bzang po 'dzag /o ṭas bkug pa mchog gi bde ba rang bzhin gyis ster thig le grol ba dag ni gsum gyi mthar/ zhes gsungs te/mthong ba dang reg pa las 'dod pas yid gdung ba ni dga' ba/ 'khyud pa lasogs pa'i bya bas thig le cung zad zhu ba ni mchoge dga'/ thig le gnang b.raphyin pa ni khyad dga'/ nor bur son pa 'dzag pa'i skad cig ni lhan cig skyesapa'i dga' ba'o/ /yang dbang bzhi'i ye shes dga' bar sbyar ba ni/ rmeje ga rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa so sor dbye ba yod mod kyi/ bsdu na gong ma chen po'i skabs su nang gi 'khor lo dang rim pa bzhin du sbyar te shes rab ma'i nu ma la reg pa las thob pa ni dga' ba bum pa'i dbang ste/ bde ba nar ma son pa'i phyir byis pa/ gsang ba rdo rje cung zad bskyod pas mchog dga' ni bde ba shin tu 'phel yang mi brtan pas dar ma/ yun ring du bskyod pas rdo rje nor bu'i rtsemor 'ong ba sngar gyi yon tan nyis 'gyur du 'phel zhing smin yang mi brtan pas —169—

rgan po'o/ /der rnam bcas phyag gyo chen po gzugs brnyan dang bde bdabyeramed du bsgoms pas 'dzag med thob pa gang yin pa ni bzhi pa lhan skyes shes rab ye shes chen po ste/ shin tu brtan pa skye dgu'i bdag po'o/ /dbang mo dorabastan las kyang / bum pa dang ni gsang ba'i dbang / /shes rab ye shes mo ngon brjod pa/ /slar yang shes rab chen po 'di/ /de'i ye shes mngon parabarjod/ /'gyur zhing 'gyur te de nas 'dzag /de nas gzhan ni 'dzag med pa'o/ /zhes dang / byis pa dar ma de nas rgan/ /bzhi pa dag ni skyedagu'i bdag /shes rab yan lag nu ma ni/ /reg las byang chub sems 'pho bde/ /gang phyir byis pa bde thob pa/ /zhes dang / gsang ba mnyes las yun ring skyes/ /byang chub sems 'pho bde ba ste/ zhes dang / yun zin gsang ba mnyes las skyes/ /rdo rje'i rtse mor 'dzag pa ste/ /zhes dang/ phyag rgya tshe la rjesachags pas/ /rgyu mthun las skyes bde ba gang / /gang phyir rgyu mthun nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di dag 'khor lo bde mchog gi phyogs la yangaphyag rdor bstod 'grel las rgyas par gsungs pa de blta bar bya'o/ /lnga pa ni/gong du bshad pa'i snang gsum gyi rtogs pa skyes pa dang / dga' ba dngapogasum gyi rtogs pa skyes pa ni don gcig /dpe'i 'od gsal mthar thug skyesapa dang / lhan skyes kyi rtogs pa skyes pa yang don gcig ste/ rtogs pa'i rim pa yon tan yar ldan du 'ong ngo / /gzhi dus kyi snang gsum tshan bzhi yod pa de dag kyang / don gyi gzhi dus kyi dga' bzhir yang 'gyur mod kyi/ de lta na yanga'akhrig dus kyi bzhi ni dngos yin la/ gzhan rnams ni cha mthun tsam yin no/ /—170—

gnyis pa la/ spyir bstan du dga' ba bcu drug gi sa mtshams dang/de'i dbyangs 'char tshul bstan pa dang / bye brag tu phyag rgya las thob pa'i dga' ba bcu drug gorang bzhin bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ phyag rgya chen po thigalesogs thig le'i skor rnams las shin tu rgyas par bshad cing / khyad par phyagachen thig le las/ tshangs bug nas ni mgrin gnas su/ /de tsam du ni thig lebazhi/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs te/ spyi bo nas mgrin pa'i bar du chabazhin byas pa la/ dang pos dga' ba'i dga' ba dang / gnyis pas dga' ba'i mchog dga' dang / gsum pas dga' ba'i dga' bral dang / bzhi pas dga' ba'i lhan skyes te/ byang chub kyi sems de dag tu phyin pa na/ dga' ba'i skad cig ma bzhi po de dag skye bar shes par bya ste/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lo'i stod du phyin pa na dga' ba'i dga' ba rdzogs shing / mgrin pa'i 'khor lo'i rtsam dud kyi smad khon nas mchog dga'i dga' ba'i mgo rtsom ste/ mgrin pa nas snyingaga'i bar la cha bzhir byas pas/ cha re re'i gnas su mchog dga'i dga' ba nas lhan skyes kyi bar bzhi po 'char la/ snying ga nas lte ba'i bar la chabazhinabyas pa la/ dga' bral gyi bzhi 'char te/ dga' bral gyi dga' ba nas de'i lhan skyes kyi bar ro/ /lte ba nas nor bu'i bar cha bzhir byas pa'i cha re rel/lhan skyes kyi dga' ba nas/ lhan skyes kyi bar 'char ro/ /yang nyi me'i bgrod pa la ltos pa'i dga' ba bcu gnyis kyang bshad de/ dga' ba che chung gsu5nasalhan skyes che chung gsum gyi bar te/ dpral pa nas mgrin pa'i bar la chagasum/du byas pa'i cha re re'i mtshams su 'char ba yin no/ /mas brtan kyi dga' ba —171—

bcu drug 'char ba'i tshad ni sngar gyi de nyid go zlog pa ste/ gsang ba nas lte bo'ibar du cha bzhir byas pa la/ cha dang por byang chub kyi sems zlog pa na dga' ba'i dga' ba 'char ba nas thams cad la rim pa bzhin du sbyar te/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo'i dbus su sleb pa lhan skyes kyi lhan cig skyes pa'i bar ro/ /thigale'abab pa'i tshe spyi bo nas rgyun mi 'chad par 'bab pa sogs kyi nges pa ni med do/ /'on kyang spyi bo'i byang chub kyi sems de nyid kyis drangs te/ rtsa ༅ sagazhan gyi thig le rnams je 'phel du 'bab pas/ yas brtan la gnas kyi khyad par re re bzhin du dma' ram gyi bde ba shas che la/ mas brtan la ni gnasamatho ris kyi bde ba shas che ba yin no/ /'on kyang yas brten gyi dga' ba bcu drug gis bde stong gi ye shes mtshan nyid tshang bar mtshon nus nas kyang / masabartan gyi dga' ba ji bzhin mtshon nus pa la yun ring du thogs te thig le spyi bor 'gro 'ong byed pa legs par shes kyang / de las bde chen 'dren mi nus pa mang ngo / /thig le lugs 'byung gi cha shas gcig brtan pa de'i tshe/ mas brtan mtshon pa nus te/ 'di'i ye shes kyi rim pa'i rtogs pa skyes pa dang/ masabartan dngos su mtshon nus pa dus mnyam mo/ /dngos sam ji bzhin du masabartan marsā pa'i don dbu mar zlog pa'i bde stong 'dren pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/'di'i lugs kyi dga' ba'i skad cig ma bzhi la a ā i yī rnams dang /mchog dga'i bzhi la u mū ṛ grwa/ khyad dga'i bzhi la le zhwa e e/ lhan skyes kyi bzhi la o au a a rnams yas brtan mas brtan gnyis char la 'char/ dusakyi 'khor lo las ni dbyangs sum cu 'char tshul yas brtan mas brtan sdoms —172—

pa dga' ba'i skad cig ma so gnyis la rim pa bzhin du/ a i lhu rtsa sna zhi lo.e ar tse du al/ ha ya ra wa ra la a/ lā wā rā yā hā a'i/e sto ura'i/ā/ āoṃmū grwa yī ā a rnams 'char bar bshad do//dbyangs 'char ba'i thig le'i ming ni/ phyag chen thig le las/ 'od dang stobs dang sprin dang mtshungs/ /dbugs dang utpal sa dang yid/ /snying po zla nyi mun pa dang / /mchog dang sgra dang ro dang glog /de ni bcu drug shes par bya/ /bde ba'i thig le dri med do//zhes gsungs shing / snying stobs brgyad la sogs pa'ang bshad do/ /'di dgargyas par thig le skor bzhi sogs las shes par bya'o/ /dbyangs 'char ba'i don thig le 'pho ba bcu drug gi dwangs ma zhu ba'i don no/ /gsum pa ni/ dpalaphyag rgya chen po theg le las/ so rbo'i skad cig ma'i ming yang bshad de/ ji skad du/ 'dod dang 'dar dang 'gro ba dang / /dga' ba dang ni bzhi yin te/ /de ni dang po sbyor ba yin/ /de ni dga' ba'i don yin no/ /rgyas dang twan dngaḥngab dang / /mchog gi dga' ba bzhi yin te/ /de ni sbyor ba gnyis pa yin/ /mchog gi dga' ba'i don yin no/ /'bar dang thig le myos pa dang / /dga' bral dang ni bzhi yin te/ /de ni sbyor ba gsum pa yin/ /dga' bral dga' ba'i don yin no/ /o sna dang ni tshul dang gnyid/ /lhan cig skyes pa bzhi pa'o/ /de ni sbyor ba bzhi pa ste/ /dga' ba'i skad cig bcu drug go /de la 'dod pa te 'dod chags kyis yid dkrugs pa dang / lus 'dar ba ni 'darab dang / phyi rol kyi rtsa gnas na rangs sar byang chub kyi sems g.yo ba ni 'grob dang / de las bde ba cung zad thob pa ni dga' ba ste dang po bzhi gi /spyod —173—

sems rgyas pa dang / 'dod 'dun shugs drag pa dang / thig le 'byung bdang de las mchog tu dga' ba ste bde ba thob pa ni gnyis pa bzhi'o/ /drod 'bar ba dang / thig le lhag par zhu ba dang / myos pa ltar rnam rtog dang dran pa nub pa dang / 'dod 'dun nub pa ni chags bral te gsum pa bzhi dang / rtsa dang rludadang sems dang thig le kha sbyor du gyur pa'i nus pas kunda 'chings pa tsam o spyo dang / dbu ma'i sgra 'byung ba tshul dang / rnam rtog nub cing gsal ba na gnyid yur dang / de las mchog tu bde ba thob pa ni lhan skyes te bzhi pa bzhi'o/ /dus 'khor las ni 'di dag dang ming phyogs mthun gsungs kyang don ni dga' bzhi la ldog myos phye ba yin pas migacig ste/ yang der dga' ba bzhi la re reralus ngag yid dang ye shes kyi dbye bas phye bas dga' ba bcu drug tu gsungs pa mang la/ cha shas bcu drug gsungs pas skad cig ma bcu drug kyang don gyis ni bstan no/ /gsum pa la gnyis las/ dang po sgrub byed thun mong ma yin pa'i rkyen ni rang lus kyi rtsa dbu ma la gnad du bsnun pa dang / phyag rgya bston pa'o/ /yas brtan dang mas brtan gyis thig le byang chub kyi sems dbu mirabartan par byed pa ni thog mtha' bar gsum du rang lus kyi dbu ma la gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs dang / rnam bcas rnam med kyi stong nyid sgom pa kun yang ngesapar dgos mod kyi/ 'di'i dngos rgyu ni las kyi phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor gyi sgrub pa yin no/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo las kyang / me ni dngul chu'i dgra nyid yin te me dang rnam par bral na dngul chu nam yang 'a cing ba med/ /ma bcings na ni gser byed med de gser dang bral na smra po rnams la longs spyod med pa —174—

nyid/ /de bzhin bud med sbyor ba bral na rtag tu rnal 'byor pa rnams dgagisems ni 'ching mi 'gyu/ra/ /bcings pa med na lus 'bugs med de ma phugs lus kyi lhan skyes bde ba ster ba min/ /zhes phyag rgya dang bral ba la byang chub kyi sems 'ching ba'i nus pa med cing / de ma bcings na lus 'bugs pa ste 'ja' lus su 'gyur ba med/ de med pas mchog gi bde ba'i rten gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku mi 'grub ces pa'o/ /rgyud kyi rgyal po 'dir yang / phyag rgyadangabral gsang sngags ni/ lus can rnal ge rna 'byar 'gru ba mi 'gyur/ zhes gsu ngas te mi 'grub pa'i don ni sngar bshad pa bzhin no/ /'o na las rgya spangs par rgyud gzhung mang po las gsungs pa ma yin nam/ nges pa'i don du de ga la de gos zhe na/ rgyud gzhung de dag gi dgongs pa ni las kyi phyag rgya spangs nas don dmapa'i phyag rgya sgom par gsungs pas/ las rgya'i thun mong ma yin pa'i nus pa tsiyod pa mthar phyung zin pa na/ de yang rnam par rtog pa'i g.yengs pa 'byung nye bas 'bor bar gsungs pa ste/ lha sku bzlas bsgom dang sbyin sreg dang rtsa rlungathig le'i rnal 'byor la sogs pa spros pa thams cad 'dor ba gsungs pa bzhin no/ /las rgya 'gog pa shin tu rgyas pa'i dus kyi 'khor lo las kyang/rgyal ba'i lhan skyes bde ba 'di ni 'phel ba'i don slad dang por las kyi phyag rgya bsten par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'dod bya bde stong dbyer med dam stongagazugs phyag rgya chen mo yin yang / las rgya spangs pas de mi 'grub ste/ phyagachen de mngon du 'gyur ba de la ltos pa ni/ sangs rgyas thod par/ gang ciraguwo ba'i dga' rtse 'jo/ /'byud pa dang ni 'o byed dang / /nyed dang 'tsher ba nyid —175—

kyis kyang / /phyag rgya chen po mthong bar 'gyur/ /zhes bstan po rdo /dga' ba bcu drug thams cad gsal bar mtshon pa dang / rlud sems thim tshul khyad paracan ma byung na byang sems kunda mi brtan la/ de 'byung ba ni 'di la rags lasapa'o/ /gnyis pa zhu bde'i rgyu 'bras rtsi ba ni/ gzhi dus su lus dang semasaganyis las/ sems kyi rang bzhin bde bar gnas pa la/ dbye ba med kyang/lus 'byung ba lnga'i dbye bas lus sems ngo bo dbyer med kyi rgyas btab can yin pa'i phyir/ sems kyi rnal 'byor rnam pa lnga'o/ /spyir zhu bde thams cad 'byung ba lnga'i bde ba can ni yin mod kyi/ de yongs su rdzogs par mtshon nusapa ni las kyi phyag rgya las byung ba'i bde ba'o/ /bde ba de bsgoms pas semasarnam 'gyur lnga ldan yin pa'i gnad kyis/ rang bzhin lhan skyes kyang ye shesarnam pa lnga'i tshul can du 'byung la/ de las 'bras bu ye shes lnga dang rigs/lnga 'byung ste/ dpal yang dag sbyor ba sa skru ṭi dang / kyai rdo rje gnyis char lasagasung gcig tu/ 'byung ba lnga yi rang bzhin las/ kun tu ru las lnga ru'agyur/ /dga' ba chen po gcig nyid las/ /dbye bas lnga ru 'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa nas/ mchog tu dga' ba'i rigs las byung ba rnams/ /zhes pa'i b.radu rgyas par gsungs so/ /bzhi pa la/ yas brtan dga' ba'i rtogs pa skye ba'i rim pa/ mas brtan dga' ba rjes dran skye ba'i tshul/ byang sems kyi ngo bobashad pa/ sku gsum rnam par gzhag pa/ ye shes rim pa'i sa mtshams so/ /dang po ni/ rtsa 'khor rnams kyi nye ba'i mdud pa rnams re re nas shin tu yang༅—176—

par song zhing grol ba na/ gong du bshad pa'i cha shas bzhin pa'i tshul sa byangachub kyi sems 'bab tshul 'byung la/ de byung ba na thig le rtsa 'khor de dgatudangos su brtan par byed pa'i mgo rtsom/ brtan pa'i don ni de'i dwangs rme'i chashas rnams g.yo ba med pa'i tshul gyis khams la dngus chus khyab pa bzhin du 'dres pa yin gyi/ gnas so sor 'pho 'jug med pa ni ma yin no/ /de la gtum mo'i me 'bar ba ni sngon yun ring po nas yin mod kyi 'dir 'bar ba mthar thug pa'o/ /de ltar yang sdom pa bshad par/ de ltar sku yi ma rnams thi /dbangadang longs spyod thim pa dang / /ji ltar gnas su de bzhin du/ /dga' ba rtagatuskye bar 'gyur/ /skye ba dang ni gnas pa dag /rim pa 'di yis thim para'agyur/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma bskul bas/ /gnas kyi sgo nas dbye bar bya/ /dpal ldan 'bar 'dzin bu gar ni/ /de yi skad cig de 'byung bag /bde bsathig le skye 'gyur zhing / zhes gsungs te/ de yang 'bar 'dzag khyad par can gyi nus pas yul nyer bzhi'i rlung rnams sngar gnas so sor dbang dang longs spyod pa dang thim par byed pa/ 'dir dha ting byas pas gnas de kun gyi thig ledagapas bde ba 'byung ba/ rdo rje mkha'o 'gro ma sto phyag rgya'i sbyor bas gnas rmyuphyezhing 'bar 'dzin te spyi bo'i thig le zhu ba nyer bzhi po'i khams kun gyi dwangs ma/rdo rje nor bu'i bu gar gnas pa mi 'pho ba'i bde ba la sems rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /las kyi phyag rgyalas re zhinagatum mos kyang rung ba'i dbang du byas nas thig les mgrin pa'i yas mtha' yan chad gang bas bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin rgyun mi 'chad/ yul can thams cad —177—

bde bar mthong yang mi gsal tsam 'byung ngo / /lha yi bu'i bdud btul bdangardo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin phyogs mthun dang glang po lta bu'i stobs su 'gyur/kha zas kyi bya ba las grol/ mgrin pa gang bas dga' ba ste yul yul can gnyis char bde bar mthong / nyon mongs pa'i bdud btul ba phyogs mthun/'du ba rnam bzhi'i nad mi 'gyung / dga' ba'i thig le brtan pa'o/ /snying ga yan chad gang / lus la bde ba rgyun mi 'chad/ rnam rtog ci 'byung ba yang bde babaskyed pa'i grogs su 'gyur phung po'i bdud btul ba phyogs mthun/ phyi'i 'byung bzhi'i gnod pa las grol/ mchog dga'i thig le brtan pa zho /bdeb chen pos drangs pa'i mngon shes ci rigs pa yang 'dir thob pa yin no/ /lteb yan chad gang gang snang thams cad bde stong du rang shar du 'gyur/ 'chi bdagagi bdud btul ba phyogs mthun/ tshe la ci rigs par dbang thob/ de co/grub brgyad sogs ma bskrubs par 'byung ste/ khyad dga'i thig le brtan pa zho /thigalas gsang gnas yan chad gang / sprul sku mang po la dngos su chos nyan pa dang / zhing khams dpag tu med par 'grob dang / 'od zer 'khor lo spro bsdumang po dang / gar byed pa sogs spyod lam 'khrul pa sna tshogs 'byung ste/ lhan skyes kyi thig le brtan pa'o/ /de yan chad du dbu ma'i nang du mas brtan 'dren nus kyang / yas brtan gyi skabs ma gtogs re re brtan par byed mi nusaso/ /gnyis pa ni/ de dag tu legs par byang bas bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes de'i snang ba la 'od kyi dkyil 'khor dpag tu med pa 'byung ba 'di ni rjes dran no/ /de nas mas brtan gyi dus su nor bur thig le gcig brtan pa —178—

na/gtum mo'i me lce'i snang ba dkyil 'khor gyi gzugs brnyan dpag tu med pa spro ba 'byung ste rjes dran dang po'o//de bzhin du spyi bo'i bar du yon to sngamayar ldan du yod cing /phyi ma phyi ma brtan pa na gtum mo'i snang ba gong 'phel gyi dkyil 'khor dpag tu med pa spro ba'i rjes dran lhag po re re 'byung ste/snang ba de ṣka 'char gzhi'am rjes su dran pa po bde stong gi ye shes de nyid la rjes dran zhes bya ba yin no//de yang gsang ba'i de nyid rab tu gsal bar sa myu shi'i tshigardedon drangs pa/bha gar ling ga rab bzhag nas//sangs rgyas rjes su sprin pa bsgom//thog ma dbus mthar dri med pa'i//ye shes ci zhig skye 'gyur te//yeshes de ni rang rig pas//gzhan gyis brjod par nus ma yin//na tshamakha'i khams kyi dbus gnas par//zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sgom par bya//delasogs pas de nyid gsungs//rjes su dran pa bcu drug gnas//bde chen nawamakha'i khams gnas pa//bde ba can zhes mngon par brjod/khes/gsungasate/'di la 'dus par bshad pa'i rjes dran bcu drug gi don tshang yang/de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor dpag tu med pa nyams kyi snang ba la 'phro ba 'byung bas/sangs rgyas rjes dran zhes thams cad la 'dogs te/phyag rgyadangamanyam par sbyar ba'i rkyen sa cha shas bzhi pa'i tshul gyis 'bab pa'i thig le/nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus te/bha gar thabs shes kyi rtsa phrad pa'i mtsharma na(suzla ba'i dkyil 'khor te thig le bde bar bcas pa la sems gzhug go/rangalus kyi dbang du byas na/nam mkha'i khams rtsa dbu ma/zla ba wib/le'i rdegazugs yin no//de las ye shes brjod bral rang bzhin dag pa'i mawo nyid 9

can rang rig bde ba chen por 'char zhing / rjes dran bcu drug go 'char sa bde chen nam mkha'i khams ni dbu ma'i nang du ste/ de la bde ba can zhes kyangabya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ nus pa 'jog pa'i khyad par dang / de dang de'i rtogasapa ched du phyin ma phyin ma gtogs/ ye shes rims pa'i skabs thams cad du mnyam bzhag thun re la dga' ba bcu drug lugs 'byung lugs ldog tshang bar 'char ro/ /de yang so so'i rtogs pa ma skyes phan chad kyi de rnams 'char ba ni/rtsol ba la ltos so/ /de la 'khor lo de dang de thig les gang zhes pa/ rga drosasulugs 'byung lugs zlog la de gang ba'i rim pa ni 'byung la/ 'on kyang deranus pa bzhag pas rtsa khams de rnams bde ba bskyed pa'i mthu can du song ba ni/de gang nas gnas pa'i don te/ bde ba'i ting nge 'dzin rkyen gyis mi 'phrog pa re re sar thob 'byung ba la kun rdzob byang sems kyis gang ba dang / lam de bsgoms pas rtsa khams de dang de stong pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin bskyed pa'i mthu can du song bas/ stong nyid kyi ye shes mchog gang gi khyad par thob pa la de dang de don dam byang sems kyis gang zhes gsungs pa dang / mkhas grub rnams/de ltar tha snyad 'dogs pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ saX pu ṭi dpyid thig tu drangs pa las/gang tshe mgrin par chags chen gyi/ /gzu gas kyi zla ba gnas pa na/ tangs rgyas rnams ni dam pa'i sku/ /de tshe longs spyod rdzogs par bshad/ khres norabu'i mgrin par thig le phyin pa tshun chad zhu bde sgrub pa'i phyir longs sku/ gangatshe rdo rje rtser gnas pa/ /de yi tshe yang sna rtse ru'o/ /zhes mas brtan nor bur—180—

gnas pa ni/ spros pa nus pas chos sku'o/ /gang tshe longs spyod rdzogs gyurapa/ /nub par gyur pa de yi tshe/ /bha ga'i nang du son de dang/ khrir kar༅5du rnam par brjod/ /spros zhes tha mal pa'i 'dzag pa dang / 'dir mkha' nang gtsobor gyur par rjes dran spro ba ni snang ba ma nges par sna tshogs pas sprul sku'i ye shes te/ ye shes kyi rim pa'i sku gsum mo/ /lnga pa ni/ thig le lugs 'byung lugs zlog 'di ltar brtan thub kyang / ji srid du khams thams cad kyi thim rim dngos su 'byung ba'i 'gomirtsom pa de srid du ye shes kyi rim pa yin la/ de phan chad gsang rim mo/ /de yang rdor bzlas dang snying ga'i 'khor lo rjes zhig sogs kyis/ thim rim ཿ ngaba'ang thogs yun yun ring zhing re re'i bar du'ang ring du thogs kyang khyad par snang ba so so'i rtogs pa la ring du 'gor te/ snang ba thob nas/ mgo pa thosapa la ring du 'gor ba bzhin yin la/ 'dir ni thig le lugs 'byung lugasazlog goms pas snang gsum yang yang drangs shing / de dang de'i rtogs pa'angabartan zin pas/ thim rim dngos yud tsam gyis 'grub pa dang / snang gsurayang snga ma las ches myur bar rtog pa na 'pho ste/ rten thig le 'ching zlogogozab khyad do/ /gnyis pa gzhung don ni/ /yas brtan sogs te yas brtan dga' babacu drug legs par mtshon pa'i rim pas nor bur byang sems brtan pa'i bde ba thob pa na yas brtan gyi rtogs pa rdzogs/ mas brtan gyi skabs rjes sprin 'char bsams brtan rjes dran bcu drug go rim pas thig le brtan pas mas —181—

brtan gyi rtogs pa rdzogs te/ ye shes kyi rim pa mngon du gyur par shogaces pa'o/ /yas brtan mas brtan gyi rtogs pa rdzogs pa zhes pa'ang de dngade'i thig le brtan pa ste/ ye shes kyi rim pa la ltos pa'i yin gyi/ spyir yas babs mas brtan gyi rtogs pa rgyun mtha'i bar du gong 'phel du 'byung ngo / /der ma zad/ dper na nor bur dang por thig le brtan pa de/rdorje sked par brtan pa'i tshe rdo rje'i sked pa'i de sar thob yin pas smos kyi/ nor tsa) de yang snga ma las lhag pa'i brtan tshul yod do/ /bzhi pa gsang ba'i rim pa la/ spyi don dang gzhung don go nyog dang po la/ gsang rim 'char tshul/ ngo bo ngos 'dzin ni/ sa mtshams 'bras bu dngabacas pa'o/ /dang po ni/ phyi'i 'byung ba sogs khams phra rags rim pas riwapa 'byung ste/ der dpe'i ye shes mthar thug skye/ de'i rjes thog kho nar rludasems kyi sku 'grub/ de nas rang lus gtum mo'i gtso bo las rgya la brten pa'ibade chen yang yang drangs pas las rlung 'gags te/ khams dkar dmar gyi bgrod pa dkar po'i shin tu dwangs ma mas brten gyi rim pas brten/ dmarapospyi bo nas mar nor bu dang rkang mthil bar du brtan pas lus 'ja' lus dang /sems rtog med du 'gyur te/ lte ba man chad don dam gyi byang sems kyis gang/yul can stong par mthong / lam dus kya sprul sku thob zer te/ 'khor lo sdomapa'i dpa' bod pa' mo mang po sprul nas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la chosa'achad/ ba skru re re nas sprul pa brgya phrag sogs 'gyed de rtog med kyi dga' bzhes bya/ snying ga man chad gang bas yul yun can stong par mthong ba sngar bas182—

kyang gsal ba dang /lam dus chos sku te 'od gsal shin tu brtan pa dang /'od zer dang sprul pa dang chos 'chad pa dang /zhing khams bgrod pa sogasasngam bcu gyur te/phyi ma rnams la'ang bcu 'gyur bcu 'gyur bsgribar bya ste/rtogamed kyi mchog dga' 'o//mgrin pa man chad gang bas stong pa'i ye shes sngarabs kyang gsal/lam dus kyi longs sku ste/lha sku'i snang ba dang mi 'bral//mtshan dpe ci rigs pa 'byung ste/rtog med kyi dga' bral lo//spyi bo'i bar du gang bas stong pa'i ye shes tshes gsal bar song ste/'phral nyid du mngon suwagyis mthong bar nye ba yin/lam dus kyi bde chen kyi sku ste/phyin chad mnyatsharjes thams cad du bde ba rgyun chad par mi 'gyur ba thob/bde chen gyis dra pasapa'i mngon shes drug khyad par can rnams dang /tha mal gyi lus gnas 'gyurate so so skye bos mi mthong bar 'ja' lus su 'gyur ba ni ci rigs par 'byung la/gal te de dag tu gnas ma 'gyur na 'di'i rjes su mthong lam skye ste/'dir gnas mi 'gyur ba mi srid do//de yang gsang rim gyi rtogs pa dang po skyes pa nas/rlung sems kyi sku grub zin pa'i gnas skabs ci rigs pa rnamasasu rgyud nas bshad pa ltar mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis nyams zas pa'i phyir/'jigs pa byed pa dang /brda ston pa 'byung ste/de la 'jigs par mi bya zhing/shes na brda'i lan bya/rdzi srid du mngon shes rgya chen po ma thob pa de srid du brda'i mtha' thams cad kyang mi rtogs pas/g.yon nas lan gsum bskorabasogs byas te/thams cad stong pa nyid du shes par bya'o//gang ltar yang tingange 'dzin las ma g.yos shing yid gzhan du ma gyur na/de rnams mnyes nas8

'jig rten las 'das pa rnams la bskul te/ spyod pa'i phyag rgya lung ston pa 'byung ba shas che'o/ /gsang rim gyi rtogs pa dang por skyes pa ni/ spyod pa spyod dam mi spyod kyang rung / las rgya la nges par ltos te/ de man chad ye rgyas kyanga'agrub la/ mthong lam thob pa nas nges par spyod pa la ltos mod kyi/ lelocan bar dor 'da' ba'i rigs rnams ni ma gtogs so/ /rim pa dang po gsum dang gsang rim gyi thog ma 'ga' zhig tu rlud sems kyi byed pag bde bas rang dbang med par 'gyur te/ ku co 'don pa sogs byung na rtsol ba klod de dmigs par sgom/ de ltar sgom pas rmongs na zhi gnas tshes rgyas pa yin te/yul sna tshogs bstan zhing sgyu ma lta bur bsam/ sngar zhi lhag zung sbyor shin tubyang zhing brtan pa zhig yin na yang / 'di dag tu rlung sems kyi byed pa'i shugs kyis mtho dman mang du 'byung ste/ de rnams nyid ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ sems snang ba bzhin mthar thug ye shes dang/ lusardzogs rim gyi 'ja' lus phal pa'i so skye'i ye shes kyi sku'o/ /'di'i skabs kyi mas brtan la/ gsang bar las rlung sum stong drug brgya 'gags pa gnyis thob bo/ /lhe snying mgrin pa spyi bo gtsug tor te spyi bo'i steng gi 'khor lo ste lnga po rerer yang sa gnyis gnyis thob pa ste/ las rlung stong brgyad brgya 'gags pa'i sa re re'o/ /zhes gong ma rnams dus 'khor dang mthun pa zhig ba lko do/ /waṃ yang rtse mo nas chos mchog bar gyi sa bcu gnyis te gong ma rnams kyang 'phags lam gyi sar mi ba ched de/ gsang rim thob pa'i tshad bde chen gyi mngon shes— —184—

thob pa la mdzad pas so/ /de nyid dngos su sgrub par byed pa'i lam yang gsangarim dngos yin la/ de dag gi spyod pa ni gsang rim gyi yan lag go /gsum pa la/ mthong lam skye ba'i lnga log yan chad lam gyi gsang rim dang / de nas sangs rgyas kyi bar ni 'bras bu'i gsang rim mam gnyis su med pa'i rim pa zhes bya'o/ /'on kyang gsang rim dngos ni snga ma yin no/ /o la pa ti las/ de ni sngags rgyud dang ye shes spangs pa/ sgo gnyis 'gags pa/ 'gro ba 'ong ba las grol ba/ phung po dang khams dang skye mched dang bral ba/ yularnams las nges par 'das nas/ mun nag 'thug po la zla ba chu shel ltar 'od gsal ba/ rdul dang bral ba/ stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang/ smen pa med pa'i ye shes rang gzhan rig pa dang bral ba/ mchog tu zhi ba 'dod chagasadang bral ba/ 'brel ba mar la mar bzhag pa ltar mya ngan las 'das pa bdagamed pa'o/ /byang chub kyi sems zhes gsungs te/ rnam thar sgo gsum gyi rangabazhin dang / rdul te rnam rtog thams cad dang bral ba/ rang gzhan rig pa dngabral ba ste gnyis snang nub pa dang / mchog tu zhi ba ste gdod ma nas stong pa nyid du mthong ba dang / 'dod chags rang bzhin mi dmigs par mthong bas 'o dod chags dang bral ba ste/ bdag med pa'i byang chub kyi sems snang ba bzhi'i rangabazhin can rnams kyi spyi'i mtshan nyid bshad pa'o/ /ro rkyang gi sgo gnyisa'agags pa dang / sngags te khams dkar dmar gyi 'gros dang / rgyu sto thamalagyi rtsa dang / ye shes te tha mal kyi thig le spangs pa/ ngag rlung 'gro'ong dngabral ba/ lus phung po rags pa dang / yul du chen pa dang bral bgo /chen pa —185—

las 'das pa/ rlung sems tsam mam ye shes las grub pa'i lha sku'i 'od zerashin tu gsal ba/ lha sku dang ye shes ngo bo dbyer med du sgrub pa'i phyir/ nyamasasu len pa zhes sku snang phyogs kyi mtshan nyid gsungs so/ /de sgrub byed kyithabs kyang / o la pa ti las/ rdorje ni byang chub kyi sems go /de'i btsun moni ma la sogs pa'i gzugs su gnas pa'o/ /de'i bha ga de la zhes bya ba'i don no/ /e yig cha byad bzang po gang / /dbus su bgyis rnam par brgyan/ zhesnasogs dngos bstan las kyi phyag rgyas 'dren tshul kho na gsungs la/ shugasalagazhan rnams 'phangs so/ /gsang ba'i de nyid las kyang rgyas par gsungs so/ /skabs 'dir dus gnyis zhes bya ba'i tha snyad yod pa/ 'gog pa'i dusadang dpyid kyi dus te/ dang po ni/ rim pa gong ma gsum la rlung dbu mara'agags shing thim pa dang / 'dir phung khams skye mched rnams dpe'am don gyi 'od gsal thim pa'i skabs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ dang po gsum gyi skabs su byangachub kyi sems zhi ba'i bde ba dang / khyad par ye shes kyi rim pa'i skabs/ shesarab thabs kyi gsang ba'i sna rtse gnyis su kunda'i rgyun 'ong ba ste/ 'dir ni rlupasems kyi sku 'grub nas bde ba chen po rol pa'o/ /yang dus bzang dang dusangan dang bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i dus gsum du bshad de/ 'di ni dbugs 'gro 'ong gnas gsum la yang 'jog la/ gong gi dbyid kyi dus dang / (〈li rgo'agog pa'i dus dang ) de'i bde ba las bsam mi khyab pa'i ye shes thob pa rnams rim pa bzhin du sbyar ro/ /'bras bu ni gnas skabs kyi sku dang/ ye shes ni 'od gsal chos sku dang / sprul pas sems can gi don byed pa sprulnga—186

sku'o/ /ye shes/ ni dmar cha'i snang ba nor bur brtan pa mnyam nyid ye shegadakar cha gtsug tor du brtan pa tshe long ye shes gong gi sku gsum ngo bo gcig pa sor rtog ye shes/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i nus pa can ni bya sgrub ye shes/ dbyings rang bzhin stong par mthong ba ni chos dbyings ye shes te/ 'di ni slob pa'i zung 'jug yin no/ /mthar thug gi 'bras bu ni/ de thob nas spyod pa spyad pas 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kya sa'i sku gsum 'gru/ba par 'gyur te/ /gsang ba'i de kho na nyid rab tu gsal ba las/ thog ma thamalasogs rab tu dbye ba spangs shing dpe med kun 'gro nam mkha'i dngos zhes sna ( 5 sku ste/ zhes kun 'gros khyab pa dang gzhan rnams kyis rtag pa bstan1 no/ /bsod nams ye shes bdag nyid sbyor ba gnyis kas rnam spras rang gorangabazhin shar gang yin/ zhes longs sku ste/ bsod nams kyis gzhan snang dang /rang gi sogs kyis sangs rgyas rang snang ngo / /rgyal ba khyu mchog sku rnam gsurapo de la bstud nas gsang ba'i de nyid rab gsal ba/ zhes pa'i rgyal ba khyumachog ni sprul sku'o/ /de rnams kyi rang bzhin gong du bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa gzhung gi don ni/ phra rags sogs te/ khams phra rags dbu mar thim pas/ rlung sems kyi sku 'grub cing / de nas lus kyi chos rlungadang thig le phra mo'i 'gros rnams dang / sems kyi chos gnyis snang rang bzhin brgyad cu stong par thim/ sems gsum yang thim rim gyi 'od gsal du thitshahūṃ dī/ga bha brasa~X sna~X ༵ dzī ༵snro / /rdo / ༵ ༵rdo zhu/ /sngu dzi dzhai ༵sdo —187—

so'i ngo bo ma phro she da khos pa spyod kyang wo ste/rim bzhi so sa'ang ba/mas ni/mu ge mu ge ༵pa/nyaXgashe ba tha sde 9 bogs dza rto rdeb la gzhan sdo pa ni bsha/da zan zhang /sna ri bya zhi : pa zhe/ sna zung ga// na pa dang bcas rnyi yi man ngag tu shes ༵rngog sku dzug bya nga /sgra 'a /khro rtsa gsumarde'akhore lo ba ge dang bcas pa na la/sngags na lte ba gtum/mo//ye shes ni thig le brtan byed kyi dga' bzhi/gsang ba ni stsu sems 'od gas5rde:ga ri 'ad da 7 :)sbyonge ra dzodu 'a ṇa sdug pa/sam pa na da dag sgam pa ma pa'//she spyi' sgo ge shes mu rdo dod dge 'bra~Xbu lbob tshul la/ye bgya yul zhis du sbyar 'a /sa 'a bgrad tshul brag tu bshad pa'/sa/dang pa la/she sdo tho / nordeb 'a las she dang /gshe lji du sbyar baXlam 'bras sa//mu mu~Xm/ pas thi ba da' te/bzhi po bsgoms su med zhi steng gi sgrib bzhi dgan pas ga le' mchogo ba po bsgoms pas/de' steng ba ba dganasaskubazhi ma// du 'gyur zhes pa ste/de la thig le bzhi lus kyi thig lo ni/rags/skya thig rnyims 'a /ngag gi thig le ni 'a thig le mu di rnams kyi/yid kya ge ge mu mun pa' rnyims dnga'i/ye shes kyi ga 'e ru/de rnams / 'dzagabacas kya spen ge sde ge ba ni//ba pa la na gnas skabs po ge zhe mu sgrib pa ste/ni rmi 9 /pa khrim rags pa' snang si gi rgyu rdo spro ris pa ni /mu ye sems tsam sna snril pa rma la5dang /pa : rno/rde//ri 'i rgyu/ rmangs pa ga spyod 'thu/ga thag 'gyu/ra bcas(lags pa je she dil spyo skaba~Xshe te/'gro ba thams go rtagatu 'khru/la pa ba pa 'a la spyad pa na ༷da kyang /gnas skabs de dag tubag

chags 'jog tshab che bas de ltar brtags pa yin no//de na dga' ba'i ye shesakyis lus kyi thig le smin mtshams dang lte ba brtan par byas pas sad dus kyi sgrib pa sbyong zhing /sprul sku mngon du byed/mchog dgas ngag gri thig lo mgrin pa dang gsang bar bcings pas rmi lam gyi gnas skabs dag ste longs sku mngon du byed/khyad dgas yid kyi thig le snying ga dang nor bur bangs pasaganyid 'thug gi gnas skabs dag ste/chos sku mngon du byed/lhan skyes kyi ye shes kyi thig le lte ba dang rtsa kha sbyor gyi gnas su bcings pas bzhi pa'i gnas skabs 'gag cing /bde chen gyi sku mngon du byed do//gnyis pa ni/bsgo5bya bden pa gnyis dang zung 'jug ste gsum mo//sgom tshul rnal 'byor gsu5gyi rim pas bsgom pa'i ye shes bogs 'byen spyod pa gsum gyis mthar phyung bas/bdag nyid gang zag gsum du na 'phos shing /mthar 'bras bu sku gsum mngon du gyur zhes pa'i ston pa ni bden gnyis sogs so//kun rdzob bden pa ni snangaphyogs dang don dam bden pa ni stong phyogs dang /zung 'jug ni zung 'jugagorim pa ste/de rnams dngos brgyud kyi lam dang bcas pa'i bskyed rdzogs thamasacad de/sgom tshul rnal 'byor gsum ni/rnam snang sgyu dra sogs rgyud slabapolas gsungs pa dang /grub chen gyi bstan bcos mang po yang drangs te/rdziskad du/rnal 'byor gsum du shes bya ste/byin gyis rlabs dang yongs rtags dang//bsam gyis mi khyab gzugs rdzogs pa'i//rnal 'byore sangs rgyas rnams/kyisabasngags//zhes gsungs te/rnal 'byor gsum gyi rang bzhin/bcosamabacos kyi rnam dbye/de nyid bstan tshul gyi mtha' bcad pa ste gsum las/dang89
