tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i spyod pa 'di yin te/thams cad bde ba chen po la lhan cig spyod pa dang /sdug bsngal te lhan cig tu zhing du 'gro ba dang/bya rtsol gyisangal bar byed pa'o//bla ma gong ma 'ga' zhig gis ni/bde ba dang sdug bsngal/kun 'byung gi don 'di skabs kyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams skyid mnyam sdug mnyam gyi don lta bur bzhed do//rig sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyi byin gyis rlabs pa'i zas te longs spyod rnams la rtag tu spyod pa dang/rnawa'abyor ni sbyor ba ste/drug cu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa dang /dga' ba spel ba'i yin lag glu gar rom mo sogs kun la 'jug pa dang /bde stong dang lha shi skul na tu mnyam par bzhag pas 'jug go zhes pa'i don te/des na bde mchoge tu yangatshogs dkyil shin tu gsal mod kyi/tshogs khang la sogs pa gsal b.ratshabastan pa ni/rgyud 'di'i lugs kyi spros bcas spros med gnyis la zhing rnamasasu rgyu ba gtso che bas yin no//gsum pa ni/gcig tu gnas pa dang /zhing du rgyu ba'i spyod pa gang yin yang rung ste/rgyud 'di'i lugs kyi pho nya bskul ba ni cesapar dgos so//spyir gnyis char la yang de 'byung mod kyi/yul rnams su rgyu ba pho nya'i 'du ba thob pa chog sla ba yin te/ji srid du lhan skyes kyi 'du ba mthosabar de srid du/zhing skyes dang /khyad par sngags skyes kyi rdzu 'phrul la rgyang ringathung gi bye brag yod pas so//rang sems shin tu dag pa la ni/mkha' khyab kyi lus can lhan skyes rnams kyi 'du ba thob pa'i phyir de la ni gnas pa dang /rgyubal phan yon 'dra'o//pho nya gsum bskul ba'i tshul ni/rtsa rgyud la gde ni rolapar yang dag gnas/sgrub pa dag /nga nye ba'o//pho nya rnams ni yang dag

bskul/ /zhes pa dang / ma ceb dbus tha ma lhan cig dgug ga /de ltar rdzasanirnam nges yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ spyod pa las byung ba yang dag par bstan pas/ sngags skyes rnams de'i lus la 'jug ste bde ba chen po'i rjes sumachod pa len par byed cing de mnyes nas dngos su 'du ba ster/ de dngos su bstan pa na/ des kyang gnas sogs rigs mthun pa'i zhing skyes rnams la gsol ba 'debs shing sgrub pa po 'di rjes su bzung bar mdzod cig ces so/ /de ltarabaskul ba des sngags skyes ma'i lus la zhing skyes ma 'jug ste/ der bdeb chen po'i mchod pa len zhing mnyes pa na/ rang gi 'du ba dngos su ster bar byed do/ /de bsten pa na des rang gi rigs kyi bdag mo'i lhan skyes ma rnams bskulabar byed do/ /de'i lus la lhan skyes mas byin gyis rlobs shing zhugs nasamachod pa len/ mnyes pa na/lhan skyes kyi 'du ba mngon sum du ster te/ de nyid du grol bar 'gyur ro/ /pho nya gsum gyi mchod pa len pa las bdag nyid labasod nams kyi tshogs 'phel ba dang / sgrib pa zad pa la phyi ma phyi ma stobasatshes che ba dang / pho nya gsum dang phrad na de dros grub che chung gsum de nyid du 'grub kyang bar de nams dman pa la las kyi 'ching ba las gzhan pa'i 'du ba mi 'byung bas 'phel zad byed pa'i thabs de ltar dgos pa yin no/ /dper na bcud len chen po ni sus bsten kyang 'ja' lus su 'gro ba yin mod kyi/ nusapa dang skal pa med pas mi rnyed pa bzhin no/ /pho nya'i lam la zhugs pa rnamasani/ sngags skyes kyi 'du ba spyod pa'i thog ma nas 'byung zhing / rnal 'byor pa lam 'ba' zhig sgom pa rnams kyis ni/ spyod pa'i thog mar sbyangs pa'i rigam—2yo—

༷ brten she sngags 'a bskul bas/phyisa~Xthug ma yin ya 'gyur ba las/thag ma ༵sa thab pa myur zhang /lung bstan rnyi phyag sbyi yan yang/sngags skyesprasogs na pas mkhyaX/'i/pho de dag gi //ris dgos pa' cho//de na sbyangs par gsungs pa' phyar ro//de dag sa bdang ni re/bdag pho nya mo kun 'gro//pho nya mo de kun lbob ste/ni/mthong ba )nga /du ji~X rtedang rna'/kho spa na ༵nga rtag pa 'khyud//rnal 'byor gnas khyad par nyad// rnal/rga sgyi/rdem yi tsho gos//thams cad rtse gen grub byed par bsha/da//bde can kun la ci byā na//gzhan du nam 'a ma yan no//zhes gsungs pa rnams/leg//par phye zan to//gong du bshad pa' dam kho brgyad po rnams kyang /spyod pa shar ltasa'adir rṣa gtso bor spyod pa yin te/dam rdzo brgyad po de dag gi mi mthun she she shephyags phra mas kyang ma ༷rda/ pa dang she/bsgrub par bya ṭā thams cad she yang lhagapas ste the/ta pas/khwa gdang ma la sags pa rnams kyas sgrub pa pa de la gus/she na spya mnyes pas/rdos su she grub ster bar byed do//rtsa rgyud las/khwa gdang zhe ge bshad dge ge ge ge ge zhen mu 'a zhe /mas dang dad pa 'phel byed pa/rtagapar dngos grub pab ni kya rgyu//dam rdeg rnams kyang bskyang dro'o//zhes te/dam sda 'a bsrung ba she mo rnams kya she grub khyiX dang rgyu she she can te 'a—'a dam tshig du khwa mdang /'ug pa tshadang / ma dang /ge ge zhe mun ge ge zhe ge ge she mo la yang gus par bya'o//zhes bla ma sngar rabs pa rnams kya man garngab// 0ri :re/ 0ri yi nge rwab/rderderdeganyas pa /lha grangs dang ༷nyam pa'am/mang ba 'a phyag rgyadang/

ma snyag kho nā yang rung ste/ma༅pas ci rig dkyil 'khor dang /tshogasakhadang /tshogs kyi 'khotshor lo'i bya ba rnams mi zang spyod kyang /sna ma las rṣa yi ba dang /res 'ga' byed la phal sto byed pa sogs kyi spros pa congutsam byed pa'o//'di ni gnod sbyin mo dang nags phro gyi lha la gos pa tshas/ral tsho ge dzo ge dzo :dro de rte ྅ di/ra tshogazhug tu sgrub ste/des yi byad she baXd yod de/ skad du/sprabaX pa steglabartan pas/nags phro dag tu bsad snyams she /kha su skabadaganyid / rardzudag/skrag nas de la ster bar 'gyu/ra//'das na dzñā rje tshe lha ma yin//mi'agyur rdo rje ma wos ris/ra/'i/lha mo klu mo gnod —na mo//lha ma namasnang wo //rnyed nas rag pa' brtul zhugs sbyangs//shi ni 'dus par gsus/nga /rdo rje gur las kyang de lta~X spyod 'di rje mu//'a /rnyi pa sna༅/oṃ'aḥngabaXm phro no/ni/ra spyo pa she she skabs 'ar /shershagya 'bras bu ༵gas za spyad pa spyad pa'ang yod/'gas she pa lag sdang bu rtsab 'bras bu //gsungs pas sna gi/sa skya 'khor lo'i/rde/'an tang myur du sangs/she//she sa kyā wor la bya ba cu~X zad chabayang yad do//ni~Xm pa la/spyod tshul ngas bzung ba dang /gi dbye ba ༅da pa'o//dang po she spyi chu ye she dur khrod dang rang khang pa sog༅kying yang wo ba skyin gyi —na ma she drang ste tu rtswa pa'am/bgo sde ge ge ge mu//zhan sa kha zas sbyar ba smu dzin pa : ) /dor na garang gi snying spangs shang/'i ye shes skra5 yang yongs su 'dzin pa blo dor ler pa yi/ ngakha nas phyung ba ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang ༷lta par sbyor ba lhur len pa na la/

khyad par rdzogs rim pas ni gnyid kyi 'od gsal nyid rtag tu sgom pa yin no/ /'di la bhu su ku'i spyod pa zhes bya ste/ bhu ni bhañdza na sto za ba/ su ni su ta ne ta gnyid log pa/ ku ni ku ṭi sa ra ste bshang gci'i phyir 'chag pa ste/ lus 'tshoba'i zas tsam za ba dang / 'od gsal gyi gnyid log pa dang / 'chag par 'grob tsam ma gtogs gzhan rnam par rtog pa thams cad spangs pa'i don no/ /'dir gnyid kyi 'od gsal bsgom par gsungs pa gnyid rang babs su byung ba tsam 'od gsal du 'jug pa ni ma yin te/ de ni skabs 'di'i spyod pa gzhan gnyis la yang yod pa'i phyir ro/ /des na spyod pa gzhan gnyis la phyi'i phyagagyobasten pa'i dod 'dir gnyid kyi 'od gsal bsgom pa yin pas rtag tu gnyid log par byed pa yin no/ /des na bskyed rim gyi shin tu spros med la ni bhu suku'i spyod pa zhes mi bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ chags can 'dod chags kyi spyod pa tsam po 'di ni/ bskyed rim gyi shin tu spros med kho na yin la/ brtson 'gru༅can tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya ba'i spyod pa ni/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya gnyid bsre dngabacas pa gong du bstan pa ste/ shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa dngos nyid dang / bar dor 'da' ba'i tshe 'chi ba 'od gsal mthong ba'i lam la 'jug pa de nyid 'chi ba dang bgreb dang / drod thob nas gnyid kyi 'od gsal la rtse gcig tu drilabs/ tshe 'dir sgyu lus ma thob par/ bar dor thob nas de'i rten la zung las/gi sku 'gru ba pa'am/ rig pa 'jin pa'i lus khyad par can zhig grub pa'i rten la 'da' ba'i lugs la yang rung ste/ gnyid dang bgreb skye ba brgyud nas 'tshangargya ba'i spyod pa dang / sa bcu bar mdo lugs kyis bgrod nas/ sngags la—247—

'jug pa nye rgyu btsan thabs kyi spyod pa ste/ shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa dngaphyogs mthun gsum mo/ /bar pa de gnyis ni spyod pa dngos ma yin zhing/ phyi tshani/ las kyi phyag rgya la brten pa yin yang shin tu spros med kyi phyogs su bsdusate dmigs pa yin no/ /'di ni mtshon byed tsam sto 'tshang rgya ba'i nye rgyu'i spyod pa thams cad do/ /de dag gi mtha' cung zad dpyad na des na spyir gong du bshad pa ltar 'od gsal ma thob na/ sgyu lus thob kyang skye ba len par bshad pa/ sprukhobor bar do skye srid dang 'dra ba la dgongs pa yin yang / bar do nyid du ngesathob pa la/ skye srid len pa'i rigs can yang yod pas/ 'od gsal mthob na zhes brtag pa mthar bzung yin gyi/ spyir de 'dra mi srid de/ sgyu lus thob pa tshe'adir 'od gsal ma thob kyang / 'chi ba'i tshe don gyi 'od gsal mi thob mi srid pas so/ /des nas don 'grub rab tu mi 'byung ba mi srid kyang / rab tum byungan 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur zhes pa dang 'dra zhes zer ba ni/ bar dor sgyu lus 'grub pa'i skabs yod pa tsam gyi don la yang zhib tig ma byung ba ste/ rang gis kyang snang ba'i rtogs pa rgyud la skyes pa spyod pa spyod rgyu ma byung b.rashi ba de skye ba brgyud nas 'tshang rgya ba'i rdzogs rim par ngos bzung ba brjod pa'i gtam ste/ sgyu lus thob na skye ba mi len pas khyab pa dang tsi phyir mi 'gal lo/ /rang gi rjes su 'brang ba'i lugs la 'gal ba rags pa de tsam yod pa'i ma tshang yang ma rigs par/ kho bos gsung rab la lta rtog dang thos bas5byasapa na/ rgya bod du nyi zla ltar grags pa rnams la yang gsung rab kyi gnad mgoba'i 'khrul pa mang po yod ces sems tsam gyi lugs 'dzin pa'i pa ni ta chen po —248—

rnams dang / dbu ma rang rgyud pa rnams dang / khyad par mi tri pa dang/ a bha ya sogs dang / bod kyi snga phyir byon pa'i mkhas grub rnams la sdang smra mi bzad pa ste/ mdo las/ byis pa gang zhig byas pa'o zhes/ /shes pa de 'dir mkhas pa'o/ /byis pa gang gis mkhas sems pa/ /de ni shin tu byis par brjod/ /ces blun po gang rang blun por shes pa ni cung zad mkhas pa yin la/ rang blun po yin yang mkhas par nga rgyal byed pa ni shin tu blun no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don bsam dgos so/ /'dir sgyu lus thob kyang skye ba len par gsungs pa'i gzhung don dngos ni/ bar srid len pa nyid yin te tshe 'dir sgyu lus thob pa'i skabs kyi spyod pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rlung sems tsam gyi sku 'grub pa'i gang zagagis spyod pa spyad pas/ khams phra rags kyi thim tshul re re la brten nas 'od gsal du 'jug ldang byed pa 'khor mor 'gyung bas spyod bsdus su spyod pa'i skabs su khams phra rags thim tshul gsungs pa yin la/ 'dir mchoge gi dngos grub thob pa'i ltas kyi rmi lam rnams 'byung ba dang / lus phra yang go yon tan brgyad ldan gyi rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas thob pa shas che'o/ /bskyed rim gyi spyod pa'i skabs su dngos grub dngos la sbyor ba ni shin tu spros med kyis chog pa yod kyang / spros bcas dang spros med gang rung zhig nges par sngon du 'gro dgosapa yin/ shin tu spros med la/ lus mtsho ba tsam gyis zas kyis chog par bshad pa la/ 'ga' zhig dka' thub la brten par 'dod pa dang / kha cig lus brtan par gyur pa'i zas dgos zhes smra ba ni/ gnyis char gyis gnad ma longs b.rasnang ste/ spyod pa spyi'i mtshan nyid du/ 'ga' zhig dka' thub spangs nas 'don —249—

yon bsten pa yin pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyas 'byung mchog thob pa'i skabasazas kyang za dgos pa'i nges pa med so/ /des na spyod pa gzhan gnyis la 'ongasaspyod mang po don gnyer yod kyang 'di la lus 'tsho ba tsam gyi yo byad las lhag po ched gnyer med do/ /dpe'i 'od gsal mthar thug gi sgrub byed kyi spyod pa layang / gtso bor gsum po gang spyod kyang / spros bcas spros med gang rigasashig nges par spyod dgos la/ rlung sems tsam gyi sku 'grub phan chad du ni/ spyod pa gsum gang la brten kyang rung ste/ dbang po rnon po la shin tu spros med myurab dang 'bring po la spros med dang / tha ma la spros bcas so/ /'di la dgosasnanas 'gos ches po/ shes rab che chung gsum go zlog tu sbyor bar mdzad pa yanga'agal ba med do/ /snang ba'i rtogs pa skyes nas spyod pa la ma brten parasgyulus thob pa yang yod na/ spyod pa dang po gnyis nges par spyod dgos pa dnga'agal snyam na mi 'gal te/ spyod pa ma spyad na las rgya la brten nas de 'grub kyang / spyod pa spyad phyin sangs rgyas pa nye rgyu yin na ma gtogs shin tu sposamed 'ba' zhig yin na las rgya nges par spong dgos pa yin pas snang ba thob nas shin tu spros med 'ba' zhig gis de sgrub par mi nus pa'i rgyu mtshan gyisayin no/ /yang spyod pa'i skabs su drag shul sgrub pa 'byung ste/ phyag rgya'i padmaraganas pa'i lha la phur bus btab pas dngos grub ster ba'i don du gnad la 'bor zhing bskul ba'o/ /de yang spyod pa dang bcas pa'i sgrub pa shin tu zla ba drug tu bya zhing / des ma 'grub na lan gnyis des ma 'grub na lan gsum du bskyar bas 'grub/ des kyang ma 'grub na drag shul sgrub pa rdo rje sems dpa' —250—

bsad pa'i cho ga byas pas nges par 'grub par gsungs pa/ bod la ladagardzogs rim par 'dod/ la la dag bskyed rim gyi spyod pa bzhed/sa par bya ba ni rdzogs rim gyi rtogs pa mthon po bsam mi khyab kyi dgongs pa can sngon bskyed rim mthar byung ba zhig gis yi dam gyi lha bskul ba'i spyod pa ste/ bskyed rim la gtso bor brten pa'i khyad par cig ste/ lha de dang mjal bas 'phral du mchog 'grub pa ste 'di zur pa zhig go /gnyis pa gzhung gi don la/ spyod pa'i go rim/ 'bras bu/chog gsukholas/ dang po ni/ bde bas gnyis snang rags pa 'gog pa la brtson pa laspangs pa zhes brtags pa'am/ 'phags lam gyi kun 'dar mnyam bzhag tu re zhig spangs pa'ang yin pas de kun 'dar gyi spyod pa dam pa ste/ bzang po ni thog ma spyod cing / rdzun dang log g.yem dang tshig rtsub sogs ci byas pa thamasacad/ rgyu'i dus su byang chub kyi sems dang / dgos pa khyad par can rang gisabyang chub myur du 'grub pa'i tshul mthong ba dang / dngos gzhi'i dus na rnam parami rtog pa'i ye shes kyi rnam rol du song / 'bras bu'i dus na rang gi ye shesacher 'phel ba gzhan don du 'gyur bas na/ de dag kyang sdig pa'i dri masatshagos pa'i dge ba mchog bya ba bzang po 'ba' zhig yin na/ de la nam yang nyesaspyod mi srid pas/ yul dus gnas skabs kun tu bzang po 'ba' zhig tu spyod pas kun bzang spyod pa lte bar du byed de/ de yang sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor lagagayem pa rnams la g.yem par 'gyur/ khro ba rnams la khro ba'i mchog /zhi ba rnams la zhi ba'i mchog /drag shul can la drag pos gnon/ /zhes gang—251—

'dul du spyod cing / de ni dge ba mnyam pa nyid du mthong ba zhes bya ste/ saXpu ṭalas/ de yi sdig dang bsod nams kyi/ /cha gnyis rnam par rtog pa ste/ mkhas pas 'di dag rnam par spangs/ zhes pas blang dor med pa'i gnas lugs rtogs pa'o/ /de dag spyad pas dngos grub rab 'byams thob pa'o/ /drod chen po thob nas ni don du 'gyur na/ phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa bya ste/ bdaganyid 'jigs pa dang dogs pa med pas bdud dang mim yin dang mu stegs sogs/ mi dang smra ba dang / sdang ba dang gdug pa thams cad tshar bcad pasazil gyis gnon pa dang / gzhan yang / dpos grub dang rdzu gyi 'phrul sprul pasagazhan gyi don zad mi shes par sgrub par byed pa tha mar spyod pa phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa ste/ spyod pa gsum po de yang nang tshan spros bcas sogs gsum gsum du dbye bas so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de dag spyad pas gong ma'i 'a wa mthongasgom sogs dang / sa bcu gong 'og rnams thob bo/ /gsum pa ni/ spos bcasadang / spros med dang / shin tu spros med kyi spyod pas rim pa bzhi pa mthar phyin pa byed pa ste/ dngos ni rim pa bzhi pa mthar phyin pa byed pa'o/ /da ni de dag kun gyi grub don spund na/ 'dod 'jug brten slob drod tshar nyul ba yi/ /spyod pa 'di gsum rig spyod phyogs mthun yin/ /kun 'darakun bzang phyogs las rnam rgyal gsum/ /skye 'phags so sor bstan na thad da de/ /'phags pa'i gsum ka'ang phyogs las rnam rgyal yin/ /spros bcas sogs gsum bya ba'i khyad par te/ /dbang po gsum la mthu yang so sor phye//rnal 'byor lam pa dang po gnyis bsten dgos/ /zhes kyang smras go /'o dod —252—

yon ji lta 'dod pa la ma bkag par longs spyod pas bde bas/ bde stonge go ye shes brtan por gyur pa'i rgyun gong 'phel du byed cing / gzhan yang rang gzhan gyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya spyod sna tshogs pa dang / gnas dang longs spyod dang / /dus mi 'dra ba sna tshogs par dga' ba dang / skyo ba dang/tho mtshar dang/rnam g.yeng dang / brtse sems dang / chags sdang sogs nyon mongs dang/sems kyi 'gyur ba'i khyad par sna tshogs skye 'gyur gyi yul thams cad nges med du spyod lam sna tshogs pas bsten zhing / bde stong dang lha sku'i rnal 'byor gyi dmigs pa'i rtsa ba las skad cig kyang ma yengs par sems kyi rtsal 'gyur ba de dag tu cung zad snang ba ji snyed byung ba thams cad/ rig ma dang mnyam par sbyaraba'i bde stong gi dbyings su bsre ba'o/ /drod chung ngu skyes pa dang / le do skabasakyi bde stong shin tu brtan pa dang / dga' ba'am snang ba'i rtogs pa skyes pa rnams don gcig ste/ mchog kho na'i dus su rdzogs rim pa'i spyod pa byed pa'i skabs kyi thog ma'o/ /rtogs pa de dag dang ldan pas phyag rgya sna tshogs pa'i longs spyod bsten pa na/ sngar pho nya'i lam gyi dus las ches lhag pa'i rtsa thigale rlung sems te bzhi po de dag tshul mthar phyin pa 'byung ngo / /rig rme'i khyad par mang po dang / spyod lam sna tshogs pa bsten pa dag ni/ sems kyi dri ma phra mo zhen pa'i tshul gyi gnas pa rnams mngon gyur du slong nas bde stong gi dbyings su spyad de dag par byed pa yin no/ /zhes pa 'di grub bo/ /mthar thug pa yanga'i de la ltos pas/ dam pa kha cig yongs su grags pa'i rig spyod kyis spangs bya rags pa las phra mo spong mi nus/ rig spyod khyad par 'phags pa tshul khrims/kyi —253—

sdom pa yin zhes gsungs pa tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dge slong gi sdom pa la ngos 'dzin par mdzad do/ /dgos pa gzigs pas gsung pa yin snang ba'i phyir/spyir mi 'gal mod kyang / don la ni mi rung ste/ de lta na mi'i rten can gyi nyan thos dgra bcom rnams kyang zla phyed dam zla ba drug tshun chad kyis sangs rgyas thob dgos par 'gyur te/ 'phags lam gyi rig spyod la lpin mtshan rtagatuganas pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang 'di'i lugs la dam bca' 'ba' zhig lu gu rgyud du byed pa ma gtogs/ lung rigs kyi sgrub byed sna gcig kyang med pa dang/rang nyid kyis chos gzhan du mi zab pa 'dir zab ces thun mong gi lam thamasacad zab par mdzad cing / thun mong ma yin pa stong nyid/ phra thig phyag rgya'i lamal sogs pa mi zab ces gsungs pas/ mdo sngags kyi zab khyad phyin tsi lo gotukhas len dgos te/ zab tshad mdo lugs nas rtsal du bton pa dang/ mi zab tshe snga nas rtsal du btan par song ba'i phyir ro/ /de yang de lta na ni byung theg pa'i lam sangs rgyas thob pa la myur bar 'gyur dgos pa las/ de ni rangagi gzhung las kyang bskal pa grangs med gsum sogs thogs par bshad la/sngags la tshe gcig la grub pa 'o skol gnyis ka la grub pa ma yin nam/ mthar ga‘kas na theg chen gyi mdo rnams las/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa nyid ston la/ de tsam du so sor thar pa rig bdun mi ston pa dang / zin spyo ni 'a sangs rgyas kya nye rgyu yin par bzhed pas/ theg chen las kyang nyan thos kyi sdesnod zab ces bya bar song zhing / de zab pa ni lta ci smos/ de dag tu byang chusasems dpa'i lam yang rdzogs par ma bstan par grub bo/ /gzhan yang/ dgo—254—

slong mchog 'dzin can rig spyod kyi chos nyan pa'i snod tsam yang ma yin par gsungs pa yin te/ dpal rdorje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud spyod pa bsdus pa'i sgron maralung drangs par yang / gang zhig dge slong dngos gnas dang / /gang yang rtogaladaga' ba'i mi/ /mi gang rgan por gnas gyur pa/ /de la de nyid mi ston zhesapa'i de nyid kyang spyod pa yin par gsungs shing / de nyid las/ bde ba chen po'i 'bras bu mchog la mngon par dga' ba rnams la/ nyan thos dang mdo sde'i tshuwadang ldan pa'i spyod pa ma gsungs te zhes pa nas/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan bstoganyis la sogs pa'i spyod pa dka' ba rnams kyis dus ring pos byang chub tshol bar byed mod kyi/ 'on kyang thob par mi byed do/ /zhes gsungs pas shin tuganod pa yin te/ de 'dra'i dge slong de rig spyod khyad par du 'phags pa laganas bzhin par song bas/ myur du 'tshang yang rgya dgos na/ de kho na nyid bstan pa'i yul ma yin par mi 'gyur dgos pa las/ de ma yin par bshad pa dang / de tsam gyis nyan thos kyi byang chub kyang mi thob na/ bla na med pa'i byangachub lta smos kyang ci dgos/ ji skad du/ thabs dang mi ldan ye shes dang/bslab pa dag kyang gsung pa ni/ dpa' bo chen pos nyan thos rnams/ de lazhugs pa'i phyir gsungs so/ /zhes thabs dang mi ldan pa'i ye shes te/ snying rje chen po 'khor bcas dang / lha'i rnal 'byor dang bde chen 'khor bcas kyisamazin pa'i spros bral tsam gyi stong nyid dang / nyes spyod sdom pa'i bslab bya rasa'abyams gsungs pa tsam ni/ nyan thos kyi gdul bya rnams re zhig de tsamalabakod de/ de'i dgra bcom sogs thob na/ slar yang theg pa chen po lab/—255—

pa'i don tsam yin zhes gsungs na/ khyed kyi lugs kyi rig spyod pa de la ni/ rezhig theg chen la 'jug pa'i skal pa med pa yang mang du snang bas/ 'di tsi zhig bya/ dge slong sngags kyi rten mchog yin pas so snyam na/ yin mod de ni shin tum nges te/ de lta na nyid dag rig spyod khyad par du 'phags pa mi lus rin po tshecis kyang ci phyir mi 'chad/ nyes par spyod pa mtha' dag sdom zhing dge ba'i chosal rtse gcig tu spyod pa sems can ma lus pa sgrol ba'i rlabs chen gyi spyod pa dang 'brel ba byang chub sems pa'i sdom pas kyang / mthar thug gi spyod parami'agyur na/ nyes spyod kyi cha shas sdom pa khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu sogs/ nye tshetsam la gnas pa 'dis mthar thug gi spyod par ga la 'gyur/ spros pas chogardego /spyod pa'i skabs kyi bde chen gyi tshul ni bogs 'byin yin la/ pho nye'i la5la ni gnyis yod de/ mi rtog pa khyad par can bde stong gi ye shes ma skyed pa bskyed pa'i don du phyag rgya'i lam la brten nas bde ba sngon song gi stong pa nyid khyad par can bsgom pa/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes skye bar 'gyur ba dang / rnal 'byor lam dang pho nya'i lam gang la brten nas 'byung ba yin yang/ye shes de'i rgyun 'phel ba dang brtan par bya ba'i phyir phyag rgya bsten pa ste/phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor dus tha dad pa'i dbye bas gsum mo/ /dang po la yang rlungadabu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum rim pas sgrub byed kyi phyag rgya'i sbyor ba dang /btsan thabs su sgrub byed de gnyis yod do/ /bde stong sgrub pa dang brtan 'phewabyed pa la/ rang lus 'ba' zhig gis kyang 'grub par byar yod mod kyi/ bogasa'abyin ni nges par phyag rgya la rag las so/ /bogs 'byin gyi de yin yang / spyod —256—

pa~Xn pas sto ma mu she /'a/da yon nga me tha nī rdzos 'a sa she ma sna tshoXrdepya du par gas ༵ cha ga 'a ma pa 'a she da pa skye /gnyad kya dmu she.āobar sgam rnyi kau she dā/snang ba 'a ye ༷ sa da da~X' smod kyi chu/rdemathar thug phyar du rdzu nya3 'ang she sa pa yad ri/dā la 'ig spyad dan ba ni gas ma tshang bas sa//ti phyaX gres 'a lam la ga snid dzo //ba ༷she zi pa nyi /nas bshad dzo//༷ bha / 'tshe ༷ri ge 'a ba 'a tshuX /yis rde~Xgar/ pa ri 'a bsha/da pa' thu) oṃ 'a yan pa' rnam gzhag gno/lha rdzuspyirngos she 'a la yang/la sogs pa thun mong gi/rim dang yas sa /spyad pa' rnam gzhag la /sku /sa pa blo bzu~Xs pa'i khyad par dpa cad de ltar nges mu byas na~X/'a sel 'dra ba 'a she 'a khyad par dgardi)rded pa she/gnyas she pū sa pa' /zhung las byung dzi pa spyi zim yad pa la/dzo zhes dang /༷sna gzha 'dir shos/sa/'i zam ga' yo /༷co hā gnyan//dang pa /kyang rgyud sde/rda rja' bzlas pa 'a gzhan mang rab/sa 6 1 rdetsam las zi gsungs kyang rgyud gzhan 'di la she ba 'as bya cung gi de rnyi bka pa / da / 'a bsha/da na kri ba sa/saXrda 'a spyir she brdzu/'a zhin hro /༷tho tshoni sa yo bang ༅ ༄ ( /rde kha/bsgam bya spege ge rdzo gya rang ban gsum las/dang pa /g.ya ba 'a(nghru rde spre skabs su bar/da zan ta// sa kyishe' sgo dang shad dod dodage ge ge ge pa la/༵rtsa bste ba/sngags kru brda/sngags sna//gsardekya dan dam/sngags rtsa ba lnga las/dang pa la/sngags btu / ltang tso ba'i tshul/sngags kyi ngo bo//de'i byed las te bzhi ldog dang po ni lten

rje gshed kyi bshad rgyud rtog pa gsum pa las/ ā li kā li grong khyer ni/gsang sngags 'byu/nga ba'i rtsa ba ste/ /zhes/ ā li kā li rnams so/ /gnyis/pa ni/dbyangs nas a yig dang / u yig gnyis/ gsal byed nas ma srog med de/yi ge gsum bshus pa las oṃ ste/ a'i yi ge u'i yi ge la o te pha rol 'thang/yang bya'o/ /zhes a dang u phrad pas o ru gyur pa/ ma srog med rjes su dzarothig ler gyur pa steng du bzhag pas cha mo/ /de bzhin du a yig gnyis dang/ha srog med bzhag pa mtshungs pa 'dra ba'i yi ge la ring por 'gyur te/ pha rolayang dbye'o/ /zhes pas a thung gnyis ring po gcig tu gyur pa dang/ ha srogamed rnam bcad du gyur pa'o/ /rnam bcad ha yig las 'byung ba ni/ bod na yod pa'i brda sprod kyi bstan bces rnams las ma byung yang / gzhan rnams las yon par snang zhing / rgya gar ba rnams kyi ngag rgyun la rnam bcad ha sgra 'ba' cigatu'abyung ngo / /ha srog med dang / u dngam srog med rnams las gsal byed dbyangs med pha rol gyi yi ger drang ngo / /zhes pas/ ha u la sbyar bas tu yigatu song zhing / ma rjes su nga ror sbyar bas hūX ngo / /de dag nang du sbyar bgisngags btu gzhi ā li kā li ni rtsa nang gi rlud ā li kā li'i gdangs su gnas pa dag yin la/ de nyid 'thu ba'i tshul yang rdo rje 'phrong ba las rgyas paragasungs te/ snying po bsdus pa ni/ rgyud de nyid las/ a ni chos zhabor padmaraganas/ /hro gi sto bor lo la ni khyab/ /'di to kho na rma chog po/ khro gcesabya ba thams cad bsdus/ /zhes snying kha'i a thung las 'byung ba'i srog 'a rjen gyi hro de'i gdangs can dang / u ni longs spyod ga bor lor gnas/ /medang nyi ma—258—

'dra ba yi//mgrin pa'i mtha' nas spyi gtsug bar/khyab pa gzi brjid kyi ni lus/zhes gyen rgyu'i rlung mgrin pa nas spyi'i bar tu u yig gi gdangs kyisa'agro ba dang /bde chen 'khor lor zhes byar gnas//yi ge ma ni thig le tsam//mthe bo'i tshad ni sor bcu gnyis//rgyal po gtsug tor nang na gnas//smin mtshams nas logs su sor bcu gnyis gzhal pa'i gnagagatsug tor gyi 'khor lo'i lte bar byang chub kyi sems thig le gnas pa ste/snyingakha li rlud a'i gdangs can la mgrin pa'i rlung u'i gdangs can 'dres pas o yig gdangs su gyur pa spyi bo'i thig le'i rlung snying kha'i gnas su phyin pas oṃ ru 'gyur te/dbugs nang du 'ong ba na'o//mgrin par u yig 'byung ba ni/yongs su grags pa mgrin par yi ge o yin pa dang mi 'gal te/o yigagyiyon to o yig dang 'phel pa au yin pas so//des na rdo rje 'phreng ba'i dpe 'ga' zhig las/o ni longs spyod 'khor lor gnas/zhes 'byung ba'angatshadag pa ma yin no//yi ge a ni sngar bshad zin//srog gi rlung ni ༅ba/yin nino//zhes snying ga'i rlung a yig gong bzhin dang /a chos 'khor padma las//mgrin par yi ge a gnyis 'gyur//srog rtsol nyid dang thub sewab//yi ge ha yi kun nas ni//mgrin pa'i dbus na gnas pas bcings//zhes gsungs te/mgrin pa yan chad kyi rlung snying khar phyin nas gnas pa/snyingakha'i a thung dang 'brel bas a'i gdangs su song ba gzhi gnas srog 'dzin gyi rlung a'i gdangs can dang 'dren pas ā ring po'i gdangs su song zhing /derathur sel gyi rlung gi cha shas gnas pa ༷ yig sgra can du yod pas chog drag tu

song ste/ āXzhes bya'i gdangs su gyur te rlung gnas pa'i tshe'o/ /yang ha ni thurasel ming can rlud / /bshang sgo gsang ba'i dbus na gnas/ /yi ge u ni stenga'agro'i rlung / /mgrin pa'i padma'i dbus gnas pa/ /yi ge ma ni srog rlungayin/ /dpral pa rlud gi 'khor lo la/ /de dag gcig gyur snying gal/ /thugs/kyi sa bon du ni brjod/ /ces gsungs te/ thur sel he'i sgra ho dang/ snyingakanas smin mtshams su rlung gi 'khor lo'i bar khyab pa/ srog ni ma'i dbyangasasu'agyur ba ste/ de'i don yang srog 'dzin gyi rlung spyi bo'i thig le la 'dres pa slayig gi gdangs su 'gyur zhing / de'i rgyun smin mtshams kyi bar du 'gro ba yin la/ gyen rgyu yang steng du 'gro ba'i tshe/ mū ring po'i gdangs kyis 'gro bsho /de rnams 'dzoms pas hūX yig ste/ thur sel gyi rlud mgrin par gyen rgyu dang 'dresapas/ huX yig tu song ba spyi bor phyin pa na/ srog 'dzin ma yig gi gdangs dnga'adres pas hūX ste rlung (〈pho〉 rtse phyir ) 'gro ba na'o/ /'di ni slob dpon a laṅka ka la shas bshad pa dang / da lta 'phags skor la mkhas pa rnams/'chad pa bzhin te/ bde mchog gi rdor bzlas phal cher rlung nang du 'ong ba oṃ dang/gnas pa āXdang phyir 'gro ba huX ring por mdzad pa 'phags skor ba'i lugs dziltar ba bzhin snang bas de ltar bshad pa'o/ /gu ru ni khyu ṇa shrī zhal snga nas la/rdo rje 'phreng ba'i sngags btu skabs 'phags skor gyi dngos bstan pa dang bstun nas 'chad zhus pas/ de ni yi ge'i don la shin tu ma zhugs pa ste rludago'akhor lo la ni khyab/ /ces sogs ni rlung phyir 'gro ba kho na la gsal zhing/des na/ 'di'i man ngag du 'byung ba oṃ/ 'jug pa āX gnas pa spyiX dang sbyorab—260—

rgyud don la shin tu 'byor zhing / de dag gcig gyur snying ga la/ zhes so gesakyang dbugs phyir 'gro ba ma yin par gsal te/ phyir 'gro ba rnams kyi 'ad 1 da pa ltar na/ gcig gyur huX gi gdangs su song ba ste/ spyi bo yan chad du 'byung ba las/ 'dir thugs kyi sa bon huX gi gdangs snying gar 'byung bas gsungs pasaso/ /gzhan yang thugs kyi sa bon bslas pa'i gtso bor 'dod pa dbugs phyira'agro ba la sbyor ba dang / rlung gi de nyid kyi skabs 'jug gnas lda nga gsum gyi gtso bor gnas pa yin pa gnyis mi 'grig cing / des na 'phags skor ba'i lugs la yang man ngag sbas pa yin te/ āXganas pa dang sbyor ba'i tshe āXnyid bzlas pa'i gtso bor byed pa ye shes zhabs lugs dang 'dra ba gcig dgos pa yin no/ /des na rdo rje 'phreng ba'i don la rang lugs ni spyi bo'i rlung ma yigagogadangs can la/ mgrin pa'i gyen rgyu me rlung o lam o'i gdangs can 'dresapas/ uX maX oṃ du gyur pa snying gar srog 'dzin a'i gdangs can spyi bor son pa dang 'dres pas oṃ maX oṃ ke sha can du 'gyur/ snying ga'i a la rlung nang du 'ongaba'i tshe/ steng rlung a'i gdangs can 'dres pas/ ā ring po de nyid gsangaganas su thur sel ha srog med kyi gdangs can 'dres pas āXtsheg drag can du gyur pa dang / rlung gnas pa'i tshe spyi bo'i thig le dang 'dres pa'i rlung gi cha shasaklad kor gyi gdangs can/ mgrin pa'i gyen rgyu/ u'i gdangs can dang le drosanas mar 'ong ba thur sel ha srog med kyi gdangs can steng du 'ong ba dang 'dres pas huX du gyur pa'o/ /'di huX thung ngo / /de nas bzlas pa'i gtso bo huX dang / rludagi gtso bo gnas pa yin pas/ rlud 'gags pa'i tshe yang / gnas pa la brten —261—

nas 'ga' zhig 'chi ba'i tshe 'gag pa ltar dbugs dbyung ba'i tha mar 'gag pa ni 'di la ma yin no/ /de ltar gnas pa la huX sbyor ba 'di ni kho bo'i bla me'i zhalasnga nas kyis rtsod 'i dus kya grub pa'i dbang phyug rje btsun zhi ba'i zhabs kyi zhal lung las rnyed pa yin gsungs te/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba chen pho/ /gsum pa ni/ lha thams cad kyi sku'i spyi sngags ni oṃ dang / gsung gyi spyi sngags ni āXdang thugs kyi spyi sngags ni hūX ste/ de ltar gsum dang / glu te skyes pa dang / āXbud med dang / huX ma ning gi ngo bor gsungs te/ ji skad du spyod bsdus las/ gang gi phyir sngags thams cad ni bud med dang skyes pa dang ma ning gi ngo bo nyid/ man ngag ji ltar thob pa yi ge gsum la rab tu 'jug go /des na yi ge gsum ni sngags thams cad kyi bdag po'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don lha phomore dang gnyis ka'i spyi sngags yin pa'am/ oṃ rkyang ma dang 'brel bas thabasadakar cha yin pa'i phyir skyes pa dang / āXro ma dang 'brel ba'i phyir shes tha dmar cha yin pas bud med dang / huX dbu ma dang 'brel bas mun pa thabs shes cha mnyam pa'i phyir ma ning ste/ 'byung 'jug gnas gsum thams cad la yod kyang / nang khams kyi byed pas skyes pa dang bud med dang ma ning rnams la yi gogasum po de dag shas che chung 'byung ba yin no/ /des na gzhi 'bras kyi sngags thams cad 'di gsum du 'du ba yin zhing / yang dbyangs bcu gnyis bud med dang / gsal byed rnams skyes pa dang / ṛ '-i bzhi ma ning ste yi go de rnamasamatshon pa thig le dang / tsheg drag dang gnyis char mtshon pa gsu༅go /bzhi pa —262—

ni/ lha thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs bskul ba dang / sngags gzhan gyi de ngosagrub thams cad rdzogs rim gyi skabs su 'dis 'grub pa dang / bskyed rim pa spyod pa gsum nyam 'og tu chud pas kyang / dngos grub ma grub na/ lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud 'dis bskul bas dngos grub 'phral du stsol ba thob pa'i phyir/bzlas pa'i mthar thug yin pa dang / gzhi dus su ldang 'jug gnas gsum gyi nus pas srog 'dzin zhing lus gnas pa dang / 'bru gsum gyis byin gyisabarlabs pa'i khu khrag ā li kā li'i gdangs can dbang po gnyis sbyor gyi dus su gsang ba'i sna rtse nas 'bru gsum gyi sgra dang bcas te byung ba la brten nas lus chags pa dang / steng du srog dang 'brel nas mig sogs dbang po rnams yulal sad par byed pa dang / khu khrag rlud dang 'brel nas 'og tu 'gro ba na/gsang skor 'byung 'jug byed pa dang / 'chi ba'i mthar yi ge gsum gyi rim pasami shigs par thim 'gro ba dang / bskyed rim pa'i lha thams thams cad 'di las bskyed cing 'dis byin gyis rlobs pa dang / kha zas sbyang rtogs sbar gsuragyis byin gyis rlobs pa yang 'di byed pa dang / rdo rje'i bzlas pas sngon gyilasasgrib sbyong zhing rlung dbu mar 'jug pa dang / 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor labarten nas bzlas na las bzhi 'grub pa'o/ /gnyis pa sngags kyi brda ni/ thogardemar oṃ dang mthar swāhā yod pa sprul dang / swāhā med pa mjug med dang/ oXmed pa mgo med dang / gnyis ka med pa btus pa zhes bya la/ dgos/pa lungaston las/ brda yi de nyid gsum gnas pa/ /rang bzhin bzlas pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes 'bru gsum gyis sngags de rnams mtshon pa dang / gzhan yang 'byung—263—

'ju / ga gnas gsum kyi bzlas pa la lag pa'i phyag rgya'i 'ching ba'i ming gsungs pa/dgongs pa lung ston las/myur ba la sogs gsum ldan pa//phyag rgya sgrub par bshad pa yin//zhes myur ba dang /rnam par sdud pa dang/dal ba can zhes kyang btags la/yang rim pas lha gshe/gas su gsol ba dang /sbyan 'dren pa dang /bzhugs su gsol ba yang btags te/de rnams/las/las dang dngos grub kyi phan yon ji ltar 'byung ba 'di la dgongs so//sngagasakyi brda zhes bya ba ni ming gi rnam grangs so//gsum pa ni/yi go 'bru gsum po 'dis mtshone pa'i don/lus sku dang /ngag gsung dang /sems thugs kyi rdorje'i ngo bor rnam par dag pa dbyer mi phyed pa'i lha ste/gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku'o//dgongs pa lung ston las/de ni yongs su gyur pa'i gzugs//lha ru nye bar dmigs pa'o//zhes gsungs pa'i don no//bzhi pa ni/dgongs pa lung ston las/'gag med rab tu zhi ba ste//rtag dang chad pa rnawaspangs pa//dus gsum mkhyen pas ma byas pa//rtog pa nam mkha'adi dbyer med mashaṃ//'di ṣka kho na don dam ste//so so rang rig mashaṃ nyid do//zhes rtogapa thams cad nam mkha' lta bu'i stong pa nyid du thim zhing /rang gi rig pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi spros bral ni don dam ste/ngag thams cad rdo rje'i bzlas par sbyangs pas/de yang mi shigs pa'i thig ler thim zhing ngag thams cad brjod bral nam mkha' dang mnyam par rtogs pa'o//so so rang rig gi mtshan nyid can du bshad pas/med dgag gi mtshan nyid can ni ma yin no//des na sngags btu ba'am brjod par bcas pa'i sngags dang /brdar gyur pa'i sngagasarde64

kyis rdor bzlas kyi ngo bo dang byed tshul bshad/ sngags kyi dmigs pa ste/sngags don gyis kun rdzob bden pa sgyu lus dang / don dam gyis sngags kyi 'od gsal te/ sngags nyid la brten pa'i phyogs rnams bstan no/ /lnga pa ni/ dziskad du/ thung ngu ma lus ngag tu 'gyur/ /gcig min du ma ma yin no/ /zhesangagathams cad kyi rtsa ba a thung yin zhing / de yang gcig dang du ma bral ba'i stonganyid du gsungs te/ dngos grub thams cad 'grub par byed pa'i sngags dang/bstan bcos thams cad ni ā li kā li las 'byung ba yin la/ gsal byed rnams kyang dbyangs la brten dgos shing / dbyangs thams cad a'i 'gyur ba yin pa dang / ngag gi smra ba thams cad rlung gis 'gyur bar byed pa lce rkan 'phrad pa'i rkyen las byung ba ste/ rlung de thams cad kyi rtsa ba mi shigs pa'i thigale a thung ki gdangs can yin pa dang / skye ba'i tshe thig le de thog ma yin pa dang / 'chi ba'i tshe khams thams cad de la thim nas 'chi ba 'od gsal 'charab dang / lam dus su rlung sems 'dus pas lam gyi 'od gsal skye zhing/'od gsal de skye ba med pa'i rnam pa can yin pa dang / yi ge a dang / mi shigasapa'i thig le'i tha ma rnam par dpyad na stong pa nyid las gzhan brjod du med pa'i phyir/ a ni skye ba med pa'i don te/ 'di nyid rtogs pa las tsha3 par byangachub par 'gyur bas na/ spyod bsdus las skabs 'dir/ rdzogs pa'i sangasargyas a las byung / /a ni yig 'khru kun gyi mchog /don chen yi ge dam pa ste/ /srog chen po ni skye ba med/ /tshig tu brjod pa spangs pa ste/ /brjod pa kun gyi rgyu yi mchog /ces pa mtshan yang dag pa'i lung 'dren par mdzad de shin —265—

tu 'byor ba yin no/ /gsum pa/ bsgom bya srog rtsol gyi rang bzhin bshad pa la/(〈rdza〉 go rtsol gyi sgra don/) srog rtsol gyi ngo bo/ /bye brag rdo rje'i bzlas pa la sogs pa'i byed las bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ srog rtsol gyi skad dod bhā ṇa a ya ma (〈dzi〉 rtse zhes bya ba yin la/ pra ṇi) ni srog dang / a ya ma ni rtsol ba dang / 'gog pa dang / ring por byed pa rnams la las/pag srogastorlung dbu mar 'gags pa dang / ring du byed pa'i don no/ /yang rlung 'byung 'jug gnyis la srog dang rtsol ba zhes ming btags pa'ang yod do/ /de'i rnal 'byorayin pas srog rtsol zhes ming btags so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje 'phreng ba las/'dod chags shas che bas rdzas kyi thig le dang / zhe sdang shas che bas sngags kyi thig le dang / gti mug shas che bas 'od kyi thig le sgom par gsungs pa ni/gtso bo'i dbang du byas pa ste/ gang zag gcig la yang gsum ka 'jug pa dang/gzhan yang gsum po der ma nges par srog rtsol mang du yod pa yin no/ kha cigarlung thams cad yi ge 'bru gsum gyi gdangs su gdod nas yod par 'dod bzhin du/ lus lha sku dang / sems chos sku'i rang bzhin du gdod nas yongasagacod du grub par 'dod pa la dgra ltar lta ba ni/ don 'gal ba yin la/ rludathams cad 'bru gsum gyi rang bzhin du khas blangs nas/ bum can las rdorabazlas bzang ste/ de dag la sngags kyi don bsgom pa med pas so zhes zer bzhi bum can gyi rlung sbyor de 'byung 'jug gnas gsum gyi rlung ma yin par 'dod dgos pa sogs de'i lugs kyi grub mtha'i mtha' dpyad na/ gzhan yang skyon mang du 'jug pa dag yod do/ /de la 'dir gsang ba'i sna rtser rdzas kyi thig le'i —266—

srog rtsol bsgom pa dang / gdong gi sna rtse 'od kyi thig le'i srog rtsol bsgom pa dang / snying ga'i sna rtser sngags kyi thig le'i srog rtsol bsgom pa'o/ /dang po ni/las kyi phyag rgya'i padma'i sna rtse dang / rang gi rdo rje'i sna rtse phrad mtshams su byangasems (〈j-i〉rtse mi 'pho bar 'dzin pa la sems)rtse gcig tu byas pas der rlud sems 'gag pa dang / 'di'i yan lag tu ye shes kyi phyag rgya la sogs pa dmigs pa gzhan gyi khyad par gyi dmig/sa pas zhu ba'i thig le'i gzugs can der sgom pa la brten nas rma 'gog pa dang / yang rtsa phrad pa'i sbyor bas dbu ma kha phye nas ro rkyang gi rlud 'gag pa'i tshul te gsum mo/ /bar pa la ni dkyil 'khor phra mo bsgom pa la sogs pa'i lugs kyang yod de/ de rnams ni rdorje snyingapo rgyan gyi dgongs pa dang mthun par/ 'jam dpal zhal lung las ni nor burathig le'i rnal 'byordo ra zhes kyang gsungs so/ /gnyis pa la/ rlung gang la rdorabazlas bya ba dang / rdor bzlas kyi dbye ba dang / rlung sngags sbyor tshur go /dngapo ni/ sngar snying ga'am nye ba la sogs pa rtsa 'khor gyi gnas rnams su rnala'abyor gzhan la brten nas rlung dbu mar zhugs na ni rdor bzlas khyad par can si ti'i nang nas bya ba nyid ches zab cing / de'i sngon du ni thun mong gi rdorabazlas bya ba la yang 'gal ba med do/ /de yang rdzogs rim pas ni zhi rgyasadabang drag gi don du rdor bzlas byed na/ rtsa ba'i rlung bzhi la byed cing/ 63 shes lnga sgrub pa'i don du byed na/ yan lag gi rlud lnga la byed pa dang/ dpe'i 'od gsal mthar thug pa bskyed pa'i don du rtsa ba'i rlung lnga la dang por byed cing / de la nus pa rnyed pa'i skabs shig nas yan lag gi rlung lnga rnams la byed —267—

de/ gong du sngags kyi de nyid skabs su bshad pa ltar/ 'dus pa'i lugasalasnying ga'i mi shigs pa'i thig le nyid gtso bo yin pas/ thog mar rtsa mdud gzhan rnams grol ba'i phyir rtsa gnas gzhan du byed pa yod kyang / mthar thugapa ni snying ga nas bya dgos so/ /gnyis pa ni/ dmigs pa'i khyad par gyi dbye ba ni/ gdams ngag rnams nas mi 'dra ba sna tshogs pa 'byung la/ yi go'i sgonasakyang / yi ge gsum pa dang / rdo rje 'phreng ba nas hu dang ho ste yi goganyis pa bshad cing / sangs rgyas thod pa sogs nas yi ge mang po dang sbyar ba'i bzlasapa'ang 'byung zhing / de dag thams cad la 'bru gsum bzhin du nang gi sngags btu dang / byed las rnams kyang 'byung du rung bas/ yi ge gsum gyi rdor bzlasakyi phan yon rnams gzhan de rnams la med pa ni ma yin no/ /spyir bskyed rdzogasakyi bzlas pa phal cher la rdor bzlas kyi ming 'jug cing / gsang ba 'dus pa las/ 'bru gsum gyi de kho na nyid las spyad pa'i gzungs kyi sgo la sku gsungathugs kyi rdor bzlas dang / mkha' 'gro'i bzlas pa dang / dug gsum gyi sems can rnams 'od gsal du 'jug pa de gsum gyi rdor bzlas dang /'od gsal bsgom pa ma ning gi bzlas pa sogs rnam grangs su bsha/da nag skabasadon gyi rdor bzlas la don gyi rjes 'tsho bzlas pa ni/ ngo bo ṣka med bzangapoyis/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams dpyad pa/ /rin chen bzlas par de bshad do/ /zhes rtsa ba'i rlung gi rdor bzlas sam rin chen bzlas pa dang/sangs rgyas zhing rnams thams cad du sku yi sprin rnams spros pa dang / bzhugacingabyon pa rdo rje'i don/ de ni thogs med bzlas pa'ang yan lag gi hro gi rdor —268—

'a sdo//gas sems sang pa rnga/she / pe'i she gnyas kya dus su hro she da pa dang /rtsa lha/rded gral ba 'a/dad 'ad she la mthar thug thab byad dang /las sa sgrub pa' dus ta drugab / / na char de tsho ra 7 'i sa she sti re ni/dzña(ru pa 4 )rder rwagasum pa na/ ska~X //ye ༷༵ sgyu myo da ṣa rda/zla ni// dho dan bsha/da rgyud las/tha she ga st+ri/ra sde ge she 'a/da 'dan pa yi zab/ rdza'/ra zhes te/she 'a/ge ste zhes pa la na lha pa / ru mi / /da akṣa rasaX/des na 1 / gā dad dhi /da kau she /rterdeshas par bzla ba 'a//gā na gnyas ga 'a byad pa' dan/mu zhe ge skabs su spyod dā ltar kau dzo su gau nus pa' tshul snyu gsum gya ka sum gyi su ཿnga bha ༷ning ga 'ang /da ༵ 'jisang ces 'brags mthi ge ge zhera~X gdangs bsgam pa yan zhang /kha ga 'ad skad sa 'bru/ gsum gya skad gagadangs la byed pa ni ma yin te/de ni phyi'i gdangs la dmigs pa yin pasar tsho da can/ da lbo pe ke tsho yin re ni/sa(rdezi//kau na hro rang de'i don yige : dang ༵nasang ngang nga 'ang ba slo//gis sgro bzhi tu byasna rdzo/sa/she' dan ya gsum gda~X ga 'dral ༵ shan narmazhes sgro ༵sne she/ldebazlas nang gi gdangs su /detrīn ya geX sgogs bsgam pa bar mi/rdar bzlas kau yi se'i spra su shad ༵gnad ma /gas pa ste/bye ltar byar wo mi zer ra// ge' gzugasa~X she yang mi zu sa der lbor zhi du wo na/rjoXbarnams ri se la/rde'agad par yang wo bar 'gyu rdor ༷ /de dag ma byad tsam dang

gzung ba'i phyir yin zhe na/ 'dir yang de ltar yin pas ci phyir 'gal/ des na rlung sngags dbyer med kyi bzla tshul ma tshang na rdzogs rim pa'i rdor bzlas su mi 'gro ba'ang srid kyi/ yi ge'i rnam pa bsgom pa la skyon du 'gyur ba ga la lod/rlung sngags dbyer med kyi bzla tshul khon las/ gzhan rdor bzlas kyi skabasasugatan byed du mi rung na rdor bzlas kyi skabs su rang lhar bskyed pa yang mi rung bar 'gyur ro/ /snying ga'i mi shigs thig le la a thung gi rnam par bsgom pa yang mi 'thad par 'gyur te/ a'i gzugs su yod pa gang nas kyang ma bshad cing / thig le de la a thung du bshad pa ni/ stong pa nyid mtshon don yin paragasungs shing khyed kyang khas len pa'i phyir ro/ /yi ge gsum gyi gdangs dnga'adra bar sgrog pa ste/ sgra ma yin na gang zhig yin pa brtag dgos te/ sgro'i rnamapa yin na yi ge gsum gyi gdangs can rlung de'i rnam pa yin par song ba'i phyir shes par 'gyur la/ rlung phyi don tshad grub pa yang 'dod pa'i phyir/ bem shes kyi gzhi mthun par khas blangs par mi 'gyur ram/ yang yi ge gsum dang 'dra ba'i gdangs te ldan min 'du byed kyi yi ger 'dod na ni/ ldan min 'du byed thamasacad btags yod yin pas/ rlung rnams btags yod du rdzas su 'dod cesarang tshig 'gal ba 'dir mi 'gyur ram/ gal te sgra yin na/ 'bru gsum gyi sgra'i gdangs tshig tu bton pa'i rnam pa yid la byas pa kho na ma yin nam/ yangarlung gdangs de ltar sgrog pa gsal du bsgom pa ma yin la/ dngos gnasalayod pa de la ngo shes byas nas da gtod pa yin zhes pa 'di ni shin tu mi rung ste/ de lta bu'i gdangs su yongs su chug kyang / dngos su mi thos pa ga ngo shesadzi—270—

ltar byed/ yid gang la gtod pa phar rgyab kyi grong khyer mig gis mi mthong na de la mig ltas te brtags mi thub pa bzhin no/ /tshig gi zol 'jog tsam du byasazin na yang / /don la rang lugs kyang rang gis bkag pa de nyid khas len te/thog mar rlung la yi ge'i gdangs gsum gyi mos pa byas nas bsgom pag phyisamos pa ma byas kyang yi ge'i gdangs su snang ba 'ong ste/ lha'i nga rgyal bzhin no zhes zer ba'i phyir ro/ /'dis rlung yi ge gsum gyi gdangs su gdod mnasaganas zhes pa yang shin tu bkag pa yin te/ bskyed rim gyi nga rgyal ltar 'du shes log par zhugs pa khas blangs pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir smras pa/ skyon med lugs la skyon btags pas/ /skyon gyis gangapa skyon can du/ /mi shes pa de blun po rnams/ /kun gyi spyi lugs nyid du 'khums/ /des na rlud sngags dbyer med kyi tshul shin tu gal che ba yin lbod kyi/ de ni yi ge'i gdangs bsgom pa nyid yin la/ de'i man ngag tu gzugasarnabasgom pa yang mi 'gal te/ des de la shin tu phan pa'i phyir ro/ /las dang po pa la phan mi thogs pa la/ zab don du 'dzin pa 'di mtshar/ dngos po'i dzinasatshul la sangs rgyas kyi sa bas bzang ba med de/ de'i rnam gzhag bshad pa tsamogyis man ngag mthar thug tu mi 'gyur te/ de las dad pa bsgom pa'i blin ngagabastan na/ las dang po pa la phan par 'gyur ba yin no/ /des na blam dam pa 'bad pas bsnyen nas man ngag tshol ba'i dod/ da lta glegs bam lta ba yin zhes zer ba ni/ rim lnga las/ bla ma la brnyas rgyu can dad pa med/ /sngags kyis rlom zhing glegs bam mthong bas khengs/ /dad pa med cing dbang bskur—271—

dman pa la/ /gtam gyi rim pa'ang de la brjod mi bya/ /zhes dang/ mkhas pa rnams kyis mngon pa'i nga rgyal gyis glegs bam mthong ba tsam la brten nasargyud 'chad par byas pa zhes gsungs pa'i skyon de dag rang la tshang ba yin pasango shes 'tshal lo/ /dngos su bla ma las man ngag tshol ba lta tsi spog dam pa snga ma rnams kyi thugs kyi bcud man ngag bkod pa'i glegs bam tsam yang gzhung dang mi mthun na 'dor ba'i sbus man ngag la yod ces sun 'byin zhing / gzhukhogi dngos bstan de nyid man ngag yin par 'dod par snang bas/ gzhung dang man ngag ces pa yang mi 'thad par 'gyur te/ de gnyis gcig par khas blang pasaso/ /des na lhag pa'i lha gsung wo zhes pa'i gtam rgyud mang po bsgrigs kyangaman ngag mchog la sdang ba'i tshig ma rung pa gzhung lugs nyid gdam ngag gi mchog yin zhes gzhung la gus par rdzu ba 'dis/ kho bo cag ci ste bslu b.ranus/ 'dir rlud gnas pa ni bla ma'i man ngag gi thog mar mchod bstod bzo dgos la/ phyis rang shugs su 'byung / yang thog mar bzo bcos med parabazhag pas chog pa'i lugs kyang 'byung bar mngon la/ yang dbang po rabasasrog rtsol rdo rje'i bzlas pa zla ba drug gi rtsa mdud grol bar 'gyur ba la cha drug tu byas te/ de'i nyams myong rnams dang bstun te bzla tshul mi 'dra bar 'byung ba/rdo rje la nyeng ba las/ thog mar 'byung dang rngub pa rnams/ nyi khri dang ni chig stongadang / de bzhin grangs ni brgya phrag drug /ces sogs rgyas par gsungs pa rnams kyi snying po'i don ni/ zla ba dang po la/ rlung nyi khri rmag stong drug brgya lanyin re bzhin du rdor bzlas de nyid byed pa yin la/ zla ba gnyis pa la thun chod —272—

re'i rlung dgu brgya pa phrag re la 'jug gnas ldang gsum du dbye bas/ nyisastong bdun brgyar 'gyur ba thams cad nges par 'gyur ba dang / 'khor lo sosolas 'byung ba tsam shes pa dang / de dag la brten nas snga ma las phra zhing zhib par rdo rje'i bzlas pa byed pa yin no/ /zla ba gsum pa la rlung rnams rtsa ge boraso so nas gsal bar 'byung ba dang / rgyun gcig nyid rtsa 'khor tha dad du rgyu ba'i tshul dngos su mthong bas/ de la brten te rdo rje'i bzlas pa bya/ zla ba bzhi pa la/ rlung brgya rtsa brgyad kyi rgyu ba'i tshul shes nas rdo rje'i bzlas pa byas pas/rang bzhin gyi rnam rtog brgya rtsa brgyad kyi rgyu bar rags pa 'od gsal du 'jug pa'i mgo rtsom mo/ /zla ba lnga pa la/ rlung brgya rtsa brgyad po cung zad re log ste/rtog med kyi ye shes 'dren pa'i rlung chen por song ste/ rtsa 'khor gyi lte ba rnamasasu rgyu ba mthong nas rdor bzlas byed de/ rlung rnams phyi rol nas log stomishigs pa'i thig le'i gnas su phyin pa'o/ /zla ba drug pa la/ der phyin pa de mishigs pa'i thig le la thim par 'gyur te/ nyon mongs kyi g.yo ba las leg pa dang / rnam rtog yul la g.yeng ba'i sems dag par 'gyur/ de yang zhaganyi shu rtsa bdun rtsa bdun du bsgoms pas de dag 'grub par gsungs pas/ zhag lhagam gsum gsum snga ma grub nas/ phyi ma mgo mi rtsom pa'i bar ro/ de drugalabagrang ba dang rjes 'gro dang gnas kyi dbye ba'i rtog pa dang / dus kyi dbye ba'i rtog pa dang / rlung bzlog pa dang / yongs dag ces btags go /yang yi gosdu ༵na ḍā pa sngu /kyā /dzī ḍā ༵dī shā sogs sdud pa'i ༵/ ༵ kau ༵'i —273—

chos kun 'grub par byed/ u yis sangs rgyas sogs bzung ba'i dus su brtan g.yo gnyis med kyi ye shes 'jug par byed pa dang / rlung phyir ldang ba'i tshe chos kun dag par byas nas bdud rtsir gyur pa nang du 'ongs pas rang rgyud kyi bag chags bkrus pa dang / gnas pa u'i ngo bos kyang rang rgyud dag pa mthar phyin par byed pa/ 'jam dpal zhal lung dang grol thig sogs kyi dgongs pa stoshin tu gnad che bar yod do/ /gsum pa ni/ snying ga'i mi shigs pa'i a thung ste/ rdo rje snying po gyon gyi rgyud las/ /snying ga'i dbus na mi shigs pa/ /'ba' zhig mar me dgadangamatshungs/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu phra ba ste/ /a ni gtso bo dam po rdo /zhes dang/grol ba'i thig le las/ bde gsal mi shigs thig le'i gzugs/ /yungs kar gyi ni 'bru tshad tsam/ /'od zer sna lnga 'bar 'dzag pa'o/ /tshul can rtag tu snyingadabus gnas/ /de la bltas pas ye shes che/ /skad cig tsam gyis rnal 'byoral/ /'bar ba 'di la the tshom med/ /ces gsungs te/ gzung 'dzin gyi rludabacu gnyis thig le 'di las 'byung bas/ 'di la mnyam par bzhag pa na/ rludarnams 'dir thim pas 'od gsal la 'char ba 'gyur/ sdom 'byung las kyang/snying ga'i chu skyes son pa'i rlung / hū yig dkar po dang mtshungs pa/ bas5bya mnyam par bzhag pa gang / de las yul sogs kyis mi 'ching / /'khore ba'i steng du 'gro ba'i rlung / /mya ngan 'das pa'i 'og tu bgrod/ /rab mi tu gnasamyangan 'das/ /snying ga'i chu skyes ze'i 'brur gnas/ /zhes gsungs te/ 'di ni steng 'og gi rlung gi snang ba dang mun pa'i rlung gnyis te/ mi shigs thig le'i —274—

sbyil wor 'di'i yi nu / sa ri ge ge pa mu phyin pa na/snang bas mun pa phug spyi jo gro du/stardema~Xs/rlung kri bgrod pa snyang ga dang /dkar po'i bgrod pa — rnga~Xpas gnas pa' sbyi ngan las ༷dri par 'a/ra te/grub chen dza lanta pasadwo nga snyi / ///nga spyi bo de de thim / bral zhang//mun byā sdog ku 'bor skyo~X/ shar// nga dang — bo de de ma//zhes gsungs te/'ad na rnal 'byor rgyud kho na las bsha/da pa'o//des na snying gar thig le bsgom tshul mi 'drab/snying ga'i sa mi 'ang ba 'a lo dang /yi ge mu ge /thig le dang sa/nyi zla kha lju/ rnyi re re sogs 'dra ba 'byams klas pa' bar du 'byung ba yan no//'a—ra ngag ni mtshon byed de/rtsa 'thu ge zhen gzhan pa gci rdo yo kyang bstan te/sprerdeyang de 'ad la bsgom 'a gnad yod dā gag dgos mod kyang /dmigasardedas kya rten 'ge ni ge ge ldig tu dgos pa'i nges pa med do//murges no la/rdorje' bzlas pa' byed rnyis bshad pa dang /srog rtsol kho ge ge de ri shad gnyas kya byed las/ni thi pa'o//dang po —/rdo rje phreng ba las/'ad ra (bus na khas pa //ga le rlung du yang dag bsha/da/sngags kya de nyan kyis de 'byed/rnalaṣe'abye 3 mdud pa bkrol nas ni//rlung gi de nyid rig pa de//zhes gcos te/thig le'i steng 'og gi snying kha'i rtsa mdud ma rig sgo nga'i sbugs kyi ming can ge je do rdo/'dre/da par byed de/dper na smyug ma 'tsha rdzug rgon ce 'gags pa ra/lcags/ thurams 'byung 'ju / ga sga'i don ni spri /ba ba—— no//mdud pas 'gags nas rlunga'agro 'a mi byed pa'i don —/—ra thur sel sna sgor 'ong ba dang /go won rtags kya rtser 'gro ba dus rtag tu 'ong ba la yang /cha shas dbu mar 'phyupa

'jug rtag tu byed mod kyang / mdud pa de dag gi thad du de des bkag pasadabu ma spangs te rtsa gzhan la brten nas 'byung 'jug byed dgos pa'o/ /de grol ba na lam de nyid nas kyang de ltar 'byung 'jug byed pa yin no/ khog rgoṭagazhan gyi rdor bzlas la yang 'di dang 'dra'o/ /gzhan yang rdo rje'i bzlas pags chu la 'jug pa nas/ thob pa 'od gsal la 'jug pa'i bar du 'byung zhing/de'i rtags rnams kyang / rtags lnga dang lnga pa las phye ba'i zla ba'i zla 'od nyid 'od mun nag skya rengs kyi dpe can rnams 'byung ngo / /rtags 'di dag lasasogs zlog tu rung ba dang / cung zad log pa dang / gtan nas log pa dang / de dag la yang nang tshan du dbye bas rnam grangs du ma 'byung ba yin no/ kha cig mirtog pa tsam bsgom pa la yang / rtags 'di dag phyogs mthun 'byung ba yod de/dbye ba phyed dgos zhes smra ba ni/ gzhan dag rdzogs rim rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes khyad par can bsgom pa la rtags 'di dag 'byung bar mthong nag derarang skal pa dman pa'i stobs sa kyas la ma dang rtags gnyis char la yid ma tshes pa'i gtam ste/ rdzogs rim ma yin pa bsgom pas rdzogs rim gyis rtagasa'abyung ba ngo mtshar che/ dbye ba 'byed rgyu med kyang dbye ba phyed dgos zhes g.yo sgyu'i zol gyis bslu ba 'dis ci zhig bya/ gzhan yang / rlung sngags dbyer med du bzlas pa 'dis/ rlung dbu mar zhugs gnas thim gsum byed cing/ derasems 'gog pa dang / mi rtog pa'i ye shes khyad par can skye zhing/ rlung thim pa des gtum mo 'bar zhing dga' ba bzhi dang snang ba gsum 'dren par byed do/ /gzhan yang rlud rags pa la bslab pa mthar phyin na/ rgyu ba gsal ba ste kha —276—

dog dang /3 mngon sum du mthong ba dang /yi ge'i sgra'i 'a du ga.āoX dang/gnas pa rni /phra ste grangs ma /myur bul dung /lnga yang thams cad de ye she ༷rtses ge/ni gsum gyi rlung / ma 'khru/zhes par she pa'//phra ma mtharagi ( 'a ༷ /kau gsum gya rlung rni lus kya nang du shang rwang ci ༷/nang rlung phyar la tub ba 'a /ba gi khung bu rnams nas kyang 'dad paraḥng khrug byed pa /nga/phya hro sas reg pas ༷peX zi ༵nga yang ba ཿnga/ris pa~X yan she stsu mthar phyan zhi gres pa she ra dbang shes gas mthun spras pa dang /gi spre gno ba rgyu ba 'a dus su sgam na/she rdel la mi bdang/grang ri'i tsho nad gshe /she go ) ba5pa sgyu pa snaspyir ba nus pa dang /me' gnad pa med pa sa spru/sa 'khyu/ngang//yin zhi zung/ra gang du sems gtad pa der rlung rin 'gas gnas thimatha sum ni ngeb /de yang rtsa 'kho 3 / ga du byas pa rgyun ma ho na la ni gnas ma gsum nges par 'byurdo nga ngo //ra 'bar ྅dzag rna she/rlung dbu mar sems 'a sku/rded she snyug/ma zhugs gang du yang gtum thig le~X nas ༷ she zhu ḍi bde drad mang du ཿnga ba tshes sla la/sdong zhi 1 ga le rnal 'di sde slo rda/gas jab gal ni/sgam/she~Xkra tshong 'gas gnas thim gas ma mi/dbang po zang re yo la tshi/dha ti/ mad thi zu kyang zhugs gnas tham gsum gya cha shas cung smi ཿḍi la/ rtswaghri ma pa brtan por song nas bzlog pa la rtsol ba dgos shang /de sngan du ni dgos so//drod 'bar ba la thig le zhu thub mi thub gnyis yod chi/8gleng pa ri 0ga de :nirde 0ri spra ka/)sa(rderderdethub pa la'ang dhū chug ma chug gnyas dang / la'ang ma ma tham

dang / lus kyi bde ba yang zhu bde yin min gnyis dang / de dag la yang nangatshan mi 'dra ba mang du yod do/ /des na rdzas kyi thig le'am nor bu'i thigalebasgom pa'i tshe/ yid kyi phyag rgya la brten pa na/ thur sel gyi sgo chud 'tshi gyi dbye bas rlung dhwa zhwang 'jug pa'i thabs byed pa yin te/ phyag chen thig lelaga'adzum pa dang sna 'byed pa yis/ /rlung gi me ni khong du chud/ khres dang/ dpalaldan a ti sha'i rdo rje'i glu las kyang / gzhan du nam mkha' chen po skor/ /peram pa ni 'jug mi 'gyur/ /'byed dang 'dzum pa'i sbyor ba yis/ khrag mo de ni bskul bar bya/ zhes dang / rang snang ye shes gzu gas can gyi/ /padma'i lte ba'i dbus na gnas/ /nor bu'i rtse mor gnas pa'i tshe/ /mar me lta bu myag 'da'/ /zhes gsungs te/ rang snang ye shes ni de'i rig mgo /'ar phyi srogartsol gyi dang po rlung sems sdud pa mang dugasungs pas so/ /'ga' zhig snyingakha'i thig le dang rdor bzlas kyi rnal 'byor mthar phyin pa'i ngag dben mthar thug la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor ba khyad par chen po can/ 'ga' zhig kho na laphyag rgya'i srog rtsol bshad pa yin/ zhes pa yang rgya chung bar shes parabya'o/ /gzhan yang btsan thabs su rlung 'gag ru par byed pa'i man ngag zab mornams la/ de 'dra gegs che bas mi legs zhes smra ba ni/ nyams/myong med paraslob ma 'khrid dgos pa byung ba'i gtam ngo sor byas pa'o/ /dper na/ sman pa mkhas pa nyams myong can dag mngon shes med kyang / nad pa mthong ma thags de phan pa'i thabs 'di yin no zhes shes par 'gyur ba de bzhin du/ bdaganyid nyams myong dang ldan na de'i thabs thams cad shes par 'gyur bas/ de tsam du —278—

'jigs pa bya mi dgos/de ltar srog rtsol de rnams kyi gtso bo 'dus pa las ni rdo rje'i bzlas pa mdzad do//de nyid rtsal du bto te/gsaraḥgal gshi wo wo po kha dog lnga//nyung kar gyi ni 'bru 3 tsam//sna yi rtse mor nan to du//rnal 'byor gyis ni rtag tu bsgom//zhes dang /'dus pa'i rgyud ma las/rin chen kha dog sna lnga pa//srog dang rtsol ba zhes byar bshad/khres gsungasardepa'i rin chen ni rlung kha dog 'od zer lnga'i rnam pa thig le nyung kar lta bu sogs bsgom ste/sna'i rtse ste rtsa 'khor gyi lte ba rnams su bsgom par bya la/de la thigale bsgom pa kho na'am/de las rdor bzlas sogs rlung gi sbyor bas srog rtsolabya'o zhes pa'o//srog dang rtsol ba zhes pa ltar na/'ong ba dang 'gro brnyas te bzlas par gsal lo//ma rgyud rnams las ni phyag rgya'i srog rtsol gtso borartsal du bton zhing gtum mo 'bar ba gtso bor gyur pa gzhan yang phra thig gi rnal 'byor yang ji snyed cig gsungs so//gnyis pa gzhung gi don la/dmigs pa'i gzhi dang /de la brten pa'i bya ba gnyis las dang po ni/zla ba'i dkyila'akhor rdzogs pa ni//lte ba'i rtsa bar gnas pa bsgom//yi ge ma rnga gtu gyurapa'i brtanas//de 6kyid/bun/sdo9kra/bcu pa/par bya// 'i jordo na ni/ rdzawaṃgazhan yang sogs te/ lugs snga ma nag po pa'i lugs kyi rdzogs rim las gzhan yang lte ba'i gnas su zla ba yi ge'i mchog sprin gyi sgra dang bcas pa la sems bzung bas/ro rkyang gi rlung gnyis dbu mar thim pa las/gtso/mo'abar zhing ha yig zhu bas dga' ba bzhis bde stong 'dren pa 'kho 3 lo'i nye bar hro sems sdud byed kyi ting nge 'dzin no//lte ba zhes bya ba ni/mu sgo ltar9

na sprul 'khor gyi lte ba dang / 'og sgo ltar na shes rab kyi padma'i lte ba dang/thabs kyi rtsa phrad pa'i mtshams so/ /zla ba yang zla ba'i gzugs brnyan bsgom pa dang / zhu ba'i thig le gnyis la 'jug cing / sprin gyi sgra yang huX yig thig lerabacas pa dang / thur sel gyi rlung nor bur bsdu ba gnyis la las/ste/ 'i de ni thig le bsdu ba zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi sngags/ yi ge 'khru gsum gyi gdangs rlung dang dbyer med du byas nas/ dhwa ti re nang du 'jug gnas ldangagasum gyi rim pas/ yang yang bsgrags pa los/ snga ma las kyang lhag pa'i zhugs gnas thim gsum gyi rim pas gtum mo 'bar te dga' ba bzhi'i rim pa la brten nas/ rnal 'byor 'di mthar phyung ba na/ dpe'i 'od gsal mtharathug sems la dmigs pa 'dzin pa'i yan lag 'dren par 'gyur te/ 'di la'ang rang lus la brten pa dang / gzhan lus la brten pa gnyis yod do/ /'di sngon 'gro lam sbyangs pa dang bcas pa la/ 'od zer bsdu ba'am yi gobasduba'i tha snyad mdzad do/ /'di dag ni rnal 'byor nor bu'i thig le la brten pa'i man ngag rgyas pa mkhas pa mar pa do pa'i gsung rgyun rnams las 'byung zhing /lte bar bsgom pa'i rim pa ni/ nā ro pa'i man ngag thams cad las ni 'byung la/jo bo rje'i gdam ngag las ni steng 'og gi sgo la brten pa gnyis char gyi bshad pa gsal por 'byung zhing / rgya bod kyi gzhung dang man ngag gzhan rnams lasacirigs par 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ rjes gzhig gi rnal 'byoragyis 'od gsal du ldang 'jug byed pa yin te/ 'di la rgyu 'bras gnyis/ dang po —280—

ni lte bar sems dpa' gsum brtsegs su bsgoms pa'i ting nge 'dzin semasadapa'i 'od kyis snod bcud phyi nang thams cad bsdus pa'i rjes gzhig bsgom pas 'od gsal du 'jug cing / de las sgyu lus su ldang ba'i rdzogs rim chen po ste/ rnal 'byor chen po'o/ /'di la ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i 'od kyis snang ba thams cad g.yo ba ni/ rdo khab len gyis lcags g.yo ba bzhin dang/ snod bcud nas brtsams te dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i rim pas rang la sdud pa ni/ lci bas dngul chu sdud pa dang / rang gi zhal phyag bsdu ba ni/ rus sbal yan lag bskums pa dang / sems dpa' gsum gyi bsdu tshul nā da'i bar du byed pa giskar mda' gcig (〈lbo〉 rgol bcu sheg ) thim pa dang / de la yang mi dmigs pa ni/ lan tshwa chu la thim pa ste dpe lnga'o/ /rang bzhin brjod bral de ni gnamakhan dang / nyi ma dang rgya mtsho ste dpe gsum gyis mtshon zhing / de nyid lha skurashar ba'i sgyu lus ni cha lugs dang nyi zer dang / rlangs gsum gyis mtshon/ gar mkhan dang cha lugs/ nyi ma dang nyi zer/ rlabs dang rgya mtsho rnams rang bzhin dbye ba med pa ni zung du 'jug pa'i dpe'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de lta bu'i rnawa'abyor de nyid bsgom pa mthar phyin pa phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor dang bcas pas gong gi rnal 'byor mthar phyung na/ 'dir dpe'i 'od gsal mthar thug 'grub cing/de'i skad cig gnyis par sgyu lus thob/ gal te gong du steng sgo'i rdor bzlasamathar phyung ba'i rjes su nges par phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor 'bad de bsgom na/ derade gnyis 'grub cing / sgyu lus de yang spyod pa dang bcas te 'od gsalatubacug pas/ mthar don gyi 'od gsal du zhugs nas zung 'jug mngon du gyur—281—

pa gong du bshad pa'i gsang sngags kyi spyod pas mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba la sbyor ba'o//de yang kun spyod kyi lung slob dpon wo po pū yi pa'i gzhungadu drangs pa/ā li kā li mdun bsam nas//rnal 'byor chen po ngal bso bya//zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa ni//lte ba'i rtsa bar gnas par she /yi ge mchog tu gyur pa'i gnas//de yi dbus su bsam par bya//sku gsung thugs/ni rdo rje can//lha yi sku ni bsgom par bya//zhes sems dpa' gsum brtsegasardekyi gdams ngag dngos su bstan zhing /thig le dang yi ge bsdu ba ni de'i nangatshan cha shas bsgom pa yin pas shugs la bstan pa yin no//de ni gzugasalas 'das pa ste/zhes pa ni rdo rje sems dpa' bsdu ba sto rjes gzhig dang/dngos po med pa'i sems nyid yin//sems nyid brtag par mi bya zho/bsatshagyis mi khyab de bsam na//zhes spyir phyag rgya chen po bsam mi khyab kyi gdatshangag bstan pa yin kyang /skabs 'dir de'i nang shaṃ dpe'i 'od gsal la sbyarab yin no//des ni gzungs ni thob par 'gyur//zhes pas sgyu lus dang/myangan 'das 'byung dpa' bo ni//drug pa sems kyi sprul pa yin//dag pa chos kyi sprul pa ni//phag mo'i gzugs su bstan pa'o//zhes pa mya ngan 'das zhes/pasa'od gsal dang de man chad kyi zung 'jug bstan to//skrag pa thams cad rnatshaspangs te//ge rgor lo bde mchog sdom pa la//blo wo rnal 'byor nga pasaspyod//rigs lnga kun tu spyod pa yis//rigs gcig tu ni rnam brtagasapas//rnam rtog med pa'i sems bdag nyid//'dod pa'i yon to lnga laspyod//dogs pa thams cad rnam spangs nas//rnal 'byor seṅge bzhi du spyod/8

ces pa tshig rkang dang po bdun gyis spyod pa sgyidang / mtha' ma gnyis kyisaphyogs las rnam rgyal bstan no/ /gsum pa grub chen rdo rje dril bu pa'i gzhung las byung ba rdzogs rim rim pa lnga pa'i rnam par bzhag pa la/ spyi don dang / gzhung gi don gnyis las/dang po la/ rdzogs rim bsgom pa po'i gang zag rdzogs rim gyi ngo bo dngade'i phan yon/ de phyi rol med kyang lam gzhan thams cad 'dus tshul/ de nyid gang las thob par 'gyur ba'i rgyu'i gtso bo/ ji ltar 'khrid pa'i rim pa zho /dngapo ni/ gzhung 'di nyid las/ rnam par rtog med 'jigs bral bzhi slob mgus la kun mkhyen gyi/ /spyod yul ye shes gang zhig ni/ zhes gsungs pas/ the tshom gyi rnam par rtog pa dang / lam zab mor blor mi shong ba'i 'jigs pa dngabral ba/ slob dpon la gus pa ste mtshan nyid gsum ldan du gsungs shing/dam tshig dang ldan pa dang / rdzogs rim gyi snod du rung ba sogs ni spyi dnga'adra'o/ /lus dkyil gyi dbang bskur thob dgos par grags kyang / de bzhin gyi phyag len du mdzad pa ni legs mod/ mtha' gcig tu lus dkyil gyi dbangabaskur sngon du ma song ba bsgom du mi rung ba ni ma yin no/ /gnyis pa la/rdzogs rim gyi ye shes dngos dang / rim pa la dpyad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mkha' 'gro ma yi tshogs kyi ni/ /snying po sdom pa bla ma nyid/ /ces bstan te mkha' 'gro ma yi tshogs thabs kyi snying por sdom pa yin pas te/ gong gi mtshon don gyiskabs su bshad pa ltar/ /dmar cha gtum mo'i me spyi bo'i haX la sdom pa dang/rtsa rnams dbu mar sdom pa dang / shes rab mo sgrub pa por sdom pa dang/spros pa —283—

sdims snrad ༷ gsal du sdom pa dang /zhu bde dang rang bzhin lhan skyes kyi ye 4/sa gnya//ri sa//ni sa 'i:gong:3nga zhe radzoganyas/ pa /mur la 'aX/ gya 'a 'a 'a tshul bad pa sna phrags pa dag byung zhi/skya' zhag /hūṃ pa bum dbang /bzhi pa dho mdu rnga zheng/gsu5rdepa dang byā pa shes ya she/lnga pa mu ba rnyi lam du rda/da pa dang/dang bzhi pa thiga~X'adi rje snye she stir/sems kyi rnal 'byor zhes lta/ci rtsa ka : /pa pa dung dā pa gal 'a rnal ༷ged/'a pa mas kya rnal /rno/'a/kyig dang pa gnyas snang ba gi ku pa~X zhi pa' lam/gsum dā ba pa shes staX ga tā/lnga pa zung 'jug ge zhe ru de sa pa kau /༵ga 'a zhag dzī pa da ba bye gzugs sa sgrub byad/bye ces pa nga 'gyur ba bad rda sgrub ༵/dbus snying khang wo dzī da steng 'og gi/da she yang she ra lo'i ba dbus nga kha dang/gnyas pas nga 'ag sna sa thiga~XsheX'adziXbaste rdod la gnad du 'a ༵ dang /gsum pas ga ཿnga bzhi tuzi / gsum byang chub kya mas la gnad du ba/na pa dang /ba rdo gas ga'i/rderdem 'bar ba dmar cha 'a gnad shel du bsnun pa dang/chi ge ge rtse ye ge ge mu ge ge rdemibo zhe /nas bsam gto sngi 'dang ca gsal du ldang khug byad se mas nga ben sa khyab ba sa she/yang dang pa rdar bzlas/ba/ ma gsum mas/dban zhe/mtha' rdemasgyu she gsal rti med mu du snye ge mu de pa dang /yang sa she dngas lardepa 'is bsam/sab na da pa' bdag byan rlabs dang /sab na dang bcas(pa sna rmyas rdo rje srog rtsol/sna rdzos rdo rje'i lhag ma dang /nor bu rmed pa 84

'dzin pa/ dza lanta ra'i rim pa rjes dran/ bsam mi khyab kyi rim pa ting nge 'dzin te yan lag drug gi 'ching mdzad pa'ang yod do/ /dang po bum dbang gi lam du mdzad pa mi bde la gzhan thams cad ni rung bar mthong / phyi ma 'di dgaladon gyi dbang du cung zad dpyad par byar yod cing / de dag kyang rim pa lnga charagang zag cig gi cha rkyen du sdeb pa ste/ yang re re la 'bad de nus pa mthar phyud/nas spyod pas mtsham sbyar bas zung 'jug gi bar du 'grub pa yin te/ rim pa re re la rdo rje 'chang nyid sgrub par byed do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs parablam gong ma rnams bzhed pa ni/ de kho na ltar te/ lung rigs gnyis kyis grub pa'o/ /lnga char bsgom pa'i dbang du na/ go rim ni/ dang po gnyis ngag dag byed/de nas gnyis lus dag byed/ lnga pa sems dag byed do/ /des na rlung ma byangabar la rnam par rgyal ba mi thob/ de ma thob par thig le mi brtan/ de slabartan par gtum mo rang 'bar mi brtan/ de ma brtan par dngos su 'od gsalala'aju/ga mi thub pas snga mde dang de 'grub na phyi ma phyi ma rnams sgrub pa la dgros su 'ju ga nus pas rim pa lngar bstan pa'am/ sa bon dang bcas pa'i bdagabyin rlabs par rlung sems dbu ma'i nang snying khar ci rigs par 'dus nas/sa bon med pa'i bzlas pas rtsa mdud 'joms par byed/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i rimapas bum can gyi sbyor bas rtsa 'khor thams cad du g.yas g.yon srog thur stong par thim nas/ dbu ma'i thig le thim par byed/ nor bur 'gengs pa'i sngarakhams kā raga~X rnyi thi~X ༵la dpo~X ༵ hūṃ nas / chi ga phyag lhi dzhai spu ༵rdong gi —285—

gtum mo 'bar ba yin la/de brtan pa'i phyir gtum mo bsgom pa ni wora'adzin gyi rim pa ste de bsgom/des ye shes shin tu goms pas/phro su don gyi 'od gsal la 'jug pa'i phyir du bsam mi khyab bsgom ste go rim mo//rdzogs rim thams cad rlung dag par byed pa dang /sa ri le dag parazhe ge zhes pa /nga /sems dag par byed pa pa dang bzhing sa thig leng karang mang gnyas/ kyas rlung dag par ba mi/ga sdoX4pa dang ba ngas thag le dkar dmang dag par byed/lnga pa bsam khyab kyas sems dag par byed do//yang gnyis/su med mi khya ye shes kyi sku dngos su da tsho thi pa dang /de'i rgyu gnyis las/dang po ni bsam khyab bo/khyu la dngos rgyu ga le kā/ra dmar gyi ru mi pa 'gag kha(pas bha/na par byed pa dang /brgyud rgyu rlung ma snar byed pa na par beng ciXbapo la rngan le dkar po gsum yi kha the/ /dmar po ba pas brtan par byed /rlung la dang por zhugs gnas : sprong pa gsum byed pa dang/lam sbyang ba byin/brtan par byed sna gsum las/dang po sa bon dang bcas pas bdag brlabs pa/gnyas(pas sa bon med pa/gsum pa sna tshogs rdo rje'i risapa'o//de'i de ltar grangs nges pa'o//gsum pa ni/ji skad du/skyes pa tsargadi :ne :de sno ni/gyis mchog tu //dga' ba dang ldan 'gyur nga 〉//mngon par shes pa lnga cing ldan//mkha' la 'gro dang rdzu 'phrul 'i // sdung khyad ni ri du thosang //skye ba dran dang khams gsum pa//gnas kya sa— gas pa dang //'dakong ma 'ongs pa dang ni//da lta byung ba shes pa'o//rdzogs rim gyi ye shes bla ma'i drin las thob pas dgaX ba'i mchog lhan skyes kyi ye shes nges

par skye ba dang mig dang / rna ba dang sna dang lce dang lus dang yid kyi mngon shesate drug yod pa las/ drug pa ni/ skye ba dran pa dang gzhan sems shes pa sogasayin pa phyis bshad pas 'di lnga'o/ /'di dag lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi nus pas thob pas te/ dbang shes lnga char bde chen gyi ye shes su gyur pa na/ de la goms pas 'phral du lkog gyur gyi gzugs sogs thams cad shes pa'i mngon shes lnga 'byung ste/ ḍombi he ru ka'i lhan cig skyes grub lag dpa' bo bde chen grub pa yis/ /de nas bde ba can du 'gro/ /don chen bde ba la brten nas/ /rnam pa kun tu dgros grub dag /de la nye bar gnas par 'gyur/ /mngon par shes pa lnga yang 'byung / /de la rdo rje'i mig dang zhes sogasargyas bshad du drug char gsungs so/ /'di la thun mong ma yin pa'i mthon shesalnga zhes bya'o/ /nam mkhar 'gro ba sogs rig pa 'dzin pa'i lus dang/ rdzu'aphrul sna tshogs dang / mi snang ba dang / skye ba dran pa dang / khams gsum pa'i sems can gyi sems shes pa dang / dus gsum 'byung ba thams cad shes pa skelha'i mig dang rna ba'i mngon shes gnyis gong du bstan zin pa ste/ mngon shesathun mong ba lnga yang bstan no/ /bzhi pa ni/ bgrang 'phreng bzlas pa le dor med de/ /bsam gtan lha mchod yod ma yin/ /tshes grangs med cing ces pa med/ /sbyin sreg yang dag gnas pa med/ /klog dang 'don pa yod tshayin/ /zhes phyi rol gyi de dag med do/ /'on kyang 'di la de rnams tshang ste/ rtsagi bzlas pa dang / ye shes kyi mtshan rtogs las/ skyobs pa'i sngags dang/bde stong gi bsam gtan dang / rang shar du 'byung ba'i lhar snang dang yul snang—287—

thams cad mchod pa dang / rlung gis 'pho ba'i tshes grangs dang / rang bzhin nyes pas ma gos pa'i nges pa ste sdom pa dang / phung khams 'od gsal du bsregapas sbyin sreg dang / ji tsam smra ba thams cad sems can sgrol ba'i chos yinapas/ klog pa dang 'don pa'o/ /dgyes rdor las kyang / stong nyid snying rje dbyeramed pa/ /byang chub sems zhes rab tu brjod/ /sngags kyi bzlas brjod dka' thub me dang spyin sreg med/ /dkyil 'khor can yang med cing dkyil 'khor yangani med/ /de ni sngags bzlas de dka' thub dang de sbyin sreg /de ni dkyila'akhor can dang de ni dkyil ge ngor nyid/ /mdor bsdus na ni sems ni 'dusapa'i tshul can no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa'o/ /kun spyod sogs lasakyang 'byung ste/ phyi'i de dag dang nang gi de dag bya ba mi mtshungs shing/ ces nangalhag pa'o/ /lnga pa ni/ rang gi sbyor bas brtson pa sogs rgyu tshogs ji snyed pa yod kyang / rgyu rkyen gyi gtso bo rang gi de kho na nyid thob pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'o/ /ji skad du/ bla ma'i byin rlabs tsam gyis ni/ /skad ciganyid la 'byung gang yin/ /'khor lo sdom par sbas pa yi/ /byin rlabs rim parabashad par bya/ /spyir bla ma ni rnam pa gsum ste/ rgyu dang rkyen dang lhan cig byed pa'i bla ma'o/ khyu'i bla ma ni rang gi rgyud la skyes pas ye shes so/ /rkyen gyi glamani rig ma'o/ /lhan cig byed pa'i bla ma ni rdo rje slob dpon te/ gos bo ni 'di'o/ /drug pa ni/ 'di la lus kya dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing/zab mo bskyed pa'i rim pa la legs par goms pa dag rdzogs pa'i rim pa —288—

'dir 'jug par byed pa ni gzhung gi dngos bstan gyi rim pa yin zhing / gangazag gi bsam pa'i khyad par dang / skal pa'i dbye bas/ de sngon du ma song b.rayang rdzogs rim bsgom pa yod la/ rdzogs rim gyi sngon gyi ye shes 'pho ba'i byin rlabs byas pa na/ /ye shes phebs pa'i rtags 'phar g.yo byung na/ rim pa dang po nas thams cad la rim can du 'jug la/ 'dar skrug byung na rim pa gnyis pa nas dang / bde gsal byung na gsum pa dang / smra rgod byung na bzhi pa dang / stong gsal kyi nyams byung na/ lnga pa nas dkri bar bzhed do/ /kha cig de ltar mi 'thad de/ rim pa snga ma rnams kyi rtogs pa la mi gnas par/ phyi marnams kyi ye shes mtshan nyid tshang ba mi skye ba'i phyir ro snyam du bsam pa ni/legs par ma brtags pa yin te/ /dper na rtsa 'khore rnams su bum can slabartan par/ phyag rgya bsten du mi rung ba ma yin zhing / phyag rgya'i bde chen 'dren mi thub par gtum mo bsgom du mi rung ba yang ga la yin/ de rnams/de ltan/ snatshogs rdo rje'i rim pa ma brtan par nor bu 'gengs pa'i rim pa dang / nge zhi rimapa'i ye shes rgyud la ma skyes par/ dza lkan ra'i rim pa sgom du mi rung ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yod/ yang de dag rim can du bsgom pa yin du chug kyang/ 'di'i byin rlabs kyi skabs rtags so sor 'byung ba de rnams de yan chad kyi lam dngos sam de dang mthun pa dag skye ba snga mar goms pa'i rtags yin par bzhed pas/ de ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhig smra/ des na lung dang gas pas grub ༵༵/ ༵/ ༵ zlo/ rdo gsu~X ghri~X bci/ sdo~X yong ༵༵ rdo tshol ba 'bad der mdzad dzi/ —289—

rgyal ba sras bcas 'ba' zhig gi spyod yul lo//mkhas pa 'ga' zhig spyir byin rlabs kyi cho ga de ltar byed pa ma bkag kyang /'di'i byin rlabs kyi rim pa'i gzhung don ma yin zhes gsungs yang /gzhung nyid byin rlabs kyi cho gar gsawazhing /'di'i lugs srol 'dzin pa lo paṇa snga phyir byon pa thams cad kyi lugasal/'di'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga bstan pa nyag gcig bzhed par snang ba'i phyir/khyed kyi de ni dam bca' tsam zhig go /yang 'ga' thig gis man ngag tu/gzhung 'di'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga bstan zhing de'i nyams len du rnam par mi rtog pa'i lta ba skyong bar byed de//bla ma'i man ngag gi rgyun ma chad pa'i khungs zhinayod na ni de yang rung ngo //gnyis pa gzhung gi don la/bdag byin gyisabarlabs pa'i rim pa/sna tshogs rdo rje'i rim pa/nor bu'i 'gos/pa'i ri5pa/dza lanta ra'i rim pa/bsam mi khyab pa'i rim pa ste lnga las/dang po la sgra don dang /dbye bdang /'bras bu gsum mo//dang po ni/ dzee /mi shigs thig ler sogs te/ bdag ces bya ba snying kha'i mi shigs pa'i thig le ste/de nyid byin gyis rlabs pas/'od gsal 'char bar 'gyur bas/bdag byin gyisabarlabs pa zhes bya'o//gnyis pa ni/de la dbye na/sa bon dang bcas pa dang/sa bon med pa gnyis te/dang po ni/dmigs pa gzhi gcig tu nges pa dang /sabon gyi yi ge'am thig le ste/de ltar bsgom pa yod pas/sa bon dang bcas pa zhes bya ste/de yang snying kha'i mi shigs pa'i thig ler rtse gcig tu bsgo5pagarlung zhugs gnas thim gsum gyi ye shes skye ba'o//de la mi shigs pa'i thigaleni/mi shigs pa'i sems la 'jog pa yang yod de/dus 'khor 'grel chen du/90

'dir sems can thams cad kyi snying gi nang na gnas pa ni ye shes so/ /de yangagazhom du med pa'i sgra ste/ rtag tu nā da'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes rten thigalebarten pa sems dang bcas pa gnyis char bstan te/ 'di ni lus sems kyi 'brel ba zhes kyang bya/ khu rdul rlud gi tshogs pa'i bde bas byin gyis brlabasapa'i sems 'gyur bcas kyi rnam pa can te/ 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes mgatogs gzhan gyis 'jig par mi nus pas/ mi shigs pa'i thig le dang/ skye'achis mi rdzi zhing 'gyur ba ston pa las grol bas/ grol ba'i thig le zhes kyangabya ste/ 'di'i rten du gyur pa ni khams dkar dmar gyi dbus na tshe srog gorangabazhi/ rlung drod kyi ngo bo nye bar brten (〈rdza〉 rtse pa ) tsan ka'i 'bru 3 tsam gyi thig le snying ga'i dbus na gnas pa dpyid ces bya ba de yin te/ 'di yanga'achi ba'i tshe ma gtogs zhig mi thub cing / 'pho 'jug byed pa las grol ba dang /gong gi de'i rten yin pa'i phyir/ mi shigs pa dang grol ba'i thig le zhesabatags so/ /gzhung 'dir/ rtag tu snying la gnas pa yi/ /thig les khrin/pu 'gyur med de/ /de sgom byed pa'i skye bo la/ /nges par ye shes skye bar 'gyur/zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis/ pa ni/ dbugs 'byu/nga 'ju/ga gnas gsum sna tsho go/sal dmigasadzhapas/ dmig/sa yul gzhi mi brtan pa dang/ thig le'am yig 'bru/'i gzugasamidamigs pas/ sa bon med pa ste/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa byed pa'o/ /'di gnyis char la bogs 'don gyi tshul du dbang po'i sgor 'gro ba yin no/ /gsum pa ni/ sabon dang bcas pa'i skabs/ dang por thig le mthong ba bstan pa ste/ tswasasu—291—

mthong ba lta bu'i mtshan ma 'byung / de nas snying khar bde ba rang byung du 'byung/de nas lus thams cad la khyab pa'i bde ba 'byung / de nas bde ba de la yongasasu 'dzin pa rang sar sangs te/ bde stong gnyis su med pa phyag rgya chen poskyebar 'gyur ro/ /rtags bzhi po 'di brtan mi brtan dang / rgya che chung gi khyad par ma gtogs/ 'og ma rnams la yang 'dra'o/ /dang por bde ba skye ba'i gnas kyang 'dis bsgres te shes par bya'o/ /rtsa ba'i dmigs pa brtan nas thig le rnamasadabang po'i sgor spros pas/ dbang shes rgyu ba'i rlud rnams las su rung ste/ yulagyi rkyen gyis bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin skye bar byed do/ /'di dag la ba tshe nasarlung de rnams nang du bzlog par 'gyur bas/ 'jug shes drug thig le la 'chingabar gsungs pa'i gzhung don du nges par 'gyur zhing / de dag tu thig lo bsgomazhes bya ba'i tshig gis ma zin pa yang ma yin te/ yid snying khar bzhag nasaganas pa na thig le'i gzugs su 'gyur ro/ /zhes yid shes kyi de snying kharathig le'i gzugs su bsgom par gsungs pa/ mtha'i gsal byed yin pasaso/ /gal te gzhung tshig gis dngos su ma zin kyang / khog don la drang ba ni shin tu mang ba zhig yod pas/ gzhung tshig gi don tsam yin min gyi dpyad pa tsam la snying po mi snang ngo / /yang gzhung las/ rtag tu snying la sogs kyi rjesabar ma chad par 'di'i don brjod par bya ste/ mig dang rna ba dang sna dang lce dang / pags pa'i phyogags la gnas pa'i shes pa rnams kyi kun gzhi rnam parashes pa'i rang bzhin gyi sems la rnam par shes pa lnga po de dag yang dag pa bzhag cing mi g.yo bar byas nas/ yid snying khar bzhag nas gnas pa ni thig—292—

le'i gzugs su 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa la/ kha cig 'di'i 'thad kyi'agos 'gyur las shes pa rnams ni kun gzhi rnam par shes pa'i rang bzhin gyi sems kyis bsdus pa ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltar bshad dgos te/ kun gzhi rnam shes yang drug pa yid kyi rnam shes yin zhes zer ro/ /'di'i 'gos 'gyur ni sngam yin pa las/ phyis nag 'tsho'i 'gyur sogs snga phyi'i lugs thams cad labartags te/ rngog 'gyur gyi tshig dag pa byas te gtan la phab pa yin pasatshogs brgyad kyi kun gzhi rang gi grub mtha' la mi 'dod pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'gyur ma dag pa la 'dam dgos byung bar snang ngo / /'gos 'gyur ltar na yang/tshogs brgyad kyi kun gzhir shin tu gsal te/ drug pa yid kyis dbang shes lnga bsdus pa'i rgyu mtshan gang gi lugs la yang 'thad ldan med cing / kun bzhi 'dod pa'i lugs ltar na de rnams kun gzhis bsdus pa yin te/ laṅkaragade/gas pa las/ de bzhin kun gzhi'i chu bo yang / /rtag tu yul gyi rkyen gyis 'byung / /rnam shes rba rlabs sna tshogs kyis/ rab tu g.yo ba'i gar byed do/ /zhes chu dang rlabs kyi dpes bstan te/ rlabs chus bsdus pa bzhin no/ /yangarnam shes drug 'das ma thag pa'i yid dbang 'dir 'dod na 'das pa'i chos thig ler bsgom par song bas/ spyi dang 'gal bar lo zad 'das pa la sbyangasagazhi sogs mi rung ba'i rgyu mtshan lung rigs mang por rang gis sgrub pa dang yang 'gal lo/ /gzhan yang rnam shes tshogs drug las/ gzhan mib ched pa'ilugs la stong pa nyid la kun gzhir gsungs pa mang gi drug pa'i yid la kun gzhir bzhed pa tshad ldan ni shin tu nyung ngo / /gzhan yang grub chen rdo rje dril bu —293—

pa kun gzhi mi bzhed pa'i rgyu mtshan zhig 'chad rgyu yod na de ltar smra ba bden yang / 'phags pa yin pa'i thal 'gyu ra ba yin no/ /zhes pa las gzhan rgyuḍimatshan 'god rgyu med la/ de ni rgyu mtshan rnam dag ma yin te/ de ltar na 'phags pa thogs med dang / mthong ba'i chos la mya ngan las 'das pa'i/ slob dpon mar me mdzad bzang po sogs kyang rgyu mtshan de'i phyir/ de dag gis mdzad pa'i gzhung thams cad thal 'gyur ba'i lugs su 'dren dgos par 'gyur rdo /gzhan yang kun gzhi rnam shes kyi gzher ra bzhin sems zhes pa yang sems yid rnam shes gsum gyi sems kun gzhi la 'jog pa'i lugs su gsal lo/ /de gsum tha dad du 'jog pa shin tu mang ste/ sgra don yang 'di nyid kho na legs pa yin no/ /theg pa chen po bsdus pa las kyang / kha cig 'di snyam du sems dngayid dang rnam par shes pa zhes pa ni don gcig kho na ste/ 'dir tshig 'bruthadad do snyam pa de yang mi 'thad de/ yid dang rnam par shes pa gnyis don thad da par dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i phyir sems kyang tha dad do zhes gsungs shing/theg pa chen po'i chos mngon par kun gzhi la sems dang / nyon yid la yid dang tshogs drug la rnam shes su bshad pa ni/ nges par gzung bar bya ske tsitta zhes pa bag chas/sa sogs pa'i gzhi yin pa dang / ma na zhes pa nga rgyal 'jug pa'i don dang / bidzñā na zhes pa yul rnams so sor rnam par rig cing shes pa'i don yin pas so/ /de la kun gzhi rnams ni/ sems kyi steng du zag bcas zagamed kyi chos thams cad kyi bag chags bgo ba'i gzhir gyur pa ste/ ldog pasaphyen/ sa bon gyi cha dang / rnam smin gyi cha dang / zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi —294—
