cha'o/ /dang po la nyon sgrib dang / shes sgrib kyi sa bon gyi cha gnyis te/ de gnyisarim pas dgra bcom pa'am sangs rgyas kyi sa nas ldog go /gnyis pa la shes sgrib kyi rnam smin gyi cha med pas/ nyon mongs kyisakun nas bslang ba'i rnam smin kyi cha ste/ de'i phyir sems tsam pas lhag med myang 'das su yang ldog par 'dod kyang / 'dir sangs rgyas kyi sa 'ba' zhinatuldog ces bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ 'khor 'das kyi gnas skabs thams cad du/thobo la khyad par med par 'jug pa/ bde gshegs snying po dang / dang po'i sangasargyas dang / rgyu'i rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / yongs gcod du grub pa'i chos ni dang/de bzhin nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' dang / gnas skabs kyi don dmabaden pa dang / gzhi dus kyi gnyis med kyi ye shes zhes bya ba rnams 'di khona'o/ /des na bde gshegs snying po med dgag tu 'dod pa rgyud bla ma'i dgongasapar smra ba rnams ni/ /rigs khams sbrang rtsi dang 'dra 'di gzigs nas/ zhes pa dang / lus can la yod zag pa med pa'i shes pa sbrang rtsi dang 'dra/ zhes gsungs pas/ dngos su bkag pa yin no/ /nyon mongs pa can gyi yid ni/ kun gzhi ladamigs nas bdag tu 'dogs pa ste/ ji skad du/ ma rig pa dang bdakaltadang / /nga 'o nga rgyal sred 'di bzhis/ /kun nas nyon mongs can 'gyurayid/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ bdag med par mi shes pa'i bdag tu rma pa༅pa dang / bdag tu 'dzin par byed pa'i bdag tu lta ba dang / de la dza'o snyam pa'i sems 'jug pa dang / bdag tu rgyal ba dang de la 'dzin pa dam po'i shugasakyis zhen zhing chags pa ni/ bdag la chags pa ste/ ngar 'dzin bzhi'i rang—295—

bzhin can nam 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /dbang shes lnga ni/ phyi'i yul rnamasamathong ba tsam las/ tha dad du sgro 'dogs pa'i las can ma yin la/de rnamasadang rnam rtog rnams kyi yul la dmigs nas sgro 'dogs pa'i las can ni/ yid kyi rnam shes kho na ste/ des na 'di la yid rtog ces kyang bshad do/ /des na kun gzhi'i snang ba khams gsum du snang ba la/ nyon yid kyis nang du kun gzhi la dmigs nas bdag tu sgro btags/ yid shes kyis phyi rol tu sgro btags pas/ gnyis snang rags pas 'khrul pa 'di 'byung ngo / /zhes de nyid zig pa dag 'dom par mdzad do/ /de ltar na yid phra ma mkhan dang 'dra bas 'khru9rgyu byas pa'i mtshang 'jig par byed pa ni sems kyi rang zhal lta ba'i man ngag kho na lags te/ rjes su dpag pa tsam gyis ni phyogs tsam yang ma yin no/ /kun gzhi med na yid kyi rnam shes kyis nyin mtshan mtshams sbyor ba sogs kyang mi nus te/theg bsdus las/ rnam par shes pa yang ma'i mngal du nur nur po nyid brgyawalo/ /zhes pa dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa brgyal ba de ni yid kyi rnam parashes pa nyid du mi rigs te/ dus rtag tu nyon mongs pa can gyi gnas yin pa dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i dmigs pa la mi dmigs pa'i phyir rdo /zhesasogs rgyas par gsungs pa'i don gyi snying po ni/ lha spyin ma shi bar de'i b.rasrid mngal du 'ju/ga pa ni mi srid la/ shi ba na yid shes ma 'gags pa yangamisrid pas/ bar do len pa po med par 'gyur ba dang / mngal du zhugs/mthagagi shes pa de yang yid shes ma yin te/ yid kyi dbang po la ma brten pas de'i dmigs pa la mi dmigs pa'i phyir/ zhes pa'i don yin zhing / kunas zhi med —296—

par 'dod pa rnams kyis kyang /kha tan dang /mar medang/gzugs brnyan lasogs pa'i dper rten cing 'brel ཿnga tsam gyi sgo nas 'jog ce na/de ni yin 0ri ge ge ge ge ge 9ri myur / ji/ pho gra spra(/tre ste pab/rderdemod kyang /des de 'a za ༷/sa yan zhang kun gzha ma na pa rgyu mtshan lakyang phan rnyi med la/ she pa snga ma la yang gnod byed 'thad ldan ston rgyu med do//'o na da pa 'pho ba 'a mdo rgyal po la gdams par/rgyal po wo po de larnam par shes pa tha ma 'gags pa gang yin pa de ni 'chi 'pho ba zhes bya/gangardernam par shes pa dang po ཿnga ba de ni skye ba zhes bya'o//rgyal po wo po rnam par shes pa mtha' ma 'gags pa'i tshe yang gang du yang mi 'gro'o/rde/rnam par shes pa dang po skyes pa'i char rtogs pa 'byung ba'i tshe/gang nas mi 'ong zhes dang/khadon mar me tshe lo~X rgya//me shel sa bon skyur dang sgras//phung po rkyang pa lnga/sa5sbyor ba dag / 'pho bar yang mkhas rtogs bya//zhes bsha/da pa ltang drangs she na/kho bo cag yang 'chi mkhan de nyid skye ba len par mi 'dod de/'dus byas 'a cad skad cig du'ang mi gnas pas ༵//'on kyang rgyun ༵ chad pa snga ma las phya ma 'byung la/de der 'pho ba yang ma na pa dpe rnams don dang /'gro 'ong med pa'i don kyang de yin no//dang po ཿnga zhes pa yang skye srid dang bar srid de la ltos pa'o//des na dbu ma'i zab don 'chi rdo pa na yang/'chad da~X 'ad 'dod chags bral//nyams 'a 'a 'pho skye ba rnams//da kya rnam shes kho nar 'dod//ces don smra ba 'a lugs me dzan pa ma sgo kyi gzhung 'a pa 'a~Xd la bshad na yid kyi rngam//skabs 'gal na ge nyordorngog 'gyu/ra ltar na na/kun gzha da ༷ bshad na da rnam shes lan —

su zlos par yang 'gyur la/ des na rang lugs ni gong du bshad pa'i (〈lirgo mi shigs pa'i ) thig le shes pa'i cha de ni/ kun gzhi rnam shes nyid yin la/de'i rten thig le la yang kun gzhi rnam shes btags pa ste/ des na kun bzhi rnam shes kyi rang bzhin te rten du gyur pa'i thig le byang chub kyi sems dang /dbang shes lnga'i bzhon par gyur pa'i rlung rnams bzhag pa te thim par gyur pa'i phyir du rang rang gi gnas su thig le 'god pa la sems 'jog la/ yid shesal spyir gnas pa'i nges pa med pas / gang du 'god pa gsal bar ston dgosapa gzigs pas yid snying khar bzhag nas zhes snying kha'i sngar gyi thig le'i gnas su 'god pa bstan to/ /'o na 'di'i don brjod par bya ste/ zhes snying kha'i thig le'i rgyas bshad yin pas mig sogs su 'god par mi rigs snyam na/ mi'agal te/ de thams cad snying kha'i thig le la brtan nas bya ba byed pa can yin pa'i phyir/ 'bras bu chos sku'i rgyas bshad du sku gsung thugs 'phrin las dngabacas pa bshad pa yin no/ /gzhan yang rdo rje'i bzlas pa'i phan yon ni rgyasapar gong ltar te/ 'dir yang ji skad du/ blo yi gzhir rang khyim du khyer ro lkogartsa ba'i rdor bzlas gyis rma sems dbu mar 'jug pa dang / dbang po'i sgornams nas yan lag gi rlud la rdor bzlas byas pas mngon shes lnga 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /des na de dag tu dbang po drug sogs sna tshogs la gnad du bsnun tshul byung yang / gtso bo snying kha la bsgom pa dang / de nas rgyu zhing 'byung ba'i gzung 'dzin gyi rlung rnams la gnad du bsnun pas te/ des na snying kha'o/ /gnyis pa la/ sgra don/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ 'bras bu bzhi lag dang po ni/—298—

dmigs pa'i rnam pa sna tshogs la brten pa'o/ /rdo rje ni 'dir rlung gnyisamiphyed par byed pa ste/ de yang gnas sna tshogs su 'ching bas sna tshogs rdo rje'i rim pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni bum can gyi sbyor bas dhwa ti'i nang du thig ler rluda'aching ba'i rim pa'o/ /gsum pa la/ sa bon dngo bcas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i rim pa/ rnam pa sna tshogs rdo rje'i rim pa/ sa bon med pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i rim pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhung gi dngos bstan las kyi phyag rgya la brten paragasal la/ gang ltar na'ang / nor bu'i thig le la brten nas dbu mo'i mas snar rlud sems sdud pa ste/ der zhugs gnas thim gsum byed pa sho /gnyis pa ni/ dbang po'i sgo rnams su spros te/ bum pa can gyi sbyor bas de rnamasasurlung sems brtan par byed pa dang / rtsa 'khor lo bzhin srog thur brtan pa'i phyir/ de dag tu bum pa can gyi sbyor ba 'ching ba rnam pa sna tshogs rdo rje'i rislapa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ dbu ma'i yas sna smin mtshams kyi 'khor lo ro rkyang dbu wagasum gyi rlud 'du/sa pa'i thig le la sems bzhag pas/ dbu ma'i yas sna smin mtshams kyi 'khore lor rlud sems 'dus te zhugs gnas thim gsum byas pa las/ byang chub kyi sems dbyangs bcu drug gi rnam pas dpral par gnas pasathig le rnams rgyas par 'gyur ba yin no/ /'dir sa bon yod med ni/ yi goyod med la 'chad pa ltar yin la/ rnam pa sna tshogs rdo rje'i rim pa ni sa bon dang bcas pa'i yan lag yin par shes par bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ sa bon dngabacas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i rim pas byang chub kyi sems nor bur 'ching ba'i mthu thob par 'gyur te/ gang du sems gnas pa der rlung yang thim par 'gyur—299—

te/ der byang chub kyi sems zhu nas gzhan du mi 'pho bar yun ring du gnas par 'gyur te/ thig le'i 'pho byed kyi rlud thim pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis yin no/ /dbangapo lngar spros pas ni/ rim pa dang po'i skabs las tshes lhag pa'i lha'i riganasalus kyi mngon shes kyi bar du 'byung ste/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes 'ba' chigagis drangs pa'i mngon par shes pa lnga ni/ 'dis cungu zad thob pa ma yin te/'di ni rlung sbyor dang dmigs pa'i khyad par gyis thob—pa yin zhing / bde bsadrangs pa'i mngon shes lnga ni/ bde chen gyi ye shes 'ba' zhig gi nus pas thob pa yin la/ dmigs pa'i khyad par gyis thob pa las ces rgya che zhing myur ba yin no/ /pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa ni/ de skad du mdo sde gyon lag bas sogatan bzhi pa shin tu dag thob nas/ /mi rtog ye shes yongs su gzung ba dang/ /dziltar rnam gnas yid la byed pa las/ /mthu sgrub pa yi dam pa thob para'agyur/ /zhes bsam gtan gyi sems la brten te rnam gnas yid la byed pa las/ mngon shes lnga sgrub pa yin la/ 'dir ni dmigs pa'i khyad par dedagagis rtsa rlud thig le 'phral du dag par 'gyur zhing / de las mngon shes 'byungab yin te/ rnam smin gyi khyad par ni/ mkha' lding gi rgyal po'i mig bzhin no/ /sems kyi rten chags bral byed pa la sogs pas/ sa 'pho ba ni dgos pa ma yin zhing / de la brten pa ni sgrub pa dka' la/ 'di ni shin tu myur ba yin te/lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i khyad par gyis rnam smin 'dod dgur bsgyur ba ni theg pa 'di'i khyad chos so/ /mdo las sa thob nas dbang po lnga rnams gzhan du 'gyur te/ de'i dbang shes lnga po de dag re re bzhin don lnga char la shes pa —300—

'jug ste/ de yang dus gsum char la tshad med par 'jug go /de dag ni sgrib gnyis dag pa'i sems kyi rang snang las snang ba yin gyi/ dmigs pa'i khyad kyis sgrub pa ma yin pa bzhin du 'di'i bde chen gis drangs pa'i mngon shes kyang ngo / /'di ni so so'i skye bo'i lam du yang 'grub ste/ rdzogs rim gyi drod thob nas mthong lam ma thob bar du ci rigs pa thob pa'i thog ma'ang / 'thoralo bzhir rlung thog mar thim pa'i nus pa mthar phyung ba las/ spyi bos ni sangasargyas rnams kyi sprul pa'i sku thams cad mthong ba dang / mgrin pas ni bstan chos byung ba dang ma byung ba thams cad shes shing / sems kyi bsam pa dang mthun pas chos ston nus pa dang / snying khas ni gzung 'dzin gyi mngon shes drugabla lhag tu thob pa dang / lte bas ni lha mchog rnams kyi bu mo sogs mi ma yin gyi bud med mthu dang rdzu 'phrul che ba thams cad kyi bdag po rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /sa bon med pas ni dbu ma'i yas snar rlung sems thim pa de'i rgyusngams brtan gyi lhan skyes yun ring du gnas pa dang / zhu bar bya ba byang chub kyi sems rgyas pas bde ba shas che bar 'gyur ba yin no/ /gsum pa la/ sgra don/ ngo bo/ /dbye ba/ 'bras bu bzhi las/ dang po ni/'di la byang chub kyi sems brtan par byed pa'i phyir/ mas brtan te bsgom pa yod kyang / gtso bor yas brtan bsgrub pa yin pas de'i gtso bo lhan cig skyesapa ni nor bur 'char ba yin pa'i phyir/ byang chub kyi sems kyi nor bu 'gongasapar byed pa'i sgom rim yin pas na nor bu 'gongs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni phyagargya'i lam 'khor dang bcas pa ste/ spyir phyag rgya bzhir rdzogs rim thams cad —301—

'du yang / 'di'i phyag rgya bzhir ni mi 'du ste/ 'di ni las kyi la5zhanarabacas las phye ba'i phyag rgya bzhi yin pas so/ /gsum pa ni/ sngon 'gro yid kyis sgom pas phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyorab dam tshig gi phyag rgya ste/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang / dngos kyi phyag rgya'am/ las kyi phyag rgya de ngos dang / bde bas snang ba thams cad la rgyas btab pa ga snangab rnams bde rṣa 'bar ba'i grogs su gyur pa chos kyi phyag rgya dang / bde stongagi ye shes nyid la brten nas zhu bde'i bde ba chen po 'dren pa rnam med phyag chen ni/ phyag rgya chen po ste/ grub chen dza ladha ra'i do ha lag bya ba med parabazhag pan/ /bde ba las ni bde ba 'gyung / /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ de ltar phyag rgya bzhi la brten nas 'khor lo bzhi byang chub kyi sems kyis gang bas dga' bzhi lugs 'byung lugs ldog bsgom pa'o/ /gsum pa'i man ngagatulas rgya'i bde ba thun mtshams thams cad du skye 'bri mi byed pa zhig sgrub dgos pas/ de'i mtshams sbyor du gtum mo'am gsang ba thig le bsgom pa sogs gang ltar byas kyang rung ngo / /gu ru nirsā ṇa shrī'i zhal snga nas/ dam kyi rgyalas phyagagyodang / /gnyis pa lag pa'i phyag rgya dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa gong bzhin bzhed do/ /bzhi pa ni/ gong du rim bzhi'i skabs su shes par bya go /pu ros/lo chung gi rang lugs 'dzin pa rnams rim pa 'di dngos gzhir bzhed sgo /bzhipa la sgra don sogs gong ltar bzhi las/ sgra don ni sna tshogs su 'chad para'abyung yang / lte ba dang chu so'i mtshams te/ lte 'og sor bzhi'i dzinas ni gtso/mo 'bar ba'i me tshang yin pa'am/ gtum mo 'bar ba la brten nas bde ba tshen —302—

po ra sdes/(re / bang chabaskya~X'am/dza she ra ni rtsa rnams thams rdad pa yisapa' de'i spya bas byang chub kya 'a bce/ ma ༷bar 'di zhu ni byad pa na brte/ rdzo/ par sa//tshe / rim rim lusalaban nas gtum ma rnyir das bde~Xkhyad na khya par can ta/ ma lnga rdo ༵༵rde shesardespya/she lus ga la ban spyas byā ljid ༷ra she grub nas/ sahūṃ bags 'dan du rna~X stir gya gtum ma ba ga 5 ba'i na pa spe//'a pa kyi/gtso/zi 'a ༵ bsgrub ༷ 'a she /'bar kyu'i me ༵ mu we ba'i blda/kaupa ༵/mi' she byad kyā gtso / spros phyis nye ba'i na gya/she a shad ma mu sde ge//kau kyang 'ad she she ba~X.a shad kyang ḍi~Xgyi skabarab na 'gyu/ra/ ma pa gzhan rnams sngan sang ma na na/sngags skabasabazhi shes par bya ba yin no//'di ni tshas pa'i me'i gnas su dmigs pa je do 0ri bi grwa pe yirigatad pas ra sngigs gnas ra rdzo gsum sngim pa she ༷ra /na gya hro 'gags she/she su ka6pa ma mu she bar she ma// shebalas/sti/ la de gsum dkar dmar na/snag 'gag dpal ldan rnga son mi pa ni / sati'i///skad ga la 'bar bar 'gyu/ra/chi/na gshegs pa sna// pa she/4hū ཾ da nang du 'dzo 'di dzag go pu / snye sdod pa nghru/de ba ye she pa' rgyud mu 'gra rnyisnrad she /she ltaXbasgam te spya lto gi dngas su 'dzo rim rdzo/ma pa gang ma rnams sngan sni rjo sa pa'i 1 rkyang sna/ra 'byog ga she pa dar bar bya 'a/lhag ma sngags kya bde / ska~Xs ba du ga baX byaXtshe//dis na tshangs pa' me 'bar ba las zhu ba / na da pa yang dag pa thab /rlungarde

rnams rtsa'i 'khor lo la thim pa brtan pa dang / gtum mo 'bar ba yang brtan par gyur nas/ steng du 'bar zhing bde ba chen po 'dzin pa'i rim pa kho /bzhi pa ni/ gtso/ mo 'bar ba'i rtags 'bar snang dngos su 'byung ba dang/ ltebara'abar 'dzag gi thig le brtan pas/ dkar zhing phra la 'jam pa me long go ngosaltar 'byung ba dang / snying khar brtan pas dpung pa rgyas shing sred med kyi bre'istobs su 'gyur ba dang / mgrin par brtan pas lces gdong khebs pa dang/ spyi bor brtan pas rdzu 'phrul gyis kun tu 'gro ba dang / mngon shes lnga po snga warnams las kyang tshes lhag par thob pa yin no/ /lnga pa la/ sgra don/ ngo bo/ /dbye ba/ thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor/ 'bras bu ga lnga las/ dang po ni/ rnam parartog pa'i bsam pa'i yul las 'das pas bsam mi khyab bo/ /gnyis pa ni/sems kyi rang bzhin spros pa thams cad dang bral ba/ spros pa'i rnam pasamabacos pa sgom pa ste/ de ltar yang gzhung las/ gzung 'dzin dang ni bral bsan/ /dmigs pa kun dang bral ba'i sems/ /bsam du med pa'i rang bzhin phyir/ /ci yang bsam par mi bya'o/ /zhes dang / stong dang stong min la sogasal/ /kun rtog rags spangs mkha' mnyam 'gyu/ra/ /zhes dmigs gtad thamasartacad dang bral ba gang du yang mi 'dzin zhing / ci ltar snang yang rang bzhin sprosabral 'od gsal ba dang / gdod nas skyeb med par mthong ba'o/ /won kyangaspros bral de'i snang ba ched du ma bcos kyang / dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du snang ba yin no/ /'o na snod bcud bsdu ba dang / de las lha skur bskyed pa sogasami'athad de/ sems kyi rang bzhin spros pa dang bral ba de la ma bcos par le rdog—304—

dgos pas so snyam na/ spyir bsam mi khyab kyi rim pa la de dag bsgom dgosapa'i nges pa med kyang / las dang po pas bsam mi khyab thob pa'i phyir de ltarabasgom pa dang / phyis rnal 'byor gom pas 'od gsal dang sgyu lus kyi bas5mikhyab mthar phyin pa'i phyir du rlung dang khams rnams sdud dgos pas de ltar bsgom pa yin la de yang bsam mi khyab ma yin par mi 'gyur te/ ji ltar ba blo kha kyang gong du bshad pa'i mtshan nyid de las mi 'da' ba'i phyir te/ sdud par snangab rang shar gyi tshul du byung ba la bzo bcos med pa dang lha skur rang shar du snang ba la'ang bzo bcos med par skyong ba'i phyir ro/ /gal te rim pa lnga pa'i rtogasapa bskyes pa'i tshe na ni de dag dngos su 'byung ba yin pas/ de la rnam par rtogapa'i 'bad rtsol yang ga la dgos/ kha cig shes pa bzo med du 'jog pa dang /bza' gtad dang bral ba zhes bya ba'i tshig tsam yang mkhas pa dag mi bzhed de/bod sgom blun po rnams kyis byas pa'o/ /zhes zer ba ni mkhas pa rnam ces pa'i don 'chad pa la/ bab col blos mi khyud pa yin zer zhing / rang nyid bab col rngam po che rtag tu byed par snang ste/ rje btsun byams pas/ de ni rgyal po bzo med par/ /bshad pa dag ni kun tu 'byung / /zhes pa dang/ grub chen sarahas/ bde chen bza' gtad bral ba'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag gyur na/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rgyal tshab byams pa dang / grub chen sa ra ha yang bod sgom blun po yin zhes zer ram ci/ yongs ye don ma 'khrul bar ston mi ston las/ tshigagi brda la ni kho bo cag don la rton pa rnams gtso bor mi byed de/ yul gyi sgra yi don rnyed pa/ /de la bstan chos sgra yi ci/ /zhes pa dang / dus 'bor bsdus pa'i —305—

rgyud las kyang / dam pa'i byams ldan rmongs pa'i tshig las mchog gi bde babaskyed cing 'jig rten pa de la rjes su chags/ zhes dang / 'grel chen dri med 'od las kyang / /yul gyi skad dang zur chags sgra las kyang / /lte rnal 'byar ldan pas don ni 'dzin byed de/ /chu la 'o ma nges par zhugs pa dang / /nga pa pas rosatu phyung nas 'thung bar byed/ /don dam de nyid yul la rtag tu ni/ /chen pornams ni tshig la ston pa min/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rtsom na blun po'i grong tshigabargyud mar rtsom/ /zhes rnal 'byor lhur len pa'i gang zag rnams la bskur ba 'debs pa ni/ rang nyid lasang na gyi khur chen po khur ba tsam go /gzhan yangarang gis dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i rigs pas phu thag chod pa dgos zhes dang /ga ge mo zhig de'i lag rjes yin zhes sogs yang yang bskyar zlos byed pa'i tshig mang po zhig yul skad grong tshig gis byas nas/ gzhan la zur za ba yid mimakhas pa'i rnam thar kho na yin te/ sa yi dngos gzhi las/ mtha' ske yis dngagrong khyer ngan pa'i skad kyi chos mi smra bar gsungs pas so snyams na/ 'o na khyed dag mtha' 'khob yul 'khor ngan pa bod kyi skad kyis mi smra na/ gzhan gdazhig gis smra/ des na khyed kyi zur za'i tshig de dag ni/ rang chags sdang phragadog ma rungs pa can yin pa dang / dam pa'i khyu nas bud pa tsam mtshon pa tshagatogs snying po ni cung zad kyang med do/ /gsum pa ni/ rjes gzhin ni rimapas 'jug pa sems stong pa nyid la 'jug pa dang / de las lha skur ldang ba'i stong pa nyid sems su zhugs pa gnyis te/ dang po la/ dpe'i ye shes mtharathug sgrub byed dang / don gyi ye shes sgrub byed gnyis/ gnyis pa ni/ snang phyogs —306—

rdzogs rim ste/ de la ma dag pa'i ye shes kyi sku dang / gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku dag pa'i sgyu lus kyi dbye bas gnyis te/ de dag ni/ ri5pa bzhi sngon du song ba ste/ rim pa lnga pa'i bsam mi khyab kyi dbye ba'o/ /spyir de bzhi dang / thun mong gi bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor dang / de'i rgyur snod bcud 'od gsal du ldang 'jug byed pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang / thun mtshams kyi rnala'abyor te/ de ltar na bsam mi khyab kyi rim pa bdun no/ /bzhi pa nyi shing dngatsher ma lcug ma sogs/ khams gsum rgyu dang mi rgyur bcas/ /de kun bdag gi de nyid dang / /rjes su mthun pas mdor bsgom byed/ /ces gas pas te/ sprosapa thams cad dang bral ba'i ye shes dang / bde stong gnyis su med pa bdaganyid kyis bsgo me pa'i de kho na nyid gang yin pa de/ ji ltar snang ba 'di thamasacad dang dbyer med par bsgom ste/ des bogs 'byin par byed sgo /gzhuda'adis ni spyod pa yang don gyis 'phangs pa yin no/ /lnga pa ni/ rim pa lnga pa'i bsam mi khyab pa'i ye shes dang / ma dag pa'i sku gnyis thob pa la ni nges paralas rgya la ltos shing / spyod pa 'di ni byed mi byed gnyas ka la yod do/ /don gyi ye shes dang dag pa'i sku 'khru/ba pa ni spyod pa la nges par ltos la/ las gyolaltos pa'i nges pa ni med do/ /gang ltar yang mthar phyin byed de dag byung bgadangos 'bras ni de dang de dag yin la/ /gtso bo ni brgyud pa'i 'bras bu ste/ /gal te kun tu rab rtogs na/ /'gro ba spyod pa 'jig par 'gyur/ /zhesadang / des na rang byung rang nyid ni/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas zhes brjod pa yin/ /mtha' bzhi las ni rnam grol ba/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas rang bzhin —307—

te//sgom pa de ni ring po nyid//mi thogs rdo rje sems dpar 'gyur//zhesagasungs te/ye shes rtogs na blang dor dang bral ba'i don rtogs par gyur ba dang /rang byung gi sems rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ba mtha' bzhi las rnam paragrol ba/dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes kyi rigs su gyur zhing ngo bo rnam dbyer med pas na/sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin te/gser rdo gser gyi rang bzhin can no//zhes pa ltar ro//des na rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa skelam bsgom pa'i rkyen gyis shes bya'i yul yongs su rdzogs pa la/sgrib g.yogs bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sangs zhing /ye shes kyi 'jug pa dang blo gros kyi snang ba rgyas pa ni glo bur rnam dag ste/dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos sku dang /rdo rje sems dpa' ni gzugs kyi sku ste/de ltar na kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i sku de gnyis 'grub pa yin no//des na gang dag bde mchog dang 'a 'dus pa' rim lnga dang /sems 'grel ba'i sbyor drug lta bu rdzogs rim zab moyin gyi/'bras bu'i rnam gzhag ma bstan pas/lam 'bras bur bcas(pa'i thasnyad med do zhes zer ba ni/legs par ma bslab bzhin du kha tshon gcod sngasapa yin te/tha snyad ni brjod 'dod la rag las shing /ming de tsam gyis kho bo cag mchog tu tshim pa thob pa yang med la/don la 'bras bu med pa'i rdzogasarim rnam dag de 'dra ga la srid/'on kyang gzhung du ma bshad pas so snyam na/'dir 'bras bu sku gnyis dang /rdo rje 'chang 'grub tshul yang yang byung zhing/gsang 'a 'dus ram lngar yang /rim pa dang lnga sogs su 'bras bu 'grub tshul/mang du bshad cing /spyod bsdus las kyang rgyas par 'byung ba dang/sems08

'grel pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug gi gzhung de tsam/ rtsa ba'i gzhung ni rgyud rnamasayin pas/ 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag ces zhib cing gtan la 'bebs pa'i dusakyi'akhor lo'i rgyud las 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag ma bstan zhes sam de'i gzhung phran 'ga' zhig las ma bsha/da pas so/ /zhes pa las/ gzhan smra rgyu med la/ 'di las snying po med pa'i gtam ci zhig smra/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yan lag gi skabasasās bcu gnyis la sogs pa bgrod tshul ni de'i yi ge phal cher las 'byung la/lam skor las nyams kyi rnam gzhag mang mod kyi/ 'bras bu nyid kyi rnam gzhagani lam skor las kyang 'di dag rgyas na/ cha med pa'i rgyus gtam ma sgrogacigamachog tu gyur pa'i lam/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa/ grub pa rnams kyi wan bkadus gsum du 'gro ba mtha' yas pa sgrol bar byed pa'i lam 'di dag la/ gusapa lhod par 'gyur ba'i gtam de lta bu smra ba ni bdud kyi 'jug pa ste/ gtamadebor la mchog tu gus pa bskyed par bya'o/ /gsum pa 'bras bu bla na med pa'i ye shes mngon du 'gyur tshul la/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag dang /mthar thug gi 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag go /dang po la/ 'bras bu'i nye rgyu thun mongam yin pa dang / 'bras bu'i ngo bo rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin stsogad pa'o/ /dngapo ni/ 'di sgrub sogs te/ 'di zhes bya ba'i tshig ni/ bshad mthag pa'i dpe don gyi ye shes dang / dag pa dang ma dag pa'i sku ste bzhi po 'di zho /dpe'i 'od gsal mthar thug pa'i 'di phan chad ni/ theg pa bla na med pa 'dir zhugs pa thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam yin la/ ji ltar pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam la gnas pa rnams/ sa bdun pa nas bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam the bo pa —309—

bzhin te/dper na so so'i lam nyid la ltos pa'i bgrod pa gcig pa zho/yongs ye thams cad gyi bgrod pa gcig pa ni/sa bcu rgyun gyi mtha' ma las khusdorol tu thob pa med do//lam de dag bsgrub pa la thogs pa med pa'i mthudangaldan pa'i ye shes bskyed par mdzad pa/yul nyer bzhi dang dur khrod brgyan de/sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi yul mchog gi dpa' bo dang /lha mo 'khor bcas sgyidangakhyad par rnams kyis g.yel ba med par rtag tu grogs mdzad par shog cig ces pa'o//gnyis pa la/gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu rdo rje gsum ni lam dus kyi rdorje gsum ste/de la thugs dang gsung dang sku gsum lag dang po ni/snying kha'i dbus te sems kyi ngo bo la 'od gsal bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rtag tu shar bas/gzung 'dzin gyi chos kun dang /de kun gyi 'char gzhi rangasems gdod ma nas skye ba med par mngon du gyur pa thob nas/sgra don can gyi rnam par rtog pa med bzhin du/ji snyed pa'i chos thams cad kyi rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i thugs kyi rdo rje ste/mthong lam thob pa na mngon du 'gyuraro//rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid ces bya ba ni/ji snyed pa'i chos tha༅sacad kyi rnam pa kun tu 'char ba'i ye shes dam pa stong nyid mngon sum du mthong ba zhig la 'jog cing /de yang bsod nams kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa'i shes rab dam pa yin gyi/stong rkyang bsgom pa las mi 'byung ste/pha rol tu phyin pa drug las gang ma tshang yang /de mi 'grub par ri mo mkhan drug gis rgyal wo'i gzugs 'bri ba'i dpe dang 'dra bar theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma las gsungs0

so/ /des na 'dir yang mthar thug pa ni sangs rgyas kyi sa 'ba' zhig la'o/ /zhu bde reg bya'i bde bas yid kyi 'khor du tshor ba bde ba khyad par can skye zhing yid bde bar 'gyur bas/ dbang shes lnga yang bde ba'i ngo bor 'gyur te/ dziskad du/ rigs pa'i dbang phyug gi zhal snga nas/ 'di 'gyu/ra na ni gzhan dgakyang / /'gyur ba dag tu mthong ba yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar rdo /'jug shesadrug po bde bar 'gyur ba zhu bde'i ye shes de yis/ sems kyi rang bzhin bde ba nyid mngon du gyur te/ thig le 'gyur bcas kyi sgrib pa kun spangs pa ni ye shes rdo rje ste/ 'di yang phyogs mthun lam dus kyi dbang du byas na/ mthong lam thob pa ste/ 'on kyang 'dzag bde'i dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pa ni/sangs rgyas pa kho na'o/ /snga ma stong pa dang / 'di bde ba'i cha nas ba 'ag ste/thugs rdo rje chos sku yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /'di nyid so sor phye na rdo rje bzhi ste/de'i tshe chos sku bde ba chen po'i sku gnyis su sbyar te sku yang bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ nam mkha' lta bu'i stong nyid las byung zhing / nam mkha' lta bu'i stong ṣka kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i sgra dbyangs rgya mtshodang / de kun gyi don yang rtog pa med par lhun gyas grub cing / rang bzhin stong par mnyam pa nyid du gnas pa las/ gsungs gcig kho nas kyang / sems can rnams kyi bsam pa so sodang mthun par/ so so'i skad du snang ba skad cig re re 'byung ba rgyun rdzo pa med pas sna tshogs pa'i dam pa'i chos thams cad la rdzogs par longs spyod pa gsung gi rdo rje'o/ /gsum pa ni/ rnam pa mtshan dpes spras pa/ ngo bo rlung sems kyi sku 311—

mchog /yon tan gyi khyad par dbang phyug brgyad dang ldan pa/ 'jug pa'i khyad par dngos po kun la khyab cing gang yang phyin pa'i sku rdo rje'o/ /'di dngos ni zung 'jug yin pas/ rlung sems zhes pa'i skabs kyi rlung bde ba chen po'i rang snangalha sku sogs snang ba ma 'gags pa'i cha la 'jog go /spyir so so skye bo'i dus kya dpe'i 'od gsal dang bde ba chen po la sogs pa lam dus kyi sku gsum dang / rdo rje gsum tsam du 'jog mod kyi/ de dag la 'bras bu'i rdzogs rim zhes bya ba'i ming 'dogs kyang / gnas skabasakyi 'bras bu zhes gtso bor 'dogs pa'i gzhi ni ma yin pas/ 'dir zung 'jargaltar brjod pa'o/ /gnyis pa la/ gang zag gsum gyi 'tshang rgya ba'i tshuwa so so rnam gzhag /sangs rgyas kya rgyu'i gtso bo thabs mkhas bshad pa/thob bya 'bras/bu'i rang bzhin no/ /dang po la brtson 'grus can tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya tshul/ le lo can bar dor 'tshang rgya tshul/ bar chad can skyeb brgyud nas 'tshang rgya tshuwalo/ /dang po ni/ tshe 'di nyid la rim gnyis kyi rtogs pa brtan zhing brtson 'grus chen pos spyod pa spyod pa ste/ de las gzhan yang zhes pa ni/ gong du rgyasapa bstan pa las/ gzhan yang mdor bsdu na zhes pa'o/ /dge ba'i rtsab desabadag cag rnams rol (〈spo〉rgod ma )tshig kun la gus par gnas shing /skyon med pa dang / rim gnyis rtag tu ste rgyun ma 'chad par bsgom pa'i ye shesaskyes shing brtan la mthu dang ldan par song ba dang / rim pa gnyis kyi rdorje'i bzlas pa la yang dag par gnas shing / brtson pa dang gzhol ba'i spyod pasathun mong gi dngos grub dang / nang la gzhol ba'i spyod pas mchog gi dngos grub —312—

sgrub ste/ tshe 'di nyid la gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku grub nas/ sangs rgyas 'grub par shog ces pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ drod thob kyang bya ba gzhan gyis g.yengs te le los spyod pa ma spyad pa ste/ gal te bdag gis le lo'i skyon nyid kyis spyod pa 'khom ma byungabar tshe 'dir sangs rgyas ma thob na/ bla ma dang yi dam lha'i thugs rjes 'ochi'apho ba'i tshe dngos grub thob pa ste/ 'chi ba don gyi 'od gsal du gyur zhing/ de las langs te gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi sku 'grub pa de'i tshe/ bcom ldan khrag 'thung dpal 'khor lo bde mchog dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dang bcas pas me tog rgyal mtshan ba dan sogs mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad dang / rol mo glu gar gyi spyod pa dang bcas pas mkha' spyod dag pa'i gnasasu'akhrid pa dang / 'chi ba 'od gsal las langs nas de ma thag tu ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mtha' yas pa thob pa dang / nyon sgrib der spangs zin zhing / shes sgrib spong ba dang / rtogs pa'i yon tan rim gyis yang dag par rdzogs pa dang/'jig rten las 'das pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i lus ye shes kyi sku gong nas gong du 'gyur khyad thob nas/ sa bcu rnams mthar phyin te 'tshang rgya bzho /tshe 'dirasbyor lam drod wo po thob na de lta bur 'gyur zhing / drod chung ngu thob pa 4/yin na/ bar dor sgyu lus kyi sku thob ste/ de'i rten la 'da' bsrid/ /yang na rig pa 'dzin pa'i gnas su skye ba blangs te/ de'i rten la 'da' ba'ang srid do/ /gsum pa ni/ drod chung ngu ma thob pa'am/ snang ba'i rtog pa ma skyes pa stoshin tu skal pa dman par gyur pas/ rim gnyis la mi brtson pa'am/ brtson —313—

yang dam tshig gi yan lag rnams ma dag pas/ tshe 'dir drod chung ngu ma thob pas bar do der skyu lus gyi gzugs ma grub cing / rig pa 'dzin pa'i lusasuskye ba yang ma thob na/ skyeb dang skyeb thams cad du cho se dang ldan pa bdegashegs sangs rgyas kyi rigs su skyes pa'i/ lha'am mi'i rgyal po gsang sngagasaspyod par gyur te/ shin tu thogs kyang skye ba bdun gyis nges par 'grub la/ skye ba dang skyeb de thams cad du/ thes bsam sgom gsum gyis sgo nas nges pa'i don phyin ci ma log pa'i blo dang ldan zhing / rigs mthon por skye bas bzang ba dang / nga rgyal med pa dang / snying rje che zhing bla ma la gus pa dang/ gang du bshad pa ltar thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pas bsdus pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog gi dam tshig rnams la gnas pa dang / mgo bor bla ma'i cod pan 'chang ba skerdorje slob dpon bsten tshul ji lta bas bsten pa dang / lag tu rdorje dril bu 'dzin pa sogs mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig thams cad 'chang ba dang / ngag du gagangasngags kyi rgyal po rin chen bzhi'am/ rdo rje'i bzlas pa sogs bzla ba dang/yid bde stong zung 'jug bsgom pa ste/ tshe 'di dang bar dor ma grub na skyepagazhan du yang gsang sngags spyad par gyur cig ces pa'o/ /gnyis pa la rgyas bshad dang / don bsdu gnyis las/ dang po la gzhan rgyud kyis byin gyis rlobasapa dang / 'dod pa'i lha la the tshom gcod pa dang / bsngo ba'i khyad par dang/bdag gzhan brje ba'i bsam pa dang / khyad par gdul dka' 'dul ba'i tshul lo/ /'di rnams kyi tshig don ni go sla ste/ dang po ni bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang/'khor lo bde mchog he ru ka 'khor dang bcas pa ste/ yi dam lha rnams dang/ 314—

chos rdo rje theg pa dang 'bral ba med cing / rdo rje slob dpon dang he ru ka'i zhabs pad spyi bor gnas pa ste/ des rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la byin gyisarlabs shing zhugs na/ rang gis kyang sems gtad pa dang dmigs pa tsam/gyisatshad med pa'i 'gro ba yongs su smin zhing byin gyis glo bos par nus pa ste/thabs kyi khyad par ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ gang gi tshe rje btsun he ruka lta bar 'o dod pa dang / cung zad the tshom gcod pa'i dri ba bya bar 'dod na yang / mgon po rdo rje slob dpon dang / dpal khrag 'thung 'khor lo bde mchog sogs phyogs brtse re sangs rgyas rnams gegs med par mthong bar shog cig /ces sangs rgyasarnams rtag tu mthong ste/ de dag gi byin rlabs kyis rdzu 'phru/la sna tsho gos pa dang/de rnams kyi bka' bzhin bsgrub pas 'gro don spyod pa rnams kyang don med du mi 'gyu1ra ba dang / gzhan gyi mthu la brten nas/ sems can gyi bsam pa dngamathun pas chos ston nus pa rnams rnal 'byor shin tu mthu dang ldan pa yin pas kyang 'grub ste/ 'gro ba'i don phul du phyin pa bsgrub nus pa yang thabs khyad par ro/ /gsum pa ni/ ched du bya ba phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas gtugs nusapa'i sems can kun gnas skabs kyi bde ba dang / mthar thug tu phan pa byangachub kyi don sgrub phyir du yongs su bsngo ba'i tshul ni 'khor lo sdom pa dpal he ru ka nyid la sogs pa phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems 'dra~X ༵༵ kū /da kyi kyi ces mi rdo sna/༷ pa dab kau sdu tī / sna/sdu sa pad rngo /ga pa —315—

dang / reg pa'i sems can de rnams thams cad kyang myur du byang chub mo chogalanges par 'khod par shog ces sogs sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyi mdzad pa thams cad bdag gis byed pa dang / smon lam thams cad bdag gis bsgrus pa dang / sems can gcig kyang ma lus par bdag gis 'khore ba las 'dren parabasngo zhing/ de'i 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa 'di yang thabs kyi khyad pararo/ /bzhi pa ni/ bdag gis lus dang longs spyod dang dus gsum gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad dang / bde ba cung zad yod pa thams cad 'gro ba kun labasam sbyor gnyis kas sbyin pas sems can re re bzhin yang phan bde zad mishes pa thob ste/ sangs rgyas kya ye shes kyi 'byor bar smon pa dang/ 'gro ba rnams kyi mi dge ba dang / sdug bsngal dang / yul yid du mi 'ong ba ci snrod pa de kun thams cad bdag gis lus sems la smin par gyur nas/ skye bo kun sdigakun dang bral bar smen pa ste/ gzhan gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba la rjes su yi rang ba yang 'di'i zhor la 'byung bas/ rtsa ba ni bdag gzhan brje ba ste/ de'i bsamosbyor gyi yi rang dang bcas pa 'di yang thabs mkhas chen po'o/ /lnga pa ni/ sems can gyi khams na sbyor bas gnod cing / bsam pas zhe gdug par byed pa kun thog ma nyid du myur bar rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang la 'god pa'i bsam pa dang sbyor ba'i thabs byed pa dang / khyad par 'khore lo sdoslapa'i lam la ma dad cing skur ba 'debs pa la thegs pa'i sdig pa gsog pa'i bsod nams dman pa rnams ji ltar 'dul ba ltar/ dbang dang mngon spyod la—316—

sogs pa thabs sna tsho gis kyis rab tu btul nas/ thar lam 'di la brten nas rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la 'god par byed pa ste/ ma rungs pa gdul dka' ba rnams drag po la sogs pa'i thabs sna tshogs pas gdul ba 'di yang thabs mkhas pa'o/ /gnyis pa don bsdu ba ni/ mdor bsdu na skye ba thams cad du bla ma mchogagis rjes su bzung nas/ rim gnyis bsgom zhing mchog dang thun mong gosasagrub gnyis thob nas/ tshad med pa'i zhing rnams su sprul pa bgrangs ba lasa'adas pa spros te/ mu mtha' med pa'i sems can yongs su smin par byed pa'o/ /de la bla ma mchog de yang gang zhe na/ spyir rgyud nas mtshan nyid rgyas parabashad pa/ snying rje med cing khro la gdug khengs shing chags la ma bsdams pa/ /rang bstod bla ma slob ma ni/ /blo bzang ldan pas mi bya go /zhes pa'i skyon spangs shing / brtan zhing dul ba blo gros ldan/ /bzod ldan drang la g.yo sgyumed/ /sngags dang rgyud kyi spyor ba shes/ /snying brtse ldan zhing bstan bcosamakhas/ /de nyid bcu ni yongs su shes/ /dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i lasalamakhas/ /gsang sngags 'chad byed slob dpon te/ /dad pa'i bdaganyid dbangapo thul/ /zhes gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba ste/ rtsod dus mtshan nyid thams cad tshang ba'ang the tshom dang phyin ci log gi blos skyon dang ldan par mthong bsan/ de lta bu ma rnyed na yon tan shas che ba rnams blang tho/ /tshe'adi la mchog 'dod pa rnams kyis bsnyen par bya ba'i slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid ni/ gzhan dag yod dam med kyang sla ste/ rang bzhin spros pa dang bral ba mthon —317—

sum du gzigs pa dang /thig le 'gyur ba med pa'i bde ba chen po brnyes shing/bde stong gi lam des slob ma 'khrid pa la yang mkhas pa ste/slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid 'di nges par gal che'o//rang nyid tshe 'dir 'tshang rgya ba la de ltabu'i bla ma med na mi 'byung gi rgyu yin no//dus 'khor las kyang/sangs rgyasazhal 'di gang gi snying dang kha la gnas par 'gyur ba de ni dpal ldan bla ma'o//zhes gsungs pa'i 'a sangs rgyas kya zhal lam sgo ni/dpal don dmabasnyen pa las/chags chen 'dod chags chen po las ni thugs bcingasapa//dbang po'i bde ba gnyis sbyor brtul zhugs chen po can//phyag rgyad galasbyar yang chags pa nyams mi mnga'//nyi zla dag gi lam la rnal 'byor ra patunyams/khres rab me la rnal 'byor stobs kyas rab tu zhugs//dpag med bde ba'i bdud rtsi nyid la gas pa ste//sdig 'phrog rdo rje 'dzin pa de ni blamadapal zhes gsungs te/byang chub kyi sems 'pho ba med pa'i bde ba thos pa dang /nyi zla ro rkyang gi rgyu ba 'gags pas gzung 'dzin gyi 'khrul pa gzhig pa dang /gnyis su med pa'i ye shes me lta bu ma lnga zhe du gyur pa rnams dgos paragasungs pa ltar te/de lhar thugs la gnas par ma zad zhal la'ang gnas pa ste/legs par ston mkhyen pa zhig dgos pa yin no//lam gzhan du dgoba'i ru shes gnyen la brten nas dge ba'i chos thams cad 'phel tshul bstan nas de gal che bar bshad mod/bla ma de bsgom shing de'i mos gus kho nas la5bgrod pa ni ma bshad la/theg pa 'dir ni de yang gsungs te/gang zag dbang po rnon po mchog rab tu gyur pa dag gi spyod yul rdon no//

gsum pa thob bya 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag la/ 'gyur ba med pa'i ye shesangos bzung / de nyid rigs drug gi ngo bor gtan la dbab pa'o/ /dang po ni/rten khu ba nor bu nas spyi bo'i bar du brtan pa dang / rdul gyi khams spyi bonasanor bur brtan pas rnam smin gyi las zad nas rdo rje'i skur 'gyur te/ dar na/dngul chu'i bcud len pa dang / medang du ba sogs kyi sbyor bas bcos pa'i lcags ni gser du 'gyur te bcud len gyi nus pa lcags la brten bzhi khacig 'di ni dus 'khor ra gyi lugs kho na ste/ de'i lugs la rags pa'i lusatsha'agyur bar rlud sems kyi sku 'grub pa med ces smra zhing / 'dus pa bde dgyesasogs la khams dkar dmar bcings pas de ltar 'gyur ba'i rnam gzhag mi byed/ zung 'jug gi sku yang rlung sems lhar song ba yin gyi/ sha khrag ni lusaganas 'gyur ba ma yin zhes smra ba ni/ shin tu rnam par ma brtags pa rgyud rnams la skur ba 'debs pa ste/ spyir bde dgyes gsang 'dus skor thams/cad nas thig le bcings pas/ rdo rje'i sku 'grub pa kho nar bshad pa dang / man ngag lugs tha dad pa kun las mgrin gcig tu 'byung la/ de thams cad phar zhag gi gsang 'dus rdo rje 'phreng bar/ mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa rim lngaradrangs pa rnams gsungs nas zung 'jug 'grub pa'i rgyu dang 'grub tshul 'chad pa na/ rdo rje rtse mor byang sems ni/ /'dzin pa'i lus kyi brtan pa ṣka/ /de yisade nyid byang sems ni/ /rlung gi de nyid rab spyor bas/ /rig pas steng du byed pa ni/ /rgas pa med par the tshom med/ /huX ho rim bzhin zhes pa ni/ /'dzin pa steng du rnam par spel/ /sngar bshad pa yi bdud rtsi lnga/ /'di ni bcud kyi len du —319—

brjod/ /'di nyid kyis ni 'grub par byed/ /lcags kyi gser 'gyur byas nasani/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgya dngos grub che/ /zung du 'jug pa thob par 'gyur/ /zhesardorje'i rtse mo nas thig le steng du rlung gi sbyor bas brtan pa dang / 'dzin pa dang/steng du bcings pas bdud rtsi lnga'i bcud len te dwangs ma bcings par rab mthar thug pas zung 'jug 'grub ces gsungs pas rim lngar lung drangs pa'i bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug dang / bden gnyis zung 'jug sogs gsungs pa'i 'di kho na yang lta dgos so/ /des na de ni sku'i chos dang / thugs mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa dbyer med pas zung du 'jug pa/sangs rgyas kyi ye shes mngon du gyur nas/ tshe 'dir sku gnyis thob pa ste/ skuphyag rgya chen po gzhan don gyi sku'am kun rdzob kyi sku'o/ /thugs rang don gyi sku'am don dam gyi sku'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'i sems/ rnam shes las 'das pa ste/ kun gzhi gnas 'gyur ba spros pa'i chos kun de'i rang bzhin can yin kyang / de nyid spros pa'i ma gos pa ni mi bskyod pa dpal he ru ka dang/chosathams cad gdod ma nas ma skyes pa'i stong nyid/ sangs rgyas sems can sogasa'akhor 'das kyi dbye ba dang bral ba'i mnyam nyid las ma g.yos kyang / 'du byed thams cad dang bral zhing lhun gyis grub par rtsibazhed pa la dgyes dgur rol pa dang / sems can rnams kyi skal pa dang 'tsham par dus las yolabamed par 'gro ba'i don thogs med du 'byung ba/ don yod grub pa ltar/ gzhan don spyod pa myur du 'jug pas rta mchog lte rta'i rgyal po zhes bya'o/ /rtag chad—320—

las grol ba mnyam pa nyid gzigs pas 'gyur ba ste phyin ci log du g.yo ba med pa rin 'byung ste/ rdo rje nyi ma'am gzi brjid rgyal po'o/ /rlung 'gyur ba sgra thams cad nam mkha' dang mnyam pa a yig ste skye ba med pa'i ming chi'i/ gi yi ge thams cad dang bral ba'i ye shes/ 'gro ba thams cad la zhing thams cad du dus kun tu skad thams cad pas gang la gang 'dul du don du gang 'gyur ba de nyid grag stong du ston pa'i mtshan nyid can ni padma gar gyi dbang phyug ske 'od dpag med do/ /rdul phra rab kyi chos nyid las 'das pa spra phab pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi rang bzhin te de dang mtshungs pa sems dag pa'i snang cha tsam du shar ba'i zhing dang / sku dang 'byor pa sogs tshad med mu med cing 'byams klas pa yeshes gcig nyid kyi rnal rol du snang ba ni/ rgyal ba rtag pa ste rnam par snangamadzad do/ /rtag pa mchog tu khyab pa'i bdag nyid khyab pa dang rtag pa gnyisasumed pa ni khyab bdag ste/ shes bya kun nas sgyu ma lta bur mthong ba ni stong pa'i ye shes dang rang bzhin bde ba chen po mngon du gyur pa bde stong gnyis su med pa ni don dam byang chub kyi sems rdo rje sems dpa' ste/ dag pa gnyis ldan 'di la 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin zhes bya'o/ /de dag gi rnam par bzhag pa ni rgyasapar bshad na 'byams klas par 'gyur mod kyi/ ci rigs pa nye bar phan pa rgyache ba dag brjod na/ thun mong ma yin pa sngags las gsungs pa'i 'bras bu'i tshul dang / thun mong ba mdo las kyang gsal ba 'byung ba rnams go /dang po larten sku'i rnam gzhag khyad par rigs kyi dbye ba/ brten pa ye shes kyi rangabazhin gsum las/ dang po ni bshad zin to/ /—321—

gnyis pa la rnam 'gyur dang rang bzhin gnyis las/ dang po la dbye ba rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ dang po ni/ kyai rdo rje las/ de rnams la yanga'abum phrag gas can nyid/ /bye ba'i rigs la grangs ni med par 'gyur/ /de la rigs la grangs med rigs rnams nyid/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i rigs lasabyung ba rnams/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang bzhin don dam pa'i steng nas ni dbye ba med kyang / kun rdzob kyi cha shas la ltos nas phye ba'i phyir/ rigs kyi dbye ba'i mtha' bgrang bar mi spyod mod/ mdo tsam du bstan pa ni bla med spyidabang du byas nas/ gsang ba 'dus pa las/ mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni/sangs rgyas lngar ni rab tu sgrags/ /rdo rje skye mched gnyis dag kyang/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor mchog /sa ni spyan zhes bya ba yin/ /chu'i khams ni mā ma gī/ /dkar dang sgrol ma zhes bya ba/ /me dang rlung du rab tubasgrags/ /zhes dang / gzu gas sgra la sogs sngags pa yis/ /lha nyid du ni rtag tu sgoms/ /zhes gsungs te/ gzugs phung rnam snang zhes 'thon pa/'khor ba'i dus su gzugs phung du snang ba'i rnam par rig pa de gnas 'gyur ba ni/ ye shes nyid rang snang rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku mtshan dpes spras pa dang/de'i zhing dang 'byor ba'i bkod pa mu mtha' med pa dang bcas pa ste/ rnam snangagi dkyil 'khor du 'gyur ba yin la/ de la bla ma snga rabs pa rnams kyisagazugs phung gnas gyur rnam par snang mdzad ces dang / gzugs phung rnam snangagi ngo bor sangs rgyas zhes tha snyad mdzad do/ /de bzhin du gzhan rnams la sbyarate/ tshor ba ni rin ཿnga dang / 'du shes 'od dpag med dang/ ཿ byed don —322—

yod grub pa dang /rnam shes mi bskyod pa dang /mig sa'i snying po dang/nob phyag na rdo rje dang /sna nam mkha'i snying po ste/lce 'jig rten dbang phyug dang/lus sgrib pa rnam sel dang /yid kun tu bzang po'o/rde/sa sangs rgyas spyan ma/chu mā ma ki me gos dkar po/rlung sgrom ma/gzugs gzugs rdo rje ma/sgra sgra rdo rje ma/dri dri rdo rje ma/ro ro rdo rje ma/reg reg rdo rje ma/chos kha5sa na ma stoba'i dbyings kyi rdo rje ma ste/phung lnga khams bzhi skye mched bcu gnyis rnams te phungakhams nyer gcig tu snang ba'i sems gnas gyur pa las/de rnams kyi dkyila'akhor nyer gcig tu gyur te 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul byung bas/gang zag gcinasangs rgyas pa na/rang snang gis bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor ra mtha' yas pa'i b.radu 'byung ngo//de rnams la rnam par dbye na/rigs brgya'i bar du 'byung ba yin te/sngar bshad pa'i phung khams nyer gcig po de las/chos khams dang yid gnyis spyi khyab tu btang nas/bcu dgu po la gzhi'i dus kyi rigs lnga dngarigs mthun par sbyar te cha shas lnga lnga so sor phye ste/bsdu bya rigs chud dgubacu rtsa lnga dang /bsdu byed gzhi dus kyi ye shes lnga/rigs chen rgyal/ba rigasardelnga ste/rigs brgya'o//de dag kyang spyod bsdus sgron me las kyang rgyas paragasung /mdor bsdus tsam brjod na/gzugs las phye ba'i rnam snang gyi snu gosarigs lnga ste/dbyibs kyi gzugs rnam snang /rnam pa'i gzugs zin 'byung/kha dog snang mtha'/'od kyi snang ba don grub/rig byed ma yin pa'i gzugs mi bskyod pa/'di'i ngos 'dzin ni mngon pa ltar mi byed kyi/gzugs kyi rnam pa yid yul du shar ba de yin te/rang rig pa'i gzugs zhes gsung ro//mkhrisarde

pa ༵ sogs pa las skyes pa'i tshor ba mi bskyod pa/bad kan dang rlung lasasapa na ཿnga /bskre ba ༷ dpag o//sngu bsngal don sgi/༵to sgo sgo 9 5 khornam snang /'a gnyas pa ya 'du sa gi bskyad mi/rkang byā ༵ ༵sna/nga/rkang med kya ge rdzo 'as/rkang mang don grub/ 'a zhang rgyu ba 'du she /sa/sem lnga pa /zugs 'a ge ni kya lha dang /gzhan rnamasarim rnga su bstan pa' mas can /mas kya 'du shas la 'chad pa dang zhi/yangam pas rtag mtha' lta bu mtha' gnya~Xchar la brten pa dang /mtha' ba 'charag tshe she pa cig /'ji skya ma re rer she st+ri zhen pa dang /yu~Xngon pa ca / rtse ladangs pa gag tu nyukho// pa dang /stang pa ga dkyi she //ra kyi pa lda/nga ni ni/kyang dam pa' ga ring ga bla / bzhed do/༵/nga mi mi phung pa' lus 'du ska ji/ rnam snang /ngag sa 'od dpag rded/ pe bo mi sgyu ma : / pa/khams gsum gya 'i ri ( 5 9 /thar 'a 'du byed dan ༷ga rna ba/ ga skya mi she rnam snang/nobam bir ga rna /sna' snang mtha'/lce' phyi grub/lus kya thi bskyad pa sa/rgyal ba nyer lnga 'ari //pe ste phyi sa/rus pa da/ sa dang/ṭā pa rdong go/snying ste nangadang / rab phya' khams da rnams su snang ba na/rnam snang spyan ma/de bzhi du sbyar te/nang sbu dang sen mo/rnag dang snying dang /phyi dzam bu glo ni grwa pe rang tsho snyi rdo nyi de 7sbyo)na ཿnga /'a zhes 'a/spya she nga / ba pa dri ma cu rdi~X/bye khu tshan/snying sa pa sha 'phags po mi /phya sgra snyan dan grub/nang ༵rgyu nga ni ri~X/pa nga/zhin lus 'phags po bskyod pa ste/nang bang kan mchi/ phyi pa de ban du 'byung ba thams cad la sbyar 4te/nang bad kan mam/ 'bab chu

rnam snang / nang dri chu phyi rgya mtsho mi bskyod pa/ rdul dang chu bo zin 'byung/ khragadang bkod ma'i chu snang mtha'/ kha chu dang lteng ka don 'grub/ mgo bo'i drod dang rdo las byung ba'i me rnam snang / snying kha'i drod dang rgyun bzhag gi me mi bskyod pa/lte ba'i gtum mo dang me shel sogs kyi me rin 'byung / yan lag gi drod dngashing gi me snang mtha'/ lto ba'i drod de zas 'ju bar byed pa dang nags kyimedon grub/ srog rlung dang shar gyi rlung mi bskyod pa/ thur sel dang lho'i rlung rin 'byung / gyen rgyu dang nub kyi snang mtha'/ me mnyam dang byang go don grud/ khyab byed dang steng gi rlud rnam snang ste yul nyi shu'o/ /mig gi dbang po sa snying gyi mi bskyod pa/ mig 'bras dkar po dbang rten rin 'byung / zur gyis bltab snangamatha'/ mig g.yo ba don grub/ gzugs mchog dman 'bring gsum 'dzin pa rnam snang ngo / /rna ba'i dbang po mi bskyod pa/ rna ba'i rten khog pa rnam snang/ bu ga snang mtha'/ rtsa ba don grub/ sgra gsum 'dzin pa zin 'byung tho/ /sna'i dbangapo mi bskyod pa/ sna'i rang bzhin dbang rten rnam snang / sna'i bu ga zin 'byung/sbu gu don grub/ dri gsum 'dzin pa snang mtha'/ lce'i dbang po mi bskyod pa/dbang rten rnam snang / rtsa ba rin 'byung / rtse mo snang mtha'/ rogasuma'i dzen pa don grub lus kyi dbang po rnam snang / rus pa rin 'byung / sha snang mtha'/pags pa don grub/ reg bya gsum 'dzin pa mi bskyod pa ste/ sems dpa' nyeralnga'o/ /snang ba dang sgrib g.yogs med pa dang / yid la byed pa dang/ migagodabang po'i tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i rgyu las/ gzugs mthong ba ni rnam snang/'dung bag dang rol rtsed dang / sgeg pa'i gzugs mi bskyod pa dang/ rjes—325

chags kyi gzugs kyi rin 'byung / mdzes mi mdzes bar ma gsum gyi 'du shesacan gyi gzugs snang mtha'/ bya ba byed pa'i gzugs don grub/ na ba'i nangagisgra sogs rnam snang / glu'i sgra sogs rin 'byung / mgrin pa'i ngag go sgra snangamatha'/ chu dang nags tshal dang yan lag dang rol mo'i sgra don grub/ yi go hāXzhi drag sogs mi bskyod pa/ dri ma 'dus pa'i tshogs pa rnam snang/ yan lag gi dri rin 'byung / dri gsum gyi bye brag phyed pa snang mtha'/ ro'i dri don grub/dri'i ngo bo mi bskyod pa/ mngar ba rnam snang / bska ba zin 'byung / lan tshab snangamatha'/ kha ba mi bskyod pa/ tsha ba dang skyur ba sogs phyed pa don grub/ lhan gcig la gnas pa'i reg bya rnam snang / khyud pa'i rin 'byung / 'o byed pa'i snangamatha'/ rngub pa'i don grub/ bha ga dang ling ga sbyor ba'i reg bya mi bskyod pa stolha nyer lnga'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhi dus kyi me long lta bu'i ye shes rnam snang / mnyam nyid ye shes rin 'byung / /sor rtog ye shes 'od dpag med/ bya grub ye shes don grub/ chos dbyings ye shes mi bskyod pa'o/ /de ltar na phung khams skye mched brgyad po de dag gnas 'gyur ba ni/ dam pa rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor du 'gyur ro/ /yang rgyal ba rigs lnga la rigs chung lnga lngas phye bas nyi shu rtsalnga'o/ /de la yum bzhi bzhis phye bas rigs brgya ste/ yid gsum khyab tubatang nas/ rnam shes lnga'i 'khor du gyur pa'i 'du byed lnga/ gyo chus bdang/tsheb dang tshad med pa dang / ci yang med pa dang / srid rtse'i 'du shes te/ 'du shesalnga 'dus te reg pa'i tshor ba lnga/ dbyibs dang / kha dog dang/ rnam 'gyur gyi —326—

gzugs dang bu (〈j-i〉 rtseg )nam mkha' dang / rang rig pa'i gzugs phung lnga/ de rnams 'byung ba bzhi bzhi'i rang bzhin las grub pa'i phyir brgya thawapa'o/ /dus kyi 'khor lo las ni/ dam pa'i rigs brgya'i rtsi tshul gzhan gsungs so/ /des na spyod bsdus sgron me las/ phung po khams dang de bzhin skyemached rnams/ /lnga po dbye ba lnga ru byas pa las/ /de bzhin gshe/gas pa rnams kyis byin brlabs nas/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'di dag gang las 'byung / /de bzhin dbang po phyi rol yul bcas lnga/ /re re bzhin yang bde gshegags lnga rnams kyis/ /de la rtag tu byin gyis rlobs byed cing/ ye shesalnga dang gsum du byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsungs te/ chos 'di rnams kyi rangabazhin mngon par rtogs na/ 'khor ba thams cad rtsa ba nas med pa yin zhesapa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'di'i rnam snang gi rigs nyi shu rnam par snang mdzad nagami bskyod pa'i rigs nyi shu rigs chen mi bskyod par 'du ba'i bar rigs lnga ste/rnal 'byor ma kun spyod las/ 'gro ba 'di kun sangs rgyas mnga' bdaganyid/ /gar mkhan dang ni ri mo bzang ltar snang / /gang yang drug pa'i sangs rgyas zhesabya ba/ /gcig pu rnams ni du ma'i gar mdzad do/ /zhes gsungs so/ /gsum pa ni/ gzhi dus su phung po lnga lus ngag yid gsum du 'dusashing / don yod grub pa ni/ 'od dpag med dang / phyi rpā ཿrngos ni skurdorje 'dus pas/ rigs lnga po yang sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum du 'du gi /zla gsang thig le las/ rigs ni rnam pa brgyar bshad de/ /mdo ru bsdu na rnam pa lnga/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba yis/ /gsum du yang ni yi 'gyur ba na/ zhes—327—

gsungs pa'i don bstan zin to/ /gnyis pa rang bzhin ni/ gzhi dus su lusangag gnyis kyang sems kyi rang snang yin pa dang / 'bras bu'i dus su rigs ji snyed pa thams cad kyang bde ba chen po'i rang snang gcig tu 'dus pa yin te/gsang 'du/sa las/ khyod kyis sems lus lta bu dang / lus sems lta bu dang/sems tshig tu brjod pa lta bur bskyed cig /ces gsungs so/ /gsum pa ni zung 'jug yon tan sum cu rtsa dgu ste/ yan lag bdun dang yon tan brgyad dang phra yang la sogs pa brgyad dang / ro myang brgyad dang/dbang phyug brgyad do/ /'di'i yon tan brgyad ni sa'i khams rang sar dag pas/stobs mtha' yas par 'gyur ba dang / chu khams dag pas nad la sogs pa'i skyon nam yang med pa dang / me khams dag pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad 'od kyis khyab par byed pa dang / rlung khams dag pas rdzu 'phrul yid ltaramagyogs pas 'gro ba dang / nam mkha'i khams dag pas gar yang phyin pa dang/nyi ma ste dmar cha dag pas sprul pa sna tshogs pa ston pa dang / zla ba ste khu ba dgapas bde ba chen pos thugs rgyud gdwa ba dang / rnam shes kyi khams dag pasadus thams cad du bde stong gi ye shes ma g.yos shing / dus gsum chagasathogs med pa'i ye shes 'jug go /'di ni zung 'jug gi yon tan yin la/sred med kyi bu'i stobs dang / zo mdog bde ba dang / gzi brjid tshe bdang/g.yang sa la sogs pas mi gnod pa dang / mi snang ba dang / sprul pa ci rigs pa ston pa dang / grib ma med pa dang / mngon shes lnga ci rigs pa thob pa rnamasasasogs kyi yon tan du bshad pa ni/ thun mong gi dngos grub kyi yon to du —328—

bshad do/ /ro myang brgyad ni/ 'jam dpal zhal lung las/de nas mtha' med 'khore ba'i bar/ /rtag pa dang ni mi gdug dang / /bsil ba dang ni gag pa dang / /bde ba dang ni dri med dang / /dga' ba dang ni yi rang ba/ /'di ni bde chen ro myang brgyad/ /ces gsungs pas/ 'khor ba ji srid bar gnas pa'i phyirartag pa/ gzung ba la sogs pa'i rtog pas ma gos pa'i phyir na gdung ba med pa/mi slob pa'i zung 'jug la shes sgrib kyi tsha gdung med pa dang / slob pa'i zunga'ajug la yang / gnyis snang rags pa 'gags pas na bsil ba dang / bden gnyis dbyer med dang / srid zhi mnyam nyid du gyur pas gcig pa dang / semasa'agyur ba med pas bde ba dang / phyin ci log gi 'khrul pa dang bral bas drimamed pa dang / zab gsal dbyer med las mi 'da' bas 'gro don mdzad pa'iphyir dga' ba dang / dzi lta ba dang / dzi snyed pa mkhyen pas chos nyid dang /sems can la rtag tu mnyam par 'jog pas yid dang ba'am yid dga' ba'o/ /dbang phyug brgyad ni/ sgron gsal du/ sku yi dbang phyug gsung ni dbangaphyug dang / /de bzhin du ni thugs kyi dbang phyug dang / /rdzu 'phrul kun 'groganas kyi dbang phyug dang / /ci 'dod bskyed dang yon tan brgyad pa zho /zhesalung drangs te/ sku dpag med tu med pa cig car ston pa sku'i dbang phyug dang/sems can thams cad kyi skad du chos cig car ston pa gsung gi dbang phyug dang / rtog pa med bzhin du shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa thugs kyi dbang phyugadang / lhun gyis grub pa'i rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas pa stone pa rdzu 'phrul gyi dbangaphyug dang / yul dus gnas skabs thams cad du rgyal ba khyab pa kun 'gro'i sdi—329—

dbang phyug dang / stobs sogs yon tan thams cad kyi gnas su gyur pasaganas kyi dbang phyug dang / bzhed pa tsam gyis don thams cad rdzogs para'agrub pa ni 'dod pa'i dbang phyug dang / gdul bya mu med pa rnams la byang chub gsum po rgyud la bskyed par mdzad pa ni bskyed pa'i dbang phyug ste/ de rnams la dbang 'byor bas dbang phyug go /'ga' zhig gnas kyi dbang phyug mi bgrangazhing / yon tan gyi dbang phyug ces zur du byed pa ni/ rtsa ba dngas se/su 'gawalo/ /des na tsi 'dod bskyed de yon tan brgyad pa'o/ /zhes pa'i don yin paragu ru lho phyogs pas gsung ngo / /yan lag bdun dang phra yang brgyad ni shegang du bshad zin cing / ye shes de kho na nyid bdun ni/ rin chen snye mar gtan laphab zin to/ /'dir gzhan 'dod dang brda chad thun mong ba yin la/tho bo 'jog tshul mi 'dra ba 'di lta bu dag yod do/ khres pa bcu la kun rdzob shes pa ni/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi rgyu rkyen rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba tsi yod pa thams cad ji lta ba thams cad mkhyen zhing sgyur ma ltar rang bzhin med par gzigs pa'o/ /chos shes pas thabs kyi cha mkhyen pa ste/ de la bzhi las/ sdug bsngal chos shes ni sdug bsngal bden pa'i rnam pa log ste/ rang bzhin dag pa dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor gzigs pa'o/ /kun 'byung chos shes ni nyon mongs rnams kyi rang bzhin ye shes dang / bsod nams dang bsod namasamayin pa gang yin pa dang / mi g.yo ba'i yan las su snang ba gang yin pa de'ang/gdod ma nas rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i cha shas/ lhun gyis grub pa'i mdzad pa dang rang bzhin dbyer med du mthong ba'o/ /'gog pa chos shes ni/—330—

spang bya glo bur ba gsar du 'gags shing / 'gags pa'i dbyings de yang bde ba chen por mthong ba'o/ /lam chos shes ni lam gyi chos thams cad sems kyi rangabazhin gdod ma nas bde ba chen po rang rig rang gsal bar gnas pa de nyid kyi ngo bor gdod ma'i tshul gyis rang bzhin dbyer med du mthong ba'o/ /rjesasushes pa ni/ shes rab kyi phyogs te/ de la bzhi las/ sdug bsngal rjes shes ni/chos shes kyi yul de nyid la dmigs nas bde ba chen por gzigs pa zho /kun 'byung rjes shes ni/ chos shes kyi yul la dmigs nas rang bzhin med pa gzigs pa'o/ /'gog pa rjes shes ni/ spang bya thams cad gdod mnasa'agags par gzigs pa'o/ /lam rjes shes ni gzhi lam dbyer med de yangagadod ma nas stong pa'i rang bzhin du gzigs pa'o/ /bden bzhi shes pa ni/chos shes rjes shes gnyis las logs su med kyang / re re bzhin ngo bo tsamangos bzung na/ sdug bsngal rnam pa dkyil 'khor dang ngo bo bde ba chen poramathong ba ni sdug bsngal shes pa'o/ /kun 'byung gi rang bzhin ye shes 'phrin las dang bcas par shes pa yang rang bzhin med pa'i tshul gyis gzigs par yod pa ni/ kun 'byung shes pa'o/ /rang bzhin gdod ma nas 'gags pa glo bur du yang bral bar gzigs pa ni/ 'gog pa shes pa'o/ /gzhi 'bras dbyer med pa lam gyi ngo bor gnas pa de yang gdod ma nas stong par mthong ba ni/ 'tshashes pa'o/ /'di sdug bsngal bden pa'i rang bzhin 'gog bden dang/ kun 'byung bden pa'i rang bzhin lam bden tu gnas pa mngon sum du mthong ba yin zhes pa 'di'i don shes pa gnad che'o/ /pha rol sems shes ni/ chos—331—

thams cad mnyam nyid du mthong ba'i ye shes kyis drangs pa'i mngon shes kyis srid pa dang zhi bas 'i bsdus pa sems can skye 'gags thams cad kyi kun spyod thams cad shes pa'o/ /zad pa shes pa ni/ spang bya'i chos thams cad rang bzhin la gdod ma nas zad par shes pa'o/ /mi skye ba shes pa ni/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis skye ba med pa de/ spang bya thams cad lam gyis spangs pas glo bur gyi skye ba'ang phyin chad gtan mi 'byung bar mthong ba'o/ /'di dag ni sangs rgyas kyi shes pa bcu'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /mthong lam gyi chos shes rjes shes rnamasakyang nyon sgrib kyi dbang du byas nas 'di'i rigs pas shes par bya zhing / sdugabasngal chos bzod dang / rjes bzod la sogs pa bzod pa brgyad po rnams ni shes pa brgyad kyis shes shing / mthong ba'i don bzod par byas te bsgomapa'o/ /'o na mthong lam mas brtan gyi dga' ba bcu drug gi rang bzhin de rnams skad cig bcu drug tu 'chad pa'i phyir/ shes bzod bcu drug re re dngasbyor ba byed dam zhe na/ mi sbyor te/ sngags lugs kyi shes bzod bsto drugapo'adi dag ni/ thog mar rtogs tshul kyi dbye bas/ shes bzod gnyis thob pa lasnga phyi cung zad yod mod kyi/ lha ma mnyam bzhag ni thun de phal cher bcu drugapothams cad ci dus gag tu bsgom pa yin te/ dmigs yul gyi ldog chas phye batshartogs ye shes kyi ngo bo gcig yin no/ /dga' ba bcu drug ni byang chubakyisems kyi steng du bgrod dbye bas snga phyi'i go rim ste/ mthong lam dga' ba'i skad cig ma bcu drug ces brjod pas/ shes bzod bcu drug yin par mi'agro'o/ /de dag ni mtshan yang dag par brjod pa las/ shes pa brgyad po —332—

rtogs pa 'chang / /zhes pa dang / shes bcu rnam dag 'chang bzho /zhes so gosardegasungs pa'i nges don/ grub chen zhi ba'i zhal snga nas kyi man ngag gu ru shar phyogs pa las kho bos 'bad pas thob pa ste/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi skyes sngon chad gzhan gyi spyod yul du ma gyur pa 'di/ kho bos gangs ri'i khrod du yongs su bsgrags kyi/ zang zing tsam don du gnyer ba ma yin pa'i/ mkhas pa rnams kyis yi rang ba dang bcas pas khas len pa'i 'os so/ /gsang sngags/nang gi nges don gyi zhugs 'bras brgyud la sogs pa'i rnam gzhag dang / bden pa bzhi'i don rnam pa bcu gnyis la sogs pa'ang / o rgyan gyi yul nas grub chen zhi ba'i zhal snga nas kyis mkha' 'gro ma rnams las legs par rnyed pa'i rnam gzhag dang / de'i man ngag kyang yod mod kyi skal ba dang ldan pa rnams kyi rna drung du shub bu'i ngag gis brjod par bsam ste/ 'dir mi 'ebrego khres bcul sogs pa de kun yang / o ṭi ya na las byung ba rgyud kun las btus/pa zhes bya ba nas 'gyung ba yin zhes gsung ngo / /rgyud de ni dum bu dum bu'i tshur gyisa'aphags pa'i yul la yang mang du yod par snang zhing / phyogs 'di na o rgyan las byung ba'am gdan drangs pa yin zhes pa'i sgrub thabs dang man ngag thor bu sna tshogs pa 'di kun yang rgyud de las byung bar yid tshes shing / grub chen zhiba'i zhal snga nas/ rgyud de la dum bu stong phrag brgyad yod ces gsung skad/ glam rje btsun gyi zhal snga nas/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang sems skad cig mar mthong ba 'di/ mthong lam gyi ngo bo yin no zhes gsungs te/ 'di ni shin tu snying po las kyang snying po ste gnad dam par bzung ngo / /gnyis pa la/—333—

sku'i rnam gzhag ni mdo tsam bshad zin pas yon tan dang 'phrin las gnyis kyi dang po yon tan ni/ rang don gyi sku'i yon to dang / gzhan don gyi skyo) skrun tan gnyis so/ /dang po ni chos sku'i yon tan te/ zag med kyi sde tshan nyer gcigalasogs pa rgyas par pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzhung las shes par bya la/ nye bar mkho ba cung zad cig brjod na/ stobs bcu mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ ma 'dres pa'i chosabaco brgyad dang thugs rje chen po'o/ /dang po ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shesakyi stobs gcig nyid las/ mkhyen yul gyi sgo nas stobs bcu ste/ gnas dngaganas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs ni rgyu dang rgyu ma yin pa mkhyen pa ste/ dperan mtho ris dang ngan song gi rgyu ni/ las dge sdig yin pa 'di ni gnas yin la/bdag dang gtso bo dang dbang phyug la sogs pa ni/ mtho ris dang ngan songagyiganas dang rgyu ma yin pa dang lta bu ste des mtshon pa'i 'khor 'das kyi chos gang dang gang thams cad kyi rgyu dang rgyu ma yin pa thams cad mkhyen pa'o/ /gnas dang gnas min gyi rnam gzhag rgyas pa gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba las shes par bya'o/ /las dang rnam smin mkhyen pa'i stobs ni/ dge sdig gis las gang dngagang gis 'bras bu 'di 'byin zhes thams cad cig car mkhyen pa'o/ /bsamagatan dang rnam thar dang ting nge 'dzin dang kun nas nyon mongs dang rnam par byang ba mkhyen pa'i stobs shes sam/ kun byang mkhyen pa'i stobs zhes bya ba ni/bsam gtan bzhi/ rnam thar brgyad/ zad par bcu la rbo gos pa'am theg pa chen po ltar na/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin —334—

rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams dang / mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgurnams kyi bar du gcod pa'i chos kun nas nyon mongs dang / gnyen po lelaba'i chos rnam byang thams cad mkhyen pa'o/ /dbang po mchog dang mchog ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i stobs ni/ sems can dbang po rno 'bring rtul gsum dang/ de'i rab dbye mtha' yas pa dang / de dag smin pa dang sad par byed pa'i chos thams/cad mkhyen pa'o/ /mos pa sna tshogs mkhyen pa'i stobs ni/ sems can gang dag theg gsum so so la mos pa dang / sbyin pa dang tshul khrims la sogs pa rnamapar phye ba'i chos tha dad la mos pa dang / mos pa de dag gi mthu tshe chung dang/rang bzhin bzang ngan thams cad mkhyen pa'o/ khams sna tshogs pa mkhyen pa'i stobs ni/ khams dang rigs ni don gcig ste/ theg pa gsum gyi rigs sosodang / nges pa dang / ma nges pa dang / re zhig rigs tshad du gyur pa dang/ skalab dang bag chags shas che chung thams cad de mdor na rang bzhin dang rgyas 'gyur thams cad mkhyen pa'o/ /thams cad du 'gro ba'i lam mkhyen pa'i stobasani/ 'khor ba'i lam 'gro ba rgyud lngar skye ba'i las nyon rnams khams gsum du skye ba'i las thams cad mkhyen zhing zhi ba'i lam theg pa gsum gyi byang chub thob par 'gyur ba'i dmigs pa thams cad mkhyen pa'o/ /sngon gyi gnas rjesasudran pa mkhyen pa'i stobs ni/ bdag nyid kyi sngon gyi tshe rabs thams cad du gangacung zad yod pa thams cad cig car mkhyen pa'o/ /'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba mkhyen pa'i stobs ni/ phyogs bcu'i sems can thams cad kyi phyi ma'i mu mthar thuskapa'i skye ba gzhan du med pa thams cad cig car mkhyen pa ste/ 'dis de rnams—335—

kyi sngon gyi tshe rabs thams cad ma lus par mkhyen pa'o//zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobs ni/bdag nyid kyi spang bya thams cad zad de slar mi skye ba dang/sems can gzhan rnams kyi zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos/ thams cad dang/zagapa zad pa rnams la'ang de bzhin du ste thams cad cig car mkhyen pa'o//de thams cad kyang lhun gyis grub cing rnam par rtog pa mi mnga' bas/gzigs/pa med pa'i tshul gyis gzigs pa ste/ci'i phyir stobs zhes bya na rang rgyud kyi warig pa'i sgrib pa thams cad bcom zhing /gzhan gyi'ang thams cad 'jomasapas te/theg pa chen po'i rgyud bla ma las/stobs nyid ma rig sgrib la rdo rje bzhin//zhes gsungs so//yang 'di dag bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i phyir stobasate/mdo sde rgyan las/thabs dang skyabs dang dag pa dang //then chen ces para'abyung ba las//sems can rnams ni rab bslu ba'i//bdud 'joms khyod laphyag 'tshal lo//zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//de yang thabs la bslu ba'i bdud ni/mchod sbyin byas pas/byed pa po dang bsad pa'i dud 'gro rnams kyang mthoris su 'gro zhes bya ba la sogs pa/mtho ris dang thar pa'i thabs la sogasardepa rnyan pa ste/de ni stobs dang pos 'joms so//las dge sdig gis lo risadang ngan song du 'gro ba yin pa la/dbang phyug la sogs pa la skyabs su songamasong dang mnyes ma mnyes kyis de dang der 'gro bar 'dod pa ni/skyabs la bslu ba'i bdud de/stobs gnyis pas 'joms so//bsam gtan gzugs/med kyi ting nge 'dzin thar ba yin par 'dod pa sogs ni/dag pa la bslu ba'i bdud de/stobs gsum pas 'joms te/des de dag gi sa bon spongs pa'i nus pa 6

mkhyen zhing ston pas so/ /theg chen gyi rigs can theg dman la sbyor ba ni/theg pa chen po la nges par bslu ba'i bdud de/ de ni lhobs lhag ma bdun gyis 'joms so/ /gnyis pa ni/ dang po gnyis rang don phun sum tshogs par mdzad pa lami 'jigs pa dang / phyi ma gnyis gzhan don phun sum tshogs pa la mi 'ejigasapa'o zhes nges par bya'o/ /de la chos thams cad mngon par byang chub pa lami'ajigs pa ni/ chos thams cad mkhyen zhing thugs su chud pa yin pas de la'ajig rten na mthu che ba sus kyang de ltar ma yin zhes rgol ba'i gnas med pa'o/ /'di ni ye shes phun sum tshogs pa'o/ /zag pa zad pa la mi 'jigs pa ni/ 'dod chags la sogs pa zag pa thams cad zad pa yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar zhal gyis bzhes pa la rgol ba'i gnas med pa ste/ spangs pa phun sum tshog༅rdepa'o/ /bar du gcod pa'i chos lung ston pa la mi 'jigs pa ni/ 'dod yon dang chags sogs thar pa la bar du gcod par mngon sum du 'gazags pas/ de ltar ston pa la rgol ba'i gnas med pa'o/ /nges par 'byung ba'i lam ston pa lami 'jigs pa ni/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams kyis rnam par grol ba thosacing / gzhan gyis nam yang ma yin pa mngon sum du gzigs pa'i phyir/ de ltaraston pa la sus kyang rgol ba'i gnas med pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ mdo sde'i gyon las/ rtogs pa dang ni spyod pa dang / /ye shes dang ni 'phrin las kyig /nyanathos rang sangs rgyas kun gyi/ /bla ma mchog la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsung pa ltar/ dang po rtogs pas bsdus pa drug gi sku la 'khrul pa mi mnga' bani—337—

bstabs pa dang /brdeg 'chos pa la sogs pa sku'i spyod pa 'khrul ba'i rigasanam yang mi mnga' ba'o//gsungs la ca co mi mnga' ba ni/nyan thos dang rangargyal dag grong stong par su yod ces smod pa sogs yod cing /de bzhi gshegs pa la gsung don med pa mi mnga' ba'o//thugs la bsnyel ba mi mang ri ba ni/mnyam par bzhag pa'i rjes su slar mngon shes 'jug pa lta bu ma yin gyi/dus thams cad du rtsol ba med par mkhyen pa'o//g.yo ba mi mnga' ba ni/mnyam rjes so so med pas dus rtag tu mnyam par bzhag pa'o//tha dad pa'i'adu shes mi mnga' ba ni/'khor ba'i rang bzhin mya ngan las 'das pa dang/nyon mongs kyi rang bzhin rnam byang du gzigs pa sogs thams cad mnyam pa nyid du gzigs pa'o//so sor ma brtags pa'i btang snyoms mi mnga' ba ni/gang cung zad sems can 'dul ba'i skal ba yod pa thams cad la/dus lasardeyol ba sogs btang snyoms gtan mi srid de/rnam par mi rtog bzhin du dusalas ma g.yo bar 'gro don mdzad pa la rgyang ring thung mi mnga' ba'o//gnyis pa spyod pas bsdus pa drug la/'dun pa nyams pa med pa ni sems can ma lusapa'i don la mos pas/'dun pa nyams pa mi mnga' ba'o//brtson 'grus nyamasapa med pa ni/sems can gcig kho na'i phyir du yang bskal pa mtha' yas parabartson par mdzad pa ste/'bad rtsol med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis/sku gsungathugs ngal ba mi mnga' ba'o//dran pa nyams pa med pa ni/sems can gyi spyod pa dang /bsam pa dang bag la nyal ba thams cad gang gis 'dul ba sogasardesngon gnas mkhyen zhing dran pa'i ye shes kyis zin pa'o/khres rab nyams pa 8

med pa ni/ sems can gyi spyod pa dang mthun par chos sgo ston pa la zad pa mimanga' ba'o/ /ting nge 'dzin nyams pa med pa ni/ ji ltar brnyes pa'i tingange'adzin gyi grangs tshad bzung med pa thams cad la dus thams cad du mnyam par bzhag pa'o/ /rnam par grol ba nyams pa med pa ni phyogs res tsam las rnawapar grol ba ma yin par nyon mongs dang shes bya'i sgrib pa gnyis po las rdzogs par grol te mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa brnyes pa'o/ /gsum pa ye shes kyis bsdus pa gsum la/ 'das te pa'i dus la slathogs pa'i ye shes mthong ba 'jug pa ni/ thog ma med pa'i dus kyi bskal parachos ci byung ba thams cad ma nor bar mkhyen pa'o/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus lamachags ma thogs pa'i ye shes mthong ba 'jug pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i dusalam chags ma thogs pa'i ye shes mthong ba 'jug pa gnyis kyang tha ma med pa'i bskal pa rnams su chos ci byung ba thams cad dang / da lta phyogs bcu na tsi yod pa thams cad dus gcig tu ma 'khrul zhing ma 'dzing par mkhyen pa'o/ /bzhi pa 'phrin las kyis bsdus pa gsum la/ lus kyi las thams cad ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing / ye shes kyi rjes su 'jug pa ni/ rang ṣka kyis sngon mdzad do cogathams cad kyang skad cig gcig la dgongs pa la bzhag nas phyis ci mdzad pa thams cad kyang cig car ye shes des mkhyen zhing / rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa ske'i 'phrin las mdzad pa rgyun mi chad pa'o/ /ngag gi las thams cad/ ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing ye shes kyi rjes su 'jug pa ni/ 'jug tshul 'dra ba la/ sems can gyi bsam pa dang mthun par yan lag drug cu'i gsung gis chos ston pa go /—339—

yid kyi 'phrin las ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing ye shes kyi rjes su 'jug pa yang 'jug tshul 'dra ba las rtog pa dang spros pa thams cad dang bral zhing / donadamapar chos kyi dbyings la mnyam par 'jog pa'o/ /'di dag rgyas par de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rjes chen po bstan pa'i mdo'am/ gzungs kyi dbang phyugargyal pos zhus pa'i mdo las 'byung zhing / bu mo rin chen gyis zhus pa'i mdo las kyang / yon tan drug cu rtsa gnyis po thams cad rgyu dang bcas shin tu rgyasapar gsungs shing / ma 'dres pa bco brgyad la 'ga' zhig 'di dang 'dra rin lare re bzhin ting nge 'dzin dang gzungs re bshad la/ ngo bo yang gzung dbangagis zhus pa'i lugs kyang 'di dang cung zad mi 'dra bar gsungs te/ rgyas par mdo sde de dag nyid don zab cing rgya che la zhal gsal bar yod pas nges par blta bar bya la/ de tsam mi nus na theg chen rgyud bla sogs dgongs 'grel gyi gzhung rgyas pa rnams las shes par bya'o/ /bzhi pa thugs rje chen po ni/ rgyasapar mdo sde rnams su shes par bya'o/ /ji skad du/ 'jig rten kun la nyin mtshan du/ /lan drug tu ni so sor gzigs/ /thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ /phan dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes nyin mtshan lan drugatugazigs par bshad pa ni/ nyan thos dang thun mong gi mdo rnams kyi rjesasu'abrang ba ste/ don la ni/ dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen pos dus rtagatusems can rnams kyi bde sdug thams cad gzigs shing / sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung las sgrol ba'i dgongs pa mnga' ba'o/ /gnyis pa la/ mtshan sum stortsaganyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu dang / gsung dbyangs yon lag drug—340—

cu'o//dang po ni/phyag zhabs 'khor lo'i mtshan dang rus sbal zhabag khyagadang zhabs sor dra bas 'brel ba dang //phyag ni zhabs bcas 'jam zhing gzhon sha chags//'di yi sku ni bdun dag mtho ba dang //sor mo ring dang rting yangasasku che drang //zhabs 'bur mi mngon sbu ni gyen du phyogs//byin pa e na ya'i 'dra phyag ring mdzes//'doms kyi sba ba sbubs su nub pa'i mchog/pags pa gser mdog pags pa srab pa dang //skru ni re re nas g.yas legs zhakhru dardedang //zhal ma sgo sbus brgyan ro stod se rje'i 'dra//'di yi dpung pa'i mgozlum thal gong rgyas//'di la ro mi zhim pa'ang ro mchog snang //sku ni mya gro ta ltar chu zheng gab//gtsug tor dbur ldan ljags ring mdzes pa dang//tsha pa༅dbyangs 'gram pa sesgo'i 'dra dang tshems/khren tu dkar dang tshad mnya༅thabasabazang dang //grangs ni bzhi bcu tham pa tshang pa dang //spyan ni mthon mthingardespyan rdzi ba mchog gi/'dra ba 'di dag sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan//zhes gsungasaso//zhabs mthil mnyam par sa la phabs pa rus sbal gyi lto ba 'dra ba ni/rus sbas gyi zhabs/phyag zhabs gnyis kyi mthil bzhi dang phrag pa gnyis/ltagapa'i phyogs rgyas pas bdun mtho ba'o//zhabs 'bur mi mngon pa ni bolatshigs 'bur mi mngon pa'o//byin pa e na ya'i 'dra ba ni/ shing rimakhagyis 'phra ba'o//thal gong rgyas pa ni sgrog rus shas rgyas shing kyog mo med pa'o//rdzim ba mchog 'dra ba ni/mthug cing ring la gzhol go/gzhan rnams go sla'o//gnyis pa ni/thub pa'i son mo zangs mdog dang //mdogasnum mtho dang sor mo rnams//zlum rgyas byin 'gyas phra ba dang //rtsa mi ma phro dang 4

mdud pa med//long bu mi mngon zhabs mnyam dang //seṅge glang chen bya dang ni/khyu mchog stabs gshegs g.yas phyogs dang //mdzes gshegs drang dnga'akhril bag chags//byi dor byas 'dra rim par 'tsham//gtsang dang 'jam dngadag pa'i sku//mtshan ni yongs su rdzogs pa dang //sku yi kho lag yangs shingabazang //gom snyoms pa dang spyan gnyis ni//dag dang gzhon sha can nyid dang //sku zhum med dang rgyas pa dang /khren tu grims pa'i skud dang//skrun lag shin tu rnam 'byes dang //gzigs pa sgrub med dag pa dang /u zlutshaskabs phyin ma rnyongs dang //phyang nge ba dang lte ba ni//zab dang g.yas phyogasa'akhyil ba dang //kun nas lta na sdug pa dang //kun spyod gtsang dang skulani//rme ba gnag bag med pa dang //phyag ni shing bal ltar 'jam dang//phyagaring mdangs yod zab ring dang //zhal ni ha cang mi ring dang //mchu ni bi༅pa ltar dmar dang //ljags mnyen pa dang srab pa dang //dmar dang 'brun gisgranyid dang //gsung mnyem 'jam dang mche ba zlum//rno dang dkar dang mnyam pa dang //byin gyis phra dang shangs mtho dang //mchog tu dag pa dag dang shi/spyan yangs pa dang rdzi ma stug /padma'i 'dam ma 'dra ba dang //smin tshugs ringadang 'jam pa dang //snum dang sbu ni mnyam pa dang //phyag ring rgyas dang snyan mnyam dang //nyams pa rnam par spangs ba dang //dpral ba legs par 'byesapa dang //dbyes che ba dang dbu rgyas dang //dbu skra bung ba ltar gnagadang //stug dang 'jam dang ma 'dzing dang //mig sgor dri zhis skyes bu ski/yid ni 'phrog par byed pa dang //dpal gyi be'u dang bkra shis ni//g.yung drung4

'khyil bas brgyan pa ste/ /sangs rgyas dpe byad bzang por bzhed/ khres gsungs so/ /sen mo mtho ba ni ma zhom pa'o/ /long bu'i tshigs spob paramimangon pa dang / zhabs gnyis ring thung phra sbom mnyam pa'o/ /mi la sogs pasasteng gi 'gro ba zil gyis gnon pas sesgo'i stabs dang / klu la sogs pa sa'og gi 'gro ba zil gyis gnon pas glang po tshe ni stabs dang nam mkha' la rgyu ba'i sems can dang / steng gi 'gro ba rnams zil gyis gnon pas/ bya ngangapa'am mkha' lding gi stabs dang / 'khor rnams kyi sna 'dren pas khyu mchogagostabs su gshegs pa'o/ /mtshan thams cad dod cing gsal bas yongasasurdzogs pa'o/ /phyag gi dbyibs yang shing mdzes pas phyang nge ba'o/ /lte ba'i khungazab cing ri mo g.yas su 'khyil ba'o/ /zhal gyi sgo ha cang tshes pa'i skyon dngagasung thag ha cang ring ba med pa'o/ /smin ma gnyis 'brel bas tshugs ringapa'o/ /dpral pa legs par rgyas shing 'bur du dod pas dbyes pa dang / skyamatshams mnyam par phyed pa'o/ /phyag zhabs la dpal gyi be'u dang / 'khor lo'i mu khyud la bkra shis pa'i ri mo bar ma chad pa bdun rim dang / g.yung drunga'akhyil ba'i dbyibs can gru bzhi'i ri mos bskor ba'o/ /gzhan rnams ni gosla'o/ /gsum pa gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu ni/ sdoms su bsdun/1mnyen 'jam 2yid 'ong 3yid du 4'thad/ /dag pa 5dri med 6rab tu7gsal/ /snyan zhing 'jebs 8la mnyam par 9'os/ /mi tshugs 10ston pa 11dul 12mi rtsub13/ /mi brlang 14rab dul 15rna bar snyan16/ /lus citshi17byed dang sems tshim 18byed/ /snying dgar byed 19dang dga' bde 20—343—

bskyed//yongs su gdung med 21kun shes 22bya/rnam par rig bya 2nimagasal ba24//dga' bar 25byed dang mngon dga' 26byed//kun shes27byed dang rnam rig 2bud//rigs 29pa 'brel ba 30zlos skyon 31med//sesgo'i sgra yi shugs 32can dang //glang chen sgra skad 33'brun sgra dbyangs34//klu dbang 35sgra dang dri za'i 36glu//kal pidma'i sgra37dbyangasadang //tshangs pa'i 38sgra dbyangs bsgrigs pa dang /shang shang te tshu) 39gdabyangs grags//lha yi dbang po'i 40dbyangs ltar snyan//rnga sgra 41mi khengs/42mi mnga' 43ba//sgra kun gyi ni rjes su 44zhugs//tshig zur wa45chag/ma tshang 46med//ma zhum 47mi zhen 48rab dga' 49khyab50/khrib dang51rgyun chags52'brel ba 53dang //sgra kun rdzogs par byed pa 54dang/dbang kun 55tshim byed ma 56smad pa//mi 'gyur 57ma brtabs 58'khom ra kun 59grags//rnam pa kun gyi mchog lte0ldan no//gnyis pa 'phrin las ni/rgyun mi chad par gang la gang 'dul gyi bkod pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par ston pa ni ngo bo ste/gdul bya lam gyi rten dang/lam dang 'bras bu la 'bod pa gsum mo//de la gnas skabs 'khor ba'i bdeb la 'god pa ni dang por gtogs la/mthar thug byang chub gsum la 'god pa ni phyi ma gnyis so//dang po lam rnam gzhag nyams su len pa'i rtenadala'abyor tshang ba la 'god pa'i 'phrin las la/rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul dang/kun tu brjod pa'i cho 'phrul dang /rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul gyis/dzo|'grobarnams dang ba bskyed nas mtho ris la 'jog /lasang na gsog par 'gyur 44

ba rnams gdam ngag bstan nas bzlog par mdzad/'dod yon la zhen pa dang/bdag 'dzin shas che ba rnams chos kyi sdom bzhis 'dul te/dad pa dang ngesa'abyung gi blo bzang po bskyed par mdzad/des na bsdu dngos bzhis bsdus nasatshogs lam la 'god spangs gnyen blang dor dang tshad med bzhi dang /thabasashes zung 'jug nyams len la 'god/phyin drug gi go cha dang /kyisangs rgyas go 'phang thob pa'i phyir sdig spongs dge sgrub la 'god/de nas sbyor lam du gzung 'dzin rang bzhin med par bsgom pa'i nyams len la 'god/mthongalam du bdag med mngon sum rtogs pa la 'god/sgom lam du spangs rtogasagong nas gong du spel ba la 'god pa de/gdul bya'i sa dang lam gyi yon tan thams cad sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las yin no//de ltar bkod pas mthar thugardzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku bzhi'i bdag nyid dam/srid zhi'i mtha' gnyis lamiganas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa la sbyor bar mdzad pa yin no//de dgalasarnam par phye ba dang /yon tan gyi rnam grangs dang /'phrin las kyi ra po tudabyeb zhib mor brjod na shin tu mangs bar 'gyur ro//bzhi pa smon lam mtha' dag cing rja'i rtse dge zhing shis par byed pa'i tshigs bcad ni/de ltar smon lam de dag kun//rgyal ba rnams kyis 'grub par mdzod//'khore lo sdomapa'i lam bzang 'di//phyogs dus kun tu dar bar shog/ces pa zho/de ltarargyas par bshad pa thams cad bstan zin nas/de dag nyid kyis don thamasacad legs par bkrol ba'i phyir/gal te lha yi pa'i ba ched don dang sbyar ba sogs shes par 'dod na/khyad par cung zad dbye bar bya ste/ sheb zhalarde4

phyag gi skabs rtsa zhal nag cing g.yon ljang ba/ rgyab dmar g.yas ser spyan gsum ldan/ zhes dang / cang te'u dgra sta gri gug dang / /ma du brtsegasum pa g.yas pa yi/ /zhes dang / thod khrag rdo rje zhags pa dang / /zhes dang / sgo gsum gnyis spangs rnam rtog gcod/ /srid gsum 'joms la phyag 'tshal go /ye shes kyi ni sogs dang / bde wo thugs rje sogs gong 'og rje/ mkha' 'gromabazhi'i skabs su/ bha ga nu rgyas gri gug dang / /cang te'u kha ṭāX thod pa na/ ṣespyang glang po sogs sbyar/ 'khor gyi lha la/ thams cad rdo rje dril bu dang/ khongate'u kha ṭāX 'dzin zhing 'khyud/ /ces dang / sgo mtshams ma la/ yum bzhi ji lta ba nyid de/ rab khros mi ro'i gdan la bzhugs/ /gdul dka' 'du wal phyaga'atshal lo/ /zhes dang / 'khor rnams nyin mor byed la gnas/ khril bu pa'i mdun bskyed skabs/ gtso bo pū yi'i dang 'dra/ bha ga nu ma rgyas ༷ pa dang (〈kyu〉 la 'dud/)/gri gug kha ṭāX thod pa na/ /thams cad zhal gcig sogs nag po bzhin sgo mtshams ma la yum bzhi ji lta ba sogs dang / 'khor rnamasa3 yi pa dang 'dra'o/ /chos snyen ra phyi'i rtsa ba yo po/ /yan lag rlung rnams po rgyu ba/ /dbang po yul sogs 'don pa po'o/ /bskyed rim gyi skabs ྅ yi pa labasrung ba'i 'khor los bdud bcom zhing / sngon 'gro tshogs bsags mthun rkyen sgrubs/ /stong pas 'chi ba'i srid sbyong pa'i/ /ting 'dzin zab mo sgom parashog /nā das bar do sbyong ba dang / /'byung bzhi lhun po padma)gdan/ /bha gamabu sogs sbrel lo/ /mngon byang lnga las dkyil 'khor mchog /'dod chagasacan rnams sogs sbyar/ nā da zhugs sogs skye srid sbyangs/ /lus kyi dkyil —346—

bsres dzo bci 1 ye//snging chub phyogs sdi dag she ldan//pho nya snyam sherdebs ga cha bang // shas rgyas ga dbad rnya rdzo/ma dror she/shes maXrdzarjosaXs rgyas pa dang //rags dang gegaXrde pha thi//she mchad pa bkro par pe de sto//she lam du da par shag/phra ga 'ad kasa~Xje/sdu ba ge sdes//'a stang she sngas gi ba she//nā sde sdo rdzo/kau pas tha tu zhu/ ༵ nas/sman ma' lam sgam shag bar bar ba 'a//la bu lugs ltang na/ dkyil sogs zhar byung du snang bas 'dir mi 'go/lus dkyil bskyed rim gyidage tsho ra tsho ce②rde tshu)rde da ra 44zi byerdeba'i sri du byas ta/sngan 'a gas ༷kyis 'a dā nga 'dzi//yesheb 'a 3 pa sbyangs/ci/gzha lus bar da sbyangs pa rnyi//tang brten pa rdo ma snyamardeba'i dkyi/skrud she da srid smongs//spya dang ban pa kun sherdeXsna//'a~X sgam gus skya da sbyangs//thun mang spya gsuXrde'aX(bsgamardeshag/skya lus dal byed pa rnyig pa gsum//spru~X pa she gau she dang/sre/she ༵ rnyi //'bras bu lam da sgam par sha3 dzo/ nya thig sgrom ga cha dang // sa spyan drangs she ye dang //bdeX ra lnga pa lha phra kyi sgam gu dang snya//bzlaX pas rang she 'di par rang bzhi/༵sta 1 pa lha sa dkyil swoXka pa ste/da na 1 sa / snying/'grab 'dage tsho dag rang she sa/khru ta ge'i rtsa/ pa' dal ༷khar dum ṭā //she khar dag shu~X /ba lta yum sags//bu hūṃl zhes pa lol/dhe/she/she gi bza rngi she/nā rdze lta budaris pa kau/ste / ༷ she pa 'ang gyur spyag bar bar 'a//'a lta busags 'a /bad mchag/ ga dkyaX zhabar mtha' yas pa' bar du rgyas/
